source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Cfg = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local store
do
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStores.Profile)
	end)
	store = ok and result or nil
end

local LEADER = { Coins = Cfg.COINS_START or 0 }
local STATS = { RobuxSpent = 0, Playtime = 0, Rebirths = 0 }
local DEFAULT_SETTINGS = Config.DefaultSettings
local SESSION_TTL = 90
local AUTOSAVE_EVERY = 60
local PLAYTIME_TICK = 15

local profiles = {}

local Profile = {}
_G.Profile = Profile

function Profile.get(player)
	return profiles[player]
end

function Profile.value(player, folder, key)
	local f = player:FindFirstChild(folder)
	local v = f and f:FindFirstChild(key)
	return v and v.Value or 0
end

function Profile.set(player, key, amount)
	for _, folder in ipairs({ "wallet", "stats" }) do
		local f = player:FindFirstChild(folder)
		local v = f and f:FindFirstChild(key)
		if v then
			amount = tonumber(amount) or 0
			if amount ~= amount then amount = 0 end
			v.Value = math.clamp(math.floor(amount), 0, 9e18)
			return v.Value
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function build(player, saved)
	local wallet = player:FindFirstChild("wallet")
	if not wallet then
		wallet = Instance.new("Folder")
		wallet.Name = "wallet"
		wallet.Parent = player
	end
	for key, fallback in pairs(LEADER) do
		local v = wallet:FindFirstChild(key)
		if not v then
			v = Instance.new("IntValue")
			v.Name = key
			v.Parent = wallet
		end
		v.Value = tonumber(saved[key]) or fallback
	end

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("stats")
	if not stats then
		stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "stats"
		stats.Parent = player
	end
	for key, fallback in pairs(STATS) do
		local v = stats:FindFirstChild(key)
		if not v then
			v = Instance.new("IntValue")
			v.Name = key
			v.Parent = stats
		end
		v.Value = tonumber(saved[key]) or fallback
	end

	player:SetAttribute("Speed", math.max(tonumber(saved.Speed) or Cfg.SPEED_START or 1, 1))
end

local function snapshot(player)
	local out = {}
	for key in pairs(LEADER) do out[key] = Profile.value(player, "wallet", key) end
	for key in pairs(STATS) do out[key] = Profile.value(player, "stats", key) end
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if profile then
		out.Settings = profile.Settings
		out.FreeRewardClaimed = profile.FreeRewardClaimed
		out.Eggs = profile.Eggs
		out.SpeedMult = profile.SpeedMult
		out.Speed = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Speed")) or Cfg.SPEED_START or 1
		out.PetIndex = profile.PetIndex
		out.IndexClaimed = profile.IndexClaimed
        out.BatEquipped = profile.BatEquipped or 0
		out.BatForced = profile.BatForced
		out.IndexBackup = profile.IndexBackup
		out.NestEggs = profile.NestEggs
		out.NestAnimals = profile.NestAnimals
		out.TrailsOwned = profile.TrailsOwned
		out.TrailEquipped = profile.TrailEquipped
		out.PetInventory = profile.PetInventory
		out.PlotLevel = profile.PlotLevel
		out.MillLevel = profile.MillLevel
		out.BagState = profile.BagState
		out.Receipts = profile.Receipts
		out.GiftedPasses = profile.GiftedPasses
	end
	return out
end

local function lockedByOther(old)
	return type(old) == "table" and type(old.SessionJob) == "string"
		and old.SessionJob ~= game.JobId
		and os.time() - (tonumber(old.SessionAt) or 0) < SESSION_TTL
end

local saveSeq = {}
local leaving = {}

function Profile.save(player, release)
	if not store then return false end
	if not profiles[player] then return false end
	if leaving[player] and not release then return false end
	local data = snapshot(player)
	local key = "p_" .. player.UserId
	local seq = (saveSeq[player] or 0) + 1
	saveSeq[player] = seq
	for attempt = 1, 3 do
		if saveSeq[player] ~= seq then return false end
		local wrote, stale = false, false
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				if saveSeq[player] ~= seq then
					wrote, stale = false, true
					return nil
				end
				if lockedByOther(old) then
					wrote = false
					return nil
				end
				data.SessionJob = (not release) and game.JobId or nil
				data.SessionAt = os.time()
				wrote = true
				return data
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			if not wrote and not stale then
				warn(("[Profile] save skipped for %s: session locked by another server"):format(player.Name))
			end
			return wrote
		end
		warn(("[Profile] save %d/3 failed for %s: %s"):format(attempt, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt * 2) end
	end
	return false
end

local loaded = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
loaded.Name = "ProfileLoaded"
Profile.Loaded = loaded.Event

local function load(player)
	local saved = {}
	if store then
		local key = "p_" .. player.UserId
		local loadedOk = false
		for attempt = 1, 32 do
			local busy = false
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
					if lockedByOther(old) then
						busy = true
						return nil
					end
					old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
					old.SessionJob = game.JobId
					old.SessionAt = os.time()
					return old
				end)
			end)
			if ok and not busy then
				if type(result) == "table" then saved = result end
				loadedOk = true
				break
			end
			if not ok then
				warn("[Profile] load failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(result))
				if RunService:IsStudio() and tostring(result):find("403", 1, true) then break end
			end
			if not player.Parent then return end
			task.wait(3)
		end
		if not loadedOk and RunService:IsStudio() then
			warn("[Profile] DataStores unavailable in Studio (Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services). Using a fresh profile that will not be saved.")
			store = nil
			loadedOk = true
		end
		if not loadedOk then
			player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin in a minute.")
			return
		end
		if not player.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
					if type(old) == "table" and old.SessionJob == game.JobId then
						old.SessionJob = nil
						return old
					end
					return nil
				end)
			end)
			return
		end
	end

	local settings = {}
	for key, value in pairs(DEFAULT_SETTINGS) do settings[key] = value end
	if type(saved.Settings) == "table" then
		for key, value in pairs(saved.Settings) do
			if settings[key] ~= nil and type(value) == type(settings[key]) then
				settings[key] = value
			end
		end
	end

	profiles[player] = {
		Settings = settings,
		FreeRewardClaimed = saved.FreeRewardClaimed == true,
		Eggs = type(saved.Eggs) == "table" and saved.Eggs or {},
		SpeedMult = tonumber(saved.SpeedMult) or 1,
		NestEggs = type(saved.NestEggs) == "table" and saved.NestEggs or {},
		NestAnimals = type(saved.NestAnimals) == "table" and saved.NestAnimals or {},
		PetIndex = type(saved.PetIndex) == "table" and saved.PetIndex or {},
		IndexClaimed = type(saved.IndexClaimed) == "table" and saved.IndexClaimed or {},
        BatEquipped = tonumber(saved.BatEquipped) or 0,
		BatForced = tonumber(saved.BatForced),
		IndexBackup = type(saved.IndexBackup) == "table" and saved.IndexBackup or nil,
		TrailsOwned = type(saved.TrailsOwned) == "table" and saved.TrailsOwned or {},
		TrailEquipped = type(saved.TrailEquipped) == "string" and saved.TrailEquipped or "",
		PetInventory = type(saved.PetInventory) == "table" and saved.PetInventory or {},
		PlotLevel = tonumber(saved.PlotLevel) or 1,
		MillLevel = tonumber(saved.MillLevel) or 1,
		BagState = type(saved.BagState) == "table" and saved.BagState or nil,
		Receipts = type(saved.Receipts) == "table" and saved.Receipts or {},
		GiftedPasses = type(saved.GiftedPasses) == "table" and saved.GiftedPasses or {},
	}
	build(player, saved)
	loaded:Fire(player)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(PLAYTIME_TICK)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if profiles[player] then
				Profile.set(player, "Playtime", (Profile.value(player, "stats", "Playtime") or 0) + PLAYTIME_TICK)
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	load(player)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	leaving[player] = true
	Profile.save(player, true)
	profiles[player] = nil
	saveSeq[player] = nil
	leaving[player] = nil
end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(load, player)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(AUTOSAVE_EVERY)
		for player in pairs(profiles) do
			if player.Parent and not leaving[player] then
				task.spawn(Profile.save, player)
			end
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then return end
	local pending = 0
	for player in pairs(profiles) do
		if not leaving[player] then
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				Profile.save(player, true)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while (pending > 0 or next(leaving)) and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function refresh(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	end
	local plate = head:FindFirstChild("Nameplate")
	if plate then plate:Destroy() end
end

local function attach(player)
	local function onSpawn()
		local char = player.Character
		if char and char:WaitForChild("Head", 10) then
			refresh(player)
		end
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.spawn(onSpawn) end)
	if player.Character then task.spawn(onSpawn) end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(attach)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do attach(player) end

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("Settings")
local DEFAULTS = Config.DefaultSettings

local function profileOf(player)
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	return Profile and Profile.get(player) or nil
end

local function push(player)
	local profile = profileOf(player)
	if not profile then return end
	remote:FireClient(player, "state", profile.Settings)
end

local function sanitize(key, value)
	local default = DEFAULTS[key]
	if default == nil then return nil end
	if type(default) == "boolean" then
		if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return nil end
		return value
	elseif type(default) == "number" then
		if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return nil end
		return math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	end
	return nil
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, key, value)
	local profile = profileOf(player)
	if not profile then return end

	if action == "get" then
		push(player)
		return
	end
	if action ~= "set" then return end

	local clean = sanitize(key, value)
	if clean == nil then return end
	profile.Settings[key] = clean
	push(player)
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	while not Profile do
		task.wait(0.1)
		Profile = _G.Profile
	end
	Profile.Loaded:Connect(push)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Profile.get(player) then push(player) end
	end
end)

name: AdminService
source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("Admin")
local A = Config.Admin
local PREFIX = "/admin"

local banStore
do
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStores.Bans)
	end)
	banStore = ok and result or nil
end

local authCache = {}

local function isAdmin(player)
	if not player then return false end
	if authCache[player.UserId] ~= nil then return authCache[player.UserId] end

	local ok = false
	for _, id in ipairs(A.UserIds) do
		if player.UserId == id then ok = true break end
	end
	if not ok and (A.GroupId or 0) > 0 then
		local good, rank = pcall(function() return player:GetRankInGroup(A.GroupId) end)
		if good and type(rank) == "number" and rank >= (A.MinRank or 255) then ok = true end
	end
	if not ok and A.StudioAlwaysAdmin and RunService:IsStudio() then ok = true end

	authCache[player.UserId] = ok
	return ok
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) authCache[player.UserId] = nil end)

local function audit(admin, action, target, args, result)
	print(("[Admin] %s | %s -> %s | %s | %s"):format(
		admin and admin.Name or "SYSTEM", action, tostring(target),
		tostring(args or ""), tostring(result or "ok")))
end

local function findPlayer(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil, "give a player name" end
	local needle = name:lower()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Name:lower() == needle or player.DisplayName:lower() == needle then
			return player
		end
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Name:lower():sub(1, #needle) == needle then return player end
	end
	return nil, "no such player: " .. name
end

local function num(v)
	local n = tonumber(v)
	if n and n == n and math.abs(n) ~= math.huge then return n end
	return nil
end

local function stat(player, key)
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	return Profile and Profile.value(player, "wallet", key) or 0
end

local function setStat(player, key, amount)
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	if Profile then Profile.set(player, key, amount) end
end

local handlers = {}

handlers.coins = function(admin, who, amount)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local n = num(amount)
	if not n then return "give a number" end
	setStat(player, "Coins", stat(player, "Coins") + math.floor(n))
	audit(admin, "ADD_COINS", player.UserId, n)
	return ("%s: +%d coins"):format(player.Name, math.floor(n))
end

handlers.removecoins = function(admin, who, amount)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local n = num(amount)
	if not n then return "give a number" end
	setStat(player, "Coins", math.max(0, stat(player, "Coins") - math.floor(n)))
	audit(admin, "REMOVE_COINS", player.UserId, n)
	return ("%s: -%d coins"):format(player.Name, math.floor(n))
end

handlers.setcoins = function(admin, who, amount)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local n = num(amount)
	if not n then return "give a number" end
	setStat(player, "Coins", math.max(0, math.floor(n)))
	audit(admin, "SET_COINS", player.UserId, n)
	return ("%s: Coins = %d"):format(player.Name, math.floor(n))
end

handlers.boost = function(admin, kind, mult, minutes, scope)
	local Boost = _G.GlobalBoost
	if not Boost then return "GlobalBoostService is not running" end

	local kinds = table.concat(Boost.kinds(), " | ")

	if tostring(kind):lower() == "off" then
		Boost.clear(admin and admin.Name)
		audit(admin, "BOOST", 0, "off")
		return "every boost is off, on every server"
	end

	kind = tostring(kind):lower()
	local n = num(mult)
	if not n then
		return ("usage: boost <%s> <multiplier> [minutes] [here|all]   |   boost off")
			:format(kinds)
	end

	local everywhere = tostring(scope or "all"):lower() ~= "here"
	local mins = num(minutes) or 0

	local now, why = Boost.set(kind, n, mins, everywhere, admin and admin.Name)
	if not now then
		return ("%s - pick one of: %s"):format(tostring(why), kinds)
	end

	audit(admin, "BOOST", 0, ("%s x%.2f %s"):format(kind, now, everywhere and "all" or "here"))

	local where = everywhere and "on every server" or "on this server only"
	if now <= 1 then
		return ("%s boost is off %s"):format(kind, where)
	end
	if mins > 0 then
		return ("%s boost x%.2f for %d minutes, %s"):format(kind, now, mins, where)
	end
	return ("%s boost x%.2f with no time limit, %s"):format(kind, now, where)
end

handlers.kick = function(admin, who, ...)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local reason = table.concat({ ... }, " ")
	audit(admin, "KICK", player.UserId, reason)
	player:Kick(reason ~= "" and reason or "Kicked by admin")
	return ("kicked %s"):format(player.Name)
end

handlers.ban = function(admin, who, ...)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local reason = table.concat({ ... }, " ")
	if not banStore then return "no DataStore, cannot save the ban" end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		banStore:SetAsync("b_" .. player.UserId, { reason = reason, at = os.time() })
	end)
	audit(admin, "BAN", player.UserId, reason, ok and "ok" or "error")
	if ok then
		player:Kick(reason ~= "" and reason or "Banned by admin")
		return ("banned %s"):format(player.Name)
	end
	return "could not save the ban"
end

handlers.unban = function(admin, id)
	local userId = num(id)
	if not userId then return "give a UserId - the player is offline" end
	if not banStore then return "no DataStore" end
	local ok = pcall(function() banStore:RemoveAsync("b_" .. math.floor(userId)) end)
	audit(admin, "UNBAN", userId, "", ok and "ok" or "error")
	return ok and ("unbanned %d"):format(userId) or "failed"
end

handlers.teleport = function(admin, who)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local from = admin.Character and admin.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local to = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (from and to) then return "both players need to be spawned" end
	from.CFrame = to.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 4)
	audit(admin, "TELEPORT", player.UserId, "")
	return ("teleported to %s"):format(player.Name)
end

handlers.give = function(admin, amount)
	local n = num(amount)
	if not n then return "give a number" end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		setStat(player, "Coins", stat(player, "Coins") + math.floor(n))
	end
	remote:FireAllClients("announce", {
		text = ("Everyone got %d coins!"):format(math.floor(n)),
		fromUserId = admin and admin.UserId or 0,
		fromName = admin and admin.Name or "ADMIN",
	})
	audit(admin, "GIVE_ALL", 0, n)
	return ("+%d coins for everyone here"):format(math.floor(n))
end

handlers.freereset = function(admin, who)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	if not _G.FreeReward then return "free reward not ready" end
	local ok, why = _G.FreeReward.reset(player)
	if not ok then return tostring(why) end
	audit(admin, "FREE_RESET", player.UserId, "")
	return ("%s: free reward can be claimed again"):format(player.Name)
end

handlers.freegive = function(admin, who)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	if not _G.FreeReward then return "free reward not ready" end
	local ok, coins = _G.FreeReward.grant(player)
	if not ok then return tostring(coins) end
	audit(admin, "FREE_GRANT", player.UserId, coins)
	return ("%s: free reward paid, %d coins"):format(player.Name, coins)
end

handlers.speed = function(admin, who, amount)
    local player, err = findPlayer(who)
    if not player then return err end

    local Cfg = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
    local n = num(amount)
    if not n then

        local txt = tostring(amount):upper()
        local base, suffix = txt:match("^([%d%.]+)([KMBT]?)$")
        local mult = ({ K = 1e3, M = 1e6, B = 1e9, T = 1e12 })[suffix] or 1
        n = base and (tonumber(base) or 0) * mult or nil
    end
    if not n then return "give a number, e.g. 1, 170K, 5T" end

    n = math.clamp(n, 0, Cfg.SPEED_MAX)
    player:SetAttribute("Speed", n)
    audit(admin, "SET_SPEED", player.UserId, n)
    return ("%s: Speed = %s (%.0f studs/s)"):format(
        player.Name, Cfg.fmtSpeed(n), Cfg.walkForSpeed(n))
end

handlers.bat = function(admin, who, zone)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local BatCfg = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BatConfig"))
	local z = num(zone)
	if not z or z ~= math.floor(z) or z < 0 or (z > 0 and not BatCfg[z]) then
		return ("usage: bat <player> <0-%d>   (0 = default bat)"):format(#BatCfg)
	end
	local Bats = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("BatService"))
	if not Bats.adminSet(player, z) then return player.Name .. " has no profile loaded yet" end
	audit(admin, "SET_BAT", player.UserId, z)
	return ("%s: bat = %s"):format(player.Name, z == 0 and "Default Bat" or BatCfg[z].Name)
end

handlers.level = function(admin, who, kind, level)
	local player, err = findPlayer(who)
	if not player then return err end
	local U = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
	local key = ({ mill = "MILL", treadmill = "MILL", plot = "PEN", pen = "PEN" })[tostring(kind):lower()]
	local n = num(level)
	if not key or not n then
		return ("usage: level <player> <mill|plot> <1-%d>"):format(U.MAX_LEVEL)
	end
	local PU = _G.PlotUpgrade
	if not (PU and PU.setLevel) then return "upgrade service is not running" end
	if not PU.levelOf(player, key) then return player.Name .. " has no plot yet" end
	n = math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL)
	PU.setLevel(player, key, n)
	audit(admin, "SET_LEVEL", player.UserId, ("%s %d"):format(key, n))
	return ("%s: %s level = %d"):format(player.Name, key == "MILL" and "treadmill" or "plot", n)
end

local EGG_TOPIC = "EggAdmin"
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")

local function eggCfg()
    return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
end

local function clampIdx(v, hi, fallback)
    local n = tonumber(v)
    if not n then return fallback end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, hi)
end

handlers.egg = function(admin, who, zone, tier, size, count)
    local player, err = findPlayer(who)
    if not player then return err end
    if not _G.EggAdmin then return "egg service not ready" end

    local Cfg = eggCfg()
    local z = clampIdx(zone, Cfg.ZONES, 1)
    local t = clampIdx(tier, #Cfg.TIERS, 1)
    local s = clampIdx(size, #Cfg.SIZES, 3)
    local n = math.clamp(tonumber(count) or 1, 1, 10)

    for _ = 1, n do _G.EggAdmin.give(player, z, t, s) end
    audit(admin, "GIVE_EGG", player.UserId, ("z%d t%d s%d x%d"):format(z, t, s, n))
    return ("%s: %d x %s %s egg (zone %d)"):format(player.Name, n,
        Cfg.TIERS[t] and Cfg.TIERS[t].name or t,
        Cfg.SIZES[s] and Cfg.SIZES[s].name or s, z)
end

handlers.ripen = function(admin, who)
    local player, err = findPlayer(who)
    if not player then return err end
    if not (_G.Nest and _G.Nest.ripen) then return "nest service not ready" end
    local n = _G.Nest.ripen(player)
    audit(admin, "RIPEN", player.UserId, n)
    return ("%s: %d eggs ready to hatch"):format(player.Name, n)
end

local function ripenEveryone()
    if not (_G.Nest and _G.Nest.ripen) then return 0 end
    local n = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do n += _G.Nest.ripen(p) end
    return n
end

handlers.ripenall = function(admin, scope)
    local n = ripenEveryone()
    local where = "this server"
    if tostring(scope or ""):lower() == "global" then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            MessagingService:PublishAsync(EGG_TOPIC, { what = "ripen", from = game.JobId })
        end)
        where = ok and "ALL servers" or "this server (no cross-server access)"
    end
    audit(admin, "RIPEN_ALL", 0, where)
    return ("%d eggs ready - %s"):format(n, where)
end

handlers.mapegg = function(admin, zone, tier, size, count)
    if not _G.EggAdmin then return "egg service not ready" end
    local Cfg = eggCfg()
    local z = (tostring(zone or ""):lower() == "all") and nil or clampIdx(zone, Cfg.ZONES, 1)
    local t = clampIdx(tier, #Cfg.TIERS, 4)
    local s = clampIdx(size, #Cfg.SIZES, 6)
    local n = math.clamp(tonumber(count) or 4, 1, 48)

    local made = _G.EggAdmin.spawn(z, t, s, n)
    audit(admin, "MAP_EGG", 0, ("z%s t%d s%d x%d"):format(tostring(z or "all"), t, s, made))
    return ("%d eggs placed on the map (%s %s, zone %s)"):format(made,
        Cfg.TIERS[t] and Cfg.TIERS[t].name or t,
        Cfg.SIZES[s] and Cfg.SIZES[s].name or s, tostring(z or "all"))
end

task.spawn(pcall, function()
    MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(EGG_TOPIC, function(message)
        local data = message and message.Data
        if type(data) == "table" and data.what == "ripen" then
            ripenEveryone()
        end
    end)
end)

handlers.announce = function(admin, ...)
	local text = table.concat({ ... }, " ")
	if text == "" then return "nothing to announce" end
	local okFilter, filtered = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("TextService"):FilterStringAsync(text, admin and admin.UserId or 0):GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if not okFilter or type(filtered) ~= "string" then return "text filter failed, try again" end
	text = filtered
	remote:FireAllClients("announce", {
		text = text,
		fromUserId = admin and admin.UserId or 0,
		fromName = admin and admin.Name or "ADMIN",
	})
	audit(admin, "ANNOUNCE", 0, text)
	return "sent"
end

handlers.capture = function(admin, action, minutes, mult, scope)
	local Capture = _G.CaptureEgg
	if not Capture then return "CaptureEggService is not running" end
	action = tostring(action or ""):lower()
	if action == "off" then
		local everywhere = tostring(minutes or "all"):lower() ~= "here"
		Capture.stop(everywhere)
		audit(admin, "CAPTURE", 0, "off " .. (everywhere and "all" or "here"))
		return "capture the egg ended, rewards handed out"
	elseif action ~= "start" then
		return "usage: capture start <minutes> [reward x] [here|all]   |   capture off [here|all]"
	end
	local everywhere = tostring(scope or "all"):lower() ~= "here"
	local ok, why = Capture.start(num(minutes), num(mult) or 1, everywhere)
	if not ok then return tostring(why) end
	local st = Capture.state()
	audit(admin, "CAPTURE", 0, ("%s min x%g %s"):format(tostring(minutes), st.mult, everywhere and "all" or "here"))
	return ("capture the egg started for %s min, rewards x%g %s"):format(tostring(minutes), st.mult, everywhere and "on every server" or "on this server only")
end

handlers.daynight = function(admin, mode)
	local DN = _G.DayNight
	if not DN then return "DayNightService is not running" end
	local Cycle = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DayNightConfig"))
	mode = tostring(mode or ""):lower()
	if mode == "dayend" then
		DN.setPhase("day", 10)
	elseif mode == "night" then
		DN.setPhase("night")
	elseif mode == "countdown" then
		DN.setPhase("night", Cycle.COUNTDOWN + 2)
	elseif mode == "day" then
		DN.setPhase("day")
	elseif mode == "reset" then
		local count, legendary = DN.resetEggs()
		audit(admin, "DAYNIGHT", 0, mode)
		return ("eggs reset: %d eggs, %d legendary"):format(count or 0, legendary and #legendary or 0)
	else
		return "usage: daynight <dayend|night|countdown|day|reset>"
	end
	audit(admin, "DAYNIGHT", 0, mode)
	local phase, endsAt = DN.state()
	return ("%s for %ds"):format(phase, math.floor(endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 0.5))
end

local function run(admin, line)
	local parts = {}
	for word in tostring(line):gmatch("%S+") do parts[#parts + 1] = word end
	if parts[1] ~= PREFIX then
		return ("commands start with %s"):format(PREFIX)
	end
	local verb = (parts[2] or ""):lower()
	local handler = handlers[verb]
	if not handler then
		local names = {}
		for key in pairs(handlers) do names[#names + 1] = key end
		table.sort(names)
		return "unknown command. try: " .. table.concat(names, ", ")
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(handler, admin, table.unpack(parts, 3))
	if not ok then return "error: " .. tostring(result) end
	return tostring(result)
end

local function roster()
	local list = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		list[#list + 1] = {
			userId = player.UserId,
			name = player.Name,
			coins = stat(player, "Coins"),
		}
	end
	return list
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, payload)
	if action == "auth" then
		local ok = isAdmin(player)
		remote:FireClient(player, "auth", ok)
		if ok then remote:FireClient(player, "state", roster()) end
		return
	end

	if not isAdmin(player) then
		remote:FireClient(player, "denied")
		return
	end

	if action == "state" then
		remote:FireClient(player, "state", roster())
	elseif action == "cmd" and type(payload) == "string" then
		remote:FireClient(player, "reply", run(player, payload))
		remote:FireClient(player, "state", roster())
	end
end)

if banStore then
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		local ok, record = pcall(function()
			return banStore:GetAsync("b_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok and type(record) == "table" then
			player:Kick(record.reason ~= "" and record.reason or "Banned")
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.delay(2, function()
		if player.Parent and isAdmin(player) then
			remote:FireClient(player, "auth", true)
		end
	end)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("FreeReward")
local SETTINGS = Config.FreeReward

local function giveSpeed(player)
	local amount = tonumber(SETTINGS.Speed) or 0
	local cap = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggConfig")).SPEED_MAX or 1e14
	player:SetAttribute("Speed", math.min((tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Speed")) or 1) + amount, cap))
	return amount
end

local function profileOf(player)
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	return Profile and Profile.get(player) or nil
end

local function inGroup(player)
	local id = SETTINGS.GroupId or 0
	if id <= 0 then

		return false, false
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function() return player:IsInGroup(id) end)
	return (ok and result) == true, true
end

local function push(player)
	local profile = profileOf(player)
	if not profile then return end
	local joined, verifiable = inGroup(player)
	remote:FireClient(player, "state", {
		claimed = profile.FreeRewardClaimed == true,
		joined = joined,
		verifiable = verifiable,
		speed = SETTINGS.Speed,
	})
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
	local profile = profileOf(player)
	if not profile then return end

	if action == "get" then
		push(player)
		return
	end
	if action ~= "claim" then return end

	if profile.FreeRewardClaimed then
		remote:FireClient(player, "denied", "already claimed")
		return
	end

	profile.FreeRewardClaimed = true
	local joined, verifiable = inGroup(player)
	if not verifiable then
		profile.FreeRewardClaimed = false
		remote:FireClient(player, "denied", "group not set")
		return
	end
	if not joined then
		profile.FreeRewardClaimed = false
		remote:FireClient(player, "denied", "join the group first")
		push(player)
		return
	end

	remote:FireClient(player, "granted", giveSpeed(player))
	push(player)
end)

_G.FreeReward = {
	reset = function(player)
		local profile = profileOf(player)
		if not profile then return false, "profile not ready" end
		profile.FreeRewardClaimed = false
		push(player)
		return true
	end,

	grant = function(player)
		local profile = profileOf(player)
		if not profile then return false, "profile not ready" end
		if profile.FreeRewardClaimed then return false, "already claimed" end
		profile.FreeRewardClaimed = true
		local amount = giveSpeed(player)
		remote:FireClient(player, "granted", amount)
		push(player)
		return true, amount
	end,

}

task.spawn(function()
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	while not Profile do
		task.wait(0.1)
		Profile = _G.Profile
	end
	Profile.Loaded:Connect(push)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if profileOf(player) then push(player) end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GROUP = "Characters"
local SPREAD = 2.4

pcall(function()
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(GROUP)
end)

	if part:IsA("BasePart") then

	end

local function onCharacter(character)
	for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		claim(d)
	end

	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(claim)

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if root then
		local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
		local distance = math.sqrt(math.random()) * SPREAD
		root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(
			math.cos(angle) * distance, 0, math.sin(angle) * distance)
	end
end

local function onPlayer(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player.Character)
	end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayer(player)
end

name: PurchaseService
source:
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local RECEIPT_KEEP_DAYS = 60

local handlers = {}
local handlerKind = {}

local Purchases = {}
_G.Purchases = Purchases

function Purchases.register(kind, productId, handler)
	productId = tonumber(productId) or 0
	if productId <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if handlers[productId] and handlerKind[productId] ~= kind then
		warn(("[Purchase] product %d is used by both %s and %s - fix MonetizationConfig"):format(productId, tostring(handlerKind[productId]), tostring(kind)))
	end
	handlers[productId] = handler
	handlerKind[productId] = kind
end

function Purchases.processReceipt(receipt)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local Profile = _G.Profile
	local profile = Profile and Profile.get(player)
	local profileDeadline = os.clock() + 30
	while not profile and player.Parent and os.clock() < profileDeadline do
		task.wait(0.5)
		Profile = _G.Profile
		profile = Profile and Profile.get(player)
	end
	if not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if type(profile.Receipts) ~= "table" then
		profile.Receipts = {}
	end

	local purchaseId = tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
	if not profile.Receipts[purchaseId] then
		local handler = handlers[receipt.ProductId]
		local handlerDeadline = os.clock() + 25
		while not handler and player.Parent and os.clock() < handlerDeadline do
			task.wait(0.5)
			handler = handlers[receipt.ProductId]
		end
		if not handler then
			warn(("[Purchase] no handler for product %d"):format(receipt.ProductId))
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
		local ok, granted = pcall(handler, player)
		if not ok then
			warn(("[Purchase] product %d handler error: %s"):format(receipt.ProductId, tostring(granted)))
		end
		if not ok or granted == false then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
		profile.Receipts[purchaseId] = os.time()
		local spent = Profile.value(player, "stats", "RobuxSpent") or 0
		Profile.set(player, "RobuxSpent", spent + (receipt.CurrencySpent or 0))

		local cutoff = os.time() - RECEIPT_KEEP_DAYS * 86400
		for id, stamp in pairs(profile.Receipts) do
			if type(stamp) ~= "number" or stamp < cutoff then
				profile.Receipts[id] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	if not Profile.save(player) and not RunService:IsStudio() then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = Purchases.processReceipt

task.defer(function()
	local module = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MonetizationConfig")
	if module then
		pcall(function()
			require(module).validate()
		end)
	end
end)

name: LeaderboardService
source:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local LB = Config.Leaderboard or {}
local REFRESH = LB.Refresh or 60
local SAVE_EVERY = LB.SaveEvery or 60
local SHOWN = math.min(LB.Shown or 100, 100)

local CATEGORIES = {
	TopCash   = { folder = "wallet", key = "Coins" },
	TopRobux  = { folder = "stats", key = "RobuxSpent" },

	TopSpeed  = { attributes = { "Speed" } },

	TopPlaytime = { folder = "stats", key = "Playtime", format = "clock" },
}

local stores = {}
for name in pairs(CATEGORIES) do
	local ok, store = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore(Config.DataStores.Board .. name .. "_v1")
	end)
	stores[name] = ok and store or nil
end

local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
	or workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld", 30)
local boardsFolder = mapFolder and mapFolder:WaitForChild("Leaderboards", 30)
if not boardsFolder then
	warn("[Leaderboard] Leaderboards folder not found - boards stay empty")
	return
end

local function valueOf(player, category)
	local rule = CATEGORIES[category]
	if not rule then
		return 0
	end
	if rule.attributes then
		local product = 1
		for _, name in ipairs(rule.attributes) do
			product = product * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute(name)) or 1)
		end
		return math.floor(product)
	end
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	if not Profile then
		return 0
	end
	return math.floor(Profile.value(player, rule.folder, rule.key) or 0)
end

local nameCache = {}
local function nameOf(userId)
	if nameCache[userId] then
		return nameCache[userId]
	end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	name = ok and name or ("Player " .. userId)
	nameCache[userId] = name
	return name
end

local short = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig")).fmtShort

local function clock(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	local h = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
	local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
	if h > 0 then
		return ("%dh %dm"):format(h, m)
	end
	if m > 0 then
		return ("%dm"):format(m)
	end
	return ("%ds"):format(seconds)
end

local function display(category, value)
	local rule = CATEGORIES[category]
	if rule and rule.format == "clock" then
		return clock(value)
	end
	return short(value)
end

local lastSent = {}
local function save(player)
	if not player:FindFirstChild("wallet") then return end
	local sent = lastSent[player.UserId] or {}
	lastSent[player.UserId] = sent
	for name, _ in pairs(CATEGORIES) do
		local store = stores[name]
		if store then
			local value = valueOf(player, name)
			if value > 0 and sent[name] ~= value then
				local ok = pcall(function()
					store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), value)
				end)
				if ok then sent[name] = value end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function fromConnected(category)
	local rows = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local value = valueOf(player, category)
		if value > 0 then
			rows[#rows + 1] = { userId = player.UserId, name = player.Name, value = value }
		end
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.value > b.value end)
	return rows
end

local function fromStore(category)
	local store = stores[category]
	if not store then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, page = pcall(function()
		return store:GetSortedAsync(false, SHOWN):GetCurrentPage()
	end)
	if not (ok and page) then
		return nil
	end
	local rows = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(page) do
		local userId = tonumber(entry.key)
		if userId then
			rows[#rows + 1] = { userId = userId, name = nameOf(userId), value = entry.value }
		end
	end
	return rows
end

local function paint(board, rows, category)
	local holder = board:FindFirstChild("Rows", true)
	if not holder then
		return
	end
	local index = 0
	for _, row in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
		if row:IsA("Frame") then
			index += 1
			local data = rows[index]
			local rank = row:FindFirstChild("Rank")
			local name = row:FindFirstChild("PlayerName")
			local value = row:FindFirstChild("Value")
			local avatar = row:FindFirstChild("Avatar")
			row.Visible = data ~= nil
			if data then
				if rank then rank.Text = "#" .. index end
				if name then name.Text = data.name end
				if value then value.Text = display(category, data.value) end
				if avatar then
					avatar.Image =
						("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(data.userId)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function refresh()
	for _, board in ipairs(boardsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		local category = board:GetAttribute("Category")
		if category and CATEGORIES[category] then
			local rows = fromStore(category)
			if not rows or #rows == 0 then
				rows = fromConnected(category)
			end
			paint(board, rows, category)
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	lastSent[player.UserId] = nil
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while not _G.Profile do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	task.wait(2)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		save(player)
	end
	refresh()
	local nextSave, nextRefresh = os.clock() + SAVE_EVERY, os.clock() + REFRESH
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now >= nextSave then
			nextSave = now + SAVE_EVERY
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				save(player)
			end
		end
		if now >= nextRefresh then
			nextRefresh = now + REFRESH
			refresh()
		end
	end
end)

local live = 0
for _, store in pairs(stores) do
	if store then
		live += 1
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):FindFirstChild("Shop")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "Shop"
    remote.Parent = RS.Remotes
end

local Money = require(RS:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))

local PASSES = {
    { key = "Growth2", name = "x2 Growth", blurb = "Eggs Grow x2 faster!", icon = "egg",  tint = "rainbow" },
    { key = "Money2",  name = "x2 Money",  blurb = "Get x2 Money!",   icon = "cash", tint = "gold" },
}
for _, p in ipairs(PASSES) do
    local m = Money.GAME_PASSES[p.key] or {}
    p.passId = tonumber(m.passId) or 0
    p.price = tonumber(m.price) or 0
    local g = (Money.GIFT_PASS_PRODUCTS or {})[p.key] or {}
    p.giftProductId = tonumber(g.productId) or 0
    p.giftPrice = tonumber(g.price) or p.price
end

local SPEED = Money.SPEED_PACKS

local MONEY = Money.CASH_PACKS

local SPEED_MAX = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig")).SPEED_MAX or 1e14

local function addSpeed(plr, amount)
    plr:SetAttribute("Speed", math.min((plr:GetAttribute("Speed") or 1) + amount, SPEED_MAX))
end

local function addCoins(plr, amount)
    local Profile = _G.Profile
    if not (Profile and Profile.get(plr)) then return false end
    local have = Profile.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    return Profile.set(plr, "Coins", have + math.floor(amount)) ~= nil
end

local function giftedPass(plr, key)
    local prof = _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr)
    return prof and type(prof.GiftedPasses) == "table" and prof.GiftedPasses[key] == true
end

local function refreshPasses(plr)
    for _, p in ipairs(PASSES) do
        local owns = plr:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. p.key) == true or giftedPass(plr, p.key)
        if not owns and (p.passId or 0) > 0 then
            local ok, res = pcall(function()
                return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(plr.UserId, p.passId)
            end)
            owns = ok and res == true
        end
        plr:SetAttribute("Pass_" .. p.key, owns)
    end
    plr:SetAttribute("GrowthMult", plr:GetAttribute("Pass_Growth2") and 2 or 1)
    plr:SetAttribute("MoneyMult", plr:GetAttribute("Pass_Money2") and 2 or 1)
end

local GIFT_TTL = 120
local pendingGift = {}
local function takeGift(buyer, key)
    local g = pendingGift[buyer]
    if not g or g.key ~= key or os.clock() - g.at > GIFT_TTL then return nil end
    pendingGift[buyer] = nil
    return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(g.target), g
end
local function tellGift(buyer, target, name)
    if target and target ~= buyer then
        if _G.Profile and _G.Profile.save then task.spawn(_G.Profile.save, target) end
        remote:FireClient(target, "gifted", { from = buyer.DisplayName, name = name })
        remote:FireClient(buyer, "giftSent", { to = target.DisplayName, name = name })
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 200 do
        if _G.Purchases and _G.Purchases.register then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    local Purchases = _G.Purchases
    if not (Purchases and Purchases.register) then
        warn("[Shop] purchase service missing - products not registered")
        return
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(SPEED) do
        Purchases.register(e.key, e.productId, function(plr)
            local target = takeGift(plr, e.key) or plr
            if not (_G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(target)) then target = plr end
            addSpeed(target, e.amount)
            tellGift(plr, target, e.label)
            return true
        end)
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(MONEY) do
        Purchases.register(e.key, e.productId, function(plr)
            local target = takeGift(plr, e.key) or plr
            if not (_G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(target)) then target = plr end
            local ok = addCoins(target, e.amount)
            if ok then tellGift(plr, target, e.label) end
            return ok
        end)
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(PASSES) do
        Purchases.register("Gift_" .. p.key, p.giftProductId, function(plr)
            local target = takeGift(plr, p.key)
            if not target or giftedPass(target, p.key) or target:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. p.key) then
                target = plr
            end
            local prof = _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(target)
            if not prof then return false end
            prof.GiftedPasses = type(prof.GiftedPasses) == "table" and prof.GiftedPasses or {}
            prof.GiftedPasses[p.key] = true
            refreshPasses(target)
            tellGift(plr, target, p.name)
            if _G.Shop then _G.Shop.push(target) end
            return true
        end)
    end
    print(("[Shop] registered %d speed packs, %d cash packs, %d passes")
        :format(#SPEED, #MONEY, #PASSES))
end)

local function catalogue(plr)
    local function copy(list, kind)
        local out = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(list) do
            out[i] = {
                key = e.key, name = e.name, label = e.label, blurb = e.blurb,
                price = Money.displayPrice(e.productId or e.passId, e.passId ~= nil, e.price), stack = e.stack, icon = e.icon, tint = e.tint,
                kind = kind,
                ready = ((e.productId or e.passId or 0) > 0),
                giftReady = (kind == "pass") and ((e.giftProductId or 0) > 0) or ((e.productId or 0) > 0),
                owned = (kind == "pass") and (plr:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. e.key) == true) or nil,
            }
        end
        return out
    end
    local passes = copy(PASSES, "pass")
    return { passes = passes, speed = copy(SPEED, "speed"), money = copy(MONEY, "money") }
end

local function find(key)
    for _, list in ipairs({ PASSES, SPEED, MONEY }) do
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do
            if e.key == key then return e end
        end
    end
end

local lastPassCheck = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) lastPassCheck[plr] = nil end)

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, key, ...)
    if action == "state" then
        local now = os.clock()
        if (lastPassCheck[plr] or 0) + 5 <= now then
            lastPassCheck[plr] = now
            refreshPasses(plr)
        end
        remote:FireClient(plr, "state", catalogue(plr))
        return
    end
    if action == "gift" then
        local targetId = tonumber(select(1, ...))
        local e = find(key)
        local target = targetId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetId)
        if not e or not target or target == plr then return end
        local isPass = e.passId ~= nil
        if isPass and (target:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. e.key) or giftedPass(target, e.key)) then
            remote:FireClient(plr, "note", target.DisplayName .. " already owns " .. e.name)
            return
        end
        local id = isPass and e.giftProductId or e.productId or 0
        if id <= 0 then
            remote:FireClient(plr, "noProduct", "Gift " .. (e.name or e.label or key))
            return
        end
        pendingGift[plr] = { key = e.key, target = target.UserId, at = os.clock() }
        MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(plr, id)
        return
    end
    if action ~= "buy" then return end
    pendingGift[plr] = nil

    if key == "SpeedPass" then
        local SS = _G.SpeedShop
        if SS and SS.buy then
            local _, reason, tier = SS.buy(plr, true)
            if reason == "noProduct" and tier then
                remote:FireClient(plr, "noProduct", ("x%d Speed"):format(tier.mult))
            end
        end
        return
    end

    local e = find(key)
    if not e then return end
    local id = e.productId or e.passId or 0
    if id <= 0 then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "noProduct", e.name or e.label or key)
        return
    end
    if e.passId then
        MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(plr, id)
    else
        MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(plr, id)
    end
end)

local function ownsPass(plr, passId)
    if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and Money.STUDIO_TEST then
        return true
    end
    for attempt = 1, 3 do
        local ok, res = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, plr.UserId, passId)
        if ok and res == true then return true end
        task.wait(attempt)
    end
    return false
end

MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(plr, passId, bought)
    if not bought then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(PASSES) do
        if (p.passId or 0) > 0 and p.passId == passId and ownsPass(plr, passId) then
            plr:SetAttribute("Pass_" .. p.key, true)
        end
    end
    refreshPasses(plr)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "state", catalogue(plr))
end)

MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(userId, _, bought)
    if bought then return end
    local buyer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
    if buyer then pendingGift[buyer] = nil end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) pendingGift[plr] = nil end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1)
        refreshPasses(plr)
    end)
end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(refreshPasses, plr) end

task.spawn(function()
    while not (_G.Profile and _G.Profile.Loaded) do task.wait(0.1) end
    _G.Profile.Loaded:Connect(function(plr)
        refreshPasses(plr)
        if _G.Shop then _G.Shop.push(plr) end
    end)
end)

_G.Shop = {
    growthMult = function(plr) return plr:GetAttribute("GrowthMult") or 1 end,
    moneyMult = function(plr) return plr:GetAttribute("MoneyMult") or 1 end,

    push = function(plr)
        if not plr.Parent then return end
        remote:FireClient(plr, "state", catalogue(plr))
    end,
}

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SpeedPass = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SpeedPassConfig"))
local Money = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))
local TIERS = SpeedPass.TIERS
local MAX_MULT = SpeedPass.max()

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("SpeedShop")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "SpeedShop"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local function profileOf(plr)
    return _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr) or nil
end

local function multOf(plr)
    local m = tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("SpeedMult")) or 1
    return math.clamp(m, 1, MAX_MULT)
end

local function nextTier(plr)
    return SpeedPass.nextAfter(multOf(plr))
end

local function push(plr)
    local tier = nextTier(plr)
    remote:FireClient(plr, {
        mult = multOf(plr),
        max = MAX_MULT,
        maxed = tier == nil,
        next = tier and tier.mult or nil,
        price = tier and Money.displayPrice(tier.passId, true, tier.price) or nil,
        ready = tier ~= nil and (tier.passId or 0) > 0,
    })
    if _G.Shop and _G.Shop.push then
        task.spawn(pcall, _G.Shop.push, plr)
    end
end

local function setMult(plr, value)
    local m = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1, 1, MAX_MULT)
    plr:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", m)
    local profile = profileOf(plr)
    if profile then
        profile.SpeedMult = m
        if _G.Profile.save then task.spawn(_G.Profile.save, plr) end
    end
    push(plr)
    return m
end

_G.SpeedMult = multOf

local function ownedPassMult(plr)
    local best = 1
    for _, tier in ipairs(TIERS) do
        local id = tier.passId or 0
        if id > 0 then
            local ok, owns = pcall(function()
                return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(plr.UserId, id)
            end)
            if ok and owns == true and tier.mult > best then best = tier.mult end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function buy(plr, silent)
    local tier = nextTier(plr)
    if not tier then
        push(plr)
        return false, "maxed"
    end
    if (tier.passId or 0) > 0 then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(plr, tier.passId)
        end)
        if not ok then push(plr) end
        return ok, "prompted", tier
    end
    if RunService:IsStudio() and SpeedPass.STUDIO_TEST then
        setMult(plr, tier.mult)
        return true, "studio", tier
    end
    if not silent then
        remote:FireClient(plr, { mult = multOf(plr), noProduct = true, next = tier.mult })
    end
    return false, "noProduct", tier
end

local function ownsPass(plr, passId)
    if RunService:IsStudio() and SpeedPass.STUDIO_TEST then return true end
    for attempt = 1, 3 do
        local ok, res = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, plr.UserId, passId)
        if ok and res == true then return true end
        task.wait(attempt)
    end
    return false
end

MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(plr, passId, bought)
    if not bought then return end
    local tier = SpeedPass.byPassId(passId)
    if not tier then return end
    if not ownsPass(plr, passId) then push(plr) return end
    if tier.mult > multOf(plr) then
        setMult(plr, tier.mult)
    else
        push(plr)
    end
end)

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action)
    if action == "state" then
        push(plr)
    elseif action == "buy" then
        buy(plr, false)
    end
end)

local function attach(plr)
    local profile = profileOf(plr)
    local saved = (profile and tonumber(profile.SpeedMult)) or tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("SpeedMult")) or 1
    plr:SetAttribute("SpeedMult", math.clamp(saved, 1, MAX_MULT))
    push(plr)
    task.spawn(function()
        local fromPasses = ownedPassMult(plr)
        if plr.Parent and fromPasses > multOf(plr) then
            setMult(plr, fromPasses)
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
    task.delay(3, function() if plr.Parent then attach(plr) end end)
end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    task.delay(3, function() if plr.Parent then attach(plr) end end)
end

task.defer(function()
    while not (_G.Profile and _G.Profile.Loaded) do task.wait(0.1) end
    if _G.Profile and _G.Profile.Loaded then
        _G.Profile.Loaded:Connect(attach)
    end
end)

_G.SpeedShop = {
    set = setMult,
    get = multOf,
    max = MAX_MULT,
    buy = buy,
    nextTier = nextTier,
}

do
    local parts = {}
    local sorted = table.clone(TIERS)
    table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.mult < b.mult end)
    for _, t in ipairs(sorted) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = ("x%d=%dR$%s"):format(t.mult, t.price, (t.passId or 0) > 0 and "" or "*")
    end
    print(("[SpeedPass] %d tiers, max x%d | %s  (* = no pass id)"):format(#TIERS, MAX_MULT, table.concat(parts, " ")))
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local Rebirth = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local Money = require(RS:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))

local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild("Rebirth")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "Rebirth"
	remote.Parent = remotes
end

local SKIP = Money.REBIRTH_SKIP or { productId = 0 }

local function count(player)
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	return Profile and Profile.value(player, "stats", "Rebirths") or 0
end

_G.RebirthMult = function(player)
	return Rebirth.mult(count(player))
end

local lastTry = {}

local function doRebirth(player, paid)
	local Profile = _G.Profile
	if not (Rebirth.ENABLED and Profile and Profile.get(player)) then
		return false, "Not ready yet"
	end
	local n = count(player)
	if Rebirth.maxed(n) then
		return false, "Max rebirth reached!"
	end
	if paid and Profile.value(player, "wallet", "Coins") < Rebirth.cost(n) then
		return false, "Not enough cash!"
	end
	Profile.set(player, "Coins", Cfg.COINS_START or 0)
	player:SetAttribute("Speed", Cfg.SPEED_START or 1)
	Profile.set(player, "Rebirths", n + 1)
	task.spawn(Profile.save, player)
	remote:FireClient(player, "done", n + 1)
	return true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastTry[player] and now - lastTry[player] < 1 then
		return
	end
	lastTry[player] = now
	if action == "rebirth" then
		local ok, why = doRebirth(player, true)
		if not ok then
			remote:FireClient(player, "fail", why)
		end
	elseif action == "skipTest" then
		if RunService:IsStudio() and Money.STUDIO_TEST and (tonumber(SKIP.productId) or 0) <= 0 then
			doRebirth(player, false)
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastTry[player] = nil
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while not _G.Purchases do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	_G.Purchases.register("RebirthSkip", SKIP.productId, function(player)
		local Profile = _G.Profile
		if not (Profile and Profile.get(player)) then
			return false
		end
		if doRebirth(player, false) then
			return true
		end
		local n = count(player)
		Profile.set(player, "Coins", Profile.value(player, "wallet", "Coins") + Rebirth.cost(n))
		remote:FireClient(player, "fail", "Max rebirth reached - you got cash instead")
		return true
	end)
end)

source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local map = Workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld", 30)
local assets = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("EggAssets")
local ZONES = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggConfig")).ZONES

local function child(parent, name)
	return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
end

local function zoneFolder(n)
	local zones = child(map, "Zones")
	if not zones then return nil end
	for _, d in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if d.Name:match("^Zone" .. n .. "_") then return d end
	end
	return nil
end

local SKIP = {}

local LAYERS = {}

local function layer(name, roots)
	local keep = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
		if r then keep[#keep + 1] = r end
	end
	if #keep > 0 then
		LAYERS[#LAYERS + 1] = { name = name, roots = keep }
	end
end

local animalPack = Workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
if animalPack then
	for _, d in ipairs(animalPack:GetDescendants()) do SKIP[d] = true end
	SKIP[animalPack] = true
end

layer("hud", { ReplicatedStorage })

layer("items", { child(assets, "Gear") })

layer("spawn", {
	child(map, "Floor"),
	child(map, "SafeZone"),
	child(map, "MainSpawn"),
	child(map, "SpawnPens"),
	child(map, "Leaderboards"),
	child(map, "Shops"),
	child(map, "Rewards"),
	child(map, "Walls"),
	child(map, "EggSpawns"),
	child(assets, "ShopStall"),
	child(assets, "Nest"),
})

local shell = { child(child(map, "Zones"), "Dividers") }
for n = 1, ZONES do
	local zf = zoneFolder(n)
	if zf then
		table.insert(shell, child(zf, "Floor"))
		table.insert(shell, child(zf, "Walls"))
	end
end
layer("shell", shell)

for n = 1, ZONES do
	layer("zone" .. n, {
		child(zoneFolder(n), "Decor"),
		child(child(assets, "Eggs"), "Zone" .. n),
		child(child(assets, "Bosses"), "Zone" .. n),
	})
end

layer("animals", { Workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary") })

local seen = {}

local function take(into, id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" then return end
	if id:match("^rbxasset://") then return end
	if seen[id] then return end
	seen[id] = true
	into[#into + 1] = id
end

local YIELD_EVERY = 4000
local scanned = 0

local function sweep(root, into)
	if not root then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if not SKIP[d] then
			if d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then
				take(into, d.Image)
			elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
				take(into, d.Texture)
			elseif d:IsA("MeshPart") then
				take(into, d.MeshId)
				take(into, d.TextureID)
			elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				take(into, d.MeshId)
				take(into, d.TextureId)
			elseif d:IsA("Sound") then
				take(into, d.SoundId)
			elseif d:IsA("Animation") then
				take(into, d.AnimationId)
			end
		end
		scanned = scanned + 1
		if scanned % YIELD_EVERY == 0 then task.wait() end
	end
end

local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AssetManifest")
if folder then folder:Destroy() end
folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "AssetManifest"

local total = 0
local report = {}

for index, entry in ipairs(LAYERS) do
	local ids = {}

	local guard = SKIP
	if entry.name == "animals" then SKIP = {} end
	for _, root in ipairs(entry.roots) do
		sweep(root, ids)
	end
	SKIP = guard
	local value = Instance.new("StringValue")
	value.Name = ("%02d_%s"):format(index, entry.name)
	value.Value = table.concat(ids, "\n")
	value.Parent = folder
	total = total + #ids
	report[#report + 1] = ("%s=%d"):format(entry.name, #ids)
end

folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

print(("[Load] manifest: %d layers, %d assets: %s")
	:format(#LAYERS, total, table.concat(report, ", ")))
