source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local Paint = require(RS:WaitForChild("AnimalPaint"))

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local pens = map:WaitForChild("SpawnPens")

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("Nest")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "Nest"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local placed = map:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggs")
if not placed then
    placed = Instance.new("Folder")
    placed.Name = "PlacedEggs"
    placed.Parent = map
end

local animals = map:FindFirstChild("PlacedAnimals")
if not animals then
    animals = Instance.new("Folder")
    animals.Name = "PlacedAnimals"
    animals.Parent = map
end

local UpgradeCfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local PLOT_MAX_LEVEL = UpgradeCfg.MAX_LEVEL

local function upgradePrice(level)
    return UpgradeCfg.price("PEN", level)
end

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local function newKey()
    return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
end

local function animalCap(pen)
    return UpgradeCfg.petCap(pen:GetAttribute("PlotLevel"))
end

local Money = require(RS:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))
local restored = {}
local function waitRestored(plr)
    for _ = 1, 150 do
        if restored[plr] or not plr.Parent then return end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end
local SKIP_PRODUCT_ID = tonumber(Money.NEST.SkipGrowth.productId) or 0
local GROW_ALL_PRODUCT_ID = tonumber(Money.NEST.GrowAll.productId) or 0

local FENCE_INSET = 5
local MIN_GAP = 4
local DISPLAY_H = 2.6
local PROMPT_RANGE = 14

local rects = {}
local function measure(pen)
    local sign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local lo = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    local hi = Vector3.new(-1e9, -1e9, -1e9)
    for _, p in ipairs(pen:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) then
            lo = lo:Min(p.Position - p.Size / 2)
            hi = hi:Max(p.Position + p.Size / 2)
        end
    end
    rects[pen] = {
        minX = lo.X + FENCE_INSET, maxX = hi.X - FENCE_INSET,
        minZ = lo.Z + FENCE_INSET, maxZ = hi.Z - FENCE_INSET,
        floorY = lo.Y,
    }
end
for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
    measure(pen)
    pen:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlotLevel"):Connect(function()
        task.defer(measure, pen)
        task.delay(0.5, measure, pen)
    end)
end

local lastMeasure = 0
local function penAt(pos)
    if os.clock() - lastMeasure > 2 then
        lastMeasure = os.clock()
        for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do measure(pen) end
    end
    for pen, r in pairs(rects) do
        if pos.X >= r.minX and pos.X <= r.maxX and pos.Z >= r.minZ and pos.Z <= r.maxZ then
            return pen, r
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function penOf(plr)
    for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
        if pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId then return pen end
    end
    return nil
end

local function penFrame(pen)
    local r = rects[pen]
    if not r then return nil end
    return (r.minX + r.maxX) / 2, (r.minZ + r.maxZ) / 2,
           (r.maxX - r.minX) / 2, (r.maxZ - r.minZ) / 2
end

local function eggListOf(plr)
    local Profile = _G.Profile
    local prof = Profile and Profile.get(plr)
    if not prof then return nil end
    if type(prof.NestEggs) ~= "table" then prof.NestEggs = {} end
    return prof.NestEggs
end

local function takeFromInventory(plr, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    local Profile = _G.Profile
    local prof = Profile and Profile.get(plr)
    local inv = prof and prof.Eggs
    if type(inv) ~= "table" then return end
    for i = #inv, 1, -1 do
        local e = inv[i]

        if e.z == zone and e.t == tier and e.s == size and e.sp == species and e.lk == luck then
            table.remove(inv, i)
            return true
        end
    end
end

local function rememberEgg(plr, pen, pos, zone, tier, size, readyAt, species, luck)
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    if not list then return end
    local cx, cz, hx, hz = penFrame(pen)
    if not cx then return end
    local key = newKey()
    list[#list + 1] = {
        key = key,
        zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size, ready = readyAt,
        species = species, luck = luck,
        u = math.clamp((pos.X - cx) / math.max(1, hx), -0.95, 0.95),
        v = math.clamp((pos.Z - cz) / math.max(1, hz), -0.95, 0.95),
    }
    return key
end

local function eggRecordOf(list, model)
    if not list or not model then return nil end
    local key = model:GetAttribute("EggKey")
    if key then
        for i, e in ipairs(list) do
            if e.key == key then return e, i end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local zone, tier, size = model:GetAttribute("EggZone"), model:GetAttribute("EggTier"), model:GetAttribute("EggSize")
    local epoch = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("ReadyEpoch")) or 0
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        if e.zone == zone and e.tier == tier and e.size == size and math.abs((e.ready or 0) - epoch) < 2 then
            return e, i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function animalListOf(plr)
    local Profile = _G.Profile
    local prof = Profile and Profile.get(plr)
    if not prof then return nil end
    if type(prof.NestAnimals) ~= "table" then prof.NestAnimals = {} end
    return prof.NestAnimals
end

local function rememberAnimal(plr, pen, pos, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    local list = animalListOf(plr)
    if not list then return end
    local cx, cz, hx, hz = penFrame(pen)
    if not cx then return end
    local key = newKey()
    list[#list + 1] = {
        key = key,
        zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size, species = species, luck = luck,
        u = math.clamp((pos.X - cx) / math.max(1, hx), -0.95, 0.95),
        v = math.clamp((pos.Z - cz) / math.max(1, hz), -0.95, 0.95),
    }
    return key
end

local function petInventoryOf(plr)
    local Profile = _G.Profile
    local prof = Profile and Profile.get(plr)
    if not prof then return nil end
    if type(prof.PetInventory) ~= "table" then prof.PetInventory = {} end
    return prof.PetInventory
end

local function forgetByKey(list, key)
    if not (list and key and key ~= "") then return false end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].key == key then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function forgetEgg(plr, zone, tier, size, readyAt, key)
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    if not list then return end
    if key then
        for i = #list, 1, -1 do
            if list[i].key == key then
                table.remove(list, i)
                return
            end
        end
        return
    end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        if e.zone == zone and e.tier == tier and e.size == size
           and math.abs((e.ready or 0) - readyAt) < 2 then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function deny(plr, text)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", text)
end

local function heldEgg(plr)
    local ch = plr.Character
    if not ch then return nil end
    for _, t in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
        if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("EggZone") then return t end
    end
    return nil
end

local function buildDisplay(tool, size)
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not handle then return nil end

    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    local root
    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local c = p:Clone()
            c:ClearAllChildren()
            c.Anchored = true
            c.CanCollide = false
            c.CanQuery = (p == handle)
            c.Massless = true
            c.CastShadow = false

            c.CFrame = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
            c.Parent = model
            if p == handle then root = c end
        end
    end
    if not root then model:Destroy() return nil end
    model.PrimaryPart = root

    local scale = Cfg.SIZES[size] and Cfg.SIZES[size].scale or 1
    local _, box = model:GetBoundingBox()
    if box.Y > 0.001 then
        model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * (DISPLAY_H * math.sqrt(scale) / box.Y))
    end
    return model
end

local function tooClose(pos)
    for _, egg in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
        local pp = egg.PrimaryPart
        if pp then
            local d = (Vector3.new(pp.Position.X, 0, pp.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(pos.X, 0, pos.Z)).Magnitude
            if d < MIN_GAP then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local hatchPrompt

local function placeEgg(plr, pos)
    if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return end

    local tool = heldEgg(plr)
    if not tool then
        deny(plr, "Hold an egg first")
        return
    end

    local pen = penAt(pos)
    if not pen then
        deny(plr, "You can only place eggs on your own plot")
        return
    end
    if pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= plr.UserId then
        deny(plr, "This isn't your plot")
        return
    end
    if tooClose(pos) then
        deny(plr, "Too close to another egg")
        return
    end

    local zone = tool:GetAttribute("EggZone") or 1
    local tier = tool:GetAttribute("EggTier") or 1
    local size = tool:GetAttribute("EggSize") or 1
    local species = tool:GetAttribute("EggSpecies")
    local luck = tool:GetAttribute("EggLuck")

    local model = buildDisplay(tool, size)
    if not model then return end
    model.Name = tool.Name

    local r = rects[pen]
    local _, box = model:GetBoundingBox()
    local ground = r and r.floorY or pos.Y
    model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos.X, ground + box.Y / 2, pos.Z))
    model.Parent = placed

    model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", plr.UserId)
    model:SetAttribute("EggZone", zone)
    model:SetAttribute("EggTier", tier)
    model:SetAttribute("EggSize", size)
    if species then model:SetAttribute("EggSpecies", species) end
    if luck then model:SetAttribute("EggLuck", luck) end
    model:SetAttribute("Ready", false)

    local growth = math.max(1, tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("GrowthMult")) or 1)
        * (_G.GlobalBoost and _G.GlobalBoost.value("hatch") or 1)
    local wait = Cfg.hatchTime(zone, size, tier) / growth
    model:SetAttribute("HatchAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + wait)
    model:SetAttribute("HatchTotal", wait)

    local readyAt = os.time() + wait
    model:SetAttribute("ReadyEpoch", readyAt)
    model:SetAttribute("EggKey", rememberEgg(plr, pen, pos, zone, tier, size, readyAt, species, luck))
    takeFromInventory(plr, zone, tier, size, species, luck)

    hatchPrompt(model)
    tool:Destroy()
end

local eggAssets = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("EggAssets")
local eggSet = eggAssets and eggAssets:FindFirstChild("Eggs")

local function eggTemplate(zone)
    if not eggSet then return nil end
    return eggSet:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone) or eggSet:FindFirstChild("Default")
end

local AnimalEggs = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("AnimalEggs"))

local function buildFromTemplate(zone, tier, size, species)
    local speciesTpl = AnimalEggs.template(species)
    local tpl = speciesTpl or eggTemplate(zone)
    if not tpl then return nil end
    local m = tpl:Clone()

    local colour = Cfg.eggColor(zone, tier)
    local accent = Color3.new(colour.R * 0.68, colour.G * 0.68, colour.B * 0.68)
    local glow = Cfg.GLOW[tier] or Cfg.GLOW[1]
    local root
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local isShell = p.Name:lower():match("^shell") ~= nil
            if not speciesTpl then
                p.Color = isShell and colour or (glow.deco and colour or accent)
                p.Material = ((isShell and glow.shell) or (not isShell and glow.deco))
                    and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            end
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanQuery = isShell
            p.Massless = true
            p.CastShadow = false
            if isShell and not root then root = p end
        end
    end
    if not root then
        for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then root = p break end
        end
    end
    if not root then m:Destroy() return nil end
    m.PrimaryPart = root

    local scale = Cfg.SIZES[size] and Cfg.SIZES[size].scale or 1
    local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
    if box.Y > 0.001 then
        m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (DISPLAY_H * math.sqrt(scale) / box.Y))
    end
    return m
end

local function restoreEggs(plr)
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    if not list or #list == 0 then return 0 end
    local pen = penOf(plr)
    if not pen then return 0 end
    local cx, cz, hx, hz = penFrame(pen)
    if not cx then return 0 end
    local r = rects[pen]
    local now = os.time()
    local built = 0

    for _, e in ipairs(list) do
        if e.species == nil then e.species = AnimalEggs.legacy(e.zone or 1, e.tier or 1, e.size or 1) end
        local m = buildFromTemplate(e.zone or 1, e.tier or 1, e.size or 1, e.species)
        if m then
            e.key = e.key or newKey()
            m:SetAttribute("EggKey", e.key)
            m.Name = ("%s %s %s Egg"):format(
                e.species or Cfg.NAMES[e.zone] or ("Zone" .. tostring(e.zone)),
                Cfg.TIERS[e.tier] and Cfg.TIERS[e.tier].name or "Common",
                Cfg.SIZES[e.size] and Cfg.SIZES[e.size].name or "Normal")
            local x = cx + (e.u or 0) * hx
            local z = cz + (e.v or 0) * hz
            local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
            m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, (r and r.floorY or 0) + box.Y / 2, z))
            m.Parent = placed

            m:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", plr.UserId)
            m:SetAttribute("EggZone", e.zone)
            m:SetAttribute("EggTier", e.tier)
            m:SetAttribute("EggSize", e.size)
            if e.species then m:SetAttribute("EggSpecies", e.species) end
            if e.luck then m:SetAttribute("EggLuck", e.luck) end
            m:SetAttribute("ReadyEpoch", e.ready or now)

            local left = math.max(0, (e.ready or now) - now)
            m:SetAttribute("HatchAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + left)
            m:SetAttribute("HatchTotal", math.max(left, Cfg.hatchTime(e.zone or 1, e.size or 1, e.tier or 1)))
            m:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
            hatchPrompt(m)
            built += 1
        end
    end
    return built
end

local function ball(parent, size, colour, cf, name)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = name
    p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    p.Size = size
    p.Color = colour
    p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    p.Anchored = true
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.CanQuery = false
    p.CastShadow = false
    p.CFrame = cf
    p.Parent = parent
    return p
end

local function animalIndex(size, tier)
    if tier >= 3 then return 6 + (tier - 2) end
    return math.clamp(size, 1, 6)
end

local function animalTemplate(zone, tier, size, species)
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
    folder = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone) or folder:FindFirstChild("Default"))
    if folder then
        local list = folder:GetChildren()
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
        if #list > 0 then

            local pick = species and folder:FindFirstChild(species)
            pick = pick or list[((animalIndex(size or 1, tier or 1) - 1) % #list) + 1]
            local copy = pick:Clone()

            Paint.paint(copy, tier or 1)
            return copy
        end
    end

    local colour = Cfg.eggColor(zone, tier)
    local dark = Color3.new(colour.R * 0.55, colour.G * 0.55, colour.B * 0.55)
    local m = Instance.new("Model")
    local body = ball(m, Vector3.new(2.2, 1.8, 2.8), colour, CFrame.new(0, 1.0, 0), "Handle")
    body.CanQuery = true
    m.PrimaryPart = body
    ball(m, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.4, 1.4), colour, CFrame.new(0, 1.7, -1.2), "Head")
    ball(m, Vector3.new(0.32, 0.32, 0.32), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), CFrame.new(-0.38, 1.9, -1.75), "EyeL")
    ball(m, Vector3.new(0.32, 0.32, 0.32), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), CFrame.new(0.38, 1.9, -1.75), "EyeR")
    for _, dx in ipairs({ -0.7, 0.7 }) do
        for _, dz in ipairs({ -0.8, 0.9 }) do
            ball(m, Vector3.new(0.6, 0.7, 0.6), dark, CFrame.new(dx, 0.35, dz), "Leg")
        end
    end
    return m
end

local function speciesSlot(zone, species)
    local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
    local folder = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone)
    if not (folder and species) then return nil end
    local list = folder:GetChildren()
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
    for i, m in ipairs(list) do
        if m.Name == species then return i end
    end
    return nil
end

local function grantAnimal(plr, zone, tier, size, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local m = animalTemplate(zone, tier, size, opts.species)
    if not m then return nil end

    m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * ((Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE and Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE[size]) or 1))
    local ownPen = penOf(plr)
    local r = ownPen and rects[ownPen]
    if r then
        local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local longest = math.max(box.X, box.Z)
        local room = math.min(r.maxX - r.minX, r.maxZ - r.minZ) * (Cfg.ANIMAL_PEN_FILL or 0.8)
        if longest > room and longest > 0.01 then
            m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (room / longest))
        end
    end

    if not opts.restoring and _G.PetIndex and _G.PetIndex.discover then
        pcall(_G.PetIndex.discover, plr, zone,
            speciesSlot(zone, opts.species) or animalIndex(size or 1, tier or 1))
    end

    local handle = m:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        or m:FindFirstChild(tostring(m:GetAttribute("RootPart")))
        or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if not handle then m:Destroy() return nil end
    local pivotOffset = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(m:GetPivot())

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = ("%s %s %s"):format(
        Cfg.NAMES[zone] or ("Zone" .. zone), Cfg.TIERS[tier].name, Cfg.SIZES[size].name)
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.CanBeDropped = false
    tool:SetAttribute("AnimalZone", zone)
    tool:SetAttribute("AnimalTier", tier)
    tool:SetAttribute("AnimalSize", size)
    tool:SetAttribute("Species", m:GetAttribute("Species") or tool.Name)
    if opts.luck then tool:SetAttribute("Luck", opts.luck) end

    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Anchored = false
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.Massless = true
        end
    end
    handle.Name = "Handle"

    handle:SetAttribute("RestOffset", CFrame.new())
    handle:SetAttribute("PivotOffset", pivotOffset)
    handle.Parent = tool
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p:SetAttribute("RestOffset", handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame))
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0 = handle
            w.Part1 = p
            w.Parent = handle
            p.Parent = tool
        end
    end
    m:Destroy()

    local key = opts.key or newKey()
    tool:SetAttribute("SaveKey", key)
    if not opts.restoring then
        local inv = petInventoryOf(plr)
        if inv then
            inv[#inv + 1] = { key = key, zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size,
                species = tool:GetAttribute("Species"), luck = opts.luck }
        end
    end

    tool.Parent = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or plr.Backpack
    return tool
end

local function heldAnimal(plr)
    local ch = plr.Character
    if not ch then return nil end
    for _, t in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
        if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") then return t end
    end
    return nil
end

local function animalsIn(pen)
    local n = 0
    for _, a in ipairs(animals:GetChildren()) do
        if a:GetAttribute("Pen") == pen.Name then n = n + 1 end
    end
    return n
end

local pushPets

local function placeAnimal(plr, pos, forcedTool)
    if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return end
    local tool = forcedTool or heldAnimal(plr)
    if not tool then
        deny(plr, "Hold a pet first")
        return
    end
    local pen = penAt(pos)
    if not pen then
        deny(plr, "You can only place pets in your own pen")
        return
    end
    if pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= plr.UserId then
        deny(plr, "This isn't your plot")
        return
    end
    local cap = animalCap(pen)
    if animalsIn(pen) >= cap then
        deny(plr, ("Pen limit is %d pets"):format(cap))
        return
    end
    if tooClose(pos) then
        deny(plr, "Too close to another pet")
        return
    end

    local zone = tool:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") or 1
    local tier = tool:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
    local size = tool:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1
    local species = tool:GetAttribute("Species")
    local luck = tool:GetAttribute("Luck")

    local m = animalTemplate(zone, tier, size, species)
    if not m then return end
    m.Name = tool.Name

    local scale = (Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE and Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE[size]) or 1
    m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * scale)

    local r = rects[pen]

    if r then
        local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local longest = math.max(box.X, box.Z)
        local room = math.min(r.maxX - r.minX, r.maxZ - r.minZ) * (Cfg.ANIMAL_PEN_FILL or 0.8)
        if longest > room and longest > 0.01 then
            m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (room / longest))
        end
    end

    local ground = r and r.floorY or pos.Y
    m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos.X, ground, pos.Z))

    m:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", plr.UserId)
    m:SetAttribute("Pen", pen.Name)
    m:SetAttribute("AnimalZone", zone)
    m:SetAttribute("AnimalTier", tier)
    m:SetAttribute("AnimalSize", size)
    m:SetAttribute("GroundY", ground)

    m:SetAttribute("Seed", math.random(1, 2 ^ 30))
    m:SetAttribute("SpawnAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())

    m:SetAttribute("Income", Cfg.petIncome(zone, size, tier, luck))
    if luck then m:SetAttribute("Luck", luck) end
    m:SetAttribute("Species", m:GetAttribute("Species") or m.Name)
    m:SetAttribute("Rarity", Cfg.TIERS[tier] and Cfg.TIERS[tier].name or "Common")

    m.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.PersistentPerPlayer
    local key = rememberAnimal(plr, pen, pos, zone, tier, size, m:GetAttribute("Species"), luck)
    m:SetAttribute("SaveKey", key or "")
    m.Parent = animals
    pcall(function() m:AddPersistentPlayer(plr) end)
    forgetByKey(petInventoryOf(plr), tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey"))
    tool:Destroy()
    if pushPets then pushPets(plr) end
    return true
end

local function wobble(model, seconds)
    if not model.PrimaryPart then return end
    local base = model:GetPivot()
    local t0 = os.clock()
    local last = t0
    local phase = 0
    while os.clock() - t0 < seconds do
        if not model.Parent then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local k = (now - t0) / seconds
        local rate = 16 + 30 * k
        phase += rate * (now - last)
        last = now
        local tilt = math.sin(phase) * math.rad(5 + 18 * k)
        local hop = math.abs(math.sin(phase * 0.5)) * 0.22 * k
        model:PivotTo(base * CFrame.new(0, hop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, tilt))
        task.wait()
    end
    if model.Parent then model:PivotTo(base) end
end

local function hatch(plr, model)
    local owner = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
    if owner ~= plr.UserId then
        deny(plr, "This isn't your egg")
        return
    end
    if not model:GetAttribute("Ready") then
        deny(plr, "This egg isn't ready yet")
        return
    end
    model:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
    local hatchZone = model:GetAttribute("EggZone") or 1
    local hatchTier = model:GetAttribute("EggTier") or 1
    local hatchSize = model:GetAttribute("EggSize") or 1
    local hatchEpoch = model:GetAttribute("ReadyEpoch") or 0
    local hatchKey = model:GetAttribute("EggKey")

    local zone = model:GetAttribute("EggZone") or 1
    local tier = model:GetAttribute("EggTier") or 1
    local size = model:GetAttribute("EggSize") or 1
    local species = model:GetAttribute("EggSpecies")
    local luck = model:GetAttribute("EggLuck")

    model:SetAttribute("Hatching", true)
    local pp = model.PrimaryPart
    local pr = pp and pp:FindFirstChild("Hatch")
    if pr then pr:Destroy() end
    local at = pp and pp.Position or Vector3.zero

    wobble(model, 1.1)
    if model.Parent then model:Destroy() end
    if not (plr.Parent and _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr)) then return end
    forgetEgg(plr, hatchZone, hatchTier, hatchSize, hatchEpoch, hatchKey)

    remote:FireClient(plr, "hatched", {
        zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size, species = species,
        x = at.X, y = at.Y, z = at.Z,
    })
    grantAnimal(plr, zone, tier, size, { species = species, luck = luck })
end

local function ripenOne(plr, model)
    if not (model and model.Parent) or model:GetAttribute("Ready") or model:GetAttribute("Hatching") then
        return false
    end
    local unix = os.time()
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    local rec = eggRecordOf(list, model)
    if rec then rec.ready = unix end
    model:SetAttribute("HatchAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    model:SetAttribute("ReadyEpoch", unix)
    return true
end

local pendingSkip = {}

local function grantSkip(plr)
    waitRestored(plr)
    local want = pendingSkip[plr]
    pendingSkip[plr] = nil
    if want and ripenOne(plr, want) then return true end
    local best, bestAt = nil, -math.huge
    for _, m in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
        if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId and not m:GetAttribute("Ready")
           and not m:GetAttribute("Hatching") then
            local at = m:GetAttribute("HatchAt") or 0
            if at > bestAt then best, bestAt = m, at end
        end
    end
    if best then ripenOne(plr, best) end
    return true
end

local function skipGrowth(plr, model)
    if model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= plr.UserId then
        deny(plr, "This isn't your egg")
        return
    end
    if model:GetAttribute("Ready") or model:GetAttribute("Hatching") then return end
    if SKIP_PRODUCT_ID > 0 then
        pendingSkip[plr] = model
        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):PromptProductPurchase(plr, SKIP_PRODUCT_ID)
        end)
    elseif game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and Money.STUDIO_TEST then
        ripenOne(plr, model)
        print(("[Nest] Skip Growth (Studio test) for %s"):format(plr.Name))
    else
        deny(plr, "Skip Growth - not available right now")
    end
end

local function growAllNow(plr)
    local n = 0
    for _, m in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
        if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId and ripenOne(plr, m) then n += 1 end
    end
    return n
end

local function growAll(plr)
    local growing = 0
    for _, m in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
        if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId and not m:GetAttribute("Ready")
           and not m:GetAttribute("Hatching") then
            growing += 1
        end
    end
    if growing == 0 then
        deny(plr, "No eggs are growing")
        return
    end
    if GROW_ALL_PRODUCT_ID > 0 then
        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):PromptProductPurchase(plr, GROW_ALL_PRODUCT_ID)
        end)
    elseif game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and Money.STUDIO_TEST then
        local n = growAllNow(plr)
        print(("[Nest] Grow All (Studio test) for %s: %d eggs"):format(plr.Name, n))
    else
        deny(plr, "Grow All - not available right now")
    end
end

local SKIP_TEXT = "Skip Growth!"

local function paintPrompt(pr, ready)
    pr.ObjectText = ready and "" or SKIP_TEXT
    pr.ActionText = ready and "Hatch" or SKIP_TEXT
end

function hatchPrompt(model)
    local pp = model.PrimaryPart
    if not pp then return end
    local pr = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
    pr.Name = "Hatch"
    pr.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
    pr:SetAttribute("EggPrompt", true)
    paintPrompt(pr, model:GetAttribute("Ready") == true)
    pr.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
    pr.HoldDuration = 0
    pr.RequiresLineOfSight = false
    pr.MaxActivationDistance = PROMPT_RANGE
    pr.Enabled = true
    pr.Parent = pp
    pr.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
        if model:GetAttribute("Ready") then
            hatch(plr, model)
        else
            skipGrowth(plr, model)
        end
    end)
end

local NightCycle=require(RS:WaitForChild("DayNightConfig"))
local nightRate=workspace:GetAttribute("CyclePhase")=="night" and NightCycle.NIGHT_HATCH_MULTIPLIER or 1
local nightTick=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function advanceNightEgg(model,now)
 local before=nightTick[model] or now
 nightTick[model]=now
 if model:GetAttribute("Ready") or model:GetAttribute("Hatching") then return end
 local at=tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HatchAt"))
 if not at or nightRate<=1 then return end
 local elapsed=math.max(0,now-before)
 local newAt=math.max(now,at-elapsed*(nightRate-1))
 if newAt==at then return end
 local oldEpoch=model:GetAttribute("ReadyEpoch")
 local newEpoch=(tonumber(oldEpoch) or os.time()+math.max(0,at-now))-(at-newAt)
 model:SetAttribute("HatchAt",newAt)
 model:SetAttribute("ReadyEpoch",newEpoch)
 local owner=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0)
 local list=owner and eggListOf(owner)
 if list then
  local record
  if model:GetAttribute("EggKey") then
   record=eggRecordOf(list,model)
  else
   for _,r in ipairs(list) do
    if r.ready==oldEpoch and r.zone==model:GetAttribute("EggZone")
     and r.size==model:GetAttribute("EggSize") and r.tier==model:GetAttribute("EggTier") then
     record=r break
    end
   end
  end
  if record then record.ready=newEpoch end
 end
end

pushPets = function(plr)
    if not plr.Parent then return end
    local pen = penOf(plr)
    if not pen then return end
    local level = math.clamp(tonumber(pen:GetAttribute("PlotLevel")) or 1, 1, PLOT_MAX_LEVEL)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "pets", {
        count = animalsIn(pen), cap = animalCap(pen),
        level = level, maxLevel = PLOT_MAX_LEVEL,
        price = (level < PLOT_MAX_LEVEL) and upgradePrice(level) or 0,
    })
end

local function petToolsOf(plr)
    local out = {}
    for _, holder in ipairs({ plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), plr.Character }) do
        if holder then
            for _, t in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") then table.insert(out, t) end
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

local function syncPetTools(plr)
    local inv = petInventoryOf(plr)
    if not inv or not plr.Parent then return 0 end
    local have = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(petToolsOf(plr)) do
        local k = t:GetAttribute("SaveKey")
        if not k or k == "" then
            k = newKey()
            t:SetAttribute("SaveKey", k)
            inv[#inv + 1] = { key = k, zone = t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") or 1,
                tier = t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1, size = t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1,
                species = t:GetAttribute("Species") }
        end
        have[k] = true
    end
    local made = 0
    for _, e in ipairs(inv) do
        e.key = e.key or newKey()
        if not have[e.key] then
            if grantAnimal(plr, e.zone or 1, e.tier or 1, e.size or 1,
                { key = e.key, restoring = true, species = e.species, luck = e.luck }) then
                made += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return made
end

local function unequipPet(plr, model)
    if not (typeof(model) == "Instance" and model.Parent == animals
        and model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId) then
        return false
    end
    local zone = model:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") or 1
    local tier = model:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
    local size = model:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1
    local list = animalListOf(plr)
    if list and not forgetByKey(list, model:GetAttribute("SaveKey")) then

        for i = #list, 1, -1 do
            local e = list[i]
            if e.zone == zone and e.tier == tier and e.size == size then
                table.remove(list, i)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    local species, luck = model:GetAttribute("Species"), model:GetAttribute("Luck")
    model:Destroy()
    grantAnimal(plr, zone, tier, size, { species = species, luck = luck })
    return true
end

local function freeSpot(pen)
    local r = rects[pen]
    if not r then return nil end
    local rng = Random.new()
    for _ = 1, 40 do
        local p = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(r.minX + 3, r.maxX - 3), r.floorY + 0.5,
            rng:NextNumber(r.minZ + 3, r.maxZ - 3))
        if not tooClose(p) then return p end
    end
    return nil
end

local function equipBest(plr)
    local pen = penOf(plr)
    if not pen then return end
    local cap = animalCap(pen)
    local all = {}
    for _, m in ipairs(animals:GetChildren()) do
        if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId then
            table.insert(all, { model = m, income = tonumber(m:GetAttribute("Income")) or 0 })
        end
    end
    for _, t in ipairs(petToolsOf(plr)) do
        table.insert(all, { tool = t, income = Cfg.petIncome(t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") or 1,
            t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1, t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1, t:GetAttribute("Luck")) })
    end
    if #all == 0 then
        deny(plr, "You have no pets yet")
        return
    end
    table.sort(all, function(a, b)
        if a.income ~= b.income then return a.income > b.income end
        return a.model ~= nil and b.model == nil
    end)
    local keep = {}
    for i = 1, math.min(cap, #all) do keep[all[i]] = true end

    local out, into = 0, 0
    for _, e in ipairs(all) do
        if e.model and not keep[e] and unequipPet(plr, e.model) then out += 1 end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(all) do
        if e.tool and keep[e] and e.tool.Parent then
            local spot = freeSpot(pen)
            if spot and placeAnimal(plr, spot, e.tool) then into += 1 end
        end
    end
    pushPets(plr)
end

local function upgradePlot(plr)

    if _G.PlotUpgrade and _G.PlotUpgrade.buy then
        _G.PlotUpgrade.buy(plr, "PEN")
        return
    end
    local pen = penOf(plr)
    local P = _G.Profile
    local prof = P and P.get(plr)
    if not (pen and prof) then return end
    local level = math.clamp(tonumber(pen:GetAttribute("PlotLevel")) or 1, 1, PLOT_MAX_LEVEL)
    if level >= PLOT_MAX_LEVEL then
        deny(plr, "Your plot is already max level")
        return
    end
    local price = upgradePrice(level)
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < price then
        deny(plr, "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", have - price)
    pen:SetAttribute("PlotLevel", level + 1)
    prof.PlotLevel = level + 1
    pushPets(plr)
end

local lastPetAction = {}
local function petBusy(plr)
    local now = os.clock()
    if (lastPetAction[plr] or 0) + 0.4 > now then return true end
    lastPetAction[plr] = now
    return false
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) lastPetAction[plr] = nil end)

local function ownEgg(plr, model)
    return typeof(model) == "Instance" and model.Parent == placed
        and model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId
end

local lastPlace = {}
local lastMisc = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    lastPlace[plr] = nil
    lastMisc[plr] = nil
end)
local function miscBusy(plr, kind, gap)
    local now = os.clock()
    local t = lastMisc[plr]
    if not t then
        t = {}
        lastMisc[plr] = t
    end
    if (t[kind] or 0) + gap > now then return true end
    t[kind] = now
    return false
end
local function placeBusy(plr)
    local now = os.clock()
    if (lastPlace[plr] or 0) + 0.2 > now then return true end
    lastPlace[plr] = now
    return false
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, arg)
    if action == "place" then
        if not placeBusy(plr) then placeEgg(plr, arg) end
    elseif action == "placeAnimal" then
        if not placeBusy(plr) then placeAnimal(plr, arg) end
    elseif action == "hatchEgg" then
        if ownEgg(plr, arg) and arg:GetAttribute("Ready") and not arg:GetAttribute("Hatching") then
            task.spawn(hatch, plr, arg)
        end
    elseif action == "skipEgg" then
        if ownEgg(plr, arg) and not miscBusy(plr, "prompt", 0.5) then skipGrowth(plr, arg) end
    elseif action == "growAll" then
        if not miscBusy(plr, "prompt", 0.5) then growAll(plr) end
    elseif action == "petsState" then
        if not miscBusy(plr, "pets", 0.1) then pushPets(plr) end
    elseif action == "unequipPet" then
        if not petBusy(plr) and unequipPet(plr, arg) then pushPets(plr) end
    elseif action == "equipBest" then
        if not petBusy(plr) then equipBest(plr) end
    elseif action == "upgradePlot" then
        if not petBusy(plr) then upgradePlot(plr) end
    end
end)

local function restoreAnimals(plr)
    local list = animalListOf(plr)
    if not list or #list == 0 then return 0 end
    local pen = penOf(plr)
    if not pen then return 0 end
    local cx, cz, hx, hz = penFrame(pen)
    if not cx then return 0 end
    local r = rects[pen]
    local built = 0

    for _, e in ipairs(list) do
        local zone, tier, size = e.zone or 1, e.tier or 1, e.size or 1
        local m = animalTemplate(zone, tier, size, e.species)
        if m then
            m.Name = ("%s %s %s"):format(
                Cfg.NAMES[zone] or ("Zone" .. zone),
                Cfg.TIERS[tier] and Cfg.TIERS[tier].name or "Common",
                Cfg.SIZES[size] and Cfg.SIZES[size].name or "Normal")
            m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * ((Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE and Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE[size]) or 1))
            if r then
                local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
                local longest = math.max(box.X, box.Z)
                local room = math.min(r.maxX - r.minX, r.maxZ - r.minZ) * (Cfg.ANIMAL_PEN_FILL or 0.8)
                if longest > room and longest > 0.01 then
                    m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (room / longest))
                end
            end
            local x = cx + (e.u or 0) * hx
            local z = cz + (e.v or 0) * hz
            local ground = r and r.floorY or 0
            m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, ground, z))
            m:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", plr.UserId)
            m:SetAttribute("Pen", pen.Name)
            m:SetAttribute("AnimalZone", zone)
            m:SetAttribute("AnimalTier", tier)
            m:SetAttribute("AnimalSize", size)
            m:SetAttribute("GroundY", ground)
            m:SetAttribute("Seed", math.random(1, 2 ^ 30))
            m:SetAttribute("SpawnAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
            m:SetAttribute("Income", Cfg.petIncome(zone, size, tier, e.luck))
            if e.luck then m:SetAttribute("Luck", e.luck) end
            m:SetAttribute("Species", e.species or m:GetAttribute("Species") or m.Name)
            m:SetAttribute("Rarity", Cfg.TIERS[tier] and Cfg.TIERS[tier].name or "Common")
            e.key = e.key or newKey()
            m:SetAttribute("SaveKey", e.key)
            m.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.PersistentPerPlayer
            m.Parent = animals
            pcall(function() m:AddPersistentPlayer(plr) end)
            built += 1
        end
    end
    return built
end

local function restoreWhenReady(plr)
    for _ = 1, 600 do
        if not plr.Parent then return end
        if _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr) and penOf(plr) then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end

    restored[plr] = true
    syncPetTools(plr)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        syncPetTools(plr)
    end)
    if n > 0 or a > 0 then
    end
end

source:
local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local pens = map:WaitForChild("SpawnPens")
local mills = map:WaitForChild("Treadmills")

local UpgradeCfg = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local MAX_LEVEL = UpgradeCfg.MAX_LEVEL
local SIZE_LEVELS = 6
local SPAN = 9.6

local FENCE_COLOURS = {
    [7]  = { post = Color3.fromRGB(104, 132, 196), rail = Color3.fromRGB(146, 182, 244) },
    [8]  = { post = Color3.fromRGB( 92, 168, 118), rail = Color3.fromRGB(136, 226, 158) },
    [9]  = { post = Color3.fromRGB(158, 108, 200), rail = Color3.fromRGB(206, 152, 250) },
    [10] = { post = Color3.fromRGB(206, 116,  64), rail = Color3.fromRGB(252, 168,  92) },
    [11] = { post = Color3.fromRGB(190,  58,  74), rail = Color3.fromRGB(248, 104, 118) },
    [12] = { post = Color3.fromRGB(168, 132,  30), rail = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214,  76),
             neon = true },
}

local MILL_COLOURS = {
    Color3.fromRGB( 72, 208, 240), Color3.fromRGB( 74, 162, 250),
    Color3.fromRGB(120, 130, 252), Color3.fromRGB(176, 110, 248),
    Color3.fromRGB(232, 100, 224), Color3.fromRGB(250, 88, 150),
    Color3.fromRGB(252, 96, 84),   Color3.fromRGB(254, 148, 52),
    Color3.fromRGB(252, 204, 48),  Color3.fromRGB(178, 230, 56),
    Color3.fromRGB( 68, 220, 122), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 76),
}

local function fenceParts(pen)
    local sign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local list = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(pen:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) then
            list[#list + 1] = p
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function bounds(parts)
    local lo = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    local hi = Vector3.new(-1e9, -1e9, -1e9)
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        lo = lo:Min(p.Position - p.Size / 2)
        hi = hi:Max(p.Position + p.Size / 2)
    end
    return lo, hi
end

local function sideOf(p, lo, hi)
    local midX, midZ = (lo.X + hi.X) / 2, (lo.Z + hi.Z) / 2
    local nx = math.abs(p.Position.X - midX) / math.max(0.01, (hi.X - lo.X) / 2)
    local nz = math.abs(p.Position.Z - midZ) / math.max(0.01, (hi.Z - lo.Z) / 2)
    if nx > nz then
        return p.Position.X < midX and "W" or "E"
    end
    return p.Position.Z < midZ and "S" or "N"
end

local function findEntrance(parts, lo, hi)
    local bySide = { W = {}, E = {}, S = {}, N = {} }
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        table.insert(bySide[sideOf(p, lo, hi)], p)
    end
    local best, bestGap = nil, 0
    for key, list in pairs(bySide) do
        local along = (key == "S" or key == "N") and "X" or "Z"
        local coords = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(list) do coords[#coords + 1] = p.Position[along] end
        table.sort(coords)
        for i = 2, #coords do
            local d = coords[i] - coords[i - 1]
            if d > bestGap then bestGap = d best = key end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local plots = {}

local function describe(pen)
    local parts = fenceParts(pen)
    if #parts == 0 then return end
    local lo, hi = bounds(parts)
    local front = findEntrance(parts, lo, hi) or "S"

    local axis = (front == "S" or front == "N") and "Z" or "X"
    local dir = (front == "S" or front == "W") and 1 or -1

    local base = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        base[p] = { cf = p.CFrame, colour = p.Color, material = p.Material }
    end

    plots[pen] = {
        pen = pen, axis = axis, dir = dir, front = front,
        base = base, grown = 0, tinted = false,
    }
    pen:SetAttribute("GrowAxis", axis)
    pen:SetAttribute("Entrance", front)
end

local function alongOf(rec, p)
    return p.Position[rec.axis] * rec.dir
end

local function backRow(rec, parts)
    local back
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p.Size.Y > 4 then
            local c = alongOf(rec, p)
            if not back or c > back then back = c end
        end
    end
    return back
end

local function grow(rec)
    local parts = fenceParts(rec.pen)
    local back = backRow(rec, parts)
    if not back then return false end

    local shift = (rec.axis == "Z") and Vector3.new(0, 0, SPAN * rec.dir)
                                     or Vector3.new(SPAN * rec.dir, 0, 0)
    local edge = back - SPAN / 2 + 0.05

    local toClone = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        local c = alongOf(rec, p)
        if c > edge then
            p.CFrame = p.CFrame + shift
        elseif c >= back - SPAN - 0.05 then
            toClone[#toClone + 1] = p
        end
    end

    rec.grown += 1
    for _, p in ipairs(toClone) do
        local c = p:Clone()
        c.CFrame = p.CFrame + shift
        c:SetAttribute("GrownStep", rec.grown)
        c.Parent = p.Parent
    end
    return true
end

local function shrink(rec)
    if rec.grown <= 0 then return false end
    local step = rec.grown
    for _, p in ipairs(fenceParts(rec.pen)) do
        if p:GetAttribute("GrownStep") == step then p:Destroy() end
    end

    local parts = fenceParts(rec.pen)
    local back = backRow(rec, parts)
    if not back then return false end
    local shift = (rec.axis == "Z") and Vector3.new(0, 0, -SPAN * rec.dir)
                                     or Vector3.new(-SPAN * rec.dir, 0, 0)
    local edge = back - SPAN / 2 + 0.05
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if alongOf(rec, p) > edge then p.CFrame = p.CFrame + shift end
    end
    rec.grown -= 1
    return true
end

local function tint(rec, level)
    local scheme = FENCE_COLOURS[level]
    for _, p in ipairs(fenceParts(rec.pen)) do
        local isPost = p.Size.Y > 4
        if scheme then
            p.Color = isPost and scheme.post or scheme.rail
            p.Material = scheme.neon and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        else
            local b = rec.base[p]

            if b then
                p.Color = b.colour
                p.Material = b.material
            end
        end
    end
    rec.tinted = scheme ~= nil
end

local function applyPlot(pen)
    local rec = plots[pen]
    if not rec then return end
    local level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pen:GetAttribute("PlotLevel")) or 1), 1, MAX_LEVEL)
    local wantGrown = math.min(level, SIZE_LEVELS) - 1
    while rec.grown < wantGrown do
        if not grow(rec) then break end
    end
    while rec.grown > wantGrown do
        if not shrink(rec) then break end
    end
    tint(rec, level)
    pen:SetAttribute("AnimalCap", UpgradeCfg.petCap(level))
end

local function showSurfaces(part, visible)
    for _, t in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if t:IsA("Texture") or t:IsA("Decal") then
            local base = t:GetAttribute("MillTextureTransparency")
            if base == nil then base = t.Transparency t:SetAttribute("MillTextureTransparency", base) end
            t.Transparency = visible and base or 1
        end
    end
end

local function applyMill(mill)
    local level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(mill:GetAttribute("MillLevel")) or 1), 1, MAX_LEVEL)
    local colour = MILL_COLOURS[level] or MILL_COLOURS[1]
    local sign = mill:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local wood = mill:FindFirstChild("WoodLevelOne")
    for _, p in ipairs(mill:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) then

            if wood and p:IsDescendantOf(wood) then
                p.Transparency = level == 1 and 0 or 1
                showSurfaces(p, level == 1)
                continue
            end
            local original = p:GetAttribute("MillOriginalTransparency")
            if original ~= nil then p.Transparency = level == 1 and 1 or original end
            showSurfaces(p, p.Transparency < 1)
            local keep = p.Name == "belt" or p.Name == "ArrowPad" or p.Name:find("belt")
            if not keep then p.Color = colour end
        end
    end
end

for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
    describe(pen)
    applyPlot(pen)
    pen:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlotLevel"):Connect(function() applyPlot(pen) end)
end

for _, mill in ipairs(mills:GetChildren()) do
    applyMill(mill)
    mill:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MillLevel"):Connect(function() applyMill(mill) end)
end

_G.Levels = {
    MAX = MAX_LEVEL,
    SIZE_LEVELS = SIZE_LEVELS,
    animalCap = UpgradeCfg.petCap,
}

print(("[Level] %d pens, %d treadmills, %d levels (size grows until %d)")
    :format(#pens:GetChildren(), #mills:GetChildren(), MAX_LEVEL, SIZE_LEVELS))

local EXTRA_H = 320
local SHOW = false

require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local walls = map:WaitForChild("Walls")

local old = map:FindFirstChild("Barriers")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Barriers"
folder.Parent = map

local made = 0
for _, part in ipairs(walls:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then

        local cf, sz = part.CFrame, part.Size
        local top = cf.Position.Y
            + math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * sz.X / 2
            + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)    * sz.Y / 2
            + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)  * sz.Z / 2
        local spanX = math.abs(cf.RightVector.X) * sz.X
            + math.abs(cf.UpVector.X) * sz.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.X) * sz.Z
        local spanZ = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Z) * sz.X
            + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Z) * sz.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Z) * sz.Z

        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Name = "Barrier"
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.CanCollide = true
        wall.CanTouch = false
        wall.CanQuery = false
        wall.CastShadow = false
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)
        wall.Transparency = SHOW and 0.75 or 1
        wall.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(spanX, 1), EXTRA_H, math.max(spanZ, 1))
        wall.Position = Vector3.new(cf.Position.X, top + EXTRA_H / 2, cf.Position.Z)
        wall.Parent = folder
        made += 1
    end
end

print(("[Bounds] %d barriers above walls, +%d studs"):format(made, EXTRA_H))

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local EggCfg = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local SharedConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local ST = SharedConfig.Streaming or {}
local AHEAD = ST.Ahead or 3
local BEHIND = ST.Behind or 2
local EVERY = ST.Every or 0.7

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local zonesFolder = map:WaitForChild("Zones")

local ALWAYS = {}
for _, n in ipairs(ST.AlwaysLoaded or { 1, 2 }) do ALWAYS[n] = true end

local decor = {}
local bounds = {}

for n = 1, EggCfg.ZONES do
	local folder
	for _, z in ipairs(zonesFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if z.Name:match("^Zone" .. n .. "_") then folder = z break end
	end
	local d = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Decor")
	if d and d:IsA("Model") then
		if ALWAYS[n] then
			d.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
		else
			d.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.PersistentPerPlayer
			decor[n] = d
		end
	end
	local top, bot = EggCfg.bounds(n)
	bounds[n] = { top = top, bot = bot }
end

local function zoneAt(z)
	for n = 1, EggCfg.ZONES do
		local b = bounds[n]
		if b and z <= b.top and z >= b.bot then return n end
	end
	if z > bounds[1].top then return 0 end
	return EggCfg.ZONES
end

local held = {}

local function apply(plr, centre)
	local mine = held[plr]
	if not mine then mine = {} held[plr] = mine end
	for n, model in pairs(decor) do
		local want = (n >= centre - BEHIND) and (n <= centre + AHEAD)
		if want ~= (mine[n] == true) then
			local ok = pcall(function()
				if want then
					model:AddPersistentPlayer(plr)
				else
					model:RemovePersistentPlayer(plr)
				end
			end)
			if ok then mine[n] = want or nil end
		end
	end
end

local function rootOf(plr)
	local ch = plr.Character
	return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) held[plr] = nil end)

local LIBRARY_DELAY = ST.LibraryDelay or 3
local library = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")

local function onJoin(plr)
	task.spawn(function()
		local placed = false
		for _ = 1, 60 do
			local root = rootOf(plr)
			if root then apply(plr, zoneAt(root.Position.Z)) placed = true break end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		if not placed then apply(plr, 0) end

		task.wait(LIBRARY_DELAY)
		if library and plr.Parent then
			pcall(function() library:AddPersistentPlayer(plr) end)
		end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(plr) end

local last = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) last[plr] = nil end)
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(EVERY)
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local root = rootOf(plr)
			if root then
				local n = zoneAt(root.Position.Z)
				if last[plr] ~= n then
					last[plr] = n
					apply(plr, n)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local count = 0
for _ in pairs(decor) do count += 1 end
print(("[Streaming] %d decor zones, window -%d/+%d")
	:format(count, BEHIND, AHEAD))

name: PetIndexService
source:
local Bats=require(game.ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("BatService"))
Bats.init()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local ZONES = Cfg.ZONES
local PER_ZONE = 8

local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild("PetIndex")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "PetIndex"
	remote.Parent = remotes
end

local function speciesNames(zone)
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	local folder = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone)
	local names = {}
	if folder then
		local kids = folder:GetChildren()
		table.sort(kids, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
		for i, m in ipairs(kids) do
			if i > PER_ZONE then break end
			names[i] = m.Name
		end
	end
	return names
end

local RARITY = require(RS:WaitForChild("AnimalRarity"))

local function tierFor(zone, slot)
	local name = speciesNames(zone)[slot]
	return (name and RARITY[name]) or ((slot == 8) and 4 or (slot == 7) and 3 or 1)
end

local function slotInfo(zone, slot)
	local name = speciesNames(zone)[slot]
	local tier = tierFor(zone, slot)
	local tierName = Cfg.TIERS[tier] and Cfg.TIERS[tier].name or "Common"
	return {
		tier = tier,
		rarity = tierName,
		source = (name or tierName) .. " eggs",
		income = Cfg.animalIncome(zone, 3, tier),
	}
end

local IDX = Cfg.INDEX or {}

local function rewardFor(zone)
	local money = math.floor(Cfg.animalIncome(zone, IDX.MONEY_SIZE or 3, IDX.MONEY_TIER or 2) * (IDX.MONEY_SECONDS or 120))
	local nextNeed = Cfg.POWER_N and Cfg.POWER_N[zone + 1]
	local speed
	if nextNeed then
		speed = nextNeed * (IDX.SPEED_NEXT_ZONE_SHARE or 0.5)
	else
		speed = ((Cfg.POWER_N and Cfg.POWER_N[zone]) or 1) * (IDX.SPEED_LAST_ZONE_MULT or 2)
	end
	speed = math.floor(math.min(math.max(speed, 1), Cfg.SPEED_MAX))
	return money, speed
end

local function slotReward(zone, slot)
	local money, speed = rewardFor(zone)
	local TIER_MULT = { 1, 1.5, 3, 5 }
	local k = (TIER_MULT[tierFor(zone, slot)] or 1) / (IDX.SLOT_DIVISOR or 4)
	return math.max(1, math.floor(money * k)), math.max(1, math.floor(speed * k))
end

local function profileOf(plr)
	local P = _G.Profile
	local prof = P and P.get(plr)
	if not prof then return nil end
	if type(prof.PetIndex) ~= "table" then prof.PetIndex = {} end
	if type(prof.IndexClaimed) ~= "table" then prof.IndexClaimed = {} end
	return prof
end

local function key(zone, slot) return zone .. "_" .. slot end

local function listHas(list, value)
	for _, v in ipairs(list) do
		if v == value then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function buildState(plr)
	local prof = profileOf(plr)
	if not prof then return nil end
	local found = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(prof.PetIndex) do found[k] = true end
	local took = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(prof.IndexClaimed) do
		if type(k) == "string" then took[k] = true end
	end

	local zones, total, readyAll = {}, 0, 0
	for zone = 1, ZONES do
		local names = speciesNames(zone)
		local slots, count, ready = {}, 0, 0
		for slot = 1, PER_ZONE do
			local info = slotInfo(zone, slot)
			local got = found[key(zone, slot)] == true
			local claimed = took[key(zone, slot)] == true
			if got then count += 1 end
			if got and not claimed then ready += 1 end
			local money, speed = slotReward(zone, slot)
			slots[slot] = {
				name = names[slot] or "?",
				found = got,
				claimed = claimed,
				tier = info.tier,
				rarity = info.rarity,
				source = info.source,
				income = info.income,
				money = money,
				speed = speed,
			}
		end
		total += count
		readyAll += ready
		zones[zone] = {
			name = Cfg.NAMES[zone] or ("Zone " .. zone),
			slots = slots,
			count = count,
			ready = ready,
		}
	end
	return { zones = zones, total = total, max = ZONES * PER_ZONE, ready = readyAll, equippedBat = Bats.equipped(plr) }
end

local function push(plr)
	local s = buildState(plr)
	if s then remote:FireClient(plr, "state", s) end
end

local function discover(plr, zone, slot, silent)
	zone, slot = tonumber(zone), tonumber(slot)
	if not zone or not slot then return false end
	if zone < 1 or zone > ZONES or slot < 1 or slot > PER_ZONE then return false end
	local prof = profileOf(plr)
	if not prof then return false end
	local k = key(zone, slot)
	if listHas(prof.PetIndex, k) then return false end
	table.insert(prof.PetIndex, k)
	if not silent then
		local names = speciesNames(zone)
		remote:FireClient(plr, "found", {
			zone = zone, slot = slot, name = names[slot] or "?",
			complete = (function()
				for s = 1, PER_ZONE do
					if not listHas(prof.PetIndex, key(zone, s)) then return false end
				end
				return true
			end)(),
		})
		push(plr)
	end
	return true
end

local ANIMAL_SLOT = function(size, tier)
	if (tier or 1) >= 3 then return 6 + ((tier or 3) - 2) end
	return math.clamp(size or 1, 1, 6)
end

local function slotOfSpecies(zone, sp)
	if type(sp) ~= "string" then return nil end
	for i, n in ipairs(speciesNames(zone)) do
		if n == sp then return i end
	end
	return nil
end

local function backfill(plr)
	local prof
	for _ = 1, 120 do
		prof = profileOf(plr)
		if prof or not plr.Parent then break end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	if not prof then return end
	local added = 0
	if type(prof.NestAnimals) == "table" then
		for _, e in ipairs(prof.NestAnimals) do
			local zone = tonumber(e.zone)
			if zone and discover(plr, zone, slotOfSpecies(zone, e.species) or ANIMAL_SLOT(tonumber(e.size), tonumber(e.tier)), true) then
				added += 1
			end
		end
	end
	task.wait(6)
	local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if bag then
		for _, t in ipairs(bag:GetChildren()) do
			local zone = tonumber(t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"))
			if zone and discover(plr, zone, slotOfSpecies(zone, t:GetAttribute("Species")) or
				ANIMAL_SLOT(tonumber(t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize")), tonumber(t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier"))), true) then
				added += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if added > 0 then push(plr) end
end

local busy = {}

local function claim(plr, zone, slot)
	zone, slot = tonumber(zone), tonumber(slot)
	if not zone or zone < 1 or zone > ZONES then return end
	if not slot or slot < 1 or slot > PER_ZONE then return end
	if busy[plr] then return end
	busy[plr] = true

	local prof = profileOf(plr)
	local k = key(zone, slot)
	local ok, why = false, nil
	if not prof then
		why = "Profile not loaded yet"
	elseif listHas(prof.IndexClaimed, k) then
		why = "Already claimed"
	elseif not listHas(prof.PetIndex, k) then
		why = "Hatch this pet first"
	else
		local money, speed = slotReward(zone, slot)
		local P = _G.Profile
		local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
		P.set(plr, "Coins", have + money)
		local cur = tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("Speed")) or Cfg.SPEED_START
		plr:SetAttribute("Speed", math.min(cur + speed, Cfg.SPEED_MAX))
		table.insert(prof.IndexClaimed, k)
		local names = speciesNames(zone)
		remote:FireClient(plr, "claimed", {
			zone = zone, slot = slot, name = names[slot] or "?", money = money, speed = speed,
		})
		ok = true
	end
	if not ok and why then remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", why) end
	push(plr)
	task.delay(0.4, function() busy[plr] = nil end)
end

local function claimAll(plr)
	if busy[plr] then return end
	busy[plr] = true
	local prof = profileOf(plr)
	if not prof then
		remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Profile not loaded yet")
		task.delay(0.4, function() busy[plr] = nil end)
		return
	end

	local took = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(prof.IndexClaimed) do took[k] = true end
	local money, speed, n = 0, 0, 0
	for _, k in ipairs(prof.PetIndex) do
		if type(k) == "string" and not took[k] then
			local z, s = k:match("^(%d+)_(%d+)$")
			z, s = tonumber(z), tonumber(s)
			if z and s and z >= 1 and z <= ZONES and s >= 1 and s <= PER_ZONE then
				local m, sp = slotReward(z, s)
				money += m
				speed += sp
				n += 1
				table.insert(prof.IndexClaimed, k)
				took[k] = true
			end
		end
	end

	if n > 0 then
		local P = _G.Profile
		local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
		P.set(plr, "Coins", have + money)
		local cur = tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("Speed")) or Cfg.SPEED_START
		plr:SetAttribute("Speed", math.min(cur + speed, Cfg.SPEED_MAX))
		remote:FireClient(plr, "claimedAll", { count = n, money = money, speed = speed })
	else
		remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Nothing to claim")
	end
	push(plr)
	task.delay(0.4, function() busy[plr] = nil end)
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, arg, arg2)
	if action == "equipBat" then
        if not Bats.equip(plr, arg) then remote:FireClient(plr,"deny","Collect all 8 pets in this zone to unlock its bat") end
        push(plr)
    elseif action == "state" then
		if busy[plr] then return end
		busy[plr] = true
		push(plr)
		task.delay(0.4, function() busy[plr] = nil end)
	elseif action == "claim" then
		claim(plr, arg, arg2)
	elseif action == "claimAll" then
		claimAll(plr)
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) task.spawn(backfill, plr) end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(backfill, plr) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) busy[plr] = nil end)

_G.PetIndex = {
	discover = discover,
	slotOf = ANIMAL_SLOT,
	rewardFor = rewardFor,
	slotReward = slotReward,
}

local m1, s1 = slotReward(1, 1)
local m12, s12 = slotReward(ZONES, 8)
print(("[Index] %d zones x %d species, reward for each | zone 1 Tiny: $%s + %s speed | zone %d Legendary: $%s + %s speed")
	:format(ZONES, PER_ZONE, Cfg.fmtSpeed(m1), Cfg.fmtSpeed(s1), ZONES, Cfg.fmtSpeed(m12), Cfg.fmtSpeed(s12)))

name: TrailService
source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local Trails = require(RS:WaitForChild("TrailConfig"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("Trails")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "Trails"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local function profileOf(plr)
    local P = _G.Profile
    return P and P.get(plr)
end

local function ownedSet(prof)
    local set = {}
    if prof and type(prof.TrailsOwned) == "table" then
        for _, id in ipairs(prof.TrailsOwned) do
            if Trails.byId(id) then set[id] = true end
        end
    end
    return set
end

local function push(plr)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (prof and plr.Parent) then return end
    remote:FireClient(plr, "state", {
        owned = ownedSet(prof),
        equipped = Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped) and prof.TrailEquipped or "",
    })
end

local PARTS = { "EggTrail", "EggTrailTop", "EggTrailBottom" }

local function dressCharacter(plr)
    local ch = plr.Character
    local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    for _, name in ipairs(PARTS) do
        local old = root:FindFirstChild(name)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end

    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    local def = prof and Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped)
    if not def then return end

    local V = Trails.VISUAL
    local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
    top.Name = "EggTrailTop"
    top.Position = Vector3.new(0, V.top, V.back)
    top.Parent = root

    local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
    bottom.Name = "EggTrailBottom"
    bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, V.bottom, V.back)
    bottom.Parent = root

    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Name = "EggTrail"
    trail.Attachment0 = top
    trail.Attachment1 = bottom
    trail.FaceCamera = false
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(def.colors[1], def.colors[2] or def.colors[1])
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.45),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.55),
    })
    trail.Lifetime = V.lifetime
    trail.MinLength = 0.05
    trail.LightEmission = V.lightEmission
    trail.LightInfluence = 0
    trail.Parent = root
end

local function apply(plr)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    local def = prof and Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped)
    plr:SetAttribute("TrailMult", def and def.mult or 1)
    plr:SetAttribute("Trail", def and def.id or "")
    dressCharacter(plr)
    push(plr)
end

local function equip(plr, id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (prof and Trails.byId(id) and ownedSet(prof)[id]) then return end
    prof.TrailEquipped = id
    apply(plr)
end

local function unequip(plr)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not prof then return end
    prof.TrailEquipped = ""
    apply(plr)
end

local function grant(plr, id)
    local def = Trails.byId(id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (def and prof) then return false end
    if type(prof.TrailsOwned) ~= "table" then prof.TrailsOwned = {} end
    if not ownedSet(prof)[id] then
        table.insert(prof.TrailsOwned, id)
    end
    local current = Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped)
    if not current or def.mult >= current.mult then
        prof.TrailEquipped = id
    end
    apply(plr)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "bought", def.name)
    return true
end

local function buyWithCoins(plr, id)
    local def = Trails.byId(id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    local P = _G.Profile
    if not (def and prof and P) then return end
    if ownedSet(prof)[id] then
        equip(plr, id)
        return
    end
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < def.price then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", have - def.price)
    grant(plr, id)
end

local function buyWithRobux(plr, id)
    local def = Trails.byId(id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (def and prof) then return end
    if ownedSet(prof)[id] then
        equip(plr, id)
        return
    end

    if (def.productId or 0) > 0 then
        pcall(function() MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(plr, def.productId) end)
    else
        remote:FireClient(plr, "noProduct", def.name)
    end
end

local lastAction = {}

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, id)
    if action == "state" then
        push(plr)
        return
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (lastAction[plr] or 0) + 0.25 > now then return end
    lastAction[plr] = now

    if action == "unequip" then
        unequip(plr)
    elseif type(id) == "string" then
        if action == "buy" then
            buyWithCoins(plr, id)
        elseif action == "robux" then
            buyWithRobux(plr, id)
        elseif action == "equip" then
            equip(plr, id)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 200 do
        if _G.Purchases and _G.Purchases.register then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    local Purchases = _G.Purchases
    if not (Purchases and Purchases.register) then
        warn("[TRAILS] no _G.Purchases - Robux trails are not hooked up")
        return
    end
    for _, def in ipairs(Trails.LIST) do
        Purchases.register("Trail_" .. def.id, def.productId or 0, function(plr)
            return grant(plr, def.id)
        end)
    end
end)

local function watch(plr)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        dressCharacter(plr)
    end)
    for _ = 1, 150 do
        if not plr.Parent or profileOf(plr) then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
    if plr.Parent and profileOf(plr) then apply(plr) end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) task.spawn(watch, plr) end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(watch, plr) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) lastAction[plr] = nil end)

_G.Trails = {
    grant = grant,
    equip = equip,
    unequip = unequip,
    owned = function(plr) return ownedSet(profileOf(plr)) end,
}

print(("[TRAILS] %d trails, %s .. %s"):format(#Trails.LIST,
    Trails.fmtMult(Trails.LIST[1].mult), Trails.fmtMult(Trails.LIST[#Trails.LIST].mult)))

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local U = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("PlotUpgrade")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "PlotUpgrade"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local SPEC = {
    PEN  = { attr = "PlotLevel", field = "PlotLevel", holder = function(plot) return plot.pen end },
    MILL = { attr = "MillLevel", field = "MillLevel", holder = function(plot) return plot.mill end },
}

local function plotOf(plr)
    return _G.Plots and _G.Plots.of(plr)
end

local restored = {}

local function levelOf(plr, kind)
    local plot = plotOf(plr)
    local s = SPEC[kind]
    if not (plot and s and restored[plr]) then return nil end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(s.holder(plot):GetAttribute(s.attr)) or 1), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL)
end

local function deny(plr, text)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", text)
end

local function setLevel(plr, kind, level)
    local plot = plotOf(plr)
    local s = SPEC[kind]
    if not (plot and s) then return end
    level = math.clamp(math.floor(level), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL)
    s.holder(plot):SetAttribute(s.attr, level)
    local prof = _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr)
    if prof then prof[s.field] = level end
    if kind == "PEN" and _G.Nest and _G.Nest.pushPets then _G.Nest.pushPets(plr) end
    remote:FireClient(plr, "upgraded", { kind = kind, level = level })
end

local function buy(plr, kind)
    if not SPEC[kind] then return end
    local level = levelOf(plr, kind)
    if not level then return end
    if level >= U.MAX_LEVEL then
        deny(plr, U[kind].name .. " is already max level")
        return
    end
    local P = _G.Profile
    if not P then return end
    local price = U.price(kind, level)
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < price then
        deny(plr, "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", have - price)
    setLevel(plr, kind, level + 1)
end

local function buyRobux(plr, kind)
    if not SPEC[kind] then return end
    local level = levelOf(plr, kind)
    if not level then return end
    if level >= U.MAX_LEVEL then
        deny(plr, U[kind].name .. " is already max level")
        return
    end
    local id = U.productId(kind, level)
    if id > 0 then
        pcall(function() MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(plr, id) end)
    else
        remote:FireClient(plr, "noProduct", U[kind].name .. " upgrade")
    end
end

local last = {}
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, kind)
    local now = os.clock()
    if (last[plr] or 0) + 0.35 > now then return end
    last[plr] = now
    if action == "buy" then
        buy(plr, kind)
    elseif action == "robux" then
        buyRobux(plr, kind)
    end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    last[plr] = nil
    restored[plr] = nil
end)

task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 200 do
        if _G.Purchases and _G.Purchases.register then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    local Purchases = _G.Purchases
    if not (Purchases and Purchases.register) then return end
    for _, kind in ipairs({ "PEN", "MILL" }) do
        for level = 1, U.MAX_LEVEL - 1 do
            local id = U.productId(kind, level)
            if id > 0 then
                Purchases.register(("Upgrade_%s_%d"):format(kind, level), id, function(plr)
                    local now = levelOf(plr, kind)
                    if not now then return false end
                    if now == level then
                        setLevel(plr, kind, now + 1)
                    else
                        local P = _G.Profile
                        if not P then return false end
                        P.set(plr, "Coins", (P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0) + U.price(kind, level))
                        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", ("%s is already level %d - refunded as money"):format(U[kind].name, now))
                    end
                    return true
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function restore(plr)
    for _ = 1, 600 do
        if not plr.Parent then return end
        if _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr) and plotOf(plr) then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
    local prof = _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr)
    local plot = plotOf(plr)
    if not (prof and plot) then return end
    for _, s in pairs(SPEC) do
        s.holder(plot):SetAttribute(s.attr,
            math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(prof[s.field]) or 1), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL))
    end
    if plr.Parent then restored[plr] = true end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) task.spawn(restore, plr) end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(restore, plr) end

_G.PlotUpgrade = { buy = buy, buyRobux = buyRobux, setLevel = setLevel, levelOf = levelOf }

print(("[UPGRADE] pen and treadmill upgrades ready, max level %d"):format(U.MAX_LEVEL))

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Sell = require(RS:WaitForChild("SellConfig"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("Sell")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "Sell"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local function ownsTool(plr, tool)
    if typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
    local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (bag and tool.Parent == bag) or (plr.Character ~= nil and tool.Parent == plr.Character)
end

local function forgetPet(prof, tool)
    local key = tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey")
    local list = prof.PetInventory
    if type(list) ~= "table" or type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then return end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].key == key then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function forgetEgg(prof, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    local list = prof.Eggs
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        if e.z == zone and e.t == tier and e.s == size and e.sp == species and e.lk == luck then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local last = {}

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, kind, tools)
    if action ~= "sell" or (kind ~= "Pets" and kind ~= "Eggs" and kind ~= "All") or type(tools) ~= "table" then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (last[plr] or 0) + 0.5 > now then return end
    last[plr] = now

    local P = _G.Profile
    local prof = P and P.get(plr)
    if not prof then return end
    local eggsBlocked = plr:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") == true
    if kind == "Eggs" and eggsBlocked then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Bring your egg home first")
        return
    end
    local takePets = kind == "Pets" or kind == "All"
    local takeEggs = (kind == "Eggs" or kind == "All") and not eggsBlocked

    local total, count = 0, 0
    local seen = {}
    for i, tool in ipairs(tools) do
        if i > 500 then break end
        if not seen[tool] and ownsTool(plr, tool) then
            seen[tool] = true
            if takePets and tool:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") then
                local z, t, s = tool:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"), tool:GetAttribute("AnimalTier"), tool:GetAttribute("AnimalSize")
                total += Sell.price("Pets", z, t, s, tool:GetAttribute("Luck"))
                forgetPet(prof, tool)
                tool:Destroy()
                count += 1
            elseif takeEggs and tool:GetAttribute("EggZone") then
                local z, t, s = tool:GetAttribute("EggZone"), tool:GetAttribute("EggTier"), tool:GetAttribute("EggSize")
                total += Sell.price("Eggs", z, t, s, tool:GetAttribute("EggLuck"))
                forgetEgg(prof, z, t, s, tool:GetAttribute("EggSpecies"), tool:GetAttribute("EggLuck"))
                tool:Destroy()
                count += 1
            end
        end
    end

    if count == 0 then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Nothing to sell")
        return
    end
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    P.set(plr, "Coins", have + total)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "sold", { kind = kind, count = count, total = total })
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) last[plr] = nil end)

print("[SELL] sell stall ready")
