local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Cycle = require(RS:WaitForChild("DayNightConfig"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("DayNight")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "DayNight"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

local DAY_LOOK = {
    clock = Cycle.DAY_CLOCK,
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
    atmoColor = atmosphere and atmosphere.Color,
    atmoDecay = atmosphere and atmosphere.Decay,
}
local NIGHT_LOOK = {
    clock = Cycle.NIGHT_CLOCK,
    Brightness = Cycle.NIGHT_BRIGHTNESS,
    Ambient = Cycle.NIGHT_AMBIENT,
    OutdoorAmbient = Cycle.NIGHT_OUTDOOR,
    atmoColor = Cycle.NIGHT_ATMOS_COLOR,
    atmoDecay = Cycle.NIGHT_ATMOS_DECAY,
}

local clockValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
clockValue.Value = Lighting.ClockTime
clockValue.Changed:Connect(function(v)
    Lighting.ClockTime = v % 24
end)

local function applyLook(look, seconds)
    local now = clockValue.Value % 24
    clockValue.Value = now

    local goal = now + (look.clock - now) % 24
    if seconds <= 0 then
        clockValue.Value = goal
        Lighting.Brightness = look.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = look.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = look.OutdoorAmbient
        if atmosphere and look.atmoColor then
            atmosphere.Color = look.atmoColor
            atmosphere.Decay = look.atmoDecay
        end
        return
    end
    local info = TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TweenService:Create(clockValue, info, { Value = goal }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Lighting, info, {
        Brightness = look.Brightness,
        Ambient = look.Ambient,
        OutdoorAmbient = look.OutdoorAmbient,
    }):Play()

    if atmosphere and look.atmoColor then
        TweenService:Create(atmosphere, info, { Color = look.atmoColor, Decay = look.atmoDecay }):Play()
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local EggCfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")

local function findGap()
    local walls = map:FindFirstChild("Walls")
    local spawnPart = map:FindFirstChild("MainSpawn")
    local midX = spawnPart and spawnPart.Position.X or 1500
    local left, right
    for _, w in ipairs(walls and walls:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if w:IsA("BasePart") and w.Name == "WallSegment" and w.Size.X > w.Size.Z
            and math.abs(w.Position.Z - EggCfg.SAFE_Z) < 15 then
            if w.Position.X < midX then left = w else right = w end
        end
    end
    if not (left and right) then
        warn("[DAYNIGHT] no gap in the wall found - the map will not close at night")
        return nil
    end
    return {
        x0 = left.Position.X + left.Size.X / 2,
        x1 = right.Position.X - right.Size.X / 2,
        z = left.Position.Z,
        y0 = left.Position.Y - left.Size.Y / 2,
        y1 = left.Position.Y + left.Size.Y / 2,
        thick = left.Size.Z,
    }
end
local GAP = findGap()
local gate

local GATE_Z = EggCfg.SAFE_Z - 0.5

local function buildGate()
    local g = GAP
    local width, height = g.x1 - g.x0, g.y1 - g.y0
    local cx = (g.x0 + g.x1) / 2

    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = "NightGate"
    model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

    local walls = map:FindFirstChild("Walls")
    local wallTop = g.y1
    for _, w in ipairs(walls and walls:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if w:IsA("BasePart") and math.abs(w.Position.Z - g.z) < 10 then
            wallTop = math.max(wallTop, w.Position.Y + w.Size.Y / 2)
        end
    end
    local wallH = wallTop - g.y0

    local function white(part, face)
        local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        sg.Name = "White"
        sg.Face = face
        sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
        sg.PixelsPerStud = 1
        sg.LightInfluence = 0
        sg.Parent = part
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Cycle.GATE_COLOR
        f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        f.Parent = sg
    end

    local wall = Instance.new("Part")
    wall.Name = "Gate"
    wall.Anchored = true
    wall.CastShadow = false
    wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    wall.Color = Cycle.GATE_COLOR
    wall.Size = Vector3.new(width, wallH, 2)
    wall.CFrame = CFrame.new(cx, g.y0 + wallH / 2, GATE_Z)
    wall.Parent = model
    white(wall, Enum.NormalId.Back)
    white(wall, Enum.NormalId.Top)

    local _, roofEnd = EggCfg.bounds(Cycle.ROOF_ZONES)
    local x0, x1 = math.huge, -math.huge
    for _, w in ipairs(walls and walls:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if w:IsA("BasePart") and w.Position.Z < g.z - 2 and w.Position.Z > roofEnd then
            x0 = math.min(x0, w.Position.X - w.Size.X / 2)
            x1 = math.max(x1, w.Position.X + w.Size.X / 2)
        end
    end
    if x0 > x1 then x0, x1 = g.x0 - g.thick, g.x1 + g.thick end
    local roofLen = (GATE_Z + 1) - roofEnd
    local roof = Instance.new("Part")
    roof.Name = "Roof"
    roof.Anchored = true
    roof.CastShadow = false
    roof.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    roof.Color = Cycle.GATE_COLOR
    roof.Size = Vector3.new(x1 - x0, 2, roofLen)
    roof.CFrame = CFrame.new((x0 + x1) / 2, wallTop + 1, (GATE_Z + 1) - roofLen / 2)
    roof.Parent = model
    white(roof, Enum.NormalId.Top)
    white(roof, Enum.NormalId.Back)

    local top = Instance.new("Part")
    top.Name = "GateBarrier"
    top.Anchored = true
    top.CastShadow = false
    top.Transparency = 1
    top.Size = Vector3.new(width, 400, 2)
    top.CFrame = CFrame.new(cx, wallTop + 200, GATE_Z)
    top.Parent = model

    return model
end

local function fadeOut(model)
    local info = TweenInfo.new(Cycle.GATE_FADE, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
            d.CanCollide = false
            if d.Transparency < 1 then TweenService:Create(d, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play() end
        elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
            TweenService:Create(d, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        end
    end
    task.delay(Cycle.GATE_FADE + 0.2, function() model:Destroy() end)
end

local function setGate(closed)
    if not GAP then return end
    if closed then
        if not (gate and gate.Parent) then
            gate = buildGate()
            gate.Parent = map
        end
    elseif gate then
        fadeOut(gate)
        gate = nil
    end
end

local function sendHome(plr)
    if _G.EggAdmin and _G.EggAdmin.drop then pcall(_G.EggAdmin.drop, plr) end
    local spawnPart = map:FindFirstChild("MainSpawn")
    local base = spawnPart and spawnPart.Position or Vector3.new(1500, 0, -20)
    local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-4, 4), 4, math.random(-4, 4))
    if plr.Character then plr.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(base + offset)) end
    remote:FireClient(plr, "mapClosed")
end

local function sweepMap(deep)
    local limit = deep and (GATE_Z - 3) or EggCfg.SAFE_Z
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local ch = plr.Character
        local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and root.Position.Z < limit then
            sendHome(plr)
        end
    end
end

local state = { phase = "day", endsAt = 0, resetDone = false, dusk = false, dawn = false }

local function setPhase(phase, seconds, instant)
    state.phase = phase
    state.endsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        + (seconds or ((phase == "day") and Cycle.DAY_SECONDS or Cycle.NIGHT_SECONDS))
    state.resetDone = false
    workspace:SetAttribute("CyclePhase", phase)
    workspace:SetAttribute("CycleEndsAt", state.endsAt)

    if phase == "night" then
        if not state.dusk then applyLook(NIGHT_LOOK, instant and 0 or Cycle.NIGHT_FADE) end
    else

        if not state.dawn then applyLook(DAY_LOOK, instant and 0 or Cycle.TRANSITION_SECONDS) end
    end
    state.dusk = false
    state.dawn = false
    setGate(phase == "night")
    if phase == "night" then sweepMap() end
end

local function resetEggs()
    local made = {}
    if _G.EggAdmin and _G.EggAdmin.resetAll then
        local ok, res = pcall(_G.EggAdmin.resetAll)
        if ok and type(res) == "table" then
            made = res
        elseif not ok then
            warn("[DAYNIGHT] egg reset failed: " .. tostring(res))
        end
    end
    local legendary = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(made) do
        if e.tier == Cycle.ANNOUNCE_TIER then table.insert(legendary, e.zone) end
    end
    remote:FireAllClients("reset", { count = #made, legendary = legendary })
    return #made, legendary
end

_G.DayNight = {
    setPhase = setPhase,
    resetEggs = resetEggs,
    state = function() return state.phase, state.endsAt end,
    sweepMap = sweepMap,
}

task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 100 do
        if _G.EggAdmin then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
    setPhase("day", nil, true)
    while true do
        task.wait(0.2)
        if state.phase == "night" then sweepMap(true) end
        local left = state.endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        if state.phase == "day" and not state.dusk and left <= Cycle.TRANSITION_SECONDS then
            state.dusk = true
            applyLook(NIGHT_LOOK, math.max(left, 0.3))
        end
        if state.phase == "night" and not state.dawn and left <= Cycle.DAWN_SECONDS then
            state.dawn = true
            applyLook(DAY_LOOK, math.max(left, 0.3))
        end
        if state.phase == "night" and not state.resetDone and left <= Cycle.RESET_AT then
            state.resetDone = true
            resetEggs()
        end
        if left <= 0 then
            setPhase((state.phase == "day") and "night" or "day")
        end
    end
end)

    end

    for _, a in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
        local id = a:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

    end
end)

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Fuse = require(RS:WaitForChild("FuseConfig"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("Fuse")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "Fuse"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local rng = Random.new()
local last = {}

local function ownsTool(plr, tool)
    if typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
    local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (bag ~= nil and tool.Parent == bag) or (plr.Character ~= nil and tool.Parent == plr.Character)
end

local function forgetPet(prof, tool)
    local key = tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey")
    local list = prof.PetInventory
    if type(list) ~= "table" or type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then return end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].key == key then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, tools)
    if action ~= "fuse" or type(tools) ~= "table" then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (last[plr] or 0) + 1 > now then return end
    last[plr] = now

    local P = _G.Profile
    local prof = P and P.get(plr)
    if not prof then return end

    local picked, seen = {}, {}
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        local t = tools[i]
        if not (ownsTool(plr, t) and t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")) or seen[t] then
            remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Put 3 pets in the machine")
            return
        end
        seen[t] = true
        picked[i] = t
    end

    local first = picked[1]
    local zone = first:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")
    local tier = first:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
    local species = first:GetAttribute("Species")
    local sizes = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(picked) do
        if t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") ~= zone or (t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1) ~= tier
           or t:GetAttribute("Species") ~= species then
            remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "All 3 pets must be the same")
            return
        end
        table.insert(sizes, t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1)
    end

    local cost = 0
    for _, s in ipairs(sizes) do cost += Fuse.cost(zone, tier, s) end
    cost = math.floor(cost / #sizes + 0.5)
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < cost then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    if not _G.EggGrant then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "The Fuse Machine is not ready yet")
        return
    end

    local boost = (_G.GlobalBoost and _G.GlobalBoost.value and _G.GlobalBoost.value("luck")) or 1
    local size = Fuse.rollSize(sizes, rng)
    local luck = Fuse.rollLuck(tier, sizes, boost, rng)
    local granted = pcall(_G.EggGrant, plr, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    if not granted then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Fusing failed, nothing was taken")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", math.max(0, (P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0) - cost))
    for _, t in ipairs(picked) do
        forgetPet(prof, t)
        t:Destroy()
    end

    remote:FireClient(plr, "fused", {
        zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size, species = species, luck = luck, cost = cost,
    })
end)

name: AdminTreadmillService
source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")

local world = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local template = game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild("AdminTreadmillTemplate")
local U = require(RS.UpgradeConfig)
local Cfg = require(RS.EggConfig)

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "AdminTreadmillExit"
remote.Parent = RS.Remotes

local REENTER_COOLDOWN = 1.5
local STAND_HEIGHT = 7
local RUN_REFERENCE = 20

local function rateFor(p)
	local walk = Cfg.walkForSpeed(p:GetAttribute("Speed") or Cfg.SPEED_START)
	return math.clamp(walk / RUN_REFERENCE, 0.7, 3.5)
end

local sessions = {}
local lanes = {}
local cooldown = {}
local activeModel, belt
local multiplier = 1

local function stop(p, move)
	local s = sessions[p]
	if not s then return end
	sessions[p] = nil
	cooldown[p] = os.clock() + REENTER_COOLDOWN
	if s.track then s.track:Stop(0.15) s.track:Destroy() end
	if s.root and s.root.Parent then
		s.root.Anchored = s.anchored
		if move and s.hum.Health > 0 then s.root.CFrame = s.lane.exit end
	end
	if s.hum and s.hum.Parent then s.hum.AutoRotate = s.auto end
	if s.lane then s.lane.occupant = nil end
	p:SetAttribute("AdminTreadmillRunning", false)
end

local function start(p, lane, root, hum)
	if sessions[p] or lane.occupant then return end
	if not (_G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(p)) then return end
	local stand = lane.stand * CFrame.new(0, hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2, 0)
	sessions[p] = { root = root, hum = hum, anchored = root.Anchored, auto = hum.AutoRotate, lane = lane, owed = 0 }
	lane.occupant = p
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.CFrame = stand
	root.Anchored = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	p:SetAttribute("AdminTreadmillRunning", true)
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if animator then
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.AnimationId = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "rbxassetid://180426354" or "rbxassetid://913376220"
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
		anim:Destroy()
		if ok then
			sessions[p].track = track
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track.Looped = true
			track:Play(0.15, 1, rateFor(p))
		end
	end
end

local function disable()
	for p in pairs(sessions) do stop(p, true) end
	if activeModel then activeModel:Destroy() end
	activeModel, belt = nil, nil
	table.clear(lanes)
end

local function enable()
	activeModel = template:Clone()
	activeModel.Name = "AdminTreadmill"
	activeModel.Parent = world
	belt = activeModel:WaitForChild("Belt")
	local slots = activeModel:WaitForChild("Slots")
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local marker = slots:WaitForChild("Slot" .. i)
		local exitPos = (belt.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, belt.Size.Z / 2 + 7.5)).Position
		lanes[i] = {index = i, stand = marker.CFrame, exit = CFrame.lookAt(exitPos, exitPos - belt.CFrame.LookVector)}
	end
end

local function laneFor(_localX)
	for _, lane in ipairs(lanes) do
		if not lane.occupant then return lane end
	end
end

local function tryEnter()
	local half = belt.Size / 2
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if not sessions[p] and (cooldown[p] or 0) < now then
			local char = p.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and not root.Anchored and not hum.Sit then
				local rel = belt.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
				if math.abs(rel.X) < half.X and math.abs(rel.Z) < half.Z and rel.Y > 0 and rel.Y < STAND_HEIGHT then
					local lane = laneFor(rel.X)
					if lane then start(p, lane, root, hum) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function clock(sec)
	sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec))
	if sec >= 3600 then
		return ("%d:%02d:%02d"):format(sec // 3600, sec % 3600 // 60, sec % 60)
	end
	return ("%d:%02d"):format(sec // 60, sec % 60)
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p) stop(p, true) end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	stop(p, false)
	cooldown[p] = nil
end)
local function bind(p) p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() stop(p, false) end) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(p) end

local elapsed = 0
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 0.1 then return end
	local step = math.min(elapsed, 0.25)
	elapsed = 0

	local boost = _G.GlobalBoost
	multiplier = boost and boost.value("treadmill") or 1
	if multiplier <= 1 then
		if activeModel then disable() end
		return
	end
	if not activeModel then enable() end

	local state = boost.state().treadmill
	local endsAt = state and state.endsAt or 0
	activeModel:SetAttribute("Multiplier", multiplier)
	activeModel:SetAttribute("EndsAt", endsAt)
	local holo = activeModel:FindFirstChild("Hologram", true)
	if holo then
		local mult = holo:FindFirstChild("Mult")
		local info = holo:FindFirstChild("Info")
		if mult then mult.Text = ("x%g SPEED"):format(multiplier) end
		if info then
			local left = endsAt > 0 and ("  •  " .. clock(endsAt - os.time())) or ""
			info.Text = ("YOUR TREADMILL x%g%s"):format(multiplier, left)
		end
	end

	tryEnter()

	local beltRate = 1
	for p, s in pairs(sessions) do
		local rate = rateFor(p)
		beltRate = math.max(beltRate, rate)
		if s.track and s.track.IsPlaying then s.track:AdjustSpeed(rate) end
	end
	activeModel:SetAttribute("BeltRate", beltRate)

	for p, s in pairs(sessions) do
		if not s.root.Parent or s.hum.Health <= 0 or (s.root.Position - s.lane.stand.Position).Magnitude > 12 then
			stop(p, false)
		else
			s.owed += step
			local every = U.MILL.awardEvery or 0.5
			if s.owed >= every then
				s.owed -= every
				local plot = _G.Plots and _G.Plots.of(p)
				local level = plot and plot.mill:GetAttribute("MillLevel") or 1
				local award = U.MILL.awardBase * U.MILL.awardGrowth ^ (math.clamp(level, 1, U.MAX_LEVEL) - 1)
				award *= (p:GetAttribute("TrailMult") or 1) * (_G.SpeedMult and _G.SpeedMult(p) or 1)
					* boost.value("speed") * multiplier * (_G.RebirthMult and _G.RebirthMult(p) or 1)
				local speed = p:GetAttribute("Speed") or Cfg.SPEED_START
				if award == award and award < math.huge then p:SetAttribute("Speed", math.min(speed + award, Cfg.SPEED_MAX)) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local FLAGS = { "OnTreadmill", "AdminTreadmillRunning" }

local function running(p)
	for _, name in ipairs(FLAGS) do
		if p:GetAttribute(name) == true then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function stow(p)
	local ch = p.Character
	local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then hum:UnequipTools() end
end

local function bindCharacter(p, ch)
	ch.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		if c:IsA("Tool") and running(p) then task.defer(stow, p) end
	end)
end

local function bind(p)
	for _, name in ipairs(FLAGS) do
		p:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			if running(p) then stow(p) end
		end)
	end
	if p.Character then bindCharacter(p, p.Character) end
	p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
		p:SetAttribute("OnTreadmill", false)
		bindCharacter(p, ch)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(p) end

name: CaptureEggService
source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("CaptureEggConfig"))
local EggCfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild("CaptureEgg")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "CaptureEgg"
	remote.Parent = remotes
end

local TOPIC = "CaptureEggEvent"

local state = { active = false, endsAt = 0, mult = 1, holder = nil }
local scores, names = {}, {}
local cooldown = {}
local egg, core, weld, label, timeLabel, holderLabel, hologram
local groundY = 0

local function inArena(pos)
	return pos.X >= EggCfg.X_MIN and pos.X <= EggCfg.X_MAX and pos.Z <= EggCfg.SAFE_Z
end

local function floorAt(pos)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignore = {}
	if egg then table.insert(ignore, egg) end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Character then table.insert(ignore, p.Character) end end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 8, pos.Z), Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), params)
	return hit and hit.Position.Y or 0.5
end

local function buildEgg()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "CaptureEgg"
	core = Instance.new("Part")
	core.Name = "Core"
	core.Size = Vector3.new(5.2, 6.8, 5.2)
	core.Transparency = 1
	core.Anchored = true
	core.CanCollide = false
	core.CanTouch = true
	core.CanQuery = false
	core.Massless = true
	core.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = core
	local BEIGE = Color3.fromRGB(204, 182, 140)
	local SHADE = Color3.fromRGB(172, 146, 104)
	local SPOT = Color3.fromRGB(106, 66, 38)
	local widths = { 2.4, 3.6, 4.4, 4.8, 4.8, 4.4, 3.8, 3.0, 1.8 }
	local h = 0.72
	local y0 = -3.2
	local function block(size, offset, colour)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = "Voxel"
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
		p.Color = colour
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.Anchored = false
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Massless = true
		p.Parent = model
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		w.Part0 = core
		w.Part1 = p
		w.Parent = p
		return p
	end
	for i, w in ipairs(widths) do
		local y = y0 + (i - 0.5) * h
		local tint = (i - 1) / #widths * 0.08
		block(Vector3.new(w, h, w * 0.64), Vector3.new(0, y, 0), BEIGE:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), tint))
		block(Vector3.new(w * 0.64, h, w), Vector3.new(0, y, 0), SHADE:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), tint))
	end
	local spots = {
		{ 3, 1, 0.3 }, { 5, 2, -0.35 }, { 4, 3, 0.1 }, { 6, 4, 0.3 }, { 2, 2, 0 }, { 7, 1, -0.2 }, { 5, 4, -0.3 }, { 3, 3, 0.4 },
		{ 4, 1, -0.4 }, { 6, 2, 0.35 }, { 2, 4, -0.1 }, { 6, 3, -0.4 }, { 8, 2, 0 }, { 4, 4, 0.45 }, { 5, 1, 0.1 }, { 7, 3, 0.2 },
	}
	for _, s in ipairs(spots) do
		local layer, face, slide = s[1], s[2], s[3]
		local w = widths[layer]
		local y = y0 + (layer - 0.5) * h
		local off, size
		if face == 1 then off, size = Vector3.new(slide * w * 0.5, y, w / 2 + 0.02), Vector3.new(0.62, 0.62, 0.08)
		elseif face == 2 then off, size = Vector3.new(w / 2 + 0.02, y, slide * w * 0.5), Vector3.new(0.08, 0.62, 0.62)
		elseif face == 3 then off, size = Vector3.new(slide * w * 0.5, y, -w / 2 - 0.02), Vector3.new(0.62, 0.62, 0.08)
		else off, size = Vector3.new(-w / 2 - 0.02, y, slide * w * 0.5), Vector3.new(0.08, 0.62, 0.62) end
		block(size, off, SPOT)
	end
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 140)
	light.Range = 16
	light.Brightness = 1.4
	light.Parent = core
	local sparkle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparkle.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	sparkle.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 120))
	sparkle.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	sparkle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
	sparkle.Rate = 10
	sparkle.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
	sparkle.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	sparkle.LightEmission = 0.8
	sparkle.Parent = core
	model:ScaleTo(Cfg.EggScale or 1)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "CaptureHologram"
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(10, 3.8)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, core.Size.Y / 2 + 2.4, 0)
	bb.MaxDistance = 300
	hologram = bb
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	bb.Parent = core
	local function text(name, y, hgt, colour)
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		t.Name = name
		t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		t.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, y)
		t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, hgt)
		t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		t.TextScaled = true
		t.TextColor3 = colour
		t.Text = ""
		t.Parent = bb
		local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		st.Thickness = 2.5
		st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 14, 6)
		st.Parent = t
		return t
	end
	label = text("Title", 0, 0.3, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 64))
	label.Text = Cfg.Title
	timeLabel = text("Time", 0.3, 0.44, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	holderLabel = text("Holder", 0.76, 0.24, Color3.fromRGB(190, 240, 255))
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end

local function rootOf(p)
	local c = p and p.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local prompt

local function rescale(k)
	if not egg or not core then return end
	local parts = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(egg:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("WeldConstraint") and d ~= weld then d:Destroy() end
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			table.insert(parts, d)
		end
	end
	egg:ScaleTo(k)
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if p ~= core then
			p.Anchored = false
			local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			w.Part0 = core
			w.Part1 = p
			w.Parent = p
		end
	end
	if hologram then
		hologram.Size = UDim2.fromScale(10, 3.8)
		hologram.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, core.Size.Y / 2 + (state.holder and 4.2 or 2.4), 0)
	end
end

local grab

local function addPrompt()
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	if not core then return end
	prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Pick up"
	prompt.ObjectText = ""
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.45
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt:SetAttribute("EggPrompt", true)
	CollectionService:AddTag(prompt, "StealPrompt")
	prompt.Parent = core
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p) grab(p) end)
end

local function placeIdle(pos)
	if weld then weld:Destroy() weld = nil end
	if not core then return end
	core.Anchored = true
	rescale(Cfg.EggScale or 1)
	groundY = floorAt(pos)
	core.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos.X, groundY + core.Size.Y / 2 + 1, pos.Z)
	if holderLabel then holderLabel.Text = "" end
	addPrompt()
end

local function release(p)
	p:SetAttribute("HoldingCaptureEgg", nil)
	p:SetAttribute("CarryingEgg", false)
	p:SetAttribute("CarryCenter", nil)
	p:SetAttribute("CarrySize", nil)
end

local function drop(returnHome)
	local p = state.holder
	state.holder = nil
	if p then
		cooldown[p] = os.clock() + Cfg.PickupCooldown
		release(p)
	end
	local root = p and rootOf(p)
	local pos = (not returnHome and root and inArena(root.Position)) and root.Position or Cfg.Center
	placeIdle(pos)
end

function grab(p)
	if not state.active or state.holder or not core then return end
	if (cooldown[p] or 0) > os.clock() then return end
	if p:GetAttribute("Stunned") or p:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") then return end
	local root, hum = rootOf(p)
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not inArena(root.Position) then return end
	local ch = p.Character
	local anchor = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
	state.holder = p
	names[p.UserId] = p.DisplayName
	scores[p.UserId] = scores[p.UserId] or 0
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() prompt = nil end
	hum:UnequipTools()
	core.Anchored = true
	rescale((Cfg.EggScale or 1) * (Cfg.HeldScale or 0.5))
	core.CFrame = anchor.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -(anchor.Size.Z / 2 + core.Size.Z / 2 + 0.3))
	core.Anchored = false
	weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = anchor
	weld.Part1 = core
	weld.Parent = core
	p:SetAttribute("HoldingCaptureEgg", true)
	p:SetAttribute("CarryingEgg", true)
	p:SetAttribute("CarryCenter", anchor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(core.Position))
	p:SetAttribute("CarrySize", core.Size)
	if holderLabel then holderLabel.Text = "HELD BY " .. string.upper(p.DisplayName) end
end

local function ranking()
	local list = {}
	for userId, secs in pairs(scores) do
		table.insert(list, { u = userId, n = names[userId] or "?", s = math.floor(secs * 10) / 10 })
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.s > b.s end)
	return list
end

local function publishState()
	workspace:SetAttribute("CaptureEggActive", state.active)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CaptureEggEndsAt", state.endsAt)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CaptureEggMult", state.mult)
	remote:FireAllClients("state", {
		active = state.active, endsAt = state.endsAt, mult = state.mult,
		holder = state.holder and state.holder.UserId or 0, list = ranking(),
	})
end

local function finish()
	if not state.active then return end
	if state.holder then drop(true) end
	local list = ranking()
	local winners = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local e = list[i]
		local reward = Cfg.Rewards[i]
		if e and reward and e.s >= 1 then
			local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(e.u)
			local speed = math.floor((reward.Speed or 0) * state.mult)
			local money = math.floor((reward.Money or 0) * state.mult)
			if p then
				if speed > 0 then
					p:SetAttribute("Speed", math.clamp((tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Speed")) or 0) + speed, 0, EggCfg.SPEED_MAX))
				end
				if money > 0 and _G.Profile then
					_G.Profile.set(p, "Coins", _G.Profile.value(p, "wallet", "Coins") + money)
				end
			end
			table.insert(winners, { u = e.u, n = e.n, s = e.s, speed = speed, money = money, place = i })
		end
	end
	state.active = false
	state.endsAt = 0
	if egg then egg:Destroy() end
	egg, core, weld, hologram, prompt = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p:GetAttribute("HoldingCaptureEgg") then release(p) end
	end
	publishState()
	remote:FireAllClients("results", { winners = winners })
end

local function startLocal(endsAt, mult)
	state.mult = math.clamp(tonumber(mult) or 1, 1, 1000)
	state.endsAt = endsAt
	if not state.active then
		state.active = true
		scores, names, cooldown = {}, {}, {}
		state.holder = nil
		if egg then egg:Destroy() end
		egg = buildEgg()
		placeIdle(Cfg.Center)
	end
	publishState()
end

local function stopLocal()
	if not state.active then return end
	state.endsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	finish()
end

local jobId = game.JobId
local CaptureEgg = {}
_G.CaptureEgg = CaptureEgg

function CaptureEgg.start(minutes, mult, everywhere)
	local mins = tonumber(minutes)
	if not mins or mins ~= mins or mins < 0.5 or mins > 1440 then return nil, "minutes must be 0.5 to 1440" end
	local endsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + mins * 60
	startLocal(endsAt, mult)
	if everywhere then
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function() MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPIC, { op = "start", endsAt = endsAt, mult = state.mult, from = jobId }) end)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function CaptureEgg.stop(everywhere)
	stopLocal()
	if everywhere then
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function() MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPIC, { op = "stop", from = jobId }) end)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function CaptureEgg.onHit(victim)
	if state.holder == victim then drop(false) end
end

function CaptureEgg.state()
	return { active = state.active, endsAt = state.endsAt, mult = state.mult }
end

task.spawn(function()
	pcall(function()
		MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(TOPIC, function(message)
			local data = message.Data
			if type(data) ~= "table" or data.from == jobId then return end
			if data.op == "start" and tonumber(data.endsAt) then startLocal(tonumber(data.endsAt), data.mult)
			elseif data.op == "stop" then stopLocal() end
		end)
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	if state.holder == p then drop(false) end
	cooldown[p] = nil
end)

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p, action)
	if action == "sync" then
		remote:FireClient(p, "state", {
			active = state.active, endsAt = state.endsAt, mult = state.mult,
			holder = state.holder and state.holder.UserId or 0, list = ranking(),
		})
	end
end)

local sendClock, spin = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not state.active then return end
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= state.endsAt then finish() return end
	local p = state.holder
	if p then
		local root, hum = rootOf(p)
		if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not p.Parent or not core or not core.Parent then
			drop(true)
		elseif not inArena(root.Position) then
			drop(true)
		else
			scores[p.UserId] = (scores[p.UserId] or 0) + dt
		end
	elseif core then
		spin += dt
		local pos = core.Position
		core.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos.X, groundY + core.Size.Y / 2 + 1 + math.sin(spin * 2) * 0.45, pos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, spin * 0.9, 0)
	end
	if holderLabel and state.holder then
		holderLabel.Text = ("%s - %ds"):format(string.upper(state.holder.DisplayName), math.floor(scores[state.holder.UserId] or 0))
	end
	if timeLabel then
		local left = math.max(0, state.endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		local secs = math.ceil(left)
		timeLabel.Text = ("%d:%02d"):format(secs // 60, secs % 60)
	end
	sendClock += dt
	if sendClock >= 0.5 then
		sendClock = 0
		publishState()
	end
end)

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local BATCH = 12

local MAX_WAIT = 180

local seen = {}

local function dedupe(list, id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or seen[id] then return end
	seen[id] = true
	list[#list + 1] = id
end

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local startedAt = os.clock()

local queue
do
	local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 30)
	local module = shared and shared:WaitForChild("AssetQueue", 30)
	if module then
		local ok, q = pcall(require, module)
		if ok and type(q) == "table" then queue = q end
	end
end

local function hudIcons()
	local list = {}
	local shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
	local uikit = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("UIKit")
	if uikit then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, uikit)
		if ok and type(module) == "table" and type(module.ICON) == "table" then
			for _, id in pairs(module.ICON) do dedupe(list, id) end
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function pull(list)
	local done = 0
	for index = 1, #list, BATCH do
		if os.clock() - startedAt > MAX_WAIT then return done, true end

		local batch = table.create(BATCH)
		for offset = index, math.min(index + BATCH - 1, #list) do
			batch[#batch + 1] = list[offset]
		end

		pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, batch)
		done = done + #batch
		task.wait()
		if queue then
			while queue.busy() do task.wait(0.05) end
		end
	end
	return done, false
end

local function batSkins()
	local list = {}
	local module = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BatConfig", 10)
	local ok, cfg = pcall(require, module)
	if not (ok and type(cfg) == "table") then return list end
	local me = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local mine = cfg[tonumber(me and me:GetAttribute("BatEquipped")) or 0]
	if mine then dedupe(list, mine.Texture) end
	for _, c in pairs(cfg) do dedupe(list, c.Texture) end
	for _, c in pairs(cfg) do dedupe(list, c.Icon) end
	return list
end
pull(batSkins())

local icons = hudIcons()
if #icons > 0 then pull(icons) end

local manifest = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AssetManifest", 30)

if not (manifest and manifest:IsA("Folder")) then
	local list = {}
	for _, root in ipairs({ Workspace, ReplicatedStorage }) do
		for _, o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton") then dedupe(list, o.Image)
			elseif o:IsA("Decal") or o:IsA("Texture") then dedupe(list, o.Texture)
			elseif o:IsA("MeshPart") then dedupe(list, o.MeshId)
			elseif o:IsA("SpecialMesh") then dedupe(list, o.MeshId)
			elseif o:IsA("Sound") then dedupe(list, o.SoundId)
			end
		end
	end
	local done = pull(list)
	warn(("[Load] no manifest - loaded %d assets as fallback"):format(done))
	return
end

local layers = manifest:GetChildren()
table.sort(layers, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)

local total = 0
for _, value in ipairs(layers) do
	local list = {}
	for id in value.Value:gmatch("[^\n]+") do dedupe(list, id) end

	local at = os.clock()
	local done, ranOut = pull(list)
	total = total + done
	print(("[Load] %s: %d assets in %.1fs"):format(value.Name, done, os.clock() - at))
	if ranOut then
		warn(("[Load] stopped after %ds at layer %s"):format(MAX_WAIT, value.Name))
		break
	end
end

print(("[Load] done: %d assets in %.1fs"):format(total, os.clock() - startedAt))

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local UK = UIKit.Palette

local K = {
	outline = UK.outline,
	text    = UIKit.WHITE,
	gold    = UK.bar,
	green   = UK.ready,
	blue    = UK.claimed,
	purple  = UK.prize,

	orange  = UK.inProgress,

}

local ICON = {
	crateGold = "rbxassetid://78249705152730",

	inventory = "rbxassetid://135534251950969",
	money     = "rbxassetid://105247853965760",
	studs     = "rbxassetid://138926013267839",

local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

local function block(props)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")

	local tone = props.tone or K.blue

	shadow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, props.shadowY or 5)
	shadow.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex
	shadow.Parent = holder
	Instance.new("UICorner", shadow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)

	local face = Instance.new(props.clickable and "TextButton" or "Frame")
	face.Name = props.name or "Face"

	face.BorderSizePixel = 0

	face.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex + 1
	if props.clickable then
		face.Text = ""
		face.AutoButtonColor = false
	end
	face.Parent = holder
	Instance.new("UICorner", face).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = props.stroke or 3
	stroke.Color = K.outline
	stroke.Parent = face

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, tone.hi),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, tone.base),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, tone.sh),
	})
	grad.Parent = face

	local studs = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	studs.Name = "Studs"
	studs.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	studs.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
	studs.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(props.stud or 13, props.stud or 13)
	studs.ImageTransparency = 0.86
	studs.ZIndex = face.ZIndex + 1
	studs.Parent = face
	Instance.new("UICorner", studs).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)

	return face, holder
end

local function label(parent, props)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = props.name or "Label"
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Size = props.size
	l.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
	l.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
	l.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	l.Text = props.text or ""
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.TextColor3 = props.colour or K.text
	l.TextXAlignment = props.align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	l.ZIndex = props.zindex or 12
	l.Parent = parent

	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = props.strokeW or 3
	s.Color = props.strokeColour or K.outline
	s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
	s.Parent = l
	return l
end

local toastHolder, toastLabel
local function toast(message)
	if not toastLabel then
		local face, holder = block({
			parent = screen, name = "Toast", tone = K.navy, radius = 14,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(430, 62),
			position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 250), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), zindex = 40,
		})
		toastLabel = label(face, { name = "Text", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), zindex = 43 })
		toastHolder = holder
		holder.Visible = false
	end
	toastLabel.Text = message
	toastHolder.Visible = true
	task.delay(2.4, function()
		if toastLabel.Text == message then
			toastHolder.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

local CORNER_MARGIN = 18
local CORNER_BASE = 58

local refreshBoost

local function fitChrome()
	if refreshBoost then refreshBoost() end
end
fitChrome()

do
	local function track(cam)
		if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fitChrome) end
	end
	track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
	workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
		fitChrome()
	end)
	game:GetService("GuiService"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("TopbarInset"):Connect(fitChrome)
end

local lobbyHidden = false

local boostState = {}

local BOOST = {
	{ kind = "eggluck", image = "rbxassetid://86912083530579" },
	{ kind = "hatch",   image = "rbxassetid://124077178421900" },
	{ kind = "money",   image = "rbxassetid://80150641333749" },
	{ kind = "luck",    image = "rbxassetid://74489658413376" },
	{ kind = "speed",   image = "rbxassetid://129798509906580" },
 { kind = "treadmill", image = "rbxassetid://83769600890897" },
}

local SLOT_W, SLOT_H, ICON_SIDE, SLOT_GAP = 70, 76, 58, 2
local CARD_H = SLOT_H
local MULT_COLOUR = Color3.fromRGB(96, 255, 84)
local CLOCK_COLOUR = UIKit.WHITE
local ENDING_COLOUR = UK.close.hi
local BOOST_INK = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24)

local boostRow = Instance.new("Frame")
boostRow.Name = "Boosts"
boostRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
boostRow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
boostRow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -CORNER_MARGIN, 1, -(CORNER_MARGIN + CORNER_BASE + 10))
boostRow.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
boostRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, SLOT_H)
boostRow.ZIndex = 12
boostRow.Visible = false
boostRow.Parent = screen

local boostScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
boostScale.Parent = boostRow

do
	local row = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	row.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	row.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	row.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	row.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	row.Padding = UDim.new(0, SLOT_GAP)
	row.Parent = boostRow
end

local function boostText(parent, props)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Name = props.name
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Size = props.size
	t.Position = props.position
	t.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
	t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	t.TextSize = props.textSize
	t.TextColor3 = props.colour
	t.TextXAlignment = props.align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	t.Text = ""
	t.ZIndex = 16
	t.Parent = parent
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = BOOST_INK
	s.Thickness = props.strokeW or 3
	s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
	s.Parent = t
	return t
end

local function boostLeft(s)
	s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
	if s >= 3600 then return ("%dh %02dm"):format(s // 3600, (s % 3600) // 60) end
	if s >= 60 then return ("%dm %02ds"):format(s // 60, s % 60) end
	return s .. "s"
end

local boostCards = {}

for order, def in ipairs(BOOST) do
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = def.kind
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SLOT_W, SLOT_H)
	holder.LayoutOrder = order
	holder.ZIndex = 12
	holder.Visible = false
	holder.Parent = boostRow

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = holder

	local art = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	art.Name = "Art"
	art.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	art.Image = def.image
	art.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	art.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	art.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 4)
	art.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ICON_SIDE, ICON_SIDE)
	art.ZIndex = 14
	art.Parent = holder

	local mult = boostText(holder, {
		name = "Mult", size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 24),
		position = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, -2), anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		textSize = 21, colour = MULT_COLOUR, align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local clock = boostText(holder, {
		name = "Clock", size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 0, 22),
		position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, ICON_SIDE - 12), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		textSize = 17, colour = CLOCK_COLOUR,
	})

	boostCards[def.kind] = { def = def, holder = holder, scale = scale, mult = mult, clock = clock }
end

function refreshBoost()
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local shown = 0

	for _, def in ipairs(BOOST) do
		local card = boostCards[def.kind]
		local entry = boostState[def.kind]

		local live = entry ~= nil and entry.mult > 1
			and (entry.endsAt == 0 or entry.endsAt > now)
			and not lobbyHidden

		if live then
			shown += 1
			card.mult.Text = ("x%g"):format(entry.mult)
			if entry.endsAt > 0 then
				local left = entry.endsAt - now
				card.clock.Text = boostLeft(left)
				card.clock.TextColor3 = (left <= 30) and ENDING_COLOUR or CLOCK_COLOUR
			else
				card.clock.Text = ""
			end

			if not card.holder.Visible then
				card.holder.Visible = true
				card.scale.Scale = 0.6
				TweenService:Create(card.scale,
					TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Scale = 1 }):Play()
			end
		else
			card.holder.Visible = false
		end
	end

	boostRow.Visible = shown > 0
	if shown == 0 then return end

	local rightInset = CORNER_MARGIN
	local bottomInset = CORNER_MARGIN + CORNER_BASE + 10
	boostRow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightInset, 1, -bottomInset)

	local natural = shown * SLOT_W + (shown - 1) * SLOT_GAP
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local fit = 1
	if cam then
		fit = cam.ViewportSize.X * 0.86 / natural

		local emotes = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("EmoteHud")
		local face = emotes and emotes:FindFirstChild("EmoteButton")
		if face and face.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
			local canvas = cam.ViewportSize.Y - game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y
			local ceiling = face.AbsolutePosition.Y + face.AbsoluteSize.Y + 14
			fit = math.min(fit, (canvas - bottomInset - ceiling - 8) / CARD_H)
		end
	end
	boostScale.Scale = math.clamp(fit, 0.5, 1)
end

do
	local function watch(cam)
		if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(refreshBoost) end
	end
	watch(workspace.CurrentCamera)
	workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		watch(workspace.CurrentCamera)
		refreshBoost()
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes", 20)
	local remote = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("GlobalBoost", 10)
	if not remote then return end

	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(state)
		if type(state) ~= "table" then return end
		boostState = {}
		for kind, entry in pairs(state) do
			if type(entry) == "table" then
				local endsAt = tonumber(entry.endsAt) or 0
				local startedAt = tonumber(entry.startedAt) or 0
				boostState[kind] = {
					mult = tonumber(entry.mult) or 1,
					endsAt = endsAt,

					span = (endsAt > 0 and startedAt > 0)
						and math.max(endsAt - startedAt, 1) or 0,
				}
			end
		end
		refreshBoost()
	end)

	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		if next(boostState) then refreshBoost() end
	end
end)

local topbarPills = {}

		topbar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rect.Min.X, rect.Min.Y)

	topbarPills[#topbarPills + 1] = face

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, BAR.top),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, BAR.bottom),
	})
	grad.Parent = face

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.35
	stroke.Color = BAR.outline
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Parent = face

	local inner = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	inner.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	inner.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	inner.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	inner.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	inner.Padding = UDim.new(0, BAR_INNER_GAP)
	inner.Parent = face

	local innerPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	innerPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, BAR_PAD)
	innerPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, BAR_PAD)
	innerPad.Parent = face

	local badge = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	badge.Name = "Icon"
	badge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	badge.Image = def.image
	badge.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BAR_ICON, BAR_ICON)
	badge.LayoutOrder = 1
	badge.ZIndex = 21
	badge.Parent = face

	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "Label"
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	text.Text = def.label
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	text.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, BAR_ICON)
	text.LayoutOrder = 2
	text.ZIndex = 21
	text.Parent = face
	text.TextScaled = false
	text.TextSize = 17

	local QUICK = TweenInfo.new(0.11, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	local function tint(body, top, bottom, clarity)
		TweenService:Create(face, QUICK,
			{ BackgroundColor3 = body, BackgroundTransparency = clarity or 0.18 }):Play()
		grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, top),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, bottom),
		})
	end
	face.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tint(BAR.hover, BAR.hoverTop, BAR.hoverBottom, 0.04) end)
	face.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tint(BAR.body, BAR.top, BAR.bottom, 0.18) end)
	face.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tint(BAR.press, BAR.press, BAR.pressBottom, 0.04) end)
	face.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tint(BAR.hover, BAR.hoverTop, BAR.hoverBottom, 0.04) end)
	face.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		openPanel(def.id, def.label)
	end)

	return face
end

do

	settingsHolder = pill({ id = "Settings", label = "", image = ICON.settings },

	adminHolder = pill({ id = "Admin", label = "", image = ICON.admin }, rightRow, 1)

local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

local annGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
annGui.Name = "AnnouncementLine"
annGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
annGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
annGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
annGui.DisplayOrder = 60
annGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local ANN_FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local ANN_TEXT = 36
local ANN_HEAD = 64
local ANN_GAP = 14
local ANN_MAX_W = 980
local ANN_NICK_HEX = "#56B2FF"
local ANN_EDGE = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 26)

local annRow = Instance.new("Frame")
annRow.Name = "Announcement"
annRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
annRow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
annRow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.24)
annRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, ANN_HEAD)
annRow.Visible = false
annRow.Parent = annGui

local annScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
annScale.Parent = annRow

local annAvatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
annAvatar.Name = "Avatar"
annAvatar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 52, 72)
annAvatar.BorderSizePixel = 0
annAvatar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
annAvatar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
annAvatar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ANN_HEAD, ANN_HEAD)
annAvatar.Parent = annRow
Instance.new("UICorner", annAvatar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
local annRing = Instance.new("UIStroke")
annRing.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
annRing.Thickness = 3
annRing.Parent = annAvatar

local annText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
annText.Name = "Text"
annText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
annText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
annText.Position = UDim2.new(0, ANN_HEAD + ANN_GAP, 0.5, 0)
annText.Font = ANN_FONT
annText.TextSize = ANN_TEXT
annText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
annText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
annText.TextWrapped = true
annText.RichText = true
annText.Text = ""
annText.Parent = annRow
local annEdge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
annEdge.Color = ANN_EDGE
annEdge.Thickness = 3.5
annEdge.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
annEdge.Parent = annText

local function annEscape(s)
	return (tostring(s):gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"))
end

local function annFade(alpha)
	annText.TextTransparency = alpha
	annEdge.Transparency = alpha
	annAvatar.ImageTransparency = alpha
	annAvatar.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
	annRing.Transparency = alpha
end

local annCounter = 0
local function showAnnouncement(data)
	local body = type(data) == "table" and tostring(data.text or "") or tostring(data or "")
	if body == "" then return end
	local nick = tostring((type(data) == "table" and data.fromName) or "ADMIN")

	annText.Text = ('<font color="%s">%s</font>: %s'):format(ANN_NICK_HEX, annEscape(nick), annEscape(body))

	local bounds = TextService:GetTextSize(nick .. ": " .. body, ANN_TEXT, ANN_FONT, Vector2.new(ANN_MAX_W, 4000))
	local w = math.ceil(bounds.X) + 10
	local h = math.ceil(bounds.Y) + 6
	annText.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	local rowW = ANN_HEAD + ANN_GAP + w
	annRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rowW, math.max(h, ANN_HEAD))

	local fit = 1
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam and cam.ViewportSize.X > 0 then
		fit = math.min(1, cam.ViewportSize.X * 0.92 / rowW)
	end

	local userId = type(data) == "table" and tonumber(data.fromUserId) or nil
	annAvatar.Image = ""
	if userId and userId > 0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, url = pcall(function()
				return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId,
					Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
			end)
			if ok then annAvatar.Image = url end
		end)
	end

	annFade(0)
	annRow.Visible = true
	annScale.Scale = fit * 0.8
	TweenService:Create(annScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Scale = fit }):Play()

	annCounter += 1
	local mine = annCounter
	task.delay(7, function()
		if annCounter ~= mine then return end
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < 0.45 do
			if annCounter ~= mine then return end
			annFade((os.clock() - t0) / 0.45)
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
		if annCounter == mine then annRow.Visible = false end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes", 20)
	local adminRemote = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("Admin", 20)
	if not adminRemote then return end
	adminRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
		if kind == "announce" then showAnnouncement(data) end
	end)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local UIKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.UIKit)
local Sfx = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Sfx)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local K = UIKit.Palette

local ICON = {

	robuxGreen = "rbxassetid://98657106137213",
	robuxWhite = "rbxassetid://102382554203100",

	rays   = "rbxassetid://75235337881072",
	glow   = "rbxassetid://110083852572719",

	gift      = "rbxassetid://112514590166782",
	arrowDown = "rbxassetid://83205092246605",}

local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Name = "GamePanels"
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screen.DisplayOrder = 5
screen.Parent = PlayerGui

local corner = UIKit.corner
local tint = UIKit.tint

local function block(props)
	local face = UIKit.block(props)
	if props.clickable and props.react ~= false then
		UIKit.reactToCursor(face)
	end
	return face
end

local reactToCursor = UIKit.reactToCursor
local tintOnHover = UIKit.tintOnHover
local headHeight = UIKit.headHeight

local function crossMark(parent, span, thick, colour, zindex)
	UIKit.cross(parent, parent.Size.X.Offset, colour)
end

local PANEL_INK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64)
local PANEL_MARK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 224)

local repaintBlock = UIKit.repaint

local function boldLabel(parent, props)
	props.parent = parent
	return UIKit.boldLabel(props)
end

local function art(parent, props)
	local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	i.Name = props.name or "Icon"
	i.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	i.Image = props.image
	i.Size = props.size
	i.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
	i.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()

	i.ScaleType = props.scale or Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	i.ZIndex = props.zindex or 20
	i.Parent = parent
	if props.tint then
		i.ImageColor3 = props.tint
	end
	if props.transparency then
		i.ImageTransparency = props.transparency
	end
	return i
end

local panels = {}
local bodies = {}
local scales = {}
local fits = {}

local function makePanel(id, title, width, height, iconImage, plainBody, iconAspect)
	local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
	shell.Name = id
	shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shell.Visible = false
	shell.ZIndex = 10
	shell.Parent = screen

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = shell
	scales[id] = scale
	fits[id] = UIKit.fitWindow(shell, scale)

	local frame = block({
		parent = shell, name = "Frame", tone = K.panel, size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
		radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 8, bevel = false, stud = 15, studAlpha = 0.55, zindex = 10,
	})
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	frame.ClipsDescendants = false

	local headH = headHeight(width)

	local header = block({
		parent = frame, name = "Header", tone = K.bar,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headH), position = UDim2.new(),
		radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58, shadow = false, zindex = 14,
	})

	if iconImage then

		local ratio = tonumber(iconAspect) or 1
		local iconH = headH - (ratio > 1.2 and 4 or 14)
		local iconW = math.floor(iconH * ratio + 0.5)
		local iconY = math.floor((headH - iconH) / 2)
		art(header, {
			name = "IconShadow", image = iconImage,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconW, iconH),
			position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, iconY + 4), zindex = 20,
			tint = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), transparency = 0.55,
		})
		art(header, {
			name = "Icon", image = iconImage,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconW, iconH),
			position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, iconY), zindex = 21,
		})
	end

	boldLabel(header, {
		name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		text = title, strokeW = 4, strokeColour = PANEL_INK, zindex = 22,
		textSize = math.floor(headH * 0.68),
	})

	local shut = headH - 24
	local close = block({
		parent = header, name = "Close", tone = K.close, clickable = true, react = false,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(shut, shut),
		position = UDim2.new(1, -(shut + 14), 0.5, 0), anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		radius = math.floor(headH * 0.16), outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.70, shadowY = 4, zindex = 22,
	})
	tintOnHover(close, K.close)
	crossMark(close, math.floor(shut * 0.55), 6, PANEL_MARK, 30)
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		shell.Visible = false
	end)

	local body
	if plainBody then
		body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.BorderSizePixel = 0
		body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		body.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		body.ClipsDescendants = false
		body.ZIndex = 12
		body.Parent = frame
	else
		body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.BorderSizePixel = 0
		body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, headH + 12)
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -(headH + 28))
		body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
		body.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		body.ScrollBarThickness = 8
		body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.slab.hi
		body.ZIndex = 14
		body.Parent = frame

		local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 14)
		list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		list.Parent = body

		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14)
		pad.Parent = body
	end

	local holdsBlur = false
	shell:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if shell.Visible ~= holdsBlur then
			holdsBlur = shell.Visible
			UIKit.blurHold(holdsBlur)
		end
	end)

	panels[id] = shell
	bodies[id] = body
	return shell, body, width - 64
end

local FLAT_TEXT = 3
local FLAT_BTN_R = 12
local FLAT_INK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64)
local FLAT_EDGE = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

local FREE_W, FREE_H = 600, 600
local freeShell, freeBody = makePanel("FreeRewards", "FREE REWARDS", FREE_W, FREE_H, ICON.gift, true)
local BODY_W = FREE_W

do
	local freeRemote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("FreeReward")

	local joined, verifiable, claimed = false, false, false

	local TASK_W, TASK_H = 500, 62
	local TASK_X = math.floor((BODY_W - TASK_W) / 2)

	local GROUP_ID = tonumber(Config.FreeReward and Config.FreeReward.GroupId) or 0

	local function openGroupPage()
		if GROUP_ID <= 0 then
			warn("[FreeReward] Config.FreeReward.GroupId = 0, set the group id in ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config, otherwise there is nothing to open and nothing to verify")
			return
		end
		pcall(function() game:GetService("GroupService"):PromptJoinAsync(GROUP_ID) end)

		task.delay(3, function()
			freeRemote:FireServer("get")
		end)
	end

	local function taskButton(name, y, text, onClick)
		local tile = block({
			parent = freeBody, name = name, tone = K.claimed, clickable = onClick ~= nil,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(TASK_W, TASK_H), position = UDim2.fromOffset(TASK_X, y),
			radius = FLAT_BTN_R, outline = 2, edge = FLAT_EDGE, stud = 12, studAlpha = 0.45, shadowY = 4, zindex = 16,
		})
		local label = boldLabel(tile, {
			name = "Label", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
			text = text, strokeW = FLAT_TEXT, strokeColour = FLAT_INK, zindex = 26, textSize = 34,
		})
		if onClick then
			tile.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
		end
		return tile, label
	end

	local likeTile, likeLabel = taskButton("TaskLike", 127, "Like the Game!")
	local groupTile, groupLabel = taskButton("TaskGroup", 205, "Join Our Group!", openGroupPage)

	art(freeBody, {
		name = "Arrow", image = ICON.arrowDown,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 72),
		position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 300), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		zindex = 20,
	})

	local prizeRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	prizeRow.Name = "Prize"
	prizeRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	prizeRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, 56)
	prizeRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 387)
	prizeRow.ZIndex = 20
	prizeRow.Parent = freeBody

	local prizeLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	prizeLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	prizeLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	prizeLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	prizeLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	prizeLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
	prizeLayout.Parent = prizeRow

	local SHOE_ICON = "rbxassetid://126213576980021"
	local function speedText(v)
		v = tonumber(v) or 0
		if v >= 1e6 then return ("%gM"):format(math.floor(v / 1e5) / 10) end
		if v >= 1e3 then return ("%gK"):format(math.floor(v / 1e2) / 10) end
		return tostring(math.floor(v))
	end

	local leftCoin = art(prizeRow, { name = "CoinLeft", image = SHOE_ICON, size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), zindex = 21 })
	leftCoin.LayoutOrder = 1
	leftCoin.Rotation = -16

	local prizeLabel = boldLabel(prizeRow, {
		name = "Amount", size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 56),
		text = ("+%s Speed!"):format(speedText(Config.FreeReward and Config.FreeReward.Speed or 5000)),
		colour = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 64), strokeW = FLAT_TEXT, strokeColour = FLAT_INK, zindex = 22, textSize = 44,
	})
	prizeLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	prizeLabel.LayoutOrder = 2

	local rightCoin = art(prizeRow, { name = "CoinRight", image = SHOE_ICON, size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), zindex = 21 })
	rightCoin.LayoutOrder = 3
	rightCoin.Rotation = 16

	local CLAIM_W, CLAIM_H = 380, 78
	local claim = block({
		parent = freeBody, name = "Claim", tone = K.ready, clickable = true,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(CLAIM_W, CLAIM_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor((BODY_W - CLAIM_W) / 2), 463),
		radius = FLAT_BTN_R, outline = 2, edge = FLAT_EDGE, stud = 13, studAlpha = 0.42, shadowY = 5, zindex = 16,
	})
	local claimMark = art(claim, {
		name = "Mark", image = ICON.gift, size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 90),
		position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), zindex = 26,
	})
	local claimLabel = boldLabel(claim, {
		name = "Label", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = "Claim",
		strokeW = FLAT_TEXT, strokeColour = FLAT_INK, zindex = 28, textSize = 46,
	})

	local function refreshClaim()
		if claimed then
			claimLabel.Text = "Claimed"
			repaintBlock(claim, K.lock)
		elseif verifiable and joined then
			claimLabel.Text = "Claim"
			repaintBlock(claim, K.ready)
		else
			claimLabel.Text = "Locked"
			repaintBlock(claim, K.lock)
		end
		claimMark.Visible = true

		likeLabel.Text = "Like the Game!"
		repaintBlock(likeTile, K.claimed)

		groupLabel.Text = "Join Our Group!"
		repaintBlock(groupTile, K.claimed)
	end

	claim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if claimed or not (verifiable and joined) then return end
		freeRemote:FireServer("claim")
	end)

	freeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
		if kind == "state" and type(data) == "table" then
			claimed = data.claimed == true
			verifiable = data.verifiable == true
			joined = data.joined == true
			if data.speed then
				prizeLabel.Text = ("+%s Speed!"):format(speedText(data.speed))
			end
			refreshClaim()
		elseif kind == "granted" then
			claimed = true
			claimLabel.Text = "Thank You!"
			repaintBlock(claim, K.bar)
			task.delay(1.8, function()
				freeShell.Visible = false
				refreshClaim()
			end)
		elseif kind == "denied" then
			local short = { ["already claimed"] = "Claimed", ["join the group first"] = "Join First" }
			claimLabel.Text = short[tostring(data)] or "Try Later"
			task.delay(1.6, refreshClaim)
		end
	end)

	refreshClaim()
	freeRemote:FireServer("get")

	freeShell:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if freeShell.Visible then
			freeRemote:FireServer("get")
		end
	end)
end

local SIZES = {
	FreeRewards = Vector2.new(FREE_W, FREE_H),
}

local PANELS_ORDER, PANELS_ORDER_OPEN = 5, 7
do
	local function syncOrder()
		for _, panel in pairs(panels) do
			if panel.Visible then
				screen.DisplayOrder = PANELS_ORDER_OPEN
				return
			end
		end
		screen.DisplayOrder = PANELS_ORDER
	end
	for _, panel in pairs(panels) do
		panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(syncOrder)
	end
	syncOrder()
end

_G.ClosePanels = function()
	for _, panel in pairs(panels) do
		panel.Visible = false
	end
end

local function open(id)

	local current = panels[id]
	if not current then
		for _, panel in pairs(panels) do panel.Visible = false end
		return
	end
	if current.Visible then
		current.Visible = false
		Sfx.play("close")
		return
	end
	Sfx.play("open")

	for panelId, panel in pairs(panels) do
		panel.Visible = (panelId == id)
	end

	local body = bodies[id]
	if body and body:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		body.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end

	local grid = body and body:FindFirstChild("Grid")
	if grid and grid:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		grid.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
	local panel = panels[id]
	local target = SIZES[id]
	if panel and target then

		panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(target.X, target.Y)
		local fitted = fits[id] and fits[id]() or 1
		if scales[id] then
			UIKit.popOpen(scales[id], fitted)
		end
	end
end

local bus = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("OpenPanel")
bus.Event:Connect(open)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local UIKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.UIKit)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("Settings")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local S = table.clone(Config.DefaultSettings)

local baseVolume = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function scaleFor(sound)
	local on = S.SFX
	if sound:HasTag("Music") or sound:GetAttribute("Music") == true then on = S.Music end
	if not on then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(S.Volume, 0, 1)
end

local function applyToSound(sound)
	if baseVolume[sound] == nil then baseVolume[sound] = sound.Volume end
	sound.Volume = baseVolume[sound] * scaleFor(sound)
end

local function applyAll()
	for sound in pairs(baseVolume) do
		if sound.Parent then applyToSound(sound) end
	end
end

local function hook(inst)
	if inst:IsA("Sound") then
		applyToSound(inst)
	end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)
PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)
for _, d in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do hook(d) end
for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do hook(d) end

local MARGIN = 18
local BAR_H = 67
local GAP_HEADER = 14
local WINDOW_W = 640
local BODY_W = WINDOW_W - 2 * MARGIN
local ROW_H = 62
local ROW_GAP = 12
local ROW_COUNT = 5
local WINDOW_H = BAR_H + GAP_HEADER + ROW_COUNT * ROW_H + (ROW_COUNT - 1) * ROW_GAP + MARGIN
local BTN_H = 42
local CTRL_W = 200
local TOGGLE_W = 120
local CTRL_X = BODY_W - CTRL_W - 14
local NAME_W = CTRL_X - 18 - 12

local screen = UIKit.screen("SettingsPanel", PlayerGui, 9)
local root, panel = UIKit.window({
	parent = screen, name = "Settings", title = "SETTINGS", icon = UIKit.ICON.settings,
	width = WINDOW_W, height = WINDOW_H, margin = MARGIN, barHeight = BAR_H, zindex = 10,
})

root:SetAttribute("SkinSizeFactor", 0.83)

local innerBorder = root:FindFirstChild("Inner")
if innerBorder then innerBorder:Destroy() end

local controls = {}

local function row(order, name)
	local w = UIKit.block({
		parent = root, name = "Row_" .. name:gsub("%s", ""), tone = K.row,
		radius = 14, stud = 13,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, ROW_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, BAR_H + GAP_HEADER + (order - 1) * (ROW_H + ROW_GAP)),
		zindex = 12,
	})
	UIKit.darkLabel({
		parent = w, name = "Label",
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_W, ROW_H - 20), position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 10),
		text = name, align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, textSize = 21,
		truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, zindex = 16,
	})
	return w
end

local function toggle(key, name, order, words)
	local onWord, offWord = words and words[1] or "ON", words and words[2] or "OFF"
	local w = row(order, name)
	local b = UIKit.block({
		parent = w, name = "Toggle", tone = K.ready, radius = 11, clickable = true, stud = 11,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(TOGGLE_W, BTN_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(CTRL_X + CTRL_W - TOGGLE_W, math.floor((ROW_H - BTN_H) / 2)),
		zindex = 16,
	})
	local label = UIKit.boldLabel({
		parent = b, name = "Label", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		text = onWord, textSize = 19, zindex = 20,
	})
	UIKit.reactToCursor(b)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		remote:FireServer("set", key, not S[key])
	end)
	controls[key] = function(v)
		label.Text = v and onWord or offWord
		UIKit.repaint(b, v and K.ready or K.close)
	end
end

local function volume(order)
	local w = row(order, "VOLUME")
	local SIDE = BTN_H
	local y = math.floor((ROW_H - BTN_H) / 2)
	local function step(name, sign, x, tone, delta)
		local b = UIKit.block({
			parent = w, name = name, tone = tone, radius = 11, clickable = true, stud = 11,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIDE, SIDE), position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), zindex = 16,
		})

		local LEN, THICK, EDGE = 22, 6, 2
		local function bar(w2, h2, z, colour, pad)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.Name = "Sign"
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w2 + pad * 2, h2 + pad * 2)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = colour
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.ZIndex = z
			f.Active = false
			local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
			c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(THICK / 2) + pad)
			c.Parent = f
			f.Parent = b
		end
		bar(LEN, THICK, 19, K.outline, EDGE)
		bar(LEN, THICK, 20, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
		if sign == "+" then
			bar(THICK, LEN, 19, K.outline, EDGE)
			bar(THICK, LEN, 20, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
		end
		UIKit.reactToCursor(b)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			remote:FireServer("set", "Volume", math.clamp(S.Volume + delta, 0, 1))
		end)
	end
	step("Minus", "-", CTRL_X + CTRL_W - 2 * SIDE - 16, K.close, -0.1)
	step("Plus", "+", CTRL_X + CTRL_W - SIDE, K.ready, 0.1)

	local value = UIKit.darkLabel({
		parent = w, name = "Value",
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(CTRL_W - 2 * SIDE - 30, BTN_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(CTRL_X, y),
		text = "70%", align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, textSize = 21, zindex = 16,
	})
	controls.Volume = function(v)
		value.Text = ("%d%%"):format(math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5))
	end
end

toggle("Music", "MUSIC", 1)
toggle("SFX", "SOUND EFFECTS", 2)
volume(3)
toggle("HideOwnPets", "HIDE MY PETS", 4, { "YES", "NO" })
toggle("HideOtherPets", "HIDE OTHER PETS", 5, { "YES", "NO" })

local HIDEABLE = { "BillboardGui", "SurfaceGui", "ParticleEmitter", "Beam", "Trail", "Highlight", "Light" }
local petFolder

local function petHidden(model)
	local owner = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId"))
	if owner == LocalPlayer.UserId then return S.HideOwnPets == true end
	return S.HideOtherPets == true
end

local function hidePart(d, hide)
	if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then
		d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hide and 1 or 0
		return
	end
	for _, class in ipairs(HIDEABLE) do
		if d:IsA(class) then
			local was = d:GetAttribute("PetHideWas")
			if hide then
				if was == nil then d:SetAttribute("PetHideWas", d.Enabled) end
				d.Enabled = false
			elseif was ~= nil then
				d.Enabled = was
				d:SetAttribute("PetHideWas", nil)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

local function applyPet(model, force)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	local hide = petHidden(model)
	if not force and (model:GetAttribute("PetHidden") == true) == hide then return end
	model:SetAttribute("PetHidden", hide)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do hidePart(d, hide) end
end

local function applyPets()
	if not petFolder then return end
	for _, m in ipairs(petFolder:GetChildren()) do applyPet(m) end
end

local function watchPet(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OwnerUserId"):Connect(function() applyPet(model) end)
	model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		if model:GetAttribute("PetHidden") == true then hidePart(d, true) end
	end)
	applyPet(model, true)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld", 60)
	petFolder = map and map:WaitForChild("PlacedAnimals", 60)
	if not petFolder then return end
	petFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(watchPet)
	for _, m in ipairs(petFolder:GetChildren()) do watchPet(m) end
end)

local function render()
	for key, fn in pairs(controls) do fn(S[key]) end
end

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
	if kind ~= "state" or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	for k, v in pairs(data) do S[k] = v end
	render()
	applyAll()
	applyPets()
end)

local bus = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("OpenPanel")
bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
	if id == "Settings" then
		if panel.isOpen() then panel.close() else panel.open() end
	elseif panel.isOpen() then
		panel.close()
	end
end)

render()
remote:FireServer("get")
