local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local UIKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.UIKit)

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:WaitForChild("Admin")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local SECOND_TEXT = UIKit.SECOND
local PREFIX = "/admin"

local authorized = false
local selected = nil
local roster = {}

local MARGIN = 18
local BAR_H = 84
local GAP = 14

local WINDOW_W = 820
local BODY_W = WINDOW_W - 2 * MARGIN
local TAB_H = 44
local PAGE_H = 330
local LOG_H = 96
local WINDOW_H = BAR_H + GAP + TAB_H + GAP + PAGE_H + GAP + LOG_H + MARGIN
local PAGE_Y = BAR_H + GAP + TAB_H + GAP

local PAGE_PAD = 6
local CONTENT_W = BODY_W - 2 * PAGE_PAD
local CONTENT_H = PAGE_H - 2 * PAGE_PAD
local CAP_H = 22
local CAP_GAP = 30
local SECTION_GAP = 18
local COL_GAP = 12

local function listPadding(list)
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.Parent = list
	return pad
end

local screen = UIKit.screen("AdminPanel", PlayerGui, 20)
local root, panel = UIKit.window({
	parent = screen, name = "Admin", title = "ADMIN PANEL", icon = UIKit.ICON.admin,
	width = WINDOW_W, height = WINDOW_H, margin = MARGIN, barHeight = BAR_H, zindex = 10,
})

local logBox = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
logBox.Name = "Log"
logBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, LOG_H)
logBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, WINDOW_H - MARGIN - LOG_H)
logBox.BackgroundColor3 = K.outline
logBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
logBox.ScrollBarThickness = 6
logBox.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.innerOutline
logBox.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
logBox.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
logBox.ZIndex = 12
logBox.Parent = root
UIKit.corner(logBox, 10)
UIKit.stroke(logBox, K.innerOutline, 2, 0)

local logList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
logList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
logList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
logList.Parent = logBox

local logPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
logPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPad.Parent = logBox

local showLog

local logOrder = 0
local function log(text, colour)
	logOrder += 1
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = "Line"
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 18)
	l.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	l.Text = text
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextColor3 = colour or Color3.fromRGB(196, 204, 226)
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	l.LayoutOrder = logOrder
	l.ZIndex = 14
	l.Parent = logBox
	l.TextScaled = false
	l.TextSize = 14
	task.defer(function() logBox.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1e6) end)
	if showLog then showLog() end
end

local function send(cmd)
	log("> " .. cmd, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	remote:FireServer("cmd", cmd)
end

local function needSelected()
	if not selected then
		log("pick a player on the PLAYER tab first", K.close.base)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local CONFIRM_W, CONFIRM_H = 460, 240
local confirmRoot, confirmPanel = UIKit.window({
	parent = screen, name = "Confirm", title = "CONFIRM",
	width = CONFIRM_W, height = CONFIRM_H, margin = MARGIN, barHeight = 48, zindex = 30,
})
local confirmText = UIKit.boldLabel({
	parent = confirmRoot, name = "Text",
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(CONFIRM_W - 2 * MARGIN, 78),
	position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, MARGIN + 48 + 12),
	text = "", textSize = 17, wrapped = true, zindex = 34,
})

local pendingAction = nil
UIKit.button({
	parent = confirmRoot, name = "Yes", tone = K.close, text = "CONFIRM", textSize = 19,
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(196, 48),
	position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, CONFIRM_H - MARGIN - 48), zindex = 32,
	onClick = function()
		if pendingAction then pendingAction() end
		pendingAction = nil
		confirmPanel.close()
	end,
})
UIKit.button({
	parent = confirmRoot, name = "No", tone = K.lock, text = "CANCEL", textSize = 19,
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(196, 48),
	position = UDim2.fromOffset(CONFIRM_W - MARGIN - 196, CONFIRM_H - MARGIN - 48), zindex = 32,
	onClick = function()
		pendingAction = nil
		confirmPanel.close()
	end,
})

local function confirm(text, fn)
	confirmText.Text = text
	pendingAction = fn
	confirmPanel.open()
end

local TAB_NAMES = { "PLAYER", "ECONOMY", "EGGS", "SERVER", "EVENTS" }
local SECTION_TAB = {
	PLAYERS = "PLAYER", MODERATION = "PLAYER", SPEED = "PLAYER", BAT = "PLAYER", LEVELS = "PLAYER",
	ECONOMY = "ECONOMY",
	SERVER = "SERVER", DAYNIGHT = "SERVER", EVENTS_SPECIAL = "EVENTS",
	EGGS = "EGGS", HATCHING = "SERVER", MAPEGGS = "SERVER",
}
local TAB_GAP = 8
local TAB_W = math.floor((BODY_W - (#TAB_NAMES - 1) * TAB_GAP) / #TAB_NAMES)

local PAGE_H_WITH_LOG = PAGE_H
local PAGE_H_ALONE = PAGE_H + GAP + LOG_H

local pages, tabs, scrollers, sections = {}, {}, {}, {}

for _, name in ipairs(TAB_NAMES) do
	local s = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	s.Name = "Page_" .. name
	s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	s.BorderSizePixel = 0
	s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, PAGE_H_ALONE)
	s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, PAGE_Y)
	s.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	s.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	s.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	s.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.innerOutline
	s.Visible = false
	s.ZIndex = 12
	s.Parent = root

	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, SECTION_GAP)
	list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	list.Parent = s

	scrollers[name] = s
end

local function makePage(name)
	local p = Instance.new("Frame")
	p.Name = name
	p.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, PAGE_H)
	p.LayoutOrder = #sections + 1
	p.ZIndex = 12
	p.Parent = scrollers[SECTION_TAB[name] or name]

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, PAGE_PAD)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, PAGE_PAD)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, PAGE_PAD)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, PAGE_PAD)
	pad.Parent = p

	sections[#sections + 1] = p
	pages[name] = p
	return p
end

local function fitSections()
	for _, p in ipairs(sections) do
		local lowest = 0
		for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
				local h = c.Size.Y.Offset
				if h == 0 then h = c.AbsoluteSize.Y end
				lowest = math.max(lowest, c.Position.Y.Offset + h)
			end
		end
		p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, math.max(lowest + PAGE_PAD * 2, 40))
	end
end

local function showTab(name)
	for n, s in pairs(scrollers) do s.Visible = (n == name) end
	for n, b in pairs(tabs) do
		UIKit.repaint(b, n == name and K.inProgress or K.lock)
		b:SetAttribute("Active", n ~= name)
	end
end

for i, name in ipairs(TAB_NAMES) do
	tabs[name] = UIKit.button({
		parent = root, name = "Tab_" .. name, tone = K.lock, text = name, textSize = 18,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(TAB_W, TAB_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN + (i - 1) * (TAB_W + TAB_GAP), BAR_H + GAP),
		zindex = 12,
		onClick = function() showTab(name) end,
	})
end

local LOG_LINGER = 10
local logToken = 0

local function setLogShown(on)
	logBox.Visible = on
	local h = on and PAGE_H_WITH_LOG or PAGE_H_ALONE
	for _, s in pairs(scrollers) do
		s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BODY_W, h)
	end
end
setLogShown(false)

showLog = function()
	setLogShown(true)
	logToken += 1
	local mine = logToken
	task.delay(LOG_LINGER, function()
		if logToken == mine then setLogShown(false) end
	end)
end

local titleLabel
do
	local header = root:FindFirstChild("Header")
	titleLabel = header and header:FindFirstChild("Title")
	if titleLabel then

		titleLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	end
end

local TITLE_NAME_MAX = 15

local function refreshTitle()
	if not titleLabel then return end

	if not selected then
		titleLabel.Text = "ADMIN PANEL"
		return
	end
	local name = selected.name
	if #name > TITLE_NAME_MAX then
		name = name:sub(1, TITLE_NAME_MAX - 1) .. utf8.char(0x2026)
	end
	titleLabel.Text = ("ADMIN  %s"):format(name)
end
refreshTitle()

local function caption(owner, text, y)
	return UIKit.boldLabel({
		parent = owner, size = UDim2.fromOffset(CONTENT_W, CAP_H), position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y),
		text = text, align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, textSize = 16,
		colour = K.bar.base, zindex = 16,
	})
end

local pagePlayers = makePage("PLAYERS")
local selectedLabel = UIKit.boldLabel({
	parent = pagePlayers, name = "Selected",
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(CONTENT_W, 24), position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
	text = "nobody selected", align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, textSize = 17,
	colour = K.bar.base, zindex = 16,
})

local playerList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
playerList.Name = "List"
playerList.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CONTENT_W, CONTENT_H - 34)
playerList.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34)
playerList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
playerList.BorderSizePixel = 0
playerList.ScrollBarThickness = 6
playerList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.row.base
playerList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
playerList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
playerList.ZIndex = 16
playerList.Parent = pagePlayers

local rowList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
rowList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
rowList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
rowList.Parent = playerList
listPadding(playerList)

local RowCfg = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local function shortNum(n)
	n = tonumber(n) or 0
	local units = { { 1e15, "Qa" }, { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1e6, "M" }, { 1e3, "K" } }
	for _, u in ipairs(units) do
		if math.abs(n) >= u[1] then
			local s = ("%.2f"):format(n / u[1]):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
			return s .. u[2]
		end
	end
	return tostring(math.floor(n))
end

local function renderPlayers()
	for _, c in ipairs(playerList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	for i, entry in ipairs(roster) do
		local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
		holder.Name = "Slot_" .. entry.userId
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1

		holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
		holder.LayoutOrder = i
		holder.ZIndex = 16
		holder.Parent = playerList

		local picked = (selected and selected.userId == entry.userId)
		local row = UIKit.block({
			parent = holder, name = "Row", tone = picked and K.claimed or K.row,
			radius = 11, stud = 11,
			size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), zindex = 16,
		})
		local label = picked and UIKit.boldLabel or UIKit.darkLabel
		label({
			parent = row, name = "Info",
			size = UDim2.new(1, -134, 1, -10), position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5),
			text = (function()
				local p = Players:FindFirstChild(entry.name)
				local sp = p and tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Speed")) or 1
				return ("%s    $%s    Speed %s"):format(entry.name,
					shortNum(entry.coins or 0),
					RowCfg.fmtSpeed(sp))
			end)(),
			align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, textSize = 15,
			truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, zindex = 20,
		})
		UIKit.button({
			parent = row, name = "Select", tone = K.ready, text = "SELECT", textSize = 15,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 32), position = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, 6), zindex = 18,
			onClick = function()
				selected = { userId = entry.userId, name = entry.name }
				selectedLabel.Text = "selected: " .. entry.name
				refreshTitle()
				renderPlayers()
			end,
		})
	end
end

local AMOUNT_SUFFIX = { K = 1e3, M = 1e6, B = 1e9, T = 1e12, QA = 1e15 }
local function parseAmount(text)
	local s = tostring(text or ""):gsub("[%s,%$]", ""):upper()
	local digits, suffix = s:match("^([%d%.]+)(%a*)$")
	local n = tonumber(digits)
	if not n then return nil end
	if suffix ~= "" then
		local k = AMOUNT_SUFFIX[suffix]
		if not k then return nil end
		n *= k
	end
	return math.floor(n)
end

local pageEco = makePage("ECONOMY")
caption(pageEco, "COINS FOR THE SELECTED PLAYER", 0)

local ECO = {
	{ "+10K COINS", K.ready, "coins", 1e4 },
	{ "+1M COINS", K.ready, "coins", 1e6 },
	{ "+1B COINS", K.claimed, "coins", 1e9 },
	{ "-1M COINS", K.close, "removecoins", 1e6 },
}
local ECO_H = 50
local ECO_W = math.floor((CONTENT_W - (#ECO - 1) * COL_GAP) / #ECO)
for i, def in ipairs(ECO) do
	UIKit.button({
		parent = pageEco, tone = def[2], text = def[1], textSize = 18,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(ECO_W, ECO_H),
		position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) * (ECO_W + COL_GAP), CAP_GAP),

		local scope = boostEverywhere and "all" or "here"

		else

		end,

local function refreshBoostRows()
	local now = os.time()
	for kind, row in pairs(boostRows) do
		local e = boostLive[kind]
		local rowNow = now
		if row.def.live then
			e = row.def.live()
			rowNow = e.now
		end
		local active = false
		if type(e) == "table" and (e.active or (tonumber(e.mult) or 1) > 1) then
			local ends = tonumber(e.endsAt) or 0
			if ends == 0 or ends > rowNow then
				active = true
				local mult = tonumber(e.mult) or 1
				if ends > 0 and row.def.noValue then
					local left = math.ceil(ends - rowNow)
					row.status.Text = ("ACTIVE - %d:%02d left"):format(left // 60, left % 60)
				elseif ends > 0 then
					local left = math.ceil(ends - rowNow)
					row.status.Text = ("ACTIVE x%g - %d:%02d left"):format(mult, left // 60, left % 60)
				else
					row.status.Text = ("ACTIVE x%g - no limit"):format(mult)
				end
			end
		end
		if not active then row.status.Text = "off" end
		if row.painted ~= active then
			row.painted = active
			UIKit.repaint(row.start, active and K.inProgress or K.ready)
			local label = row.start:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
			if label then label.Text = active and "UPDATE" or "START" end
		end
	end
end

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local Gui = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local SKIP = { Backdrop = true, Shade = true, Dim = true }
local PREFERRED = { "Buy", "Claim", "Confirm", "Next" }
local ENTRY = { "DropButton", "Card", "GrowAll", "EquipBest", "Shop" }
local DPAD = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown] = true,
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight] = true,
}

local group = nil
local padUI = false

local function pad()
	return UIS.GamepadEnabled and UIS:GetLastInputType().Name:find("Gamepad") ~= nil
end

local function shown(o)
	local a = o
	while a and a ~= pg do
		if a:IsA("GuiObject") and not a.Visible then return false end
		if a:IsA("LayerCollector") and not a.Enabled then return false end
		a = a.Parent
	end
	return a == pg
end

local function usable(o)
	return o:IsA("GuiButton") and o.Active and o.Selectable
		and o.AbsoluteSize.X > 4 and o.AbsoluteSize.Y > 4 and shown(o)
end

local function menuOpen()
	local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PanelBlur")
	if blur and blur.Enabled then return true end
	for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
		if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen:GetAttribute("Open") == true then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function panel()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local view = camera and camera.ViewportSize.X * camera.ViewportSize.Y or 1
	local pick, order, size = nil, nil, nil
	for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
		if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen.Enabled then
			local top, area = nil, 0
			for _, d in screen:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("GuiObject") and not SKIP[d.Name] and d.Visible then
					local a = d.AbsoluteSize.X * d.AbsoluteSize.Y
					if a > area and shown(d) then
						for _, c in d:GetDescendants() do
							if usable(c) then top, area = d, a break end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if top and (screen:GetAttribute("Open") == true or area >= view * 0.35) then
				if not pick or screen.DisplayOrder > order or (screen.DisplayOrder == order and area > size) then
					pick, order, size = top, screen.DisplayOrder, area
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return pick
end

local function choose(root)
	for _, name in PREFERRED do
		for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
			if d.Name == name and usable(d) then return d end
		end
	end
	local pick, score = nil, math.huge
	for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
		if usable(d) and d.Name ~= "Close" then
			local v = d.AbsolutePosition.Y * 4 + d.AbsolutePosition.X
			if v < score then pick, score = d, v end
		end
	end
	if pick then return pick end
	local close = root:FindFirstChild("Close", true)
	return close and usable(close) and close or nil
end

local function release()
	if not group then return end
	if Gui.SelectedObject and Gui.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(group) then Gui.SelectedObject = nil end
	group.SelectionGroup = false
	group = nil
end

local function hudEntry()
	for _, name in ENTRY do
		for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
			if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen.Enabled then
				for _, d in screen:GetDescendants() do
					if d.Name == name and usable(d) then return d end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function drop()
	padUI = false
	if Gui.SelectedObject then Gui.SelectedObject = nil end
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if not DPAD[input.KeyCode] or not pad() or menuOpen() then return end
	padUI = true
	if not Gui.SelectedObject then Gui.SelectedObject = hudEntry() end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 or input.Position.Magnitude < 0.2 then return end
	if not menuOpen() then drop() end
end)

UIS.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function()
	if not pad() then drop() end
end)

local elapsed = 0
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 0.15 then return end
	elapsed = 0
	if not pad() then
		release()
		drop()
		return
	end
	if not menuOpen() then
		release()
		local current = Gui.SelectedObject
		if padUI and not (current and usable(current)) then Gui.SelectedObject = hudEntry() end
		return
	end
	local current = Gui.SelectedObject
	if group and current and current:IsDescendantOf(group) and usable(current) then return end
	local root = panel()
	if not root then release() return end
	if group ~= root then
		if group then group.SelectionGroup = false end
		group = root
		root.SelectionGroup = true
		root.SelectionBehaviorUp = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
		root.SelectionBehaviorDown = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
		root.SelectionBehaviorLeft = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
		root.SelectionBehaviorRight = Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
		for _, screen in pg:GetChildren() do
			if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				for _, d in screen:GetDescendants() do
					if SKIP[d.Name] and d:IsA("GuiButton") then d.Selectable = false end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	Gui.SelectedObject = choose(root)
end)

name: DecorCulling
source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local BEHIND = 4
local AHEAD = 4
local EVERY = 0.5

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local zonesFolder = map:WaitForChild("Zones")

local park = Instance.new("Folder")
park.Name = "ParkedDecor"
park.Parent = RS

local homes = {}
for _, z in ipairs(zonesFolder:GetChildren()) do
	local n = tonumber(z.Name:match("^Zone(%d+)_"))
	if n then homes[n] = z end
end

local parked = {}
local lastCentre = 0

local function apply(centre)
	for n, zone in pairs(homes) do
		local want = n >= centre - BEHIND and n <= centre + AHEAD
		if want then
			local m = parked[n]
			if m then
				if m.Parent == park then m.Parent = zone end
				parked[n] = nil
			end
		else
			local m = zone:FindFirstChild("Decor")
			if m then
				parked[n] = m
				m.Parent = park
			end
		end
	end
end

local function centreOf(root)
	local ok, n = pcall(Cfg.zoneAt, root.Position.Z)
	if ok and type(n) == "number" then lastCentre = n end
	return lastCentre
end

local function parkLibrary()
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	if lib then lib.Parent = RS end
end
workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child.Name == "AnimalLibrary" then task.defer(parkLibrary) end
end)
parkLibrary()

while true do
	local ch = plr.Character
	local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		apply(centreOf(root))
	end
	task.wait(EVERY)
end

name: CosmicSpin
source:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local RING_SPEED   = 0.35
local PLANET_SPEED = 0.16
local PORTAL_SPEED = 0.22

local rigs = {}
local dirty = {}
local base = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local clock = 0

local function baseOf(p)
	local cf = base[p]
	if not cf then
		cf = p.CFrame
		base[p] = cf
	end
	return cf
end

local function centroid(parts)
	local sum = Vector3.zero
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do sum += baseOf(p).Position end
	return sum / #parts
end

local function planeNormal(parts, c)
	local v1 = (baseOf(parts[1]).Position - c)
	if v1.Magnitude < 1e-4 then v1 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
	v1 = v1.Unit
	local best, bestMag = nil, 0
	for i = 2, #parts do
		local v = baseOf(parts[i]).Position - c
		if v.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
			local cr = v1:Cross(v.Unit)
			if cr.Magnitude > bestMag then best, bestMag = cr, cr.Magnitude end
		end
	end
	if not best or bestMag < 1e-3 then return Vector3.yAxis end
	return best.Unit
end

local function snapshot(parts)
	local t = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do table.insert(t, {part = p, cf = baseOf(p)}) end
	return t
end

local function collect(model, ringMatch, bodyMatch, ringSpeed, bodySpeed)
	local ring, body = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local n = d.Name:lower()
			if n:find(ringMatch, 1, true) then table.insert(ring, d)
			elseif bodyMatch and n:find(bodyMatch, 1, true) then table.insert(body, d) end
		end
	end
	if #ring < 3 then return end
	local c = centroid(ring)
	local axis = planeNormal(ring, c)
	local rig = {
		ringPivot = c, axis = axis, ring = snapshot(ring),
		ringSpeed = ringSpeed, bodySpeed = bodySpeed,
	}
	if #body > 0 then
		rig.bodyPivot = centroid(body)
		rig.body = snapshot(body)
	end
	return rig
end

local function build(m)
	rigs[m] = nil
	if not m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	if m.Name == "RingedPlanet" then
		rigs[m] = collect(m, "ring_block", "planet", RING_SPEED, PLANET_SPEED)
	elseif m.Name == "Portal" then
		rigs[m] = collect(m, "ring_segment", nil, PORTAL_SPEED, 0)
	end
end

local function isRig(m)
	return m and m:IsA("Model") and (m.Name == "RingedPlanet" or m.Name == "Portal")
end

local function mark(d)
	if isRig(d) then
		dirty[d] = true
	elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
		local m = d:FindFirstAncestor("RingedPlanet") or d:FindFirstAncestor("Portal")
		if isRig(m) then dirty[m] = true end
	end
end

local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld"):WaitForChild("Zones")
for _, d in ipairs(zones:GetDescendants()) do mark(d) end
zones.DescendantAdded:Connect(mark)
zones.DescendantRemoving:Connect(mark)

local function spin(parts, pivot, axis, angle)
	local r = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, angle)
	local toWorld = CFrame.new(pivot) * r * CFrame.new(-pivot)
	local stale = false
	for _, e in ipairs(parts) do
		if e.part.Parent then
			e.part.CFrame = toWorld * e.cf
		else
			stale = true
		end
	end
	return stale
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	clock += dt
	for m in pairs(dirty) do
		dirty[m] = nil
		build(m)
	end
	for m, rig in pairs(rigs) do
		if m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			local stale = spin(rig.ring, rig.ringPivot, rig.axis, clock * rig.ringSpeed)
			if rig.body and spin(rig.body, rig.bodyPivot, rig.axis, clock * rig.bodySpeed) then
				stale = true
			end
			if stale then dirty[m] = true end
		else
			rigs[m] = nil
		end
	end
end)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local zone = map:WaitForChild("Zones"):WaitForChild("Zone10_CherryBlossom")

local TOP, BOTTOM = 44, 0.4
local rng = Random.new(tick() * 1000 % 2^31)

local homes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local petals = {}
local byPart = {}
local decor, model
local decorConns, modelConns = {}, {}

local function disconnect(list)
	for _, c in ipairs(list) do c:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(list)
end

local function addPetal(p)
	if not p:IsA("BasePart") or byPart[p] then return end
	local home = homes[p]
	if not home then
		home = p.Position
		homes[p] = home
	end
	local e = {
		part  = p,
		x0    = home.X,
		z0    = home.Z,
		x     = home.X,
		z     = home.Z,
		y     = p.Position.Y,
		fall  = rng:NextNumber(1.6, 4.2),
		swayA = rng:NextNumber(0.8, 2.6),
		swayF = rng:NextNumber(0.5, 1.4),
		phase = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2),
		spinX = rng:NextNumber(-1.4, 1.4),
		spinY = rng:NextNumber(-2.2, 2.2),
		drift = rng:NextNumber(-0.5, 0.5),
	}
	byPart[p] = e
	table.insert(petals, e)
end

local function removePetal(p)
	local e = byPart[p]
	if not e then return end
	byPart[p] = nil
	local i = table.find(petals, e)
	if i then table.remove(petals, i) end
end

local function unbindModel()
	disconnect(modelConns)
	model = nil
	table.clear(petals)
	table.clear(byPart)
end

local function bindModel(m)
	if m == model then return end
	unbindModel()
	model = m
	for _, p in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do addPetal(p) end
	table.insert(modelConns, m.ChildAdded:Connect(addPetal))
	table.insert(modelConns, m.ChildRemoved:Connect(removePetal))
end

local function unbindDecor()
	disconnect(decorConns)
	decor = nil
	unbindModel()
end

local function bindDecor(d)
	if d == decor then return end
	unbindDecor()
	decor = d
	table.insert(decorConns, d.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		if c.Name == "FallingPetals" then bindModel(c) end
	end))
	table.insert(decorConns, d.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
		if c ~= model then return end
		unbindModel()
		local other = d:FindFirstChild("FallingPetals")
		if other then bindModel(other) end
	end))
	local m = d:FindFirstChild("FallingPetals")
	if m then bindModel(m) end
end

zone.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
	if c.Name == "Decor" then bindDecor(c) end
end)
zone.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
	if c ~= decor then return end
	unbindDecor()
	local other = zone:FindFirstChild("Decor")
	if other then bindDecor(other) end
end)
local current = zone:FindFirstChild("Decor")
if current then bindDecor(current) end

local t = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	if not model then return end
	for _, e in ipairs(petals) do
		e.y -= e.fall * dt
		e.z += e.drift * dt
		if e.y <= BOTTOM then
			e.y = TOP + rng:NextNumber(0, 8)
			e.x = e.x0 + rng:NextNumber(-3, 3)
			e.z = e.z0
			e.fall = rng:NextNumber(1.6, 4.2)
		end
		local sway = math.sin(t * e.swayF + e.phase) * e.swayA
		e.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(e.x + sway, e.y, e.z)
			* CFrame.Angles(t * e.spinX, t * e.spinY, sway * 0.35)
	end
end)

local PetPaint = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("AnimalPaint"))
local AssetQueue = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("AssetQueue"))

local IconContent = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local iconToken = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local iconLoaded = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local ICON_REFRESH = { 1.5, 4 }

local function iconAssetsOf(tool)
    local ids, seen = {}, {}
    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
            for _, id in ipairs({ p.MeshId, p.TextureID }) do
                if id ~= "" and not seen[id] then
                    seen[id] = true
                    table.insert(ids, id)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return ids
end

local batIconConnections = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function fillIcon(view, tool, pass)
    if batIconConnections[view] then batIconConnections[view]:Disconnect() batIconConnections[view]=nil end
    view:ClearAllChildren()
    local token = (iconToken[view] or 0) + 1
    iconToken[view] = token
    pass = pass or 0
    if tool:GetAttribute("Gear") == "Stick" then
        view.CurrentCamera = nil
        local image=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        image.Name="BatArtwork" image.BackgroundTransparency=1
        image.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) image.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        image.ZIndex=view.ZIndex+1 image.Parent=view
        local function update()
            image.Image=tool.TextureId~="" and tool.TextureId or "rbxassetid://128088129405176"
        end
        update()
        local connection=tool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextureId"):Connect(update)
        batIconConnections[view]=connection
        image.Destroying:Once(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
            if batIconConnections[view]==connection then batIconConnections[view]=nil end
        end)
        return
    end
    if not iconLoaded[tool] then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ids = iconAssetsOf(tool)
            if #ids > 0 then
                pcall(IconContent.PreloadAsync, IconContent, ids)
            end
            task.wait()
            iconLoaded[tool] = true
            if iconToken[view] == token and tool.Parent and view.Parent then
                fillIcon(view, tool, pass)
            end
        end)
        return
    end
    local nextWait = ICON_REFRESH[pass + 1]
    if nextWait then
        task.delay(nextWait, function()
            if iconToken[view] == token and tool.Parent and view.Parent then
                fillIcon(view, tool, pass + 1)
            end
        end)
    end
    local holder = Instance.new("Model")

    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local c = p:Clone()
            c:ClearAllChildren()
            c.Anchored = true
            local rest = p:GetAttribute("RestOffset")
            if handle and typeof(rest) == "CFrame" then
                c.CFrame = handle.CFrame * rest
            end
            c.Parent = holder
        end
    end
    if #holder:GetChildren() == 0 then holder:Destroy() return end
    AssetQueue.want(holder)
    holder.Parent = view
    local cf = holder:GetBoundingBox()
    local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
    cam.FieldOfView = 30

    local eye  = Vector3.new(0.86, 0.62, 1).Unit
    local roll = math.rad(30)
    local up   = Vector3.yAxis

    local viewEye, viewUp = PetPaint.viewDir(holder:GetChildren(), tool)
    if viewEye then
        eye, up = viewEye, viewUp
        roll = 0
    end
    local isTrap = tool:GetAttribute("Gear") == "Trap"
    if isTrap then
        eye = Vector3.new(0.35, 1, 0.8).Unit
        up = Vector3.yAxis
        roll = math.rad(-14)
    end
    local function aim(dist)
        return CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + eye * dist, cf.Position, up) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll)
    end

    local probe = aim(10)
    local reach = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            for dx = -1, 1, 2 do
                for dy = -1, 1, 2 do
                    for dz = -1, 1, 2 do
                        local corner = (p.CFrame
                            * CFrame.new(p.Size * Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz) / 2)).Position
                        local inCam = probe:PointToObjectSpace(corner)
                        reach = math.max(reach, math.abs(inCam.X), math.abs(inCam.Y))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if reach <= 0 then reach = 1 end

    cam.CFrame = aim(reach / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2)) * (isTrap and 0.9 or 1.08))
    cam.Parent = view
    view.CurrentCamera = cam
    view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.4)
    view.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
end

local GEAR_ORDER = { Stick = 1, Trap = 2 }

local stored = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local storedKeys = {}
local markDirty

local function keyOf(tool)
    local k = tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey")
    return (type(k) == "string" and k ~= "") and k or nil
end

local function isStored(tool)
    if stored[tool] then return true end
    local k = keyOf(tool)
    return k ~= nil and storedKeys[k] == true
end

local wantedEggs = {}
local bagReadyAt = math.huge

local function eggSig(tool)
    local z, t, s = tool:GetAttribute("EggZone"), tool:GetAttribute("EggTier"), tool:GetAttribute("EggSize")
    if not (z and t and s) then return nil end
    return ("z%d_t%d_s%d"):format(z, t, s)
end

local function eggToolsBySig()
    local by = {}
    for _, holder in ipairs({ plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), plr.Character }) do
        for _, t in ipairs(holder and holder:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and not keyOf(t) then
                local sig = eggSig(t)
                if sig then
                    by[sig] = by[sig] or {}
                    table.insert(by[sig], t)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return by
end

local function reconcileEggs()
    local by = eggToolsBySig()
    local ready = os.clock() >= bagReadyAt
    for sig, tools in pairs(by) do
        local want = wantedEggs[sig] or 0
        local have = 0
        for _, t in ipairs(tools) do if stored[t] then have += 1 end end
        for _, t in ipairs(tools) do
            if have >= want then break end
            if not stored[t] and t.Parent ~= plr.Character then
                stored[t] = true
                have += 1
            end
        end
        if ready and have ~= want then
            wantedEggs[sig] = (have > 0) and have or nil
            Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { sig = sig, count = have })
        end
    end
    if ready then
        for sig in pairs(wantedEggs) do
            if not by[sig] then
                wantedEggs[sig] = nil
                Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { sig = sig, count = 0 })
            end
        end
    end
end

local function setStored(tool, on)
    if not tool or tool:GetAttribute("Gear") then return end
    stored[tool] = on or nil
    local k = keyOf(tool)
    if k then storedKeys[k] = on or nil end
    if on and tool.Parent == plr.Character then
        local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:UnequipTools() end
    end

    if k then
        Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { key = k, on = on == true })
    else
        local sig = eggSig(tool)
        if sig then
            local n = 0
            for _, t in ipairs(eggToolsBySig()[sig] or {}) do
                if stored[t] then n += 1 end
            end
            wantedEggs[sig] = (n > 0) and n or nil
            Remote:FireServer("BagSet", { sig = sig, count = n })
        end
    end
    if markDirty then markDirty() end
end

local function toolsOfPlayer()
    local list = {}
    local function scan(parent)
        for _, t in ipairs(parent and parent:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then
                local gear = t:GetAttribute("Gear")
                local zone = t:GetAttribute("EggZone")

                local pet = t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")
                if gear or zone or pet then
                    table.insert(list, {
                        tool = t,
                        gear = gear,
                        pet = pet ~= nil,
                        zone = zone or pet,
                        tier = t:GetAttribute("EggTier") or t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1,
                        size = t:GetAttribute("EggSize") or t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1,
                        equipped = (t.Parent == plr.Character),
                        stored = isStored(t),
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    scan(plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
    scan(plr.Character)
    table.sort(list, function(p, q)
        if (p.gear ~= nil) ~= (q.gear ~= nil) then return p.gear ~= nil end
        if p.gear then
            return (GEAR_ORDER[p.gear] or 9) < (GEAR_ORDER[q.gear] or 9)
        end
        if p.tier ~= q.tier then return p.tier > q.tier end
        if p.size ~= q.size then return p.size > q.size end
        if p.zone ~= q.zone then return p.zone < q.zone end
        return p.tool.Name < q.tool.Name
    end)
    return list
end

local function carryingEgg()
    return plr:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") == true

local function useTool(tool)
    local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (hum and tool and tool.Parent) then return end
    if carryingEgg() then return end
    if plr:GetAttribute("OnTreadmill") == true or plr:GetAttribute("AdminTreadmillRunning") == true then return end
    if tool.Parent == plr.Character then hum:UnequipTools() else hum:EquipTool(tool) end
end

local function inside(obj, pos)
    if not obj.Visible then return false end
    local p, s = obj.AbsolutePosition, obj.AbsoluteSize
    return pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
end

local function slotAt(pos)
    for i, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do
        if inside(e.slot, pos) then return i end
    end
end

local function paintTargets(hover)
    for i, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do
        local equipped = e.tool ~= nil and e.tool.Parent == plr.Character
        e.stroke.Transparency = (i == hover or equipped) and 0 or 1
    end
end

local function beginDrag(tool, from, fromSlot, button, input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    suppressClick[button] = nil
    drag = { tool = tool, from = from, fromSlot = fromSlot, button = button,
             start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), active = false }
end

local function moveDrag(pos)
    if not drag then return end
    if not drag.active then
        if (pos - drag.start).Magnitude < DRAG_START or carryingEgg() or not drag.tool.Parent then return end
        drag.active = true
        suppressClick[drag.button] = true
        grid.ScrollingEnabled = false
        local side = hotSlots[1].slot.AbsoluteSize.X
        if side <= 0 then side = 60 end
        ghost.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(side, side)
        fillIcon(ghostView, drag.tool)
        ghost.Visible = true
        markDirty()
    end
    ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X - ghost.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, pos.Y - ghost.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2)
    paintTargets(slotAt(pos))
end

local function placeInSlot(tool, from, fromSlot, target)
    local other = hotSlots[target].tool
    if other and other ~= tool then
        if from == "bar" then
            pinned[other] = fromSlot
        else
            pinned[other] = nil
            if not other:GetAttribute("Gear") then setStored(other, true) end
        end
    end
    pinned[tool] = target
    if from == "card" and isStored(tool) then setStored(tool, false) end
end
local function placeInBag(tool, from)
    if from == "bar" and not tool:GetAttribute("Gear") then
        pinned[tool] = nil
        setStored(tool, true)
    end
end
local function endDrag(pos)
    local d = drag
    drag = nil
    if not (d and d.active) then return end
    ghost.Visible = false
    iconToken[ghostView] = (iconToken[ghostView] or 0) + 1
    ghostView:ClearAllChildren()
    grid.ScrollingEnabled = true
    local tool = d.tool
    if tool.Parent then
        local target = slotAt(pos)
        if target then
            placeInSlot(tool, d.from, d.fromSlot, target)
        elseif d.from == "bar" and panel.Visible and inside(panel, pos) then
            placeInBag(tool, d.from)
        end
    end
    markDirty()
end

local function cycleSlot(step)
    local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or carryingEgg() then return end
    local filled = {}
    for i, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do
        if e.tool and e.tool.Parent then table.insert(filled, i) end
    end
    if #filled == 0 then return end
    local current = 0
    for k, i in ipairs(filled) do
        if hotSlots[i].tool.Parent == plr.Character then current = k break end
    end
    local nextK = current == 0 and (step > 0 and 1 or #filled) or (current - 1 + step) % #filled + 1
    hum:EquipTool(hotSlots[filled[nextK]].tool)
end

local layout = { slot = 60, card = 98 }

local function relayout()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local small = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) < 500
    local pw = math.floor(vp.X * (small and 0.55 or PANEL_W_SCALE))
    local ph = math.floor(vp.Y * (small and 0.52 or PANEL_H_SCALE))

    local slot = math.floor(((math.floor(vp.X * PANEL_W_SCALE) - (SLOTS - 1) * SLOT_GAP) / SLOTS) * 1.56)
    if small then slot = math.max(slot, math.floor(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.15)) end
    local touchGui = plr.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    local jump = touchGui and touchGui.Enabled and touchGui:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true)
    if jump and jump.Visible and jump.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
        local room = (jump.AbsolutePosition.X - 8) * 2 - vp.X
        local fit = math.floor((room - (SLOTS - 1) * SLOT_GAP) / SLOTS)
        if fit >= 36 then slot = math.min(slot, fit) end
    end
    layout.slot = slot
    for _, e in ipairs(hotSlots) do
        e.slot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(slot, slot)
        e.numC.MaxTextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(slot * 0.21))
        e.cntC.MaxTextSize = math.max(12, math.floor(slot * 0.38))
    end

    panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pw, ph)
    panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -(slot + 16))
    titleC.MaxTextSize = math.max(12, math.floor(ph * 0.075))
    search.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(pw * 0.19), math.floor(ph * 0.07))

    local top = math.floor(ph * 0.135)
    local gx = 10
    local gw = pw - gx * 2 - 8
    grid.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(gx, top)

    local card = math.max(1, math.floor((gw - (COLS - 1) * CARD_GAP) / COLS))
    layout.card = card

    local avail = math.max(1, ph - top - 8)
    local rowTarget = math.floor(card * 0.98) + CARD_GAP
    local rows = math.max(1, math.floor((avail + CARD_GAP) / rowTarget + 0.5))
    local cellH = math.floor((avail + CARD_GAP) / rows) - CARD_GAP

    cellH = math.clamp(cellH, math.floor(card * 0.7), math.floor(card * 1.15))
    gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(card, cellH)
    grid.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gw + 8, rows * (cellH + CARD_GAP) - CARD_GAP)
    for _, c in ipairs(cards) do
        c.nameC.MaxTextSize = math.max(7, math.floor(card * 0.135))
        c.subC.MaxTextSize  = math.max(6, math.floor(card * 0.115))
        c.cntC.MaxTextSize  = math.max(7, math.floor(card * 0.15))
        c.starC.MaxTextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(card * 0.19))
    end

    local tab = math.floor(ph * 0.19)
    rail.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tab, tab * 2 + 6)
    for _, t in pairs(tabButtons) do
        t.button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tab, tab)
        t.labelC.MaxTextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(tab * 0.22))
    end
end

renderPanel = function()
    for name, t in pairs(tabButtons) do
        t.stroke.Color = PICKED
        t.stroke.Transparency = (name == activeTab) and 0 or 1
        t.button.BackgroundTransparency = (name == activeTab) and 0.02 or 0.12
    end

    local all = toolsOfPlayer()

    local needle = search.Text:lower():gsub("[^%w%s]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local rows = {}

    for _, row in ipairs(all) do
        local mine = activeTab == nil or ((activeTab == "Pets") and row.pet) or (activeTab == "Eggs" and not row.pet)
        if not row.gear and mine
           and (needle == "" or row.tool.Name:lower():find(needle, 1, true)) then
            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
    end

    local grew = false
    for index = 1, math.max(#rows, #cards) do
        local row = rows[index]
        local c = cards[index]
        if row and not c then
            c = makeCard(index)
            cards[index] = c
            grew = true
        end
        if c then
            if row then
                c.card.Visible = true
                c.tool = row.tool
                if c.shown ~= row.tool then
                    c.shown = row.tool
                    fillIcon(c.view, row.tool)
                end
                local ink = TIER_INK[row.tier] or INK

                c.name.Text = row.tool:GetAttribute("Species")
                    or Cfg.NAMES[row.zone] or ("Zone " .. tostring(row.zone))
                c.name.TextColor3 = ink
                local sz = Cfg.SIZES[row.size]
                c.sub.Text = sz and ("(" .. sz.name .. ")") or ""
                c.sub.TextColor3 = ink
                c.star.Visible = row.equipped == true

                c.card.BackgroundColor3 = row.stored and c.baseBg
                    or c.baseBg:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 80), 0.45)
                c.stroke.Color = PICKED
                c.stroke.Transparency = row.equipped and 0 or 1
            else
                c.card.Visible = false
                c.tool = nil
                c.shown = nil
            end
        end
    end
    if grew then relayout() end

    if #rows == 0 then
        if needle ~= "" then
            empty.Text = "No results"
        else
            empty.Text = (activeTab == "Pets") and "No pets yet"
                or (activeTab == "Eggs") and "No eggs yet - steal one and bring it home"
                or "No items yet - steal an egg and bring it home"
        end
    else
        empty.Text = ""
    end
end

    local bySlot, loose = {}, {}
    for _, row in ipairs(list) do
        local want = pinned[row.tool]
        if want and not bySlot[want] then bySlot[want] = row else table.insert(loose, row) end
    end
    local nextLoose, lastUsed = 1, 0
    for i = 1, SLOTS do
        if not bySlot[i] and loose[nextLoose] then
            bySlot[i] = loose[nextLoose]
            nextLoose += 1
        end
        if bySlot[i] then lastUsed = i end
    end
    for i = 1, SLOTS do
        local row = bySlot[i]
        local e = hotSlots[i]
        if row then
            e.tool = row.tool
            e.slot.Visible = true
            paintCount(e)
            if e.shown ~= row.tool then
                e.shown = row.tool
                fillIcon(e.view, row.tool)
            end
            e.stroke.Color = PICKED
            e.stroke.Transparency = row.equipped and 0 or 1
            e.slot.BackgroundTransparency = row.equipped and 0.05 or 0.25
        else

            e.tool = nil
            e.shown = nil
            e.count.Text = ""
            iconToken[e.view] = (iconToken[e.view] or 0) + 1
            e.view:ClearAllChildren()
            e.stroke.Transparency = 1
            e.slot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
            e.slot.Visible = i <= lastUsed or (drag ~= nil and drag.active)
        end
    end
end

    local now = os.clock()
    if bAlpha == 0 and bTarget == 0 and cardAlpha == 0 and cardTarget == 0 then return end
    local k = math.min(dt * 9, 1)
    local vh = math.max(gui.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)

    if bTarget == 1 and now > bHoldUntil then bTarget = 0 end
    bAlpha = lerp(bAlpha, bTarget, k)

    plate.Visible = bAlpha > 0.004
    plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - bAlpha * 0.80
    studs.ImageTransparency      = 1 - bAlpha * 0.42
    pStroke.Transparency         = 1 - bAlpha
    bLabel.TextTransparency       = 1 - bAlpha
    bLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - bAlpha
    plate.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, vh * 0.07 + (1 - bAlpha) * 16)

    cardAlpha = lerp(cardAlpha, cardTarget, k)
    if cardAlpha < 0.004 and cardTarget == 0 then cardAlpha = 0 end
    local on = cardAlpha > 0.004
    local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 6.5)

    runPlate.Visible = on

    runPlate.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250 + pulse * 22, 0, 74 + pulse * 8)

    runPlate.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    runStuds.ImageTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha * 0.30
    runStroke.Transparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    runLabel.TextTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    runLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha

    vig.Visible = on
    for _, f in ipairs(edges) do

    dropBtn.Visible = on

    dropBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    dropStroke.Transparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    dropStuds.ImageTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha * 0.30
    dropIcon.ImageTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    dropText.TextTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha
    dropText.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - cardAlpha

end)

local function lum(c)

    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Active = false
    f.ZIndex = z
    f.Parent = parent
    corner(f, radius)
    return f
end

local function paintTile(face, look)
    local rimColour = look.rim or look.bottom:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45)
    if lum(rimColour) > lum(look.bottom) * 0.72 then
        rimColour = look.bottom:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.4)
    end
    local border = face:FindFirstChild("TileBorder")
    if not border then
        border = layer(face, "TileBorder", 0, TILE_INK, 14, 6)
        local rimLayer = layer(border, "TileRim", 2, rimColour, 12, 6)
        local fill = layer(rimLayer, "TileFill", 2, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 10, 6)
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Rotation = 90
        grad.Parent = fill
        local studs = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        studs.Name = "Studs"
        studs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        studs.Active = false
        studs.Image = ICON.studs
        studs.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
        studs.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
        studs.ImageTransparency = 0.3
        studs.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        studs.ZIndex = 7
        studs.Parent = fill
        corner(studs, 10)
    end
    local rimLayer = border.TileRim
    rimLayer.BackgroundColor3 = rimColour
    rimLayer.TileFill.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(look.top, look.bottom)
    return rimLayer.TileFill
end

local function shadeTile(face, top, bottom)
    face.TileBorder.TileRim.TileFill.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom)
end

local function hudTile(holder, name, look, text)
    local face = Instance.new("TextButton")
    face.Name = name
    face.AutoButtonColor = false
    face.Text = ""
    face.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    face.BorderSizePixel = 0
    face.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    face.ZIndex = 6
    face.Parent = holder

local function fit()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local k = math.clamp(vp.Y / REF_H, 0.62, 1.25)
    local small = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) < 500
    local inset = math.max(GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y, GuiService.TopbarInset.Max.Y)
    local lift = small and (math.floor(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.15) + 14) or 0
    if small then
        local room = vp.Y - inset - 8 - lift
        local need = STACK_H + M.statIcon * 2 + M.statRowGap + M.statBottom + 16
        k = math.clamp(room / need, 0.3, 0.62)
    end

    stackScale.Scale = k
    statScale.Scale = k
    tileScale.Scale = k
    cycleScale.Scale = k

    local jumpClear = (small and game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled) and 110 or 0
    cycle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -math.floor(M.cycleRight * k) - jumpClear,
        1, -math.floor(M.cycleBottom * k) - lift)

    if small then
        stack.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(M.edgeX * k), 0, math.floor(inset + 4 + STACK_H * k / 2))
    else
        stack.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(M.edgeX * k), 0.507, 0)
    end
    tiles.Position = UDim2.new(1, -math.floor(M.edgeX * k), 0.507, 0)
    stats.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(M.edgeX * k),
        1, -math.floor(M.statBottom * k) - lift)

    note.TextSize = math.floor(32 * k)
end

fit()

end)

do
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local lastHide = nil
    local function sidePanelOpen()
        local pg = plr:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        for _, pair in ipairs({ { "GrowingEggsGui", "GrowingEggs" }, { "ActivePetsGui", "ActivePets" } }) do
            local g = pg and pg:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
            local s = g and g:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
            if s and s.Visible then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function apply(blur)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local small = cam and math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
        local hide = (small and blur and blur.Enabled) and true or false
        if hide == lastHide then return end
        lastHide = hide
        stack.Visible = not hide
        tiles.Visible = not hide and not sidePanelOpen()
        stats.Visible = not hide
        cycle.Visible = not hide
        local bag = plr:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and plr.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("EggBag")
        if bag then bag.Enabled = not hide end
    end
    local function hook(blur)
        blur:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function() apply(blur) end)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function() apply(blur) end) end
        apply(blur)
    end
    local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PanelBlur")
    if existing then hook(existing) end
    Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if c.Name == "PanelBlur" then hook(c) end
    end)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local pens = map:WaitForChild("SpawnPens", 120)
local mills = map:WaitForChild("Treadmills")

local BADGE_LIFT = 26

local BADGE_W, BADGE_H = 240, 150
local BADGE_REF = 70
local BADGE_MIN, BADGE_MAX = 0.35, 1.25

local SHOE = "rbxassetid://126213576980021"
local ARROW = "rbxassetid://106533933580463"

local ARROWS_PER_BELT = 3
local BASE_SCROLL = 3.2

local strips = {}

local function buildStrip(mill)
    local belt = mill:FindFirstChild("belt", true)
    if not belt then return nil end
    local old = mill:FindFirstChild("BeltArrows")
    if old then old:Destroy() end

    local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
    holder.Name = "BeltArrows"
    holder.Parent = mill

    local span = belt.Size.Z
    local step = span / ARROWS_PER_BELT

    local along  = step * 0.92
    local across = belt.Size.X * 0.92

    local parts = {}
    for i = 1, ARROWS_PER_BELT do
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "Arrow" .. i
        p.Size = Vector3.new(along, 0.06, across)
        p.Transparency = 1
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.Parent = holder

        local d = Instance.new("Decal")
        d.Name = "Art"
        d.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
        d.Texture = ARROW
        d.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 245, 255)
        d.Parent = p

        parts[i] = p
    end
    return { mill = mill, belt = belt, parts = parts, span = span, step = step, offset = 0 }
end

local function layStrip(strip)
    local belt = strip.belt
    for i, p in ipairs(strip.parts) do

        local along = ((i - 1) * strip.step + strip.offset) % strip.span - strip.span / 2

        p.CFrame = belt.CFrame
            * CFrame.new(0, belt.Size.Y / 2 + 0.04, along)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
    end
end

local function buildBadge(pen)
    local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
    anchor.Name = "OwnerBadgeAnchor"
    anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    anchor.Transparency = 1
    anchor.Anchored = true
    anchor.CanCollide = false
    anchor.CanQuery = false
    anchor.CanTouch = false
    anchor.CastShadow = false
    local cf = pen:GetBoundingBox()
    anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.Position.X, BADGE_LIFT, cf.Position.Z)
    anchor.Parent = pen

    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "OwnerBadge"
    bb.Adornee = anchor
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
    bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BADGE_W, BADGE_H)
    bb.MaxDistance = 520
    bb.Parent = anchor

    local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
    ring.Name = "Ring"
    ring.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 26, 34)
    ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
    ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.72)
    ring.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
    ring.ZIndex = 4
    ring.Parent = bb
    local rc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    rc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    rc.Parent = ring
    local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 18)
    rs.Thickness = 5
    rs.Parent = ring

    local face = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    face.Name = "Face"
    face.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(196, 214, 232)
    face.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    face.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    face.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    face.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    face.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    face.ZIndex = 5
    face.Parent = ring
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = face

    local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    name.Name = "Nick"
    name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    name.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
    name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.26)
    name.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    name.TextScaled = true
    name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    name.ZIndex = 6
    name.Parent = bb
    local ns = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    ns.Color = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 16)
    ns.Thickness = 4
    ns.Parent = name

    return { gui = bb, face = face, nick = name, anchor = anchor }
end

local function setVisible(model, visible)
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.LocalTransparencyModifier = visible and 0 or 1
        elseif p:IsA("SurfaceGui") or p:IsA("BillboardGui") then
            p.Enabled = visible
        end
    end
end

local short = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig")).fmtShort

local function popup(amount)
    local ch = plr.Character
    local head = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end

    local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
    anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    anchor.Transparency = 1
    anchor.Anchored = true
    anchor.CanCollide = false
    anchor.CanQuery = false
    anchor.CanTouch = false
    anchor.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-25, 25) / 10, 0.5, 0)
    anchor.Parent = workspace

    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Adornee = anchor
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 46)
    bb.Parent = anchor

    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    row.Parent = bb
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    layout.Parent = row

    local shoe = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    shoe.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    shoe.Image = SHOE
    shoe.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    shoe.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42)
    shoe.LayoutOrder = 1
    shoe.Parent = row

    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    text.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 42)
    text.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    text.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    text.Text = "+" .. short(amount)
    text.TextSize = 34
    text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    text.LayoutOrder = 2
    text.Parent = row
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 16)
    st.Thickness = 3
    st.Parent = text

    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        local base = anchor.CFrame
        while os.clock() - t0 < 1.1 do
            local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.1
            anchor.CFrame = base + Vector3.new(0, k * 4.5, 0)
            text.TextTransparency = k * k
            st.Transparency = k * k
            shoe.ImageTransparency = k * k
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        anchor:Destroy()
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local last = plr:GetAttribute("Speed") or 0
    plr:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Speed"):Connect(function()
        local now = plr:GetAttribute("Speed") or 0
        local delta = now - last
        last = now
        if delta > 0 then popup(delta) end
    end)
end)

task.spawn(function()
    for _, mill in ipairs(mills:GetChildren()) do
        local strip = buildStrip(mill)
        if strip then
            strips[#strips + 1] = strip
            layStrip(strip)
        end
    end
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        for _, strip in ipairs(strips) do
            local rate = tonumber(strip.mill:GetAttribute("BeltRate")) or 1
            strip.offset = (strip.offset + BASE_SCROLL * rate * dt) % strip.span
            layStrip(strip)
        end
    end)
end)

local badges = {}

local collideOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function showMillPart(p, shown)
    if p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Decal") then
        p.LocalTransparencyModifier = shown and 0 or 1
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local orig = collideOf[p]
            if not orig then
                orig = { p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch }
                collideOf[p] = orig
            end
            local coll = shown and orig[1]
            local touch = shown and orig[2]
            if p.CanCollide ~= coll then p.CanCollide = coll end
            if p.CanTouch ~= touch then p.CanTouch = touch end
        end
    elseif p:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
        if p.Enabled ~= shown then
            p.Enabled = shown
            if not shown then p:Clear() end
        end
    end
end

local function showSignPart(p, mine)
    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
        p.LocalTransparencyModifier = mine and 0 or 1
    elseif p:IsA("SurfaceGui") or p:IsA("BillboardGui") then
        p.Enabled = mine
    end
end

local function ownedByMe(pen)
    return pen ~= nil and (pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0) == plr.UserId
end

local function updatePen(pen)
    local mill = mills:FindFirstChild("Mill_" .. pen.Name)
    local ownerId = pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0
    local mine = ownerId == plr.UserId
    local taken = ownerId ~= 0

    local badge = badges[pen]
    if taken then
        if not badge then
            badge = buildBadge(pen)
            badges[pen] = badge
        end
        badge.gui.Enabled = true
        badge.nick.Text = pen:GetAttribute("OwnerName") or ""
        local wanted = ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(ownerId)
        if badge.face.Image ~= wanted then badge.face.Image = wanted end
    elseif badge then
        badge.gui.Enabled = false
    end

    local penSign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    if penSign then
        local oldText = penSign:FindFirstChild("LevelText", true)
        if oldText then oldText:Destroy() end
        setVisible(penSign, mine)
    end
    if mill then
        local millSign = mill:FindFirstChild("Sign")
        if millSign then
            local oldText = millSign:FindFirstChild("LevelText", true)
            if oldText then oldText:Destroy() end
            setVisible(millSign, mine)
        end

        local shown = mine or mill:GetAttribute("Running") == true
        for _, p in ipairs(mill:GetDescendants()) do
            if not (millSign and p:IsDescendantOf(millSign)) then
                showMillPart(p, shown)
            end
        end
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    for pen, badge in pairs(badges) do
        if not pen.Parent then
            badges[pen] = nil
        elseif badge.gui.Enabled and badge.anchor.Parent then
            local dist = (cam.CFrame.Position - badge.anchor.Position).Magnitude
            local k = math.clamp(BADGE_REF / math.max(dist, 1), BADGE_MIN, BADGE_MAX)
            badge.gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(BADGE_W * k), math.floor(BADGE_H * k))
        end
    end
end)

mills.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p)
    local mill = p
    while mill and mill.Parent ~= mills do mill = mill.Parent end
    if not mill then return end
    local pen = pens:FindFirstChild((mill.Name:gsub("^Mill_", "")))
    local mine = ownedByMe(pen)
    local sign = mill:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    if sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign) then
        showSignPart(p, mine)
    else
        showMillPart(p, mine or mill:GetAttribute("Running") == true)
    end
end)
pens.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p)
    local pen = p
    while pen and pen.Parent ~= pens do pen = pen.Parent end
    if not pen then return end
    local sign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    if sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign) then
        showSignPart(p, ownedByMe(pen))
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
            local ok, err = pcall(updatePen, pen)
            if not ok then warn("[PlotClient] " .. pen.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)
