do
    local GW, GH_ = 600, 520
    local ROW_H2 = 96
    local veil = Instance.new("TextButton")
    veil.Name = "GiftVeil" veil.Text = "" veil.AutoButtonColor = false
    veil.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 4, 12) veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
    veil.BorderSizePixel = 0 veil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) veil.ZIndex = 58 veil.Visible = false
    veil.Parent = shell
    UIKit.corner(veil, 15)

    local PURPLE_PANEL = { hi = Color3.fromRGB(58, 34, 92), base = Color3.fromRGB(42, 24, 70), sh = Color3.fromRGB(10, 6, 18) }
    local win = block({
        parent = shell, name = "GiftWindow", tone = PURPLE_PANEL, size = UDim2.fromOffset(GW, GH_),
        position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 8, bevel = false, stud = 14, studAlpha = 0.6, zindex = 60,
    })
    win.Visible = false
    local gHeadH = 76
    local gHead = block({
        parent = win, name = "Header", tone = K.prize, size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, gHeadH),
        radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58, shadow = false, zindex = 62,
    })
    art(gHead, { name = "Icon", image = ICON.gift, size = UDim2.fromOffset(gHeadH - 16, gHeadH - 16),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), zindex = 66 })
    local gTitle = boldLabel(gHead, { name = "Title", text = "Gift Player", size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 1, 0),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(gHeadH + 4, 0), align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, strokeW = 4, textSize = 50, zindex = 66 })
    local gSide = gHeadH - 20
    local gClose = block({
        parent = gHead, name = "Close", tone = K.close, clickable = true, react = false,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(gSide, gSide), position = UDim2.new(1, -(gSide + 12), 0.5, 0),
        anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), radius = 10, outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.7, shadowY = 4, zindex = 66,
    })
    UIKit.tintOnHover(gClose, K.close)
    UIKit.cross(gClose, gSide, PANEL_MARK)

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.Name = "Players" list.BackgroundTransparency = 1 list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, gHeadH + 14) list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -(gHeadH + 30))
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new() list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 6 list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 230)
    list.ZIndex = 62 list.Parent = win
    local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout") lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10) lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder lay.Parent = list
    local lpad = Instance.new("UIPadding") lpad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) lpad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2) lpad.Parent = list
    local empty = boldLabel(win, { name = "Empty", text = "No other players in this server", size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60),
        position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, 0), strokeW = 3, textSize = 28, colour = SECOND, zindex = 64 })

    local current
    local function close()
        win.Visible = false
        veil.Visible = false
        frame.Visible = true
        current = nil
        shell:SetAttribute("GiftClosedAt", os.clock())
    end
    gClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)
    veil.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)

    local function render()
        for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
        local others = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p ~= plr then others[#others + 1] = p end end
        table.sort(others, function(a, b) return a.DisplayName:lower() < b.DisplayName:lower() end)
        empty.Visible = #others == 0
        for i, p in ipairs(others) do
            local row = Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Name = "Row_" .. p.UserId
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 16, 52)
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H2)
            row.LayoutOrder = i
            row.ZIndex = 63
            row.Parent = list
            UIKit.corner(row, 12)
            UIKit.stroke(row, Color3.fromRGB(12, 6, 22), 3, 0)
            local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            avatar.Name = "Avatar" avatar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 10, 36) avatar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            avatar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ROW_H2 - 12, ROW_H2 - 12) avatar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
            avatar.ZIndex = 64 avatar.Parent = row
            UIKit.corner(avatar, 10)
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, img = pcall(function()
                    return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(p.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
                end)
                if ok and avatar.Parent then avatar.Image = img end
            end)
            boldLabel(row, { name = "Display", text = p.DisplayName, size = UDim2.new(1, -(ROW_H2 + 190), 0, 40),
                position = UDim2.fromOffset(ROW_H2 + 8, 10), align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, strokeW = 3, textSize = 32, zindex = 65 })
            boldLabel(row, { name = "User", text = "@" .. p.Name, size = UDim2.new(1, -(ROW_H2 + 190), 0, 30),
                position = UDim2.fromOffset(ROW_H2 + 8, 50), align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, strokeW = 3, textSize = 24, colour = Color3.fromRGB(176, 170, 190), zindex = 65 })
            local owns = current and current.kind == "pass" and p:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. current.key) == true
            local b = UIKit.button({
                parent = row, name = "Select", tone = owns and K.lock or K.ready, text = owns and "Owned" or "Select",
                textSize = 34, size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, ROW_H2 - 24),
                position = UDim2.new(1, -172, 0, 12), zindex = 66,
                onClick = function()
                    if owns or not current then return end
                    remote:FireServer("gift", current.key, p.UserId)
                    close()
                end,
            })
            b:SetAttribute("HoverMaxGrow", 8)
        end
    end

    openGift = function(entry)
        current = entry
        gTitle.Text = "Gift Player"
        render()
        frame.Visible = false
        win.Visible = true
    end
    closeGift = close
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() if win.Visible then render() end end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() if win.Visible then task.defer(render) end end)
    shell:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() if not shell.Visible then close() end end)
end

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
    if action == "gifted" and type(data) == "table" then
        say(("%s gifted you %s!"):format(tostring(data.from), tostring(data.name)), K.ready.hi)
        return
    elseif action == "giftSent" and type(data) == "table" then
        say(("You gifted %s to %s!"):format(tostring(data.name), tostring(data.to)), K.ready.hi)
        return
    elseif action == "note" then
        say(tostring(data))
        return
    end
    if action == "state" and type(data) == "table" then
        build(data)
        local target = wanted
        wanted = nil
        task.defer(scrollTo, target)
    elseif action == "noProduct" then
        say(tostring(data) .. " - not available right now")
    end
end)

local blurHeld = false

local function hudGlow(on)
    if _G.EggHudGlow then pcall(_G.EggHudGlow, on) end
end

local function open(section)
    wanted = section or "TOP"
    headerTitle.Text = "Shop"
    UIKit.repaint(header, K.ready)
    hudGlow(false)
    remote:FireServer("state")
    dim.Visible = true
    shell.Visible = true
    if not blurHeld then
        blurHeld = true
        UIKit.blurHold(true)
    end
    UIKit.popOpen(scale, fit())
end

local function shut()
    hudGlow(true)
    dim.Visible = false
    shell.Visible = false
    if blurHeld then
        blurHeld = false
        UIKit.blurHold(false)
    end
end

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(shut)
dim.Activated:Connect(function(input)
    if os.clock() - (shell:GetAttribute("GiftClosedAt") or 0) < 0.35 then return end
    local gw = shell:FindFirstChild("GiftWindow")
    if gw and gw.Visible then
        local pos = input and input.Position
        local hit = false
        if pos then
            local ap, as = gw.AbsolutePosition, gw.AbsoluteSize
            hit = pos.X >= ap.X and pos.X <= ap.X + as.X and pos.Y >= ap.Y and pos.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
        end
        if not hit and closeGift then closeGift() end
        return
    end
    local pos = input and input.Position
    if pos then
        local playerGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        for _, hit in ipairs(playerGui and playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pos.X, pos.Y) or {}) do
            if hit ~= dim and hit.Visible and hit:IsDescendantOf(dim.Parent) then return end
        end
    end
    shut()
end)

local bus = RS.Remotes:FindFirstChild("OpenPanel")
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id, section)
        if id == "RobuxShop" then open(section)
        elseif shell.Visible then shut() end
    end)
end

_G.OpenShop = open

task.delay(1, function()
    remote:FireServer("state")
end)

name: IndexClient
source:
local BatConfig=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BatConfig"))
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local Paint = require(RS:WaitForChild("AnimalPaint"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetIndex")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local WHITE = UIKit.WHITE
local SECOND = UIKit.SECOND
local PANEL_INK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64)
local PANEL_MARK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 224)

local ICON = {
    book = "rbxassetid://137317555173832",
    cash = "rbxassetid://77975477107065",
    shoe = "rbxassetid://126213576980021",
    glow = "rbxassetid://110083852572719",
}

local ZONES = Cfg.ZONES
local PER_ZONE = 8

local W, H = 980, 556
local PAD = 16

local function block(props)
    local face = UIKit.block(props)
    if props.clickable and props.react ~= false then UIKit.reactToCursor(face) end
    return face
end

local function bold(parent, props)
    props.parent = parent
    return UIKit.boldLabel(props)
end

local function art(parent, props)
    local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    i.Name = props.name or "Icon"
    i.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    i.Image = props.image
    i.Size = props.size
    i.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
    i.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
    i.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    i.ZIndex = props.zindex or 20
    if props.tint then i.ImageColor3 = props.tint end
    if props.transparency then i.ImageTransparency = props.transparency end
    i.Parent = parent
    return i
end

local function toneOf(c)
    return {
        hi = c:Lerp(WHITE, 0.20),
        base = c,
        sh = c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.34),
    }
end

local function dimTone(t)
    local dark = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 48)
    return { hi = t.hi:Lerp(dark, 0.62), base = t.base:Lerp(dark, 0.62), sh = t.sh:Lerp(dark, 0.62) }
end

local SLOT_TONE = { K.lock, K.lock, K.ready, K.ready, K.prize, K.inProgress, K.claimed, K.bar }

local function money(v) return "$" .. Cfg.fmtSpeed(v) end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetIndexGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = 60
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local dim = Instance.new("TextButton")
dim.Name = "Dim"
dim.Text = ""
dim.AutoButtonColor = false
dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 4, 12)
dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
dim.ZIndex = 1
dim.Visible = false
dim.Parent = gui

local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
shell.Name = "Index"
shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shell.Visible = false
shell.ZIndex = 10
shell.Parent = gui

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = shell

local function fit()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return 1 end
    local small = math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
    local room = cam.ViewportSize.Y - (small and 8 or (GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y + 28))
    local s = math.clamp(math.min(room / H, (cam.ViewportSize.X - 32) / W), small and 0.3 or 0.40, 1)
    scale.Scale = s
    shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    return s
end
fit()
do
    local function track(cam)
        if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
    end
    track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
    workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
        fit()
    end)
end

local frame = block({
    parent = shell, name = "Frame", tone = K.panel, size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),
    radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 8, bevel = false, stud = 15, studAlpha = 0.55, zindex = 10,
})

frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
do
    local under = frame:FindFirstChild("Underside")
    if under then under.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 end
end

local headH = UIKit.headHeight(W)
local header = block({
    parent = frame, name = "Header", tone = K.bar,
    size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headH), position = UDim2.new(),
    radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58, shadow = false, zindex = 14,
})
do
    local iconH = headH - 16
    local iconY = math.floor((headH - iconH) / 2)
    art(header, { name = "IconShadow", image = ICON.book, size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconH, iconH),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, iconY + 4), zindex = 20, tint = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), transparency = 0.55 })
    art(header, { name = "Icon", image = ICON.book, size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconH, iconH),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, iconY), zindex = 21 })
end
bold(header, {
    name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = "PET INDEX",
    strokeW = 4, strokeColour = PANEL_INK, zindex = 22, textSize = math.floor(headH * 0.62),
})
local shutSide = headH - 24
local closeBtn = block({
    parent = header, name = "Close", tone = K.close, clickable = true, react = false,
    size = UDim2.fromOffset(shutSide, shutSide),
    position = UDim2.new(1, -(shutSide + 14), 0.5, 0), anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
    radius = math.floor(headH * 0.16), outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.70, shadowY = 4, zindex = 22,
})
UIKit.tintOnHover(closeBtn, K.close)
UIKit.cross(closeBtn, shutSide, PANEL_MARK)

local TOP = headH + 14
local LEFT_W = 190
local MID_X = PAD + LEFT_W + 14
local MID_W = 470
local RIGHT_X = MID_X + MID_W + 14
local RIGHT_W = W - PAD - RIGHT_X
local CARD_W, CARD_H, CARD_GAP = 110, 128, 10

local zoneList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
zoneList.Name = "Zones"
zoneList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
zoneList.BorderSizePixel = 0
zoneList.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PAD, TOP)
zoneList.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(LEFT_W, 436)
zoneList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
zoneList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
zoneList.ScrollBarThickness = 6
zoneList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.slab.hi
zoneList.ZIndex = 14
zoneList.Parent = frame
do
    local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    l.Parent = zoneList
    local p = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    p.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    p.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
    p.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2)
    p.Parent = zoneList
end

local mid = Instance.new("Frame")
mid.Name = "Middle"
mid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mid.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MID_X, TOP)
mid.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(MID_W, 436)
mid.ZIndex = 14
mid.Parent = frame

local right = Instance.new("Frame")
right.Name = "Right"
right.BackgroundTransparency = 1
right.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_X, TOP)
right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W, 436)
right.ZIndex = 14
right.Parent = frame

local toast = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = gui, name = "Toast", size = UDim2.fromOffset(760, 46),
    position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    text = "", colour = K.bar.hi, strokeW = 4, textSize = 30, zindex = 60,
})
toast.Visible = false
local toastToken = 0
local function say(text, colour)
    toastToken += 1
    local mine = toastToken
    toast.Text = text
    toast.TextColor3 = colour or K.bar.hi
    toast.Visible = true
    task.delay(3, function()
        if toastToken == mine then toast.Visible = false end
    end)
end

local function libraryModel(zone, slot)
    local lib = (workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary") or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary"))
    local folder = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone)
    if not folder then return nil end
    local kids = folder:GetChildren()
    table.sort(kids, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
    local m = kids[slot]
    if m and m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then return m end
    return nil
end

local function showModel(vp, zone, slot, tier, silhouette)
    for _, c in ipairs(vp:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("Camera") then c:Destroy() end
    end
    local src = libraryModel(zone, slot)
    if not src then return false end
    local m = src:Clone()

    pcall(function() require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.AssetQueue).want(m) end)
    for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true d.CastShadow = false end
    end
    pcall(Paint.paint, m, tier, { preview = true })
    m.Parent = vp

    local pivot = m:GetPivot()
    local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
    local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
    cam.FieldOfView = 32
    local radius = size.Magnitude * 0.5
    local dist = radius / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.02
    local dir = (pivot.LookVector + pivot.RightVector * 0.55 + Vector3.new(0, 0.30, 0)).Unit
    cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + dir * dist, cf.Position)
    cam.Parent = vp
    vp.CurrentCamera = cam

    vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(196, 196, 206)
    vp.LightColor = WHITE
    vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.35, -1, -0.55)
    if silhouette then
        vp.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        vp.ImageTransparency = 0.18
    else
        vp.ImageColor3 = WHITE
        vp.ImageTransparency = 0
    end
    return true
end

local state
local zoneSel = 1
local slotSel = 1
local zoneButtons = {}
local pendingModels = false

local render

local function pickSlot(zone)
    if not state then return 1 end
    local slots = state.zones[zone].slots
    for s = 1, PER_ZONE do
        if slots[s].found and not slots[s].claimed then return s end
    end
    for s = 1, PER_ZONE do
        if slots[s].found then return s end
    end
    return 1
end

local function clear(parent)
    for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
    end
end

local function bar(parent, props)
    local back = Instance.new("Frame")
    back.Name = props.name or "Bar"
    back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 20, 40)
    back.BorderSizePixel = 0
    back.Position = props.position
    back.Size = props.size
    back.ZIndex = 16
    back.Parent = parent
    UIKit.corner(back, 12)
    UIKit.stroke(back, K.outline, 3)
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Name = "Fill"
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = props.colour
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(props.ratio, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.ZIndex = 17
    fill.Parent = back
    UIKit.corner(fill, 12)
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    g.Rotation = 90
    g.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190))
    g.Parent = fill
    fill.Visible = props.ratio > 0
    bold(back, { name = "Text", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = props.text,
        strokeW = 4, textSize = props.textSize or 26, zindex = 19 })
    return back
end

local function buildZoneList()
    clear(zoneList)
    zoneButtons = {}
    for zone = 1, ZONES do
        local z = state.zones[zone]
        local h, s, v = (Cfg.COLORS[zone] or K.slab.base):ToHSV()
        local tone = toneOf(Color3.fromHSV(h, math.clamp(s, 0.55, 0.85), math.max(v, 0.92)))
        local selected = (zone == zoneSel)

        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Name = "Row" .. zone
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(LEFT_W - 12, 52)
        holder.LayoutOrder = zone
        holder.ZIndex = 15
        holder.Parent = zoneList

        local shown = tone
        local b = block({
            parent = holder, name = "Zone" .. zone,
            tone = shown, react = false,
            clickable = true, size = UDim2.fromOffset(LEFT_W - 12, 48),
            radius = 10, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.7, shadowY = 3, zindex = 16,
        })
        UIKit.tintOnHover(b, shown)
        if selected then
            local ring = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            ring.Name = "Selected"
            ring.Color = WHITE
            ring.Thickness = 3
            ring.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            ring.Parent = b
        end
        local function shine(label)
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Rotation = 90
            g.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 140))
            g.Parent = label
            return label
        end
        local nameLabel = shine(bold(b, { name = "Name", size = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.62, 0), position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.19, 0),
            align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, text = z.name:upper(), strokeW = 3, textSize = 17, zindex = 20 }))
        nameLabel.TextScaled = true
        local fit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
        fit.MinTextSize = 10
        fit.MaxTextSize = 17
        fit.Parent = nameLabel

        local ready = z.ready or 0
        shine(bold(b, { name = "Count", size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 1, 0), position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 0),
            align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            text = (ready > 0 and "! " or "") .. z.count .. "/" .. PER_ZONE,
            colour = (ready > 0) and K.ready.hi or ((z.count >= PER_ZONE) and K.bar.hi or WHITE),
            strokeW = 3, textSize = 16, zindex = 20 }))
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if zoneSel ~= zone then
                zoneSel = zone
                slotSel = pickSlot(zone)
                render()
            end
        end)
        zoneButtons[zone] = b
    end
end

local function buildMiddle()
    clear(mid)
    local z = state.zones[zoneSel]
    local zc = Cfg.COLORS[zoneSel] or WHITE
    bold(mid, { name = "ZoneTitle", size = UDim2.fromOffset(MID_W, 40), position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
        align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, text = z.name:upper(), colour = zc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.25),
        strokeW = 5, textSize = 34, zindex = 18 })

    local missing = false
    for slot = 1, PER_ZONE do
        local info = z.slots[slot]
        local col = (slot - 1) % 4
        local row = math.floor((slot - 1) / 4)
        local tone = SLOT_TONE[slot] or K.lock
        local card = block({
            parent = mid, name = "Card" .. slot,
            tone = info.found and tone or dimTone(tone),
            clickable = true,
            size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W, CARD_H),
            position = UDim2.fromOffset(col * (CARD_W + CARD_GAP), 48 + row * (CARD_H + CARD_GAP)),
            radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 11, studAlpha = 0.72, shadowY = 4, zindex = 16,
            bevel = false,
        })
        if slot == slotSel then
            local ring = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            ring.Name = "Selected"
            ring.Color = WHITE
            ring.Thickness = 4
            ring.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            ring.Parent = card
            local old = card:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
            if old and old ~= ring then old.Enabled = false end
        end

        local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
        vp.Name = "Model"
        vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        vp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 26)
        vp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W - 12, CARD_H - 32)
        vp.ZIndex = 19
        vp.Parent = card
        if not showModel(vp, zoneSel, slot, info.tier, not info.found) then missing = true end

        bold(card, { name = "Name", size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W - 8, 24), position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 3),
            text = info.found and info.name or "???", strokeW = 3, textSize = 15, zindex = 21,
            truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })

        if info.found and not info.claimed then
            local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
            dot.Name = "RewardDot"
            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W - 8, 8)
            dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
            dot.BackgroundColor3 = K.ready.base
            dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            dot.ZIndex = 24
            dot.Parent = card
            UIKit.corner(dot, 13)
            UIKit.stroke(dot, K.outline, 2)
            bold(dot, { name = "Mark", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = "!",
                strokeW = 2, textSize = 18, zindex = 25 })
        end

        card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if slotSel ~= slot then
                slotSel = slot
                render()
            end
        end)
    end

    local gridBottom = 48 + 2 * CARD_H + CARD_GAP
    local batZone=zoneSel
    local completed=z.count>=PER_ZONE
    local equipped=state.equippedBat==batZone
    local label=equipped and "Equipped" or (completed and "Equip Bat!" or (z.count.." / "..PER_ZONE))
    local reward=UIKit.button({
        parent=mid,name="EquipBat",tone=K.ready,text=label,textSize=28,
        size=UDim2.fromOffset(MID_W,44),position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,gridBottom+12),zindex=18,
        onClick=function() if completed and not equipped then remote:FireServer("equipBat",batZone) end end,
    })
    reward:SetAttribute("HoverMaxGrow", 8)
    art(reward,{name="BatIcon",image=BatConfig[batZone].Icon,size=UDim2.fromOffset(66,66),
        position=UDim2.new(1,-69,.5,-33),zindex=25})
    if completed then
        local reset=Instance.new("TextButton") reset.Name="DefaultBat" reset.BackgroundTransparency=1
        reset.Text="Default Bat" reset.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold reset.TextSize=12
        reset.TextColor3=WHITE reset.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(80,22) reset.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,11)
        reset.ZIndex=25 reset.Parent=reward
        reset.Activated:Connect(function() remote:FireServer("equipBat",0) end)
    end

    local readyAll = state.ready or 0
    local total = bar(mid, {
        name = "Total",
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(34, gridBottom + 12 + 44 + 14), size = UDim2.fromOffset(MID_W - 34, 52),
        ratio = (readyAll > 0) and 1 or (state.total / state.max),
        colour = (readyAll > 0) and Color3.fromRGB(58, 168, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 160, 240),
        text = (readyAll > 0) and ("CLAIM ALL (%d)!"):format(readyAll)
            or ("UNLOCKED: %d / %d"):format(state.total, state.max),
        textSize = (readyAll > 0) and 30 or 26,
    })
    if readyAll > 0 then
        local fill = total:FindFirstChild("Fill")
        local base = fill and fill.BackgroundColor3
        local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
        hit.Name = "ClaimAll"
        hit.Text = ""
        hit.AutoButtonColor = false
        hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        hit.ZIndex = 21
        hit.Parent = total
        hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if fill then fill.BackgroundColor3 = base:Lerp(WHITE, 0.22) end
        end)
        hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if fill then fill.BackgroundColor3 = base end
        end)
        hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            remote:FireServer("claimAll")
        end)
    end
    art(mid, { name = "Book", image = ICON.book, size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, total.Position.Y.Offset - 6), zindex = 22 })

    return missing
end

local function buildRight()
    clear(right)
    local z = state.zones[zoneSel]
    local info = z.slots[slotSel]
    local tone = SLOT_TONE[slotSel] or K.lock

    local card = block({
        parent = right, name = "Detail", tone = K.thumb,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W, 270), position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
        radius = 14, outline = 3, stud = 12, studAlpha = 0.72, zindex = 16,
        bevel = false,
    })
    local glow = art(card, { name = "Glow", image = ICON.glow, size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 150),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W / 2, 90), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        tint = tone.hi, transparency = info.found and 0.55 or 0.85, zindex = 18 })
    local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    vp.Name = "Model"
    vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    vp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    vp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W - 24, 150)
    vp.ZIndex = 19
    vp.Parent = card
    showModel(vp, zoneSel, slotSel, info.tier, not info.found)

    bold(card, { name = "Name", size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W - 16, 30), position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 164),
        text = info.found and info.name or "???", strokeW = 4, textSize = 26, zindex = 21,
        truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })

    local badge = block({
        parent = card, name = "Rarity", tone = info.found and tone or dimTone(tone),
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 26), position = UDim2.fromOffset((RIGHT_W - 130) / 2, 198),
        radius = 8, outline = 2, finish = false, bevel = false, shadow = false, zindex = 20,
    })
    bold(badge, { name = "Text", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = info.rarity:upper(),
        strokeW = 3, textSize = 15, zindex = 23 })

    bold(card, { name = "Income", size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W - 16, 24), position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 226),
        text = info.found and (money(info.income) .. "/s") or "$?/s",
        colour = Color3.fromRGB(110, 240, 100), strokeW = 3, textSize = 22, zindex = 21 })
    bold(card, { name = "Source", size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W - 16, 18), position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 248),
        text = "HATCH FROM " .. info.source:upper(), colour = SECOND, strokeW = 2, textSize = 13, zindex = 21 })

    local box = block({
        parent = right, name = "Rewards", tone = K.thumb,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W, 154), position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 282),
        radius = 14, outline = 3, stud = 12, studAlpha = 0.72, zindex = 16,
        bevel = false,
    })
    local ring = box:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
    if ring then
        if info.found and not info.claimed then ring.Color = K.ready.base
        elseif info.claimed then ring.Color = K.ready.sh
        else ring.Color = K.outline end
    end
    bold(box, { name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W - 24, 22), position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6),
        align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        text = (info.found and info.name:upper() or "???") .. " REWARD",
        strokeW = 3, textSize = 17, zindex = 21, truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })

    local function tile(x, image, text, tileTone)
        local t = block({
            parent = box, name = "Tile", tone = tileTone,
            size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 54), position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 32),
            radius = 10, outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.75, shadow = false, zindex = 18,
        })
        t:SetAttribute("SkinButtonLook", true)
        art(t, { image = image, size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38), position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), zindex = 21 })
        bold(t, { name = "Amount", size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 54), position = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 0),
            align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, text = text, strokeW = 3, textSize = 17, zindex = 22 })
    end
    tile(12, ICON.cash, money(info.money), K.ready)
    tile(RIGHT_W - 124, ICON.shoe, "+" .. Cfg.fmtSpeed(info.speed), K.bar)

    local label, btnTone, active

    local SILVER = {
        hi = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 242),
        base = Color3.fromRGB(196, 198, 204),
        sh = Color3.fromRGB(138, 140, 148),
    }
    if info.claimed then
        label, btnTone, active = "CLAIMED!", SILVER, false
    elseif info.found then
        label, btnTone, active = "CLAIM!", K.ready, true
    else
        label, btnTone, active = "HATCH TO UNLOCK", K.lock, false
    end
    local claimZone, claimSlot = zoneSel, slotSel
    local btn = UIKit.button({
        parent = box, name = "Claim", tone = btnTone, text = label, textSize = 20,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(RIGHT_W - 24, 46), position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 96), zindex = 18,
        onClick = function()
            if active then remote:FireServer("claim", claimZone, claimSlot) end
        end,
    })
    btn:SetAttribute("Active", active)
end

render = function()
    if not state then return end
    buildZoneList()
    local missing = buildMiddle()
    buildRight()

    if missing and not pendingModels and shell.Visible then
        pendingModels = true
        task.delay(2, function()
            pendingModels = false
            if shell.Visible then render() end
        end)
    end
end

local blurHeld = false
local function hudGlow(on)
    if _G.EggHudGlow then pcall(_G.EggHudGlow, on) end
end

local function pickStartZone()
    if not state then return end
    for zone = 1, ZONES do
        local z = state.zones[zone]
        if (z.ready or 0) > 0 then return zone end
    end
    for zone = 1, ZONES do
        if state.zones[zone].count < PER_ZONE then return zone end
    end
    return 1
end

local firstOpen = true
local function open()
    remote:FireServer("state")
    hudGlow(false)
    dim.Visible = true
    shell.Visible = true
    if not blurHeld then
        blurHeld = true
        UIKit.blurHold(true)
    end
    UIKit.popOpen(scale, fit())
    if state then
        if firstOpen then
            zoneSel = pickStartZone() or 1
            slotSel = pickSlot(zoneSel)
            firstOpen = false
        end
        render()
    end
end

local function shut()
    hudGlow(true)
    dim.Visible = false
    shell.Visible = false
    if blurHeld then
        blurHeld = false
        UIKit.blurHold(false)
    end
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(shut)
dim.Activated:Connect(function(input)
    local pos = input and input.Position
    if pos then
        local playerGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        for _, hit in ipairs(playerGui and playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pos.X, pos.Y) or {}) do
            if hit ~= dim and hit.Visible and hit:IsDescendantOf(dim.Parent) then return end
        end
    end
    shut()
end)

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
    if action == "state" and type(data) == "table" then
        local was = state
        state = data
        if firstOpen and shell.Visible then
            zoneSel = pickStartZone() or 1
            slotSel = pickSlot(zoneSel)
            firstOpen = false
        end
        if shell.Visible then render() end
        if not was then return end
    elseif action == "found" and type(data) == "table" then
        local zoneName = Cfg.NAMES[data.zone] or ""
        say(("NEW PET: %s - claim your reward in the Index!"):format(tostring(data.name):upper()), K.bar.hi)
    elseif action == "claimed" and type(data) == "table" then
        say(("%s: +%s  +%s SPEED"):format(tostring(data.name or ""):upper(), money(data.money), Cfg.fmtSpeed(data.speed)), K.ready.hi)
    elseif action == "claimedAll" and type(data) == "table" then
        say(("CLAIMED %d: +%s  +%s SPEED"):format(data.count, money(data.money), Cfg.fmtSpeed(data.speed)), K.ready.hi)
    elseif action == "deny" then
        say(tostring(data), K.close.hi)
    end
end)

local bus = RS.Remotes:FindFirstChild("OpenPanel")
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
        if id == "Index" then open()
        elseif shell.Visible then shut() end
    end)
end

_G.OpenPetIndex = open
remote:FireServer("state")

name: TrailShopClient
source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local Trails = require(RS:WaitForChild("TrailConfig"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Trails")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local WHITE = UIKit.WHITE
local PANEL_INK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64)
local PANEL_MARK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 224)

local ICON = {
    shoe  = "rbxassetid://126213576980021",
    robux = "rbxassetid://102382554203100",
    glow  = "rbxassetid://110083852572719",
}

local W, H = 1010, 560
local CARD_W = 300
local CARD_GAP = 16

local function block(props)
    local face = UIKit.block(props)
    if props.clickable and props.react ~= false then UIKit.reactToCursor(face) end
    return face
end

local function bold(parent, props)
    props.parent = parent
    return UIKit.boldLabel(props)
end

local function art(parent, props)
    local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    i.Name = props.name or "Icon"
    i.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    i.Image = props.image
    i.Size = props.size
    i.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
    i.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
    i.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    i.ZIndex = props.zindex or 20
    if props.tint then i.ImageColor3 = props.tint end
    if props.transparency then i.ImageTransparency = props.transparency end
    i.Parent = parent
    return i
end

local function toneOf(c)
    return {
        hi = c:Lerp(WHITE, 0.22),
        base = c,
        sh = c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.34),
    }
end

local money = Cfg.fmtMoney

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "TrailShopGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = 60
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local dim = Instance.new("TextButton")
dim.Name = "Dim"
dim.Text = ""
dim.AutoButtonColor = false
dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 4, 12)
dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
dim.ZIndex = 1
dim.Visible = false
dim.Parent = gui

local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
shell.Name = "TrailShop"
shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shell.Visible = false
shell.ZIndex = 10
shell.Parent = gui

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = shell

local function fit()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return 1 end
    local small = math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
    local room = cam.ViewportSize.Y - (small and 8 or (GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y + 28))
    local s = math.clamp(math.min(room / H, (cam.ViewportSize.X - 32) / W), small and 0.3 or 0.40, 1)
    scale.Scale = s
    shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    return s
end
fit()
do
    local function track(cam)
        if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
    end
    track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
    workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
        fit()
    end)
end

local frame = block({
    parent = shell, name = "Frame", tone = K.panel, size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),
    radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 8, bevel = false, stud = 15, studAlpha = 0.55, zindex = 10,
})

frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
do
    local under = frame:FindFirstChild("Underside")
    if under then under.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 end
end

local headH = UIKit.headHeight(W)
local header = block({
    parent = frame, name = "Header", tone = K.bar,
    size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headH), position = UDim2.new(),
    radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58, shadow = false, zindex = 14,
})
do
    local iconH = headH - 16
    local iconY = math.floor((headH - iconH) / 2)
    art(header, { name = "IconShadow", image = ICON.shoe, size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconH, iconH),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, iconY + 4), zindex = 20, tint = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), transparency = 0.55 })
    art(header, { name = "Icon", image = ICON.shoe, size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconH, iconH),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, iconY), zindex = 21 })
end
bold(header, {
    name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = "TRAIL SHOP",
    strokeW = 4, strokeColour = PANEL_INK, zindex = 22, textSize = math.floor(headH * 0.62),
})
local shutSide = headH - 24
local closeBtn = block({
    parent = header, name = "Close", tone = K.close, clickable = true, react = false,
    size = UDim2.fromOffset(shutSide, shutSide),
    position = UDim2.new(1, -(shutSide + 14), 0.5, 0), anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
    radius = math.floor(headH * 0.16), outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.70, shadowY = 4, zindex = 22,
})
UIKit.tintOnHover(closeBtn, K.close)
UIKit.cross(closeBtn, shutSide, PANEL_MARK)

local TOP = headH + 14
local BODY_H = H - TOP - 14
local CARD_H = BODY_H - 28

local body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
body.Name = "Cards"
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
body.BorderSizePixel = 0
body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, TOP)
body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 32, BODY_H)
body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
body.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
body.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X
body.ScrollBarThickness = 8
body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.slab.hi
body.ZIndex = 14
body.Parent = frame
do
    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, CARD_GAP)
    list.Parent = body
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.Parent = body
end

local toast = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = gui, name = "Toast", size = UDim2.fromOffset(760, 46),
    position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.14), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    text = "", colour = K.bar.hi, strokeW = 4, textSize = 30, zindex = 60,
})
toast.Visible = false
local toastToken = 0
local function say(text, colour)
    toastToken += 1
    local mine = toastToken
    toast.Text = text
    toast.TextColor3 = colour or K.bar.hi
    toast.Visible = true
    task.delay(2.6, function()
        if toastToken == mine then toast.Visible = false end
    end)
end

local state = { owned = {}, equipped = "" }

local function robuxButton(parent, def, props)
    local b = UIKit.button({
        parent = parent, name = "Robux", tone = K.prize, text = "", textSize = 24,
        size = props.size, position = props.position, zindex = 20,
        onClick = function() remote:FireServer("robux", def.id) end,
    })
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Name = "Row"
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    row.ZIndex = 24
    row.Parent = b
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    layout.Parent = row
    local mark = Instance.new("Frame")
    mark.Name = "Mark"
    mark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    mark.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
    mark.LayoutOrder = 1
    mark.ZIndex = 24
    mark.Parent = row
    art(mark, { name = "Glyph", image = ICON.robux, size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), zindex = 25 })
    local value = bold(row, {
        name = "Value", size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
        text = tostring(def.robux), zindex = 25, textSize = 25, strokeW = 3,
    })
    value.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    value.LayoutOrder = 2
    return b
end

local function card(def, order)
    local owned = state.owned[def.id] == true
    local equipped = state.equipped == def.id
    local tone = toneOf(def.card)

    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name = def.id
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W, CARD_H + 8)
    holder.LayoutOrder = order
    holder.ZIndex = 14
    holder.Parent = body

    local c = block({
        parent = holder, name = "Card", tone = tone, size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W, CARD_H),
        radius = 14, outline = equipped and 5 or 4, edge = equipped and WHITE or nil,
        stud = 12, studAlpha = 0.72, bevel = false, zindex = 14,
    })

    art(c, {
        name = "Glow", image = ICON.glow, size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W - 30, CARD_W - 30),
        position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 176), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        tint = WHITE, transparency = 0.5, zindex = 16,
    })

    bold(c, {
        name = "Name", size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 38), position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 10),
        text = def.name, textSize = 31, strokeW = 4, zindex = 22,
    })

    local rarityW = TextService:GetTextSize(def.rarity, 21, Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Vector2.new(400, 40)).X + 26
    local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
    pill.Name = "RarityPill"
    pill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 46)
    pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rarityW, 26)
    pill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 28)
    pill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pill.ZIndex = 20
    pill.Parent = c
    UIKit.corner(pill, 13)
    bold(pill, {
        name = "Rarity", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        text = def.rarity, textSize = 21, strokeW = 3, zindex = 22,
        colour = Trails.RARITY and Trails.RARITY[def.rarity] or WHITE,
    })

            onClick = function()

    else

            size = UDim2.fromOffset(inner - cashW - 8, BTN_H),

    end
    return c
end

local function render()
    local keep = body.CanvasPosition
    for _, ch in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
        if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then ch:Destroy() end
    end
    for i, def in ipairs(Trails.LIST) do
        card(def, i)
    end
    task.defer(function() body.CanvasPosition = keep end)
end
render()

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
    if action == "state" and type(data) == "table" then
        state.owned = type(data.owned) == "table" and data.owned or {}
        state.equipped = tostring(data.equipped or "")
        render()
    elseif action == "deny" then
        say(tostring(data), K.close.hi)
    elseif action == "noProduct" then
        say(tostring(data) .. " - not available right now", K.close.hi)
    elseif action == "bought" then
        say(tostring(data) .. " unlocked!", K.ready.hi)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local list = {}
    for _, def in ipairs(Trails.LIST) do

        table.insert(list, img)

local isOpen = false
local blurHeld = false

    isOpen = true
    remote:FireServer("state")
    dim.Visible = true
    shell.Visible = true
    if not blurHeld then
        blurHeld = true
        UIKit.blurHold(true)
    end
    UIKit.popOpen(scale, fit())
end

local function shut()
    isOpen = false
    openedByRing = false
    dim.Visible = false
    shell.Visible = false
    if blurHeld then
        blurHeld = false
        UIKit.blurHold(false)
    end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(shut)
dim.Activated:Connect(function(input)
    local pos = input and input.Position
    if pos then
        local playerGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        for _, hit in ipairs(playerGui and playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pos.X, pos.Y) or {}) do
            if hit ~= dim and hit.Visible and hit:IsDescendantOf(dim.Parent) then return end
        end
    end
    shut()
end)

local bus = RS.Remotes:FindFirstChild("OpenPanel")
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
        if id == "TrailShop" then
            open()
        elseif isOpen then
            shut()
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
    local shops = map:WaitForChild("Shops", 60)
    local ring = shops and shops:WaitForChild("ShopRightRing", 60)
    if not ring then
        warn("[TRAILS] no ShopRightRing - the Trail Shop only opens from code")
        return
    end
    local cf, size = ring:GetBoundingBox()
    local centre = cf.Position
    local radius = math.max(size.X, size.Z) / 2
    local inside = false
    while true do
        task.wait(0.15)
        local ch = plr.Character
        local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - centre.X, 0, root.Position.Z - centre.Z).Magnitude
            local level = math.abs(root.Position.Y - centre.Y) < 12
            if not inside and level and flat <= radius then
                inside = true
                if not isOpen then
                    if bus then bus:Fire("TrailShop") else open() end
                    openedByRing = true
                end
            elseif inside and (flat > radius + 3 or not level) then
                inside = false
                if isOpen and openedByRing then shut() end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Nest")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local WHITE = UIKit.WHITE
local SECOND = UIKit.SECOND
local PANEL_INK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64)

local ICON_EGG = "rbxassetid://103180943014941"
local ICON_GLOW = "rbxassetid://110083852572719"

local W, H = 440, 390
local HEAD_H = 66
local ROW_H = 74
local GAP_TO_TILES = 16

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "GrowingEggsGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = 45
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
shell.Name = "GrowingEggs"
shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
shell.Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0.5, 0)
shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shell.Visible = false
shell.ZIndex = 10
shell.Parent = gui

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = shell

local PANEL_TONE = {
    hi = Color3.fromRGB(64, 70, 88),
    base = Color3.fromRGB(38, 42, 56),
    sh = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 34),
}
local PANEL_ALPHA = 0.22
local frame = UIKit.block({
    parent = shell, name = "Frame", tone = PANEL_TONE, size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),
    radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 7, bevel = false, stud = 15, studAlpha = 0.8, zindex = 10,
})
frame.BackgroundTransparency = PANEL_ALPHA
local underside = frame:FindFirstChild("Underside")
if underside then underside.BackgroundTransparency = PANEL_ALPHA end

local header = UIKit.block({
    parent = frame, name = "Header", tone = K.bar,
    size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEAD_H), radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58,
    shadow = false, zindex = 14,
})

UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = header, name = "Title", size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 1, 0), position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0),
    text = "GROWING EGGS", align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    textSize = 30, strokeW = 4, strokeColour = PANEL_INK, zindex = 22,
})

local GROW_W, GROW_H = 150, 44
UIKit.button({
    parent = header, name = "GrowAll", tone = K.inProgress, text = "GROW ALL", textSize = 22,
    size = UDim2.fromOffset(GROW_W, GROW_H),
    position = UDim2.new(1, -(GROW_W + 14), 0.5, -GROW_H / 2), zindex = 20,
    onClick = function() remote:FireServer("growAll") end,
})

local shut
UIKit.button({
    parent = shell, name = "Hide", tone = K.close, text = ">", textSize = 36,
    size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 58), position = UDim2.new(0, -68, 0.5, -29), zindex = 12,
    onClick = function() if shut then shut() end end,
})

local body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
body.Name = "List"
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
body.BorderSizePixel = 0
body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, HEAD_H + 12)
body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -(HEAD_H + 26))
body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
body.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
body.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
body.ScrollBarThickness = 6
body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = K.slab.hi
body.ZIndex = 14
body.Parent = frame
do
    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Parent = body
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")

    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
    pad.Parent = body
end

local empty = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = frame, name = "Empty", size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 70),
    position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, HEAD_H + 90), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
    text = "No eggs growing\nPlace eggs on your plot", textSize = 24, strokeW = 3,
    colour = SECOND, wrapped = true, zindex = 20,
})

local function tilesFrame()
    for _, g in ipairs(plr.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g ~= gui then
            local t = g:FindFirstChild("RightTiles")
            if t then return t, g end
        end
    end
end

local function place()
    local tiles, tilesGui = tilesFrame()
    if tiles then
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = tilesGui.IgnoreGuiInset
        local ts = tiles:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(ts and ts.Scale or 1, 0.55, 1)

        shell.Position = UDim2.new(0, tiles.AbsolutePosition.X + tiles.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.5, 0)
    end
end

local function sidePanelOpen()
    for _, pair in ipairs({ { "GrowingEggsGui", "GrowingEggs" }, { "ActivePetsGui", "ActivePets" } }) do
        local g = plr.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
        local s = g and g:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
        if s and s.Visible then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function setTiles(on)
    local tiles = tilesFrame()
    if tiles then tiles.Visible = on end
end

local function restoreTiles()
    if not sidePanelOpen() then setTiles(true) end
end

local ids = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local nextId = 0
local function idOf(model)
    if not ids[model] then
        nextId += 1
        ids[model] = nextId
    end
    return ids[model]
end

local function myEggs()
    local out = {}
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
    local placed = map and map:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggs")
    if not placed then return out end
    for _, m in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
        if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId and not m:GetAttribute("Hatching") then
            table.insert(out, m)
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        local ra, rb = a:GetAttribute("Ready") == true, b:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
        if ra ~= rb then return ra end
        return (a:GetAttribute("HatchAt") or 0) < (b:GetAttribute("HatchAt") or 0)
    end)
    return out
end

local function preview(parent, model)
    local glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    glow.Image = ICON_GLOW
    glow.ImageTransparency = 0.55
    glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 78)
    glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-2, -2)
    glow.ZIndex = 17
    glow.Parent = parent

    local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    vp.Name = "Egg"
    vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    vp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 62)
    vp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
    vp.LightColor = WHITE
    vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1.5, -1)
    vp.ZIndex = 18
    vp.Parent = parent

    local ok = pcall(function()
        local copy = Instance.new("Model")
        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local c = p:Clone()
                c:ClearAllChildren()
                c.Anchored = true
                c.Parent = copy
            end
        end
        if #copy:GetChildren() == 0 then error("no parts streamed in") end

        require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.AssetQueue).want(copy)
        copy.Parent = vp
        local cf, size = copy:GetBoundingBox()
        local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
        cam.FieldOfView = 40
        local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.9 + 0.4
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(dist * 0.35, size.Y * 0.2, dist), cf.Position)
        cam.Parent = vp
        vp.CurrentCamera = cam
    end)
    if not ok then
        vp:Destroy()
        local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        icon.Name = "Egg"
        icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        icon.Image = ICON_EGG
        icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
        icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9)
        icon.ZIndex = 18
        icon.Parent = parent
    end
end

local rows = {}

local function buildRow(model, order)
    local ready = model:GetAttribute("Ready") == true

    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name = "Egg_" .. idOf(model)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H + 5)
    holder.LayoutOrder = order
    holder.ZIndex = 14
    holder.Parent = body

    local row = UIKit.block({
        parent = holder, name = "Row", tone = K.thumb, size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H),
        radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 11, studAlpha = 0.7, bevel = false, zindex = 14,
    })
    preview(row, model)

    local entry = { model = model, ready = ready }

    if ready then
        UIKit.button({
            parent = row, name = "Open", tone = K.ready, text = "OPEN", textSize = 26,
            size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 50), position = UDim2.new(0.5, 38, 0.5, 0),
            anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), zindex = 18,
            onClick = function() remote:FireServer("hatchEgg", model) end,
        })
    else
        local SKIP_W = 52
        local track = Instance.new("Frame")
        track.Name = "Track"
        track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0.5, 0)
        track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(80 + SKIP_W + 22), 0, 40)
        track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 22)
        track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        track.ClipsDescendants = true
        track.ZIndex = 18
        track.Parent = row
        UIKit.corner(track, 8)
        UIKit.stroke(track, K.outline, 2, 0)

        local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.Name = "Fill"
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = K.ready.base
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
        fill.ZIndex = 19
        fill.Parent = track
        UIKit.corner(fill, 8)

        local clock = UIKit.boldLabel({
            parent = track, name = "Clock", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            text = "", textSize = 24, strokeW = 3, zindex = 21,
        })

        UIKit.button({
            parent = row, name = "Skip", tone = K.ready, text = ">>", textSize = 26,
            size = UDim2.fromOffset(SKIP_W, 48), position = UDim2.new(1, -(SKIP_W + 12), 0.5, -24),
            zindex = 18,
            onClick = function() remote:FireServer("skipEgg", model) end,
        })

        entry.fill = fill
        entry.clock = clock
    end
    return entry
end

local lastSig = ""

local function refresh(force)
    local list = myEggs()
    local parts = {}
    for _, m in ipairs(list) do
        table.insert(parts, idOf(m) .. (m:GetAttribute("Ready") and "r" or "g"))
    end
    local sig = table.concat(parts, ",")

    if force or sig ~= lastSig then
        lastSig = sig
        for _, c in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        rows = {}
        for i, m in ipairs(list) do
            rows[i] = buildRow(m, i)
        end
        empty.Visible = #list == 0
    end

    local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
        if r.clock and r.model.Parent then
            local left = math.max(0, (r.model:GetAttribute("HatchAt") or 0) - now)
            local total = tonumber(r.model:GetAttribute("HatchTotal"))
                or Cfg.hatchTime(r.model:GetAttribute("EggZone") or 1,
                    r.model:GetAttribute("EggSize") or 1, r.model:GetAttribute("EggTier") or 1)
            local done = (total and total > 0) and (1 - left / total) or 0
            r.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(done, 0.03, 1), 1)
            r.clock.Text = Cfg.fmtTime(left)
        end
    end
end

local isOpen = false

local function open()
    isOpen = true
    place()
    refresh(true)
    shell.Visible = true
    setTiles(false)
    local target = scale.Scale
    scale.Scale = target * 0.85
    TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Scale = target }):Play()
end

function shut()
    isOpen = false
    shell.Visible = false
    task.defer(restoreTiles)
end

local bus = RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("OpenPanel", 20)
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
        if id == "GrowingEggs" then
            if isOpen then shut() else open() end
        elseif id == "ActivePets" and isOpen then
            shut()
        end
    end)
end

local acc = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not isOpen then return end
    acc += dt
    if acc < 0.2 then return end
    acc = 0
    place()
    refresh(false)
end)

_G.OpenGrowingEggs = open

    position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, HEAD_H + 90), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
    text = "No pets on your plot\nPress EQUIP BEST or place pets", textSize = 24, strokeW = 3,
    colour = SECOND, wrapped = true, zindex = 20,
})

local state = { count = 0, cap = 3, level = 1, maxLevel = 12, price = 0 }

local function paintHeader()
    title.Text = ("%d/%d ACTIVE"):format(state.count, state.cap)
    if state.level >= state.maxLevel then
        upgradeText("MAX LEVEL")
        upgradeTone(K.lock)
    else
        upgradeText(("+1 EQUIP [%s]"):format(money(state.price)))
        upgradeTone(K.ready)
    end
end
paintHeader()

local function tilesFrame()
    for _, g in ipairs(plr.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g ~= gui then
            local t = g:FindFirstChild("RightTiles")
            if t then return t, g end
        end
    end
end

local function place()
    local tiles, tilesGui = tilesFrame()
    if tiles then
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = tilesGui.IgnoreGuiInset
        local ts = tiles:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(ts and ts.Scale or 1, 0.55, 1)

        shell.Position = UDim2.new(0, tiles.AbsolutePosition.X + tiles.AbsoluteSize.X,
            0.5, -37 * scale.Scale)
    end
end

local function sidePanelOpen()
    for _, pair in ipairs({ { "GrowingEggsGui", "GrowingEggs" }, { "ActivePetsGui", "ActivePets" } }) do
        local g = plr.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
        local s = g and g:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
        if s and s.Visible then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function setTiles(on)
    local tiles = tilesFrame()
    if tiles then tiles.Visible = on end
end

local function restoreTiles()
    if not sidePanelOpen() then setTiles(true) end
end

local ids = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local nextId = 0
local function idOf(model)
    if not ids[model] then
        nextId += 1
        ids[model] = nextId
    end
    return ids[model]
end

local function myPets()
    local out = {}
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
    local folder = map and map:FindFirstChild("PlacedAnimals")
    if not folder then return out end
    for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId then table.insert(out, m) end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        local ia, ib = tonumber(a:GetAttribute("Income")) or 0, tonumber(b:GetAttribute("Income")) or 0
        if ia ~= ib then return ia > ib end
        return idOf(a) < idOf(b)
    end)
    return out
end

local function preview(parent, model)
    local glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    glow.Image = ICON_GLOW
    glow.ImageTransparency = 0.55
    glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
    glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-2, -1)
    glow.ZIndex = 17
    glow.Parent = parent

    local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    vp.Name = "Pet"
    vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    vp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 66)
    vp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    vp.LightColor = WHITE
    vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1.5, -1)
    vp.ZIndex = 18
    vp.Parent = parent

    pcall(function()

        local pivot = model:GetPivot()
        local root = model:FindFirstChild(model:GetAttribute("RootPart") or "", true)
        local tip
        for _, name in ipairs({ "nose", "snout", "muzzle", "beak", "head" }) do
            for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= root and p.Name:lower() == name then tip = p break end
            end
            if tip then break end
        end
        if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
            local front = root.CFrame.LookVector
            if tip then front = tip.Position - root.Position end
            front = Vector3.new(front.X, 0, front.Z)
            if front.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
                pivot = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + front.Unit)
            end
        end
        local copy = Instance.new("Model")
        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local c = p:Clone()
                c:ClearAllChildren()
                c.Anchored = true
                c.CFrame = pivot:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
                c.Parent = copy
            end
        end
        if #copy:GetChildren() == 0 then error("no parts streamed in") end

        require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.AssetQueue).want(copy)
        copy.Parent = vp
        local cf, size = copy:GetBoundingBox()
        local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.45 + 0.4
        local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
        cam.FieldOfView = 40

        local eye = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.3, -1).Unit
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + eye * dist, cf.Position)
        cam.Parent = vp
        vp.CurrentCamera = cam
    end)
end

local function buildRow(model, order)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name = "Pet_" .. idOf(model)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H + 5)
    holder.LayoutOrder = order
    holder.ZIndex = 14
    holder.Parent = body

    local row = UIKit.block({
        parent = holder, name = "Row", tone = K.thumb, size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H),
        radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 11, studAlpha = 0.7, bevel = false, zindex = 14,
    })
    preview(row, model)

    local tier = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("AnimalTier")) or 1
    local nameColour = (Cfg.TIERS[tier] and Cfg.TIERS[tier].color) or WHITE
    local UNEQ_W = 134
    UIKit.boldLabel({
        parent = row, name = "PetName", size = UDim2.new(1, -(84 + UNEQ_W + 24), 0, 28),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 10), align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        text = tostring(model:GetAttribute("Species") or model.Name), textSize = 22, strokeW = 3,
        colour = nameColour, truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, zindex = 20,
    })
    UIKit.boldLabel({
        parent = row, name = "Income", size = UDim2.new(1, -(84 + UNEQ_W + 24), 0, 24),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 40), align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        text = ("(%s/s)"):format(money(tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Income")) or 0)),
        textSize = 20, strokeW = 3, colour = INCOME_COLOUR, zindex = 20,
    })
    UIKit.button({
        parent = row, name = "Unequip", tone = K.close, text = "UNEQUIP", textSize = 22,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(UNEQ_W, 50), position = UDim2.new(1, -(UNEQ_W + 12), 0.5, -25),
        zindex = 18,
        onClick = function() remote:FireServer("unequipPet", model) end,
    })
end

local lastSig = ""

local function refresh(force)
    local list = myPets()
    local parts = {}
    for _, m in ipairs(list) do table.insert(parts, idOf(m)) end
    local sig = table.concat(parts, ",")
    if force or sig ~= lastSig then
        local changed = sig ~= lastSig
        lastSig = sig
        for _, c in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        for i, m in ipairs(list) do buildRow(m, i) end
        empty.Visible = #list == 0

        state.count = #list
        paintHeader()
        if changed then remote:FireServer("petsState") end
    end
end

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
    if action == "pets" and type(data) == "table" then
        state.count = tonumber(data.count) or state.count
        state.cap = tonumber(data.cap) or state.cap
        state.level = tonumber(data.level) or state.level
        state.maxLevel = tonumber(data.maxLevel) or state.maxLevel
        state.price = tonumber(data.price) or 0
        paintHeader()
    end
end)

local isOpen = false

local function open()
    isOpen = true
    place()
    refresh(true)
    remote:FireServer("petsState")
    shell.Visible = true
    setTiles(false)
    local target = scale.Scale
    scale.Scale = target * 0.85
    TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Scale = target }):Play()
end

function shut()
    isOpen = false
    shell.Visible = false
    task.defer(restoreTiles)
end

local bus = RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("OpenPanel", 20)
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
        if id == "ActivePets" then
            if isOpen then shut() else open() end
        elseif id == "GrowingEggs" and isOpen then
            shut()
        end
    end)
end

local acc = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not isOpen then return end
    acc += dt
    if acc < 0.3 then return end
    acc = 0
    place()
    refresh(false)
end)

_G.OpenActivePets = open

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local U = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local pg = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PlotUpgrade")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local WHITE = UIKit.WHITE
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 24)
local LEVEL_GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 100)
local ICON_ROBUX = "rbxassetid://102382554203100"
local ICON_ALERT = "rbxassetid://88282714087162"

local PPS = 100

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local pens = map:WaitForChild("SpawnPens", 120)
local mills = map:WaitForChild("Treadmills", 120)

local money = Cfg.fmtMoney

local function robuxText(n)
    n = tonumber(n) or 0
    if n >= 1000 then
        return (("%.1fK"):format(n / 1000):gsub("%.0K", "K"))
    end
    return tostring(n)
end

local function label(parent, props)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.Name = props.name
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Size = props.size
    t.Position = props.position
    t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    t.TextSize = props.textSize
    t.TextColor3 = props.colour or WHITE
    t.TextXAlignment = props.align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    t.Text = props.text or ""
    t.ZIndex = props.zindex or 5
    t.Parent = parent
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = INK
    s.Thickness = props.strokeW or 4
    s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
    s.Parent = t
    return t
end

local function icon(parent, image, size, x)
    local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    i.Name = "Icon"
    i.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    i.Image = image
    i.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    i.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    i.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0)
    i.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
    i.ZIndex = 12
    i.Parent = parent
    return i
end

local noteGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
noteGui.Name = "UpgradeNotice"
noteGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
noteGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
noteGui.DisplayOrder = 42
noteGui.Parent = pg
local note = label(noteGui, {
    name = "Note", size = UDim2.fromOffset(820, 56), position = UDim2.new(0.5, -410, 0.26, 0),
    textSize = 34, colour = K.close.hi,
})
note.Visible = false
local noteToken = 0
local function say(text, colour)
    noteToken += 1
    local mine = noteToken
    note.Text = text
    note.TextColor3 = colour or K.close.hi
    note.Visible = true
    task.delay(2.4, function()
        if noteToken == mine then note.Visible = false end
    end)
end

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
    if action == "deny" then
        say(tostring(data))
    elseif action == "noProduct" then
        say(tostring(data) .. " - not available right now")
    elseif action == "upgraded" and type(data) == "table" then
        local def = U[data.kind]
        say(("%s upgraded to Level %d!"):format(def and def.name or "Plot", tonumber(data.level) or 0), K.ready.hi)
    end
end)

local signs = {}

local function destroySign(kind)
    local s = signs[kind]
    if not s then return end
    for _, f in ipairs(s.faces) do
        if f.gui then f.gui:Destroy() end
    end
    if s.alert then s.alert:Destroy() end
    signs[kind] = nil
end

local function buildFace(kind, board, face)
    local def = U[kind]
    local W = math.floor(board.Size.X * PPS)
    local H = math.floor(board.Size.Y * PPS)

    local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
    gui.Name = ("UpgradeSign_%s_%s"):format(kind, face.Name)
    gui.Adornee = board
    gui.Face = face
    gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
    gui.PixelsPerStud = PPS
    gui.LightInfluence = 0
    gui.MaxDistance = 160
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.ClipsDescendants = true
    gui.Parent = pg

    label(gui, {
        name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 20, 58), position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8),
        text = def.title, textSize = 50,
    })
    local levels = label(gui, {
        name = "Levels", size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 20, 46), position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 66),
        text = "", textSize = 40, colour = LEVEL_GREEN,
    })

    local BTN_Y, BTN_H = 128, math.max(90, H - 128 - 16)
    local ROBUX_W = math.floor((W - 40) * 0.36)
    local CASH_W = W - 40 - ROBUX_W - 12

    local cash, _, _, setCashTone = UIKit.button({
        parent = gui, name = "CashPrice", tone = K.ready, text = "", textSize = 20,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(CASH_W, BTN_H), position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, BTN_Y), zindex = 8,
        onClick = function() remote:FireServer("buy", kind) end,
    })
    icon(cash, def.icon, BTN_H - 20, 12)
    local cashText = label(cash, {
        name = "Value", size = UDim2.new(1, -(BTN_H + 4), 1, 0), position = UDim2.fromOffset(BTN_H - 4, 0),
        textSize = 50, zindex = 12,
    })

    local robux = UIKit.button({
        parent = gui, name = "Robux", tone = K.prize, text = "", textSize = 20,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(ROBUX_W, BTN_H), position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + CASH_W + 12, BTN_Y), zindex = 8,
        onClick = function() remote:FireServer("robux", kind) end,
    })
    icon(robux, ICON_ROBUX, math.floor(BTN_H * 0.5), 12)
    local robuxLabel = label(robux, {
        name = "Value", size = UDim2.new(1, -(math.floor(BTN_H * 0.5) + 18), 1, 0),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(BTN_H * 0.5) + 14, 0), textSize = 36, zindex = 12,
    })

    return {
        gui = gui, levels = levels,
        cash = cash, cashText = cashText, setCashTone = setCashTone,
        robux = robux, robuxLabel = robuxLabel,
    }
end

local SIGN_FACE = {
    MILL = Enum.NormalId.Front,
    PEN = Enum.NormalId.Back,
}

local function buildSign(kind, board)
    local faces = {
        buildFace(kind, board, SIGN_FACE[kind] or Enum.NormalId.Front),
    }

    local alert = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    alert.Name = "UpgradeAlert_" .. kind
    alert.Adornee = board
    alert.Size = UDim2.fromScale(2.4, 2.4)
    alert.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, board.Size.Y / 2 + 2.2, 0)
    alert.LightInfluence = 0
    alert.MaxDistance = 200
    alert.ResetOnSpawn = false
    alert.Enabled = false
    alert.Parent = pg
    local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    img.Name = "Icon"
    img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    img.Image = ICON_ALERT
    img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    img.Parent = alert

    signs[kind] = { board = board, faces = faces, alert = alert, img = img, affordable = nil }
    return signs[kind]
end

local function coins()
    local ls = plr:FindFirstChild("wallet")
    local c = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Coins")
    return c and c.Value or 0
end

local function update(kind, holder, attr)
    local sign = holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local board = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("Board")
    local s = signs[kind]
    if not board then
        destroySign(kind)
        return
    end
    if s and s.board ~= board then
        destroySign(kind)
        s = nil
    end
    s = s or buildSign(kind, board)

    local level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(holder:GetAttribute(attr)) or 1), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL)
    if level >= U.MAX_LEVEL then
        for _, f in ipairs(s.faces) do
            f.levels.Text = ("Level %d - Max"):format(level)
            f.cash.Visible = false
            f.robux.Visible = false
        end
        s.alert.Enabled = false
        return
    end
    local price = U.price(kind, level)
    local canPay = coins() >= price
    local toneChanged = s.affordable ~= canPay
    s.affordable = canPay
    for _, f in ipairs(s.faces) do
        f.cash.Visible = true
        f.robux.Visible = true
        f.levels.Text = ("Level %d > Level %d"):format(level, level + 1)
        f.cashText.Text = money(price)
        f.robuxLabel.Text = robuxText(U.robux(kind, level))
        if toneChanged then f.setCashTone(canPay and K.ready or K.close) end
    end
    s.alert.Enabled = canPay
end

local function myPlot()
    for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
        if pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId then
            return pen, mills:FindFirstChild("Mill_" .. pen.Name)
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local pen, mill = myPlot()
        update("PEN", pen, "PlotLevel")
        update("MILL", mill, "MillLevel")
        task.wait(0.25)
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local t = os.clock()
    for _, s in pairs(signs) do
        if s.alert.Enabled then
            s.img.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -math.abs(math.sin(t * 4)) * 0.25)
        end
    end
end)

name: SellShopClient
