local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local Sell = require(RS:WaitForChild("SellConfig"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Sell")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local WHITE = UIKit.WHITE
local SECOND = UIKit.SECOND
local PANEL_INK = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64)
local PANEL_MARK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 224)
local INCOME_GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(96, 255, 84)
local ICON = Sell.ICON

local W, H = 1000, 640
local PAD = 16
local LEFT_W = 196
local BOTTOM_H = 92
local COLS = 4
local CARD_GAP = 12
local TAB_SIDE = 124

local money = Cfg.fmtMoney

local function block(props)
    local face = UIKit.block(props)
    if props.clickable and props.react ~= false then UIKit.reactToCursor(face) end
    return face
end

local function bold(parent, props)
    props.parent = parent
    return UIKit.boldLabel(props)
end

local function art(parent, props)
    local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    i.Name = props.name or "Icon"
    i.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    i.Image = props.image
    i.Size = props.size
    i.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
    i.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
    i.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    i.Rotation = props.rotation or 0
    i.ZIndex = props.zindex or 20
    if props.tint then i.ImageColor3 = props.tint end
    if props.transparency then i.ImageTransparency = props.transparency end
    i.Parent = parent
    return i
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SellShopGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = 60
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local dim = Instance.new("TextButton")
dim.Name = "Dim"
dim.Text = ""
dim.AutoButtonColor = false
dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 4, 12)
dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
dim.ZIndex = 1
dim.Visible = false
dim.Parent = gui

local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
shell.Name = "SellShop"
shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shell.Visible = false
shell.ZIndex = 10
shell.Parent = gui

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = shell

local FULL_W = W + 14 + TAB_SIDE
local function fit()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return 1 end
    local small = math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
    local room = cam.ViewportSize.Y - (small and -20 or GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y)

    local SHRINK = small and 1 or 0.82
    local s = math.clamp(math.min((room - 28) / H, (cam.ViewportSize.X - 32) / FULL_W) * SHRINK, 0.40, SHRINK)
    scale.Scale = s
    shell.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(14 + TAB_SIDE) * s / 2, 0.5, 0)
    return s
end
fit()
do
    local function track(cam)
        if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
    end
    track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
    workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
        fit()
    end)
end

local frame = block({
    parent = shell, name = "Frame", tone = K.panel, size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),
    radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 8, bevel = false, stud = 15, studAlpha = 0.55, zindex = 10,
})

frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
do
    local under = frame:FindFirstChild("Underside")
    if under then under.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 end
end

local headH = UIKit.headHeight(W)
local header = block({
    parent = frame, name = "Header", tone = K.ready,
    size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headH), position = UDim2.new(),
    radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58, shadow = false, zindex = 14,
})
local headIconH = headH - 16
local headIconShadow = art(header, { name = "IconShadow", image = ICON.paw, size = UDim2.fromOffset(headIconH, headIconH),
    position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), zindex = 20, tint = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), transparency = 0.55 })
local headIcon = art(header, { name = "Icon", image = ICON.paw, size = UDim2.fromOffset(headIconH, headIconH),
    position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8), zindex = 21 })
local titleLabel = bold(header, {
    name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), text = "SELL PETS",

local function gather(tab)
    local list = {}
    for _, holder in ipairs({ plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), plr.Character }) do
        if holder then
            for _, t in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") then
                    local zone, tier, size, kind
                    if (tab == nil or tab == "Pets") and t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") then
                        zone, tier, size = t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"), t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier"), t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize")
                        kind = "Pets"
                    elseif (tab == nil or tab == "Eggs") and t:GetAttribute("EggZone") then
                        zone, tier, size = t:GetAttribute("EggZone"), t:GetAttribute("EggTier"), t:GetAttribute("EggSize")
                        kind = "Eggs"
                    end
                    if zone then
                        table.insert(list, {
                            tool = t, kind = kind, zone = zone, tier = tier or 1, size = size or 1,
                            income = Cfg.petIncome(zone, size or 1, tier or 1, t:GetAttribute("Luck") or t:GetAttribute("EggLuck")),
                            price = Sell.price(kind, zone, tier, size, t:GetAttribute("Luck") or t:GetAttribute("EggLuck")),
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        local ka, kb
        if state.sort == "size" then
            ka, kb = a.size * 1e18 + a.price, b.size * 1e18 + b.price
        else
            ka, kb = a.price, b.price
        end
        if ka == kb then return a.tool.Name < b.tool.Name end
        if state.desc then return ka > kb end
        return ka < kb
    end)
    return list
end

local function preview(view, tool)
    local holder = Instance.new("Model")

    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local c = p:Clone()
            c:ClearAllChildren()
            c.Anchored = true
            local rest = p:GetAttribute("RestOffset")
            if handle and typeof(rest) == "CFrame" then
                c.CFrame = handle.CFrame * rest
            end
            c.Parent = holder
        end
    end
    if #holder:GetChildren() == 0 then holder:Destroy() return end
    PetQueue.want(holder)
    holder.Parent = view

    local cf = holder:GetBoundingBox()
    local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
    cam.FieldOfView = 30
    local eye = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.35, 1).Unit
    local up = Vector3.yAxis

    local viewEye, viewUp = PetPaint.viewDir(holder:GetChildren(), tool)
    if viewEye then eye, up = viewEye, viewUp end
    local probe = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + eye * 10, cf.Position, up)
    local reach = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
        for dx = -1, 1, 2 do
            for dy = -1, 1, 2 do
                for dz = -1, 1, 2 do
                    local corner = (p.CFrame * CFrame.new(p.Size * Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz) / 2)).Position
                    local inCam = probe:PointToObjectSpace(corner)
                    reach = math.max(reach, math.abs(inCam.X), math.abs(inCam.Y))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if reach <= 0 then reach = 1 end
    local dist = reach / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.1
    cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + eye * dist, cf.Position, up)
    cam.Parent = view
    view.CurrentCamera = cam
    view.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 196)
    view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.4)
end

local SIZE_KG = { 0.15, 0.6, 1.5, 4, 12, 40 }
local function weightOf(it)
    local base = SIZE_KG[it.size] or 1
    local key = tostring(it.tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey") or it.tool.Name)
    local h = 0
    for i = 1, #key do h = (h * 31 + key:byte(i)) % 1000003 end
    local kg = base * (0.85 + (h % 31) / 100)
    return (kg < 10) and ("%.2f kg"):format(kg) or ("%.1f kg"):format(kg)
end

function render()
    local keep = grid.CanvasPosition
    state.items = gather(state.tab)

    local alive = {}
    for _, it in ipairs(state.items) do alive[it.tool] = true end
    for tool in pairs(state.selected) do
        if not alive[tool] then state.selected[tool] = nil end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
    end
    local total, picked = 0, 0
    for i, it in ipairs(state.items) do
        buildCard(it, i)
        if state.selected[it.tool] then
            total += it.price
            picked += 1
        end
    end
    task.defer(function() grid.CanvasPosition = keep end)

    local pets = state.tab == "Pets"
    local eggs = state.tab == "Eggs"
    titleLabel.Text = eggs and "SELL EGGS" or "SELL PETS"
    headIcon.Image = pets and ICON.paw or eggs and ICON.egg or ICON.cash
    headIconShadow.Image = headIcon.Image
    empty.Text = (#state.items == 0) and (pets and "No pets to sell" or eggs and "No eggs to sell"
        or "Nothing to sell yet") or ""

    for key, t in pairs(tabs) do t.setTone(key == state.tab and K.ready or K.lock) end
    for key, sb in pairs(sortButtons) do
        local active = state.sort == key
        sb.setTone(active and K.ready or K.lock)

        sb.arrow.Rotation = (active and not state.desc) and 180 or 0
    end

    local allPicked = #state.items > 0 and picked == #state.items
    setSelectTone(allPicked and K.close or K.ready)
    selectIcon.Image = allPicked and ICON.cross or ICON.check
    selectText.Text = allPicked and "CLEAR" or "SELECT ALL"

    totalLabel.Text = money(total)
    if picked == 0 then
        setSellTone(K.lock)
        setSellText("SELL")
    else
        setSellTone(K.ready)
        setSellText(allPicked and "SELL ALL" or "SELL")
    end
end

        UIKit.blurHold(true)
    end
    UIKit.popOpen(scale, fit())
end

local function shut()
    isOpen = false
    openedByRing = false
    dim.Visible = false
    shell.Visible = false
    if blurHeld then
        blurHeld = false
        UIKit.blurHold(false)
    end
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(shut)
dim.Activated:Connect(function(input)
    local pos = input and input.Position
    if pos then
        local playerGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        for _, hit in ipairs(playerGui and playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pos.X, pos.Y) or {}) do
            if hit ~= dim and hit.Visible and hit:IsDescendantOf(dim.Parent) then return end
        end
    end
    shut()
end)

local bus = RS.Remotes:FindFirstChild("OpenPanel")
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
        if id == "SellShop" then
            open()
        elseif isOpen then
            shut()
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
    local shops = map:WaitForChild("Shops", 60)
    local ring = shops and shops:WaitForChild("ShopLeftRing", 60)
    if not ring then
        warn("[SELL] no ShopLeftRing - the sell window only opens from code")
        return
    end
    local cf, size = ring:GetBoundingBox()
    local centre = cf.Position
    local radius = math.max(size.X, size.Z) / 2
    local inside = false
    while true do
        task.wait(0.15)
        local ch = plr.Character
        local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - centre.X, 0, root.Position.Z - centre.Z).Magnitude
            local level = math.abs(root.Position.Y - centre.Y) < 12
            if not inside and level and flat <= radius then
                inside = true
                if not isOpen then
                    if bus then bus:Fire("SellShop") else open() end
                    openedByRing = true
                end
            elseif inside and (flat > radius + 3 or not level) then
                inside = false
                if isOpen and openedByRing then shut() end
            end
        end
    end
end)

_G.OpenSellShop = open

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local AssetQueue = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("AssetQueue"))
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))
local Fuse = require(RS:WaitForChild("FuseConfig"))
local PetPaint = require(RS:WaitForChild("AnimalPaint"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Fuse")

local K = UIKit.Palette
local WHITE = UIKit.WHITE
local ICON_EGG = "rbxassetid://103180943014941"
local PIPE = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 36)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(107, 255, 74)

local W, H = 700, 650
local SLOT_W, SLOT_H = 196, 118
local BOX_W, BOX_H = 196, 150

local money = Cfg.fmtMoney

local function coins()
    local w = plr:FindFirstChild("wallet")
    local c = w and w:FindFirstChild("Coins")
    return c and c.Value or 0
end

local function tierColour(tier)
    return (Cfg.TIERS[tier or 1] or Cfg.TIERS[1]).color
end

local function petPreview(vp, tool)
    vp:ClearAllChildren()
    local holder = Instance.new("Model")
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local c = p:Clone()
            c:ClearAllChildren()
            c.Anchored = true
            local rest = p:GetAttribute("RestOffset")
            if handle and typeof(rest) == "CFrame" then c.CFrame = handle.CFrame * rest end
            c.Parent = holder
        end
    end
    if #holder:GetChildren() == 0 then holder:Destroy() return end
    holder.Parent = vp
    AssetQueue.want(holder)
    local cf, size = holder:GetBoundingBox()
    local eye, up = PetPaint.viewDir(holder:GetChildren(), tool)
    eye = eye or Vector3.new(0.6, 0.35, 1).Unit
    up = up or Vector3.yAxis
    local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
    cam.FieldOfView = 32
    local radius = size.Magnitude * 0.5
    cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + eye * (radius / math.tan(math.rad(16)) * 1.05), cf.Position, up)
    cam.Parent = vp
    vp.CurrentCamera = cam
    vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(196, 196, 206)
    vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.35, -1, -0.55)
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FuseMachineGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = 60
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local dim = Instance.new("TextButton")
dim.Name = "Dim"
dim.Text = ""
dim.AutoButtonColor = false
dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 4, 12)
dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
dim.ZIndex = 1
dim.Visible = false
dim.Parent = gui

local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
shell.Name = "FuseMachine"
shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shell.Visible = false
shell.ZIndex = 10
shell.Parent = gui

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = shell

local function fit()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return 1 end
    local small = math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
    local room = cam.ViewportSize.Y - (small and 8 or (GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y + 28))
    local s = math.clamp(math.min(room / H, (cam.ViewportSize.X - 32) / W), small and 0.3 or 0.40, 1)
    scale.Scale = s
    return s
end
fit()
do
    local function track(cam)
        if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
    end
    track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
    workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
        fit()
    end)
end

local frame = UIKit.block({
    parent = shell, name = "Frame", tone = K.panel, size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H),
    radius = 15, outline = 3, shadowY = 8, bevel = false, stud = 15, studAlpha = 0.55, zindex = 10,
})
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
do
    local under = frame:FindFirstChild("Underside")
    if under then under.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 end
end

local headH = UIKit.headHeight(W)
local header = UIKit.block({
    parent = frame, name = "Header", tone = K.claimed,
    size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headH),
    radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 10, studAlpha = 0.58, shadow = false, zindex = 14,
})
UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = header, name = "Title", size = UDim2.new(1, -198, 1, 0), position = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 0),
    text = "Fuse Machine", align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, strokeW = 4, zindex = 22,
    textSize = math.floor(headH * 0.6),
})
local fuseIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
fuseIcon.Name = "FuseIcon"
fuseIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fuseIcon.Image = "rbxassetid://83291582290127"
fuseIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
fuseIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84,84)
fuseIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,.5)
fuseIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,.5,0)
fuseIcon.ZIndex = 22
fuseIcon.Parent = header

local shutSide = headH - 24
local closeBtn = UIKit.block({
    parent = header, name = "Close", tone = K.close, clickable = true,
    size = UDim2.fromOffset(shutSide, shutSide),
    position = UDim2.new(1, -(shutSide + 14), 0.5, 0), anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
    radius = math.floor(headH * 0.16), outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.70, shadowY = 4, zindex = 22,
})
UIKit.tintOnHover(closeBtn, K.close)
UIKit.cross(closeBtn, shutSide, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 224))

local line1 = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = frame, name = "Line1", size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40), position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, headH + 12),
    text = 'Bring <font color="#FF4B4B">3</font> of the same pet to fuse', strokeW = 4, zindex = 20, textSize = 32,
})
line1.RichText = true
local line2 = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = frame, name = "Line2", size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 30), position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, headH + 50),
    text = '<font color="#6BFF4A">Better pets</font> give more <font color="#6BFF4A">Luck</font> \u{1F340}!',
    strokeW = 3, zindex = 20, textSize = 26,
})
line2.RichText = true

local SLOT_Y = headH + 96
local BOX_Y = SLOT_Y + SLOT_H + 48
local function slotX(i) return 24 + (i - 1) * (SLOT_W + 32) end

local function bar(x, y, w, h, colour)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.BackgroundColor3 = colour
    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
    f.ZIndex = 15
    f.Parent = frame
    UIKit.corner(f, 4)
    return f
end
do
    local slotBottom = SLOT_Y + SLOT_H
    local boxLeft, boxRight = (W - BOX_W) / 2, (W + BOX_W) / 2
    local boxMid = BOX_Y + BOX_H / 2
    local c1, c2, c3 = slotX(1) + SLOT_W / 2, W / 2, slotX(3) + SLOT_W / 2
    bar(c2 - 9, slotBottom, 18, BOX_Y - slotBottom, PIPE)
    bar(c1 - 9, slotBottom, 18, boxMid - slotBottom + 9, PIPE)
    bar(c1 - 9, boxMid - 9, boxLeft - (c1 - 9), 18, PIPE)
    bar(c3 - 9, slotBottom, 18, boxMid - slotBottom + 9, PIPE)
    bar(boxRight, boxMid - 9, (c3 + 9) - boxRight, 18, PIPE)
    for _, c in ipairs({ c1, c2, c3 }) do bar(c - 30, slotBottom - 2, 60, 10, K.ready.base) end
    bar(c2 - 30, BOX_Y - 8, 60, 10, K.ready.base)
    bar(boxLeft - 10, boxMid - 25, 10, 50, K.ready.base)
    bar(boxRight, boxMid - 25, 10, 50, K.ready.base)
end

local chosen = {}
local state = { cost = 0 }
local showingResult = false
local slots = {}
local openPicker
local refresh

local note = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = gui, name = "Note", size = UDim2.fromOffset(720, 48),
    position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.12), anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    text = "", colour = K.close.hi, strokeW = 4, textSize = 30, zindex = 40,
})
note.Visible = false
local noteToken = 0
local function say(text, colour)
    noteToken += 1
    local mine = noteToken
    note.Text = text
    note.TextColor3 = colour or K.close.hi
    note.Visible = true
    task.delay(2.6, function()
        if noteToken == mine then note.Visible = false end
    end)
end

for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
    local s = UIKit.block({
        parent = frame, name = "Slot" .. i, tone = K.thumb, size = UDim2.fromOffset(SLOT_W, SLOT_H),
        position = UDim2.fromOffset(slotX(i), SLOT_Y), radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 12, zindex = 16,
        bevel = false,
    })
    s.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    local title = UIKit.boldLabel({

        parent = s, name = "Title", size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 30), position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 6),
        text = "Empty", strokeW = 3, zindex = 22, textSize = 24,
    })
    local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    view.Name = "Pet"
    view.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    view.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 76)
    view.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -48, 0, 38)
    view.ZIndex = 21
    view.Visible = false
    view.Parent = s
    local add = UIKit.button({
        parent = s, name = "Add", tone = K.ready, text = "", textSize = 36,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(SLOT_W - 48, 52), position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, SLOT_H - 64), zindex = 20,
        onClick = function() openPicker(i) end,
    })
    do
        local LEN, THICK, EDGE = 28, 8, 3
        local function bar(w, h, z, colour, pad)
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Name = "Plus"
            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w + pad * 2, h + pad * 2)
            f.BackgroundColor3 = colour
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.ZIndex = z
            f.Active = false
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(THICK / 2) + pad)
            c.Parent = f
            f.Parent = add
        end
        bar(LEN, THICK, 23, K.outline, EDGE)
        bar(THICK, LEN, 23, K.outline, EDGE)
        bar(LEN, THICK, 24, WHITE, 0)
        bar(THICK, LEN, 24, WHITE, 0)
    end
    local remove = UIKit.button({
        parent = s, name = "Remove", tone = K.close, text = "X", textSize = 18,
        size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 6), zindex = 24,
        onClick = function()
            chosen[i] = nil
            refresh()
        end,
    })
    remove.Visible = false
    slots[i] = { block = s, title = title, view = view, add = add, remove = remove, shown = nil }
end

local box = UIKit.block({
    parent = frame, name = "Result", tone = K.thumb, size = UDim2.fromOffset(BOX_W, BOX_H),
    position = UDim2.fromOffset((W - BOX_W) / 2, BOX_Y), radius = 12, outline = 3, stud = 12, zindex = 16,
    bevel = false,
})
box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
local eggIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
eggIcon.Name = "Egg"
eggIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
eggIcon.Image = ICON_EGG
eggIcon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
eggIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
eggIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
eggIcon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45)
eggIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 104)
eggIcon.ZIndex = 22
eggIcon.Parent = box
local eggScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
eggScale.Parent = eggIcon
local resultText = UIKit.boldLabel({
    parent = box, name = "ResultText", size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44), position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -48),

})

})

local doFuse
local _, _, setFuseText, setFuseTone = UIKit.button({

    onClick = function() doFuse() end,
})

})

local function petTools()
    local out = {}
    for _, holder in ipairs({ plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), plr.Character }) do
        for _, t in ipairs(holder and holder:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") then table.insert(out, t) end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        local ia = Cfg.petIncome(a:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"), a:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1, a:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1, a:GetAttribute("Luck"))
        local ib = Cfg.petIncome(b:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"), b:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1, b:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1, b:GetAttribute("Luck"))
        if ia ~= ib then return ia > ib end
        return a.Name < b.Name
    end)
    return out
end

local function owned(t)
    return t and (t.Parent == plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or (plr.Character ~= nil and t.Parent == plr.Character))
end

local function sameAs(t, ref)
    return not ref or (t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") == ref:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")
        and (t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1) == (ref:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1)
        and t:GetAttribute("Species") == ref:GetAttribute("Species"))
end

local function isChosen(t)
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        if chosen[i] == t then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function resetResult()
    if showingResult then
        showingResult = false
        eggIcon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        resultText.Text = ""
    end
end

openPicker = function(slot)
    for _, c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
    end
    local ref
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        if chosen[i] and i ~= slot then ref = chosen[i] break end
    end
    local n = 0
    for _, t in ipairs(petTools()) do
        if not isChosen(t) and sameAs(t, ref) then
            n += 1
            local tier = t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
            local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
            card.Name = "Pet" .. n
            card.AutoButtonColor = false
            card.Text = ""
            card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 38, 52)
            card.BorderSizePixel = 0
            card.LayoutOrder = n
            card.ZIndex = 42
            card.Parent = grid
            UIKit.corner(card, 10)
            UIKit.stroke(card, tierColour(tier), 2, 0.2)
            local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
            vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            vp.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 100)
            vp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
            vp.ZIndex = 43
            vp.Parent = card
            petPreview(vp, t)
            UIKit.boldLabel({
                parent = card, name = "Name", size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26), position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 108),
                text = t:GetAttribute("Species") or t.Name, strokeW = 3, zindex = 44, textSize = 20,
                colour = tierColour(tier),
            })
            local luck = t:GetAttribute("Luck")
            local sizeName = Cfg.SIZES[t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1] and Cfg.SIZES[t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1].name or ""
            UIKit.boldLabel({
                parent = card, name = "Sub", size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22), position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 136),
                text = luck and ("(%s) %+d%%"):format(sizeName, luck) or ("(%s)"):format(sizeName),
                strokeW = 2, zindex = 44, textSize = 16, colour = Color3.fromRGB(200, 204, 214),
            })
            card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                chosen[slot] = t
                resetResult()
                closePicker()
                refresh()
            end)
        end
    end
    emptyNote.Visible = n == 0
    emptyNote.Text = ref and "No more matching pets in your backpack" or "No pets in your backpack"
    picker.Visible = true
end

local function holoCount(count)
    local aux = workspace:FindFirstChild("FuseMachine")
    local label = aux and aux:FindFirstChild("HoloCount", true)
    if label then label.Text = ("%d/%d"):format(count, Fuse.SLOTS) end
end

refresh = function()
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        if chosen[i] and not owned(chosen[i]) then chosen[i] = nil end
    end
    local count, sizes, ref = 0, {}, nil
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        local s, t = slots[i], chosen[i]
        if t then
            count += 1
            ref = ref or t
            table.insert(sizes, t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1)
            s.title.Text = t:GetAttribute("Species") or t.Name
            s.title.TextColor3 = tierColour(t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier"))
            s.add.Visible = false
            s.remove.Visible = true
            s.view.Visible = true
            if s.shown ~= t then
                s.shown = t
                petPreview(s.view, t)
            end
        else
            s.title.Text = "Empty"
            s.title.TextColor3 = WHITE
            s.add.Visible = true
            s.remove.Visible = false
            s.view.Visible = false
            if s.shown then
                s.shown = nil
                s.view:ClearAllChildren()
            end
        end
    end

    holoCount(count)

    local left = Fuse.SLOTS - count
    if left > 0 then
        state.cost = 0
        setFuseText((left == 1 and "%d Pet Left" or "%d Pets Left"):format(left))
        setFuseTone(K.ready)
        info.Text = ("Egg size and Luck (%d%% to +%d%%) are random"):format(Fuse.LUCK_MIN, Fuse.LUCK_MAX)
    else
        local zone, tier = ref:GetAttribute("AnimalZone"), ref:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
        local cost = 0
        for _, sz in ipairs(sizes) do cost += Fuse.cost(zone, tier, sz) end
        cost = math.floor(cost / #sizes + 0.5)
        state.cost = cost
        setFuseText("FUSE " .. money(cost))
        setFuseTone(coins() >= cost and K.ready or K.close)
        info.Text = ("You get a %s egg - random size, Luck %d%% to +%d%%"):format(
            tostring(ref:GetAttribute("Species") or "pet"), Fuse.LUCK_MIN, Fuse.LUCK_MAX)
    end
end

local luckBoost = 1
local baseRefresh = refresh
refresh = function()
    baseRefresh()
    if luckBoost > 1 then
        info.Text = info.Text .. ("  |  FUSE LUCK x%g ACTIVE"):format(luckBoost)
    end
end
task.spawn(function()
    local boostRemote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("GlobalBoost", 20)
    if not boostRemote then return end
    boostRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(state)
        local entry = type(state) == "table" and state.luck
        luckBoost = type(entry) == "table" and (tonumber(entry.mult) or 1) or 1
        refresh()
    end)
    boostRemote:FireServer()
end)

doFuse = function()
    local tools = {}
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        if not chosen[i] then
            say("Put 3 of the same pet in the machine")
            return
        end
        tools[i] = chosen[i]
    end
    if coins() < (state.cost or 0) then
        say("Not enough money")
        return
    end
    remote:FireServer("fuse", tools)
end

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
    if action == "deny" then
        say(tostring(data))
    elseif action == "fused" and type(data) == "table" then
        table.clear(chosen)
        showingResult = true
        eggIcon.ImageColor3 = Cfg.eggColor(data.zone or 1, data.tier or 1)
        local luck = tonumber(data.luck) or 0
        local sizeName = Cfg.SIZES[data.size or 1] and Cfg.SIZES[data.size or 1].name or ""
        resultText.Text = ("%s %s Egg\nLuck %+d%%"):format(sizeName, tostring(data.species or ""), luck)
        resultText.TextColor3 = luck >= 0 and GREEN or Color3.fromRGB(255, 96, 96)
        eggScale.Scale = 0.4
        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(eggScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        say("Fused! The egg is in your backpack", K.ready.hi)
        refresh()
    end
end)

local isOpen, blurHeld, openedByRing = false, false, false

local function open()
    if isOpen then return end
    isOpen = true
    dim.Visible = true
    shell.Visible = true
    if not blurHeld then
        blurHeld = true
        UIKit.blurHold(true)
    end
    closePicker()
    refresh()
    UIKit.popOpen(scale, fit())
end

local function shut()
    isOpen = false
    openedByRing = false
    closePicker()
    dim.Visible = false
    shell.Visible = false
    if blurHeld then
        blurHeld = false
        UIKit.blurHold(false)
    end
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(shut)
dim.Activated:Connect(function(input)
    local pos = input and input.Position
    if pos then
        local playerGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        for _, hit in ipairs(playerGui and playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pos.X, pos.Y) or {}) do
            if hit ~= dim and hit.Visible and hit:IsDescendantOf(dim.Parent) then return end
        end
    end
    shut()
end)

local bus = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):FindFirstChild("OpenPanel")
if bus then
    bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
        if id == "FuseMachine" then
            open()
        elseif isOpen then
            shut()
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local function hook(bag)
        if not bag then return end
        bag.ChildAdded:Connect(function() if isOpen then refresh() end end)
        bag.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() if isOpen then refresh() end end)
    end
    hook(plr:WaitForChild("Backpack", 30))
    plr.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Backpack") then hook(c) end end)
    local wallet = plr:WaitForChild("wallet", 60)
    local c = wallet and wallet:WaitForChild("Coins", 30)
    if c then c.Changed:Connect(function() if isOpen then refresh() end end) end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local aux = workspace:WaitForChild("FuseMachine", 60)
    local ring = aux and aux:WaitForChild("FuseMachineRing", 60)
    if not ring then
        warn("[FUSE] no FuseMachineRing - the Fuse Machine only opens from code")
        return
    end
    local cf, size = ring:GetBoundingBox()
    local centre = cf.Position
    local radius = math.max(size.X, size.Z) / 2
    local inside = false
    while true do
        task.wait(0.15)
        local ch = plr.Character
        local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - centre.X, 0, root.Position.Z - centre.Z).Magnitude
            local level = math.abs(root.Position.Y - centre.Y) < 12
            if not inside and level and flat <= radius then
                inside = true
                if not isOpen then
                    if bus then bus:Fire("FuseMachine") else open() end
                    openedByRing = true
                end
            elseif inside and (flat > radius + 3 or not level) then
                inside = false
                if isOpen and openedByRing then shut() end
            end
        end
    end
end)

_G.OpenFuseMachine = open

local ICON = {
    shoe  = "rbxassetid://126213576980021",
    studs = "rbxassetid://138926013267839",
    rays  = "rbxassetid://75235337881072",
    glow  = "rbxassetid://110083852572719",
}

local Money = require(RS:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))
local PACKS = {}
for i, e in ipairs(Money.SPEED_PACKS) do
    PACKS[i] = { key = e.key, text = (tostring(e.label or e.key):gsub(" SPEED$", "")) }
end

local PACK_BY_ZONE = Money.BOSS_HIT_PACK_BY_ZONE or {}

local function packFor(zone)
    local i = PACK_BY_ZONE[tonumber(zone) or 1] or #PACKS
    return PACKS[i] or PACKS[#PACKS]
end

local REF_H = 1005
local SIZE = 1.2
local W, H = 220, 62
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(12, 60, 16)

local SHOE_SIDE, ROW_GAP, PAD_X = 50, 8, 20

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    g.Rotation = 90
    g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 120), Color3.fromRGB(46, 220, 44))
    g.Parent = amount
end

local current
local token = 0

local function fitWidth(text)
    local t = TextService:GetTextSize(text, amount.TextSize, amount.Font, Vector2.new(1000, 200))
    holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PAD_X * 2 + SHOE_SIDE + ROW_GAP + t.X, H)
end

local POP = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local SHUT = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
local QUICK = TweenInfo.new(0.10, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local spin
local function spinRays(on)
    if on and not spin then
        spin = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            rays.Rotation = (rays.Rotation + dt * 40) % 360
        end)
    elseif not on and spin then
        spin:Disconnect()
        spin = nil
    end
end

local function hide(mine)
    if mine ~= token then return end
    local t = TweenService:Create(popScale, SHUT, { Scale = 0 })
    t:Play()
    t.Completed:Connect(function()
        if mine ~= token then return end
        holder.Visible = false
        spinRays(false)
        current = nil
    end)
end

local function show(zone, stun)
    current = packFor(zone)
    amount.Text = current.text
    fitWidth(current.text)
    token += 1
    local mine = token

    local wasVisible = holder.Visible
    holder.Visible = true
    spinRays(true)
    if not wasVisible then popScale.Scale = 0 end
    TweenService:Create(popScale, POP, { Scale = fitScale() }):Play()

    hoverScale.Scale = 1.12
    TweenService:Create(hoverScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Scale = 1 }):Play()

    local hold = math.max(4, (tonumber(stun) or 2) + 2.5)
    task.delay(hold, function() hide(mine) end)
end

button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(hoverScale, QUICK, { Scale = 1.06 }):Play()
end)
button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(hoverScale, QUICK, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
end)
button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(hoverScale, QUICK, { Scale = 0.96 }):Play()
end)
button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(hoverScale, QUICK, { Scale = 1.06 }):Play()
end)

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not current then return end
    local key = current.key
    hide(token)
    local shop = remotes:FindFirstChild("Shop")
    if shop then
        shop:FireServer("buy", key)
    elseif _G.OpenShop then
        _G.OpenShop(key)
    end
end)

Remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
    if kind ~= "BossHit" then return end
    data = type(data) == "table" and data or {}
    show(data.zone, data.stun)
end)

_G.BossHitOffer = show

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local BossAnim = require(RS:WaitForChild("BossAnim"))
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Bosses")

local LOOPED = { Idle = true, Run = true, Sleep = true }

local POS_SMOOTH = 12
local ROT_SMOOTH = 10
local SNAP_DISTANCE = 60
local MAX_PREDICT = 0.35
local FAR = 450
local FAR_EVERY = 6
local SETTLE_TIME = 0.2

local FADE = 0.2

local function ease(style, dir, a)
	if style == Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Constant then return 0 end
	if style == Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Linear then return a end
	if dir == Enum.PoseEasingDirection.In then return a * a * a end
	if dir == Enum.PoseEasingDirection.Out then return 1 - (1 - a) ^ 3 end
	return a < 0.5 and 4 * a * a * a or 1 - (-2 * a + 2) ^ 3 / 2
end

local function readClip(kfs, name, scale)
	local joints, length = {}, 0
	local frames = kfs:GetKeyframes()
	table.sort(frames, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	for _, kf in ipairs(frames) do
		length = math.max(length, kf.Time)
		for _, p in ipairs(kf:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("Pose") and p.Weight > 0 then
				local j = joints[p.Name]
				if not j then
					j = { times = {}, cfs = {}, styles = {}, dirs = {} }
					joints[p.Name] = j
				end
				table.insert(j.times, kf.Time)
				table.insert(j.cfs, p.CFrame.Rotation + p.CFrame.Position * scale)
				table.insert(j.styles, p.EasingStyle)
				table.insert(j.dirs, p.EasingDirection)
			end
		end
	end
	return { joints = joints, length = length, loop = LOOPED[name] == true }
end

local function sampleJoint(j, t)
	local times = j.times
	local n = #times
	if n == 0 then return CFrame.identity end
	if t <= times[1] then return j.cfs[1] end
	if t >= times[n] then return j.cfs[n] end
	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while hi - lo > 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if times[mid] <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local span = times[hi] - times[lo]
	local a = span > 0 and (t - times[lo]) / span or 0
	return j.cfs[lo]:Lerp(j.cfs[hi], ease(j.styles[lo], j.dirs[lo], a))
end

local function setupAnimations(model)
	local ids = BossAnim.animations(model) or {}
	local embedded = BossAnim.embedded(model) or {}
	if next(ids) == nil and next(embedded) == nil then return nil end
	local motors = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part1 then motors[m.Part1.Name] = m end
	end
	local scale = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("AnimScale")) or 1
	local clips = {}
	for name, kfs in pairs(embedded) do clips[name] = readClip(kfs, name, scale) end
	local controller = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
	if not controller then
		controller = Instance.new("AnimationController")
		controller.Parent = model
	end
	local animator = controller:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = controller
	end
	local tracks = {}
	for name, id in pairs(ids) do
		local a = Instance.new("Animation")
		a.AnimationId = id
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
		if ok and track then
			track.Looped = LOOPED[name] == true
			track.Priority = (name == "Attack" or name == "Wake") and Enum.AnimationPriority.Action or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
			tracks[name] = track
		end
	end
	return { tracks = tracks, clips = clips, motors = motors, clock = 0 }
end

local function usableTrack(a, name)
	local t = a.tracks[name]
	if t and (t.Length > 0 or not a.clips[name]) then return t end
	return nil
end

local function has(a, name)
	return a.tracks[name] ~= nil or a.clips[name] ~= nil
end

local function resetJoints(a)
	for _, motor in pairs(a.motors) do motor.Transform = CFrame.identity end
end

local function playAnimation(a, name, speed, restart)
	if not has(a, name) then name = "Idle" end
	if not has(a, name) then return end
	if a.name == name and not restart then
		if speed then
			a.speed = speed
			if a.track then a.track:AdjustSpeed(speed) end
		end
		return
	end
	local track = usableTrack(a, name)
	local wasTrack = a.track ~= nil
	if a.track then a.track:Stop(track and FADE or 0) a.track = nil end
	a.prevClip, a.prevTime = a.clip, a.time
	a.fade = a.clip and 0 or 1
	a.name, a.clip, a.time, a.speed = name, nil, 0, speed or 1
	if track then
		if a.prevClip then resetJoints(a) end
		track:Play(FADE)
		track:AdjustSpeed(a.speed)
		a.track = track
		a.prevClip = nil
	else
		a.clip = a.clips[name]
		a.dirty = true
		if wasTrack then a.prevClip = nil a.fade = 1 end
	end
end

local function clipTime(clip, t)
	if clip.length <= 0 then return 0 end
	if clip.loop then return t % clip.length end
	return math.min(t, clip.length)
end

local function stepEmbedded(a, dt)
	if not a.clip then return end
	a.time += dt * (a.speed or 1)
	if a.prevClip then a.prevTime += dt end
	a.fade = math.min(1, (a.fade or 1) + dt / FADE)
	local t = clipTime(a.clip, a.time)
	local pt = a.prevClip and clipTime(a.prevClip, a.prevTime)
	local blending = a.prevClip ~= nil and a.fade < 1
	for name, motor in pairs(a.motors) do
		local j = a.clip.joints[name]
		local pj = blending and a.prevClip.joints[name]
		if j or pj or a.dirty then
			local cf = j and sampleJoint(j, t) or CFrame.identity
			if pj then cf = sampleJoint(pj, pt):Lerp(cf, a.fade) end
			motor.Transform = cf
		end
	end
	a.dirty = blending or nil
	if a.fade >= 1 then a.prevClip = nil end
end

local live = {}
local byIndex = {}
local held = {}
local settling = {}

local function adopt(model)
	if live[model] then return end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 200 do
			if model:GetAttribute("BossCF") then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		local cf = model:GetAttribute("BossCF")
		if not model.Parent or live[model] or not cf then return end
		local anim = setupAnimations(model)
		if not anim then
			warn(("[Boss] %s has no animations - add Idle/Run/Attack/Sleep/Wake animation ids to its Boss model"):format(model.Name))
		else
			task.delay(10, function()
				for name, t in pairs(anim.tracks) do
					if t.Length <= 0 then
						warn(("[Boss] %s: animation %s did not load - publish it for this game or set its id to 0 to use the saved one"):format(model.Name, name))
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		live[model] = {
			anim = anim,
			pos = cf.Position,
			rot = cf - cf.Position,
			shown = cf,
			phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
			frame = math.random(0, FAR_EVERY - 1),
		}
		local index = model:GetAttribute("BossIndex")
		if index then byIndex[index] = model end
	end)
end

for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do adopt(m) end
folder.ChildAdded:Connect(adopt)
folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(m) live[m] = nil end)

local function trackEgg(egg)
	if not egg:IsA("Model") then return end
	local cf, size = egg:GetBoundingBox()
	settling[egg] = nil
	held[egg] = { bottom = egg:GetPivot().Position.Y - (cf.Position.Y - size.Y / 2) }
end
for _, egg in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("BossHeldEgg")) do trackEgg(egg) end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("BossHeldEgg"):Connect(trackEgg)
CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("BossHeldEgg"):Connect(function(egg)
	if held[egg] and egg.Parent then
		settling[egg] = { from = egg:GetPivot(), t = 0, wait = 0 }
	end
	held[egg] = nil
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local eye = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
	local attackTime = folder:GetAttribute("AttackTime") or 0.65
	local posBlend = 1 - math.exp(-dt * POS_SMOOTH)
	local rotBlend = 1 - math.exp(-dt * ROT_SMOOTH)

	for model, e in pairs(live) do
		if not model.Parent then
			live[model] = nil
			continue
		end
		local stamp = model:GetAttribute("BossStamp") or 0
		if stamp >= (e.stamp or 0) then
			e.stamp = stamp
			e.cf = model:GetAttribute("BossCF") or e.cf
			e.vel = model:GetAttribute("BossVel") or Vector3.zero
		end
		local cf, vel = e.cf, e.vel
		if not cf then continue end
		local age = now - (e.stamp or now)
		local state = model:GetAttribute("BossState") or "sleep"
		local since = now - (model:GetAttribute("BossStateAt") or now)
		local wakeTime = folder:GetAttribute("WakeTime") or 1.35

		local goal = cf.Position + vel * math.clamp(age, 0, MAX_PREDICT)
		local goalRot = cf - cf.Position
		if (goal - e.pos).Magnitude > SNAP_DISTANCE then
			e.pos, e.rot = goal, goalRot
		else
			if age < MAX_PREDICT then e.pos += vel * dt end
			e.pos = e.pos:Lerp(goal, posBlend)
			e.rot = e.rot:Lerp(goalRot, rotBlend)
		end
		e.shown = CFrame.new(e.pos) * e.rot

		local offset = CFrame.identity
		if state == "sleep" then
			e.phase += dt
			offset = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(e.phase * 0.22) * 0.10, 0)
		elseif state == "waking" then
			local k = math.clamp(since / wakeTime, 0, 1)
			offset = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(since * 26) * (1 - k) * 0.30, 0)
		end

		local far = eye ~= nil and (e.pos - eye).Magnitude > FAR
		e.frame += 1
		if not far or e.frame % FAR_EVERY == 0 then
			local render = e.shown * offset
			e.posed = render
			model:PivotTo(render)
		end

		local a = e.anim
		if a then
			local flat = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
			if state == "sleep" then
				playAnimation(a, "Sleep", 1)
			elseif state == "waking" then
				playAnimation(a, "Wake", 1)
			elseif state == "attack" then
				local at = model:GetAttribute("BossStateAt")
				if a.attackAt ~= at then
					a.attackAt = at
					local track, clip = usableTrack(a, "Attack"), a.clips.Attack
					local len = track and track.Length or clip and clip.length or 0
					playAnimation(a, "Attack", len > 0 and len / math.max(attackTime, 0.2) or 1, true)
				end
			elseif flat > 1 then
				playAnimation(a, "Run", math.clamp(flat / 45, 0.6, 2))
			else
				playAnimation(a, "Idle", 1)
			end
			if not far or e.frame % FAR_EVERY == 0 then
				a.pending = (a.pending or 0) + dt
				stepEmbedded(a, a.pending)
				a.pending = 0
			else
				a.pending = (a.pending or 0) + dt
			end
		end
	end

	for eggModel, h in pairs(held) do
		if not eggModel.Parent then
			held[eggModel] = nil
			continue
		end
		local boss = byIndex[eggModel:GetAttribute("HeldBy")]
		local e = boss and live[boss]
		if e then
			local H = boss:GetAttribute("BossH") or 10
			local base = e.posed or e.shown
			local p = base.Position + base.LookVector * (H * 0.42)
			eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(p.X, H * 0.30 + h.bottom, p.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, eggModel:GetAttribute("HeldYaw") or 0, 0))
		end
	end

	for eggModel, s in pairs(settling) do
		local current = eggModel.Parent and eggModel:GetPivot()
		local loose = eggModel.PrimaryPart and not eggModel.PrimaryPart.Anchored
		if current and not s.goal then
			s.wait += dt
			if (current.Position - s.from.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then
				s.goal = current
			end
		end
		if not current or loose or (not s.goal and s.wait > 0.5) then
			settling[eggModel] = nil
		elseif s.goal then
			s.t += dt
			local u = math.min(s.t / SETTLE_TIME, 1)
			eggModel:PivotTo(s.from:Lerp(s.goal, u * u * (3 - 2 * u)))
			if u >= 1 then
				settling[eggModel] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local BLEND_SPEED = 10
local GRIP_GAP = 0.05
local GRIP_BACK = 0.35
local GRIP_DOWN = 0.15
local POLE = Vector3.new(0.7, -1, 0.8)
local DOWN = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
local FORWARD = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

local blend = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastTarget = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function rotBetween(a, b)
	local dot = math.clamp(a:Dot(b), -1, 1)
	local axis = a:Cross(b)
	if axis.Magnitude < 1e-6 then
		return dot > 0 and CFrame.identity or CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.xAxis, math.pi)
	end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot))
end

local function basis(up, hint, fallback)
	local look = hint - up * hint:Dot(up)
	if look.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		look = fallback - up * fallback:Dot(up)
	end
	look = look.Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, look:Cross(up), up, -look)
end

local function isJoint(j)
	return j ~= nil and (j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint"))
end

local function frames(j)
	if j:IsA("Motor6D") then return j.C0, j.C1 end
	local a0, a1 = j.Attachment0, j.Attachment1
	return a0 and a0.CFrame or CFrame.identity, a1 and a1.CFrame or CFrame.identity
end

local function armOf(char, side)
	local upper = char:FindFirstChild(side .. "UpperArm")
	local lower = char:FindFirstChild(side .. "LowerArm")
	local hand = char:FindFirstChild(side .. "Hand")
	local sh = upper and upper:FindFirstChild(side .. "Shoulder")
	local el = lower and lower:FindFirstChild(side .. "Elbow")
	local wr = hand and hand:FindFirstChild(side .. "Wrist")
	if isJoint(sh) and isJoint(el) and isJoint(wr) then
		return { sh = sh, el = el, wr = wr, hand = hand, sign = (side == "Right") and 1 or -1 }
	end
	return nil
end

local function rigOf(char)
	local rig = rigs[char]
	if rig and rig.torso.Parent == char and rig.arms[1].sh.Parent and rig.arms[2].sh.Parent then
		return rig
	end
	local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local right, left = armOf(char, "Right"), armOf(char, "Left")
	if not (torso and right and left) then
		rigs[char] = nil
		return nil
	end
	rig = { torso = torso, arms = { right, left } }
	rigs[char] = rig
	return rig
end

local function solve(arm, target, w)
	local sh, el, wr = arm.sh, arm.el, arm.wr
	local s0, s1 = frames(sh)
	local e0, e1 = frames(el)
	local w0, w1 = frames(wr)
	local S = s0.Position
	local v1 = e0.Position - s1.Position
	local v2 = w0.Position - e1.Position
	local L1 = v1.Magnitude
	local L2 = v2.Magnitude + w1.Position.Magnitude
	if L1 < 1e-3 or L2 < 1e-3 then return end

	local toT = target - S
	local dist = toT.Magnitude
	local dir = dist > 1e-4 and toT / dist or DOWN
	local d = math.clamp(dist, math.abs(L1 - L2) + 0.02, L1 + L2 - 0.02)
	local pole = Vector3.new(POLE.X * arm.sign, POLE.Y, POLE.Z)
	local perp = pole - dir * pole:Dot(dir)
	perp = perp.Magnitude > 1e-4 and perp.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	local cosA = math.clamp((L1 * L1 + d * d - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * d), -1, 1)
	local sinA = math.sqrt(1 - cosA * cosA)
	local E = S + dir * (cosA * L1) + perp * (sinA * L1)
	local T = S + dir * d

	local upperRot = basis((S - E).Unit, T - E, FORWARD) * rotBetween(DOWN, v1.Unit):Inverse()
	local upperCF = CFrame.new(S - upperRot * s1.Position) * upperRot
	sh.Transform = sh.Transform:Lerp(s0:Inverse() * upperCF * s1, w)

	local elbow = upperCF * e0.Position
	local lowerUp = elbow - T
	lowerUp = lowerUp.Magnitude > 1e-4 and lowerUp.Unit or -DOWN
	local lowerRot = basis(lowerUp, lowerUp:Cross(upperCF.RightVector), upperCF.LookVector)
		* rotBetween(DOWN, v2.Unit):Inverse()
	local lowerCF = CFrame.new(elbow - lowerRot * e1.Position) * lowerRot
	el.Transform = el.Transform:Lerp(e0:Inverse() * upperCF:Inverse() * lowerCF * e1, w)
	wr.Transform = wr.Transform:Lerp(CFrame.identity, w)
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = p.Character
		if char then
			local center = p:GetAttribute("CarryCenter")
			local size = p:GetAttribute("CarrySize")
			local on = p:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") == true
				and typeof(center) == "Vector3" and typeof(size) == "Vector3"
			if on then lastTarget[char] = { center, size } end

			local w = math.clamp((blend[char] or 0) + (on and dt or -dt) * BLEND_SPEED, 0, 1)
			blend[char] = w > 0 and w or nil

			local target = lastTarget[char]
			if w > 0 and target then
				local rig = rigOf(char)
				if rig then
					local c, half = target[1], target[2] / 2
					local k = w * w * (3 - 2 * w)
					for _, arm in ipairs(rig.arms) do
						local grip = c + Vector3.new(
							arm.sign * (half.X * 0.94 + GRIP_GAP + arm.hand.Size.X / 2),
							-half.Y * GRIP_DOWN,
							half.Z * GRIP_BACK)
						solve(arm, grip, k)
					end
				end
			elseif not on then
				lastTarget[char] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

name: HoloGradient
source:
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local GRADIENT = "HoloGradient"

local function pair(c)
	local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
	if s < 0.15 then
		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(176, 204, 255)
	end
	if h > 0.45 and h < 0.75 then
		return Color3.fromHSV(0.53, 0.30, 1), Color3.fromHSV(0.61, 0.85, 0.95)
	end
	local top = Color3.fromHSV((h + 0.045) % 1, s * 0.8, math.min(1, v * 1.1 + 0.12))
	local bottom = Color3.fromHSV((h - 0.06) % 1, math.min(1, s * 1.1 + 0.08), v * 0.86)
	return top, bottom
end

local function paint(label, g)
	local base = label.TextColor3
	if base == WHITE and label:GetAttribute("HoloBase") then
		return
	end
	label:SetAttribute("HoloBase", base)
	local top, bottom = pair(base)
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom)
	label.TextColor3 = WHITE
end

local dressed = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function wanted(label)
	if label:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui") then return true end
	local sg = label:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
	if not sg then return false end
	return sg.Name == "SafeZoneSign"
		or label:FindFirstAncestor("Leaderboards") ~= nil
		or label:FindFirstAncestor("ZoneSign") ~= nil
end

local function dress(label)
	if dressed[label] or not label.Parent then return end
	if not wanted(label) then return end
	local g = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if g and g.Name ~= GRADIENT then return end
	if not g then
		g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		g.Name = GRADIENT
		g.Rotation = 90
		g.Parent = label
	end
	local was = label:GetAttribute("HoloBase")
	if typeof(was) == "Color3" and label.TextColor3 == WHITE then
		label.TextColor3 = was
	end
	dressed[label] = true
	paint(label, g)
	label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(function()
		if label.TextColor3 ~= WHITE then paint(label, g) end
	end)
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
		task.defer(dress, d)
	end
end)
for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then dress(d) end
end

local Content=game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local queued={}

local cursor=1
local function enqueue(id)
 if type(id)=="string" and id~="" and not queued[id] then
  queued[id]=true table.insert(queue,id)
 end
end
for _,cfg in ipairs(Config) do enqueue(cfg.Texture) end
for _,cfg in ipairs(Config) do enqueue(cfg.Icon) enqueue(cfg.Particle) end
local function inspect(instance)
 if instance:IsA("MeshPart") then enqueue(instance.MeshId) enqueue(instance.TextureID) end
end
local urgent={}
local function now(id)
 if type(id)~="string" or id=="" or urgent[id] then return end
 urgent[id]=true
 task.spawn(function() pcall(function() Content:PreloadAsync({id}) end) end)
end
local function skinOf(zone)
 local cfg=Config[tonumber(zone) or 0]
 if cfg then now(cfg.Texture) now(cfg.Icon) end
end
local me=Players.LocalPlayer
skinOf(me:GetAttribute("BatEquipped"))
me:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BatEquipped"):Connect(function() skinOf(me:GetAttribute("BatEquipped")) end)
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local kicking=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function kick(part)
 if kicking[part] then return end
 local id=part.TextureID
 if id=="" then return end
 kicking[part]=true
 task.spawn(function()
  pcall(function() Content:PreloadAsync({id}) end)
  if part.Parent and part.TextureID==id then
   part.TextureID=""
   RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
   if part.Parent and part.TextureID=="" then part.TextureID=id end
  end
  kicking[part]=nil
 end)
end
local function kickTool(tool)
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("MeshPart") then kick(v) end end
end
local WARM_TIME=6
local function warm(tool)
 local ch=me.Character
 local hand=ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or ch:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
 if not hand then return end
 local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local old=cam and cam:FindFirstChild("BatWarm") if old then old:Destroy() end
 if not cam then return end
 local holder=Instance.new("Folder") holder.Name="BatWarm"
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do
  if v:IsA("MeshPart") and v.TextureID~="" then
   local c=v:Clone()
   c:ClearAllChildren()
   c.Anchored=false c.CanCollide=false c.CanQuery=false c.CanTouch=false c.Massless=true c.CastShadow=false
   c.Transparency=.97
   c.CFrame=hand.CFrame
   local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint") w.Part0=hand w.Part1=c w.Parent=c
   c.Parent=holder
  end
 end
 holder.Parent=cam
 task.delay(WARM_TIME,function() if holder.Parent then holder:Destroy() end end)
 local con con=tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
  if tool.Parent==ch then con:Disconnect() if holder.Parent then holder:Destroy() end end
 end)
end
local watched=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function watchTool(tool)
 if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Name~="Stick" or watched[tool] then return end
 watched[tool]=true
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do inspect(v) end
 tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(inspect)
 skinOf(tool:GetAttribute("BatZone"))
 tool:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BatZone"):Connect(function()
  local cfg=Config[tool:GetAttribute("BatZone")]
  if cfg then enqueue(cfg.Texture) enqueue(cfg.Particle) end
  skinOf(tool:GetAttribute("BatZone"))
  kickTool(tool)
  if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:IsA("Backpack") and tool:IsDescendantOf(me) then warm(tool) end
 end)
 if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:IsA("Backpack") and tool:IsDescendantOf(me) then task.defer(warm,tool) end
 tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
  if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then kickTool(tool) end
 end)
 if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then kickTool(tool) end
end
local function watch(root)
 for _,v in root:GetChildren() do watchTool(v) end
 root.ChildAdded:Connect(watchTool)
end
local function bind(p)
 if p.Character then watch(p.Character) end
 p.CharacterAdded:Connect(watch)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do bind(p) end
task.spawn(function() watch(Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack")) end)
Players.LocalPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Backpack") then watch(c) end end)
for _=1,4 do
 task.spawn(function()
  while true do
   local id=queue[cursor]
   if id then
    cursor+=1
    pcall(function() Content:PreloadAsync({id}) end)
   else task.wait(.5) end
  end
 end)
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local currentGui, original, clip, swirl
local scanIn = 0

local function clear()
	if clip then clip:Destroy() end
	if original and original.Parent then original.Visible = true end
	currentGui, original, clip, swirl = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

local function bind(gui)
	clear()
	local source = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
	if not source then return end
	currentGui, original = gui, source
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	clip = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	clip.Name = "AnimatedPortal"
	clip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	clip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	clip.ClipsDescendants = true
	clip.Parent = gui
	local function layer(name, transparency)
		local image = source:Clone()
		image.Name = name
		image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
		image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5)
		image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.43, 1.43)
		image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		image.ImageTransparency = transparency
		image.Visible = true
		image.Parent = clip
		return image
	end
	swirl = layer("EnergySwirl", 0)
	original.Visible = false
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	scanIn -= dt
	if scanIn <= 0 then
		scanIn = .5
		local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
		local model = world and world:FindFirstChild("AdminTreadmill")
		local panel = model and model:FindFirstChild("PortalTexturePanel")
		local gui = panel and panel:FindFirstChild("PortalEnergy")
		if gui ~= currentGui then
			if gui then bind(gui) else clear() end
		end
	end
	if not currentGui or not currentGui:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera and (camera.CFrame.Position - currentGui.Parent.Position).Magnitude > 180 then return end
	local t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	swirl.Rotation = (t * 12) % 360
end)

source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("CaptureEggConfig"))
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("CaptureEgg")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(28, 16, 8)
local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 64)
local RINGS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
	Color3.fromRGB(206, 214, 226),
	Color3.fromRGB(214, 132, 70),
}
local YOU_RING = Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "CaptureEggHud"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 6
gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local root = Instance.new("Frame")
root.Name = "Root"
root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 4)
root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 176)
root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
root.Parent = gui

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = root

local function stroke(parent, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = thickness
	s.Color = INK
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function text(parent, name, props)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Name = name
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Font = FONT
	t.TextColor3 = props.colour or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	t.TextSize = props.size or 18
	t.Text = props.text or ""
	t.Size = props.box or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, props.size or 18)
	t.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
	t.AnchorPoint = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
	t.ZIndex = props.z or 2
	t.Parent = parent
	stroke(t, props.stroke or 2.5)
	return t
end

local title = text(root, "Title", { text = Cfg.Title, size = 40, colour = GOLD, stroke = 3.5, box = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42) })
local shine = Instance.new("UIGradient")
shine.Rotation = 90
shine.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 150), Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 30))
shine.Parent = title
local subtitle = text(root, "Subtitle", { text = Cfg.Subtitle, size = 18, position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40), box = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20) })

local row = Instance.new("Frame")
row.Name = "Top"
row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 68)
row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 104)
row.Parent = root
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 16)
layout.Parent = row

local headshots = {}
local function headshot(userId, image)
	if headshots[userId] then image.Image = headshots[userId] return end
	image.Image = ""
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, url = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
		end)
		if ok and url then
			headshots[userId] = url
			if image:GetAttribute("UserId") == userId then image.Image = url end
		end
	end)
end

local function makeSlot(order, ring, badge)
	local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
	slot.Name = "Slot" .. order
	slot.LayoutOrder = order
	slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	slot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 104)
	slot.Visible = false
	slot.Parent = row
	local circle = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	circle.Name = "Avatar"
	circle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	circle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 4)
	circle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 66)
	circle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(62, 48, 92)
	circle.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	circle.Parent = slot
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = circle
	local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	ringStroke.Thickness = 4
	ringStroke.Color = ring
	ringStroke.Parent = circle
	local tag = Instance.new("Frame")
	tag.Name = "Badge"
	tag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	tag.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, badge == "YOU!" and 0 or -26, 0, badge == "YOU!" and 68 or 10)
	tag.Size = badge == "YOU!" and UDim2.fromOffset(52, 22) or UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
	tag.BackgroundColor3 = ring
	tag.ZIndex = 3
	tag.Parent = slot
	local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")
	tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	tc.Parent = tag
	local ts = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	ts.Thickness = 2.5
	ts.Color = INK
	ts.Parent = tag
	text(tag, "Text", { text = badge, size = 17, box = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), z = 4, stroke = 2 })
	local time = text(slot, "Time", { text = "0s", size = 22, position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 78), box = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24) })
	return { frame = slot, image = circle, time = time }
end

local slots = {}
for i = 1, 3 do slots[i] = makeSlot(i, RINGS[i], tostring(i)) end
local youSlot = makeSlot(4, YOU_RING, "YOU!")

local function clock(secs)
	secs = math.floor(secs)
	if secs >= 60 then return ("%d:%02d"):format(secs // 60, secs % 60) end
	return secs .. "s"
end

local function fill(slot, entry)
	slot.frame.Visible = true
	if slot.image:GetAttribute("UserId") ~= entry.u then
		slot.image:SetAttribute("UserId", entry.u)
		headshot(entry.u, slot.image)
	end
	slot.time.Text = clock(entry.s)
end

local holderId = 0
local function render(data)
	local list = data.list or {}
	local mine
	for i, entry in ipairs(list) do
		if entry.u == player.UserId then mine = i end
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if list[i] then fill(slots[i], list[i]) else slots[i].frame.Visible = false end
	end
	if mine and mine <= 3 then
		youSlot.frame.Visible = false
	else
		fill(youSlot, mine and list[mine] or { u = player.UserId, s = 0 })
	end
	holderId = tonumber(data.holder) or 0

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local held = list[i] and list[i].u == holderId
		slots[i].time.TextColor3 = held and GOLD or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	youSlot.time.TextColor3 = (holderId == player.UserId and youSlot.frame.Visible) and GOLD or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

local resultsToken = 0
local showingResults = false
local function showResults(data)
	local winners = data.winners or {}
	title.Text = "EVENT OVER!"
	subtitle.Text = winners[1] and (string.upper(winners[1].n) .. " WON!") or "NOBODY HELD THE EGG"
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if winners[i] then fill(slots[i], winners[i]) else slots[i].frame.Visible = false end
		slots[i].time.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	youSlot.frame.Visible = false
	resultsToken += 1
	local mine = resultsToken
	showingResults = true
	gui.Enabled = true
	root.Visible = true
	local size = scale.Scale
	scale.Scale = size * 0.6
	TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = size }):Play()
	task.delay(8, function()
		if resultsToken ~= mine or not showingResults then return end
		showingResults = false
		root.Visible = false
		gui.Enabled = false
	end)
end

local function fit()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local size = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	local s = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 1100, size.Y / 640), 0.55, 1)
	scale.Scale = s
end
fit()
local function watchCamera()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
	fit()
end
workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(watchCamera)
watchCamera()

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if kind == "state" then
		if data.active then
			showingResults = false
			title.Text = Cfg.Title
			subtitle.Text = Cfg.Subtitle
			root.Visible = true
			gui.Enabled = true
			render(data)
		elseif not showingResults then
			root.Visible = false
			gui.Enabled = false
		end
	elseif kind == "results" then
		showResults(data)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local hud = player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("EggHud", 30)
	if not hud then return end
	local plates = {
		{ frame = hud:WaitForChild("BiomeBanner", 10), top = 0.07 },
		{ frame = hud:WaitForChild("RunBanner", 10), top = 0.05 },
	}
	local function dodge()
		local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y
		local y = 4
		for _, p in ipairs(plates) do
			if p.frame and p.frame.Visible then
				y = math.max(y, hud.AbsoluteSize.Y * p.top + p.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y + 12 - inset)
			end
		end
		TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, y) }):Play()
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(plates) do
		if p.frame then p.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(dodge) end
	end
	dodge()
end)

remote:FireServer("sync")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local UIKit = require(RS:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("UIKit"))
local Rebirth = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local Money = require(RS:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local K = UIKit.Palette
local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = remotes:WaitForChild("Rebirth")

local ICON = "rbxassetid://102581215383481"
local ARROW = "rbxassetid://71395997585045"
local SKIP = Money.REBIRTH_SKIP or { productId = 0, price = 0 }

local stats = plr:WaitForChild("stats")
local wallet = plr:WaitForChild("wallet")

local W, H = 560, 390
local PINK = { hi = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 220), base = Color3.fromRGB(240, 60, 190), sh = Color3.fromRGB(170, 20, 130) }

local short = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig")).fmtShort

local function multText(m)
	local text = ("%.2f"):format(math.floor(m * 100 + 0.5) / 100):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
	return "x" .. text .. " Speed"
end

local screen = UIKit.screen("RebirthPanel", plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"), 9)
screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true

local root, panel = UIKit.window({
	parent = screen, name = "Rebirth", title = "REBIRTH", icon = ICON, width = W, height = H,
})

local function plate(name, tone, size, position, text)
	local b = UIKit.block({
		parent = root, name = name, tone = tone, size = size, position = position,
		radius = 10, outline = 3, stud = 11, zindex = 14,
	})
	local label = UIKit.boldLabel({
		parent = b, name = "Label", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		text = text, textSize = 30, zindex = 18,
	})
	return b, label
end

local _, levelLabel = plate("Level", K.ready, UDim2.fromOffset(240, 52), UDim2.fromOffset((W - 240) / 2, 90), "Level 1")
local _, nowLabel = plate("Now", K.claimed, UDim2.fromOffset(200, 56), UDim2.fromOffset(50, 160), "x1 Speed")
local _, nextLabel = plate("Next", K.claimed, UDim2.fromOffset(200, 56), UDim2.fromOffset(W - 250, 160), "x1.1 Speed")

local arrow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
arrow.Name = "Arrow"
arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
arrow.Image = ARROW
arrow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
arrow.Rotation = -90
arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W / 2, 188)
arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)
arrow.ZIndex = 16
arrow.Parent = root

local track = Instance.new("Frame")
track.Name = "Progress"
track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 41, 47)
track.BorderSizePixel = 0
track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 240)
track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 80, 42)
track.ZIndex = 15
track.ClipsDescendants = true
track.Parent = root
do
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
	s.Thickness = 3
	s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	s.Parent = track
end
local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
fill.Name = "Fill"
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
fill.ZIndex = 16
fill.Parent = track
do
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 70), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 20))
	g.Parent = fill
	local studs = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	studs.Name = "Studs"
	studs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	studs.Image = UIKit.ICON.studs
	studs.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
	studs.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
	studs.ImageTransparency = 0.45
	studs.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	studs.ZIndex = 17
	studs.Parent = fill
end
local progressLabel = UIKit.boldLabel({
	parent = track, name = "Text", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	text = "$0 / $0", textSize = 26, zindex = 19,
})

local note = UIKit.boldLabel({
	parent = root, name = "Note", size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 10),
	text = "", textSize = 24, colour = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), zindex = 20,
})
note.Visible = false
local noteToken = 0
local function say(text)
	noteToken += 1
	local mine = noteToken
	note.Text = text
	note.Visible = true
	task.delay(2.2, function()
		if noteToken == mine then
			note.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

local rebirthBtn, setRebirthEnabled = UIKit.button({
	parent = root, name = "RebirthButton", tone = K.ready, text = "Rebirth", textSize = 30,
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 62), position = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 305), zindex = 14,
	onClick = function()
		remote:FireServer("rebirth")
	end,
})
UIKit.button({
	parent = root, name = "SkipButton", tone = PINK, text = "Skip Rebirth", textSize = 30,
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 62), position = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 270, 305), zindex = 14,
	onClick = function()
		local id = tonumber(SKIP.productId) or 0
		local done = (stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths") and stats.Rebirths.Value) or 0
		if Rebirth.maxed(done) then
			say("Max rebirth reached!")
		elseif id > 0 then
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(plr, id)
		elseif RunService:IsStudio() and Money.STUDIO_TEST then
			remote:FireServer("skipTest")
		else
			say("Skip Rebirth - not available right now")
		end
	end,
})

local function refresh()
	local rebirths = (stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths") and stats.Rebirths.Value) or 0
	local coins = (wallet:FindFirstChild("Coins") and wallet.Coins.Value) or 0
	local cost = Rebirth.cost(rebirths)
	local maxed = Rebirth.maxed(rebirths)
	levelLabel.Text = "Level " .. (rebirths + 1)
	nowLabel.Text = multText(Rebirth.mult(rebirths))
	nextLabel.Text = maxed and "MAX" or multText(Rebirth.mult(rebirths + 1))
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(maxed and 1 or math.clamp(coins / math.max(cost, 1), 0, 1), 1)
	progressLabel.Text = maxed and "MAX" or ("$%s / $%s"):format(short(coins), short(cost))
	setRebirthEnabled(not maxed and coins >= cost)
end

local function watch(folder, name)
	local v = folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 30)
	if v then
		v.Changed:Connect(refresh)
	end
end
task.spawn(watch, stats, "Rebirths")
task.spawn(watch, wallet, "Coins")
refresh()

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, value)
	if kind == "fail" then
		say(tostring(value or "Not enough cash!"))
	elseif kind == "done" then
		refresh()
	end
end)

local bus = remotes:WaitForChild("OpenPanel")
bus.Event:Connect(function(id)
	if id == "Rebirth" then
		refresh()
		panel.open()
	elseif panel.isOpen() then
		panel.close()
	end
end)
