function UIKit.repaint(face, tone)
	face.BackgroundColor3 = tone.hi
	local grad = face:FindFirstChild("Gradient")
	if grad then
		local function share(c)
			return Color3.new(
				tone.hi.R > 0 and math.clamp(c.R / tone.hi.R, 0, 1) or 0,
				tone.hi.G > 0 and math.clamp(c.G / tone.hi.G, 0, 1) or 0,
				tone.hi.B > 0 and math.clamp(c.B / tone.hi.B, 0, 1) or 0)
		end
		local height = face:GetAttribute("BlockHeight") or math.max(face.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
		local breakAt = math.clamp(28 / height, 0.12, 0.50)
		grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, WHITE),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(breakAt, share(tone.base)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, share(tone.sh)),
		})
	end
	local bevel = face:FindFirstChild("Bevel")
	if bevel then bevel.BackgroundColor3 = tint(tone.hi, 0.30) end
end

function UIKit.block(props)
	local tone = props.tone or K.row
	local height = props.size.Y.Offset
	local radius = props.radius or math.max(6, math.floor(height * 0.26))
	local anchor = props.anchor or Vector2.new()
	local z = props.zindex or 1

	local shadow
	if props.shadow ~= false then
		shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
		shadow.Name = (props.name or "Block") .. "_Shadow"
		shadow.BackgroundColor3 = K.outline
		shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
		shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
		shadow.AnchorPoint = anchor
		shadow.Size = props.size
		shadow.Position = (props.position or UDim2.new()) + UDim2.fromOffset(0, props.shadowY or 5)
		shadow.ZIndex = z
		shadow.Active = false
		shadow.Parent = props.parent
		corner(shadow, radius)
	end

	local face = Instance.new(props.clickable and "TextButton" or "Frame")
	face.Name = props.name or "Block"
	face.AnchorPoint = anchor
	face.Size = props.size
	face.Position = props.position or UDim2.new()
	face.BorderSizePixel = 0
	face.ZIndex = z + 1
	if face:IsA("TextButton") then
		face.Text = ""
		face.AutoButtonColor = false
	end
	face.Parent = props.parent
	corner(face, radius)

	local edgeStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	edgeStroke.Thickness = props.outline or 4
	edgeStroke.Color = props.edge or K.outline

	edgeStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	edgeStroke.Parent = face

	if shadow then
		face:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			shadow.Visible = face.Visible
		end)
	end

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Name = "Gradient"
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = face
	face:SetAttribute("BlockHeight", height)
	UIKit.repaint(face, tone)

	if props.finish ~= false then
		local tile = props.stud or STUD_TILE
		local studs = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		studs.Name = "Studs"
		studs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		studs.Image = UIKit.ICON.studs
		studs.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
		studs.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(tile, tile)

		studs.ImageTransparency = props.studAlpha or 0.55
		studs.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		studs.ZIndex = face.ZIndex
		studs.Active = false
		studs.Parent = face

		corner(studs, radius)
	end

	if props.bevel ~= false then
		local bevelH = math.max(3, math.floor(height * 0.08))
		local bevel = Instance.new("Frame")
		bevel.Name = "Bevel"
		bevel.BackgroundColor3 = tint(tone.hi, 0.30)
		bevel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
		bevel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		bevel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -math.floor(radius * 1.6), 0, bevelH)
		bevel.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(radius * 0.8), 0, math.max(2, math.floor(height * 0.045)))
		bevel.ZIndex = face.ZIndex
		bevel.Active = false
		bevel.Parent = face
		corner(bevel, math.floor(bevelH / 2))
		local bg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		bg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.82, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		bg.Parent = bevel
	end

	local underH = math.min(26, math.max(4, math.floor(height * 0.16)))
	local underside = Instance.new("Frame")
	underside.Name = "Underside"
	underside.BackgroundColor3 = K.outline
	underside.BorderSizePixel = 0
	underside.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, underH)
	underside.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -underH)
	underside.ZIndex = face.ZIndex
	underside.Active = false
	underside.Parent = face
	local ug = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	ug.Rotation = 90
	ug.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.82),
	})
	ug.Parent = underside

	if props.inner then
		local inset = Instance.new("Frame")
		inset.Name = "Inner"
		inset.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		inset.BorderSizePixel = 0
		inset.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(props.inner, props.inner)
		inset.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2 * props.inner, 1, -2 * props.inner)
		inset.ZIndex = face.ZIndex
		inset.Active = false
		inset.Parent = face
		corner(inset, math.max(2, radius - props.inner))
		UIKit.stroke(inset, K.innerOutline, 2, 0.35)
	end

	return face
end

local GROW_ACTIVE, GROW_IDLE = 0.06, 0.025

function UIKit.reactToCursor(face)
	local baseSize, basePos = face.Size, face.Position
	local shadow = face.Parent and face.Parent:FindFirstChild(face.Name .. "_Shadow")
	local shadowPos = shadow and shadow.Position
	local tweens = {}
	local function animate(k)
		for _, t in ipairs(tweens) do t:Cancel() end
		tweens = {}
		local cap = face:GetAttribute("HoverMaxGrow")
		if cap then
			local width = baseSize.X.Offset > 0 and baseSize.X.Scale == 0 and baseSize.X.Offset or face.AbsoluteSize.X
			if width > 0 then
				local limit = cap / width
				k = 1 + math.clamp(k - 1, -limit, limit)
			end
		end
		local dw = math.floor(baseSize.X.Offset * (k - 1) + 0.5)
		local dh = math.floor(baseSize.Y.Offset * (k - 1) + 0.5)
		local dws, dhs = baseSize.X.Scale * (k - 1), baseSize.Y.Scale * (k - 1)
		local size = UDim2.new(baseSize.X.Scale + dws, baseSize.X.Offset + dw,
			baseSize.Y.Scale + dhs, baseSize.Y.Offset + dh)
		local shiftBy = UDim2.new(-dws / 2, -math.floor(dw / 2), -dhs / 2, -math.floor(dh / 2))
		local moved = face:GetAttribute("MovedBy") or UDim2.new()
		table.insert(tweens, TweenService:Create(face, UIKit.Tween.fast,
			{ Size = size, Position = basePos + moved + shiftBy }))
		if shadow then
			table.insert(tweens, TweenService:Create(shadow, UIKit.Tween.fast,
				{ Size = size, Position = shadowPos + moved + shiftBy }))
		end
		for _, t in ipairs(tweens) do t:Play() end
	end
	local function force()
		return face:GetAttribute("Active") ~= false and GROW_ACTIVE or GROW_IDLE
	end
	face.MouseEnter:Connect(function() animate(1 + force()) end)
	face.MouseLeave:Connect(function() animate(1) end)
	face.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		if face:GetAttribute("Active") ~= false then animate(1 - GROW_ACTIVE * 0.6) end
	end)
	face.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() animate(game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and 1 or (1 + force())) end)
end

function UIKit.cross(owner, side, colour)
	local LENGTH = math.floor(side * 0.50)
	local THICKNESS = math.max(4, math.floor(side * 0.13))
	local STROKE = math.max(2, math.floor(side * 0.05))
	local function beam(angle, long, thick, beamColour, z)
		local b = Instance.new("Frame")
		b.Name = "Beam"
		b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(long / side, thick / side)
		b.Rotation = angle
		b.BackgroundColor3 = beamColour
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.ZIndex = z
		b.Active = false
		b.Parent = owner
		corner(b, 999)
	end
	for _, angle in ipairs({ 45, -45 }) do
		beam(angle, LENGTH + 2 * STROKE, THICKNESS + 2 * STROKE, K.outline, owner.ZIndex + 2)
	end
	for _, angle in ipairs({ 45, -45 }) do
		beam(angle, LENGTH, THICKNESS, colour or WHITE, owner.ZIndex + 3)
	end
end

local FALLBACK_TOP = 44
local HUD_GAP = 12
local BOTTOM_MARGIN = 76
local SIDE_MARGIN = 16
local SHADOW_FADE = 5

local function playerGui()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	return player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

local function visibleBar(guiName, barName)
	local pg = playerGui()
	local sg = pg and pg:FindFirstChild(guiName)
	local bar = sg and sg:FindFirstChild(barName)
	if bar and bar:IsA("GuiObject") and bar.Visible and sg.Enabled then
		return bar
	end
	return nil
end

local function topReserve()
	local bar = visibleBar("GameTopbar", "Topbar")
	if bar then
		return bar.AbsolutePosition.Y + bar.AbsoluteSize.Y
	end
	return FALLBACK_TOP
end

local function bottomReserve(screen)
	return math.min(BOTTOM_MARGIN, screen * 0.1)
end

function UIKit.fitWindow(root, scale, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local function recompute()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return scale.Scale end
		local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y
		local screen = cam.ViewportSize.Y - inset
		local headroom = root:GetAttribute("FitHeadRoom") or 0
		local height = math.max(root.Size.Y.Offset, 1) + headroom
		local small = math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) < 500
		local top = opts.topReserve or (small and 4 or (topReserve() + HUD_GAP))
		local bottom = opts.bottomReserve or (small and 4 or bottomReserve(screen))

		local width = math.max(root.Size.X.Offset, 1)
		local byHeight = (screen - top - bottom) / height
		local byWidth = (cam.ViewportSize.X - SIDE_MARGIN * 2) / width

		local target = root:GetAttribute("FitTargetHeight")
		local s = math.min(byHeight, byWidth, target and target / height or 1)
		s = math.max(s, small and 0.3 or 0.43)
		scale.Scale = s

		local half = height * s / 2
		local highest, lowest = top + half, screen - bottom - half

		local centre = (lowest < highest) and (screen / 2)
			or math.clamp(screen / 2, highest, lowest)

		local sg = root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
		local shift = (sg and sg.IgnoreGuiInset) and inset or 0
		root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.floor(centre + shift + headroom * s / 2))

		local shadow = root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChild(root.Name .. "_Shadow")
		if shadow then
			shadow.AnchorPoint = root.AnchorPoint
			shadow.Position = root.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, SHADOW_FADE)
			local sc = shadow:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
			if not sc then
				sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
				sc.Parent = shadow
			end
			sc.Scale = s
		end
		return s
	end
	recompute()

	local function track(cam)
		if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(recompute) end
	end
	track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
	workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		track(workspace.CurrentCamera)
		recompute()
	end)

	return recompute
end

	})

	if props.icon then
		local iconH = BAR_H - 14
		UIKit.iconWithShadow({
			parent = bar, name = "Icon", image = props.icon,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconH, iconH),
			position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, math.floor((BAR_H - iconH) / 2)),
			zindex = z + 6,
		})
	end

	UIKit.boldLabel({
		parent = bar, name = "Title", size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		text = props.title, textSize = math.floor(BAR_H * 0.68),
		truncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		strokeColour = Color3.fromRGB(43, 23, 64), strokeW = 4, zindex = z + 8,
	})

	local closeSide = BAR_H - 24
	local close = UIKit.block({
		parent = bar, name = "Close", tone = K.close, clickable = true,
		radius = 11, outline = 2, stud = 9, studAlpha = 0.70, shadowY = 4,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(closeSide, closeSide),
		position = UDim2.new(1, -(closeSide + 14), 0.5, 0), anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		zindex = z + 8,
	})
	UIKit.cross(close, closeSide)
	UIKit.tintOnHover(close, K.close)

	local panel = {}
	local holdsBlur = false
	function panel.isOpen() return root.Visible end
	function panel.open()
		root.Visible = true
		if not holdsBlur then
			holdsBlur = true
			UIKit.blurHold(true)
		end
		UIKit.popOpen(scale, fit())
	end
	function panel.close()
		root.Visible = false
		if holdsBlur then
			holdsBlur = false
			UIKit.blurHold(false)
		end
	end
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(panel.close)

	return root, panel, bodyW, BAR_H + 12
end
return UIKit

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Sfx = {}

local LIBRARY = {
	click = { id = "rbxasset://sounds/clickfast.wav", volume = 0.35 },
	open = { id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch3.wav", volume = 0.4 },
	close = { id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav", volume = 0.35 },
}

local function build(name, parent)
	local entry = LIBRARY[name]
	if not entry then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "Sfx_" .. name
	sound.SoundId = entry.id
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = entry.pitch or 1
	sound.Looped = entry.looped == true

	sound.Volume = entry.volume or 0.5
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

local uiFolder = nil
local pool = {}

local function uiHome()
	if uiFolder and uiFolder.Parent then
		return uiFolder
	end
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not gui then
		return nil
	end
	uiFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	uiFolder.Name = "Sfx"
	uiFolder.Parent = gui
	return uiFolder
end

function Sfx.play(name)
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		return
	end
	local home = uiHome()
	if not home then
		return
	end
	local sound = pool[name]
	if not sound or not sound.Parent then
		sound = build(name, home)
		pool[name] = sound
	end
	if sound then
		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound:Play()
	end
end

return Sfx

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local Q = {}
local BATCH = 16

local pending = {}
local queued = {}
local running = false

local function add(id)
    if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or queued[id] then return end
    if id:match("^rbxasset://") then return end
    queued[id] = true
    pending[#pending + 1] = id
end

local function addInstance(inst)
    if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
        add(inst.MeshId)
        add(inst.TextureID)
    elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
        add(inst.MeshId)
        add(inst.TextureId)
    elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
        add(inst.Texture)
    elseif inst:IsA("ImageLabel") or inst:IsA("ImageButton") then
        add(inst.Image)
    end
end

local function addTree(inst)
    addInstance(inst)
    for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do addInstance(d) end
end

local function worker()
    running = true
    while #pending > 0 do
        local batch = table.create(BATCH)
        for _ = 1, math.min(BATCH, #pending) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = table.remove(pending, 1)
        end
        pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, batch)
    end
    running = false
end

function Q.want(what)
    if typeof(what) == "Instance" then
        addTree(what)
    elseif type(what) == "table" then
        for _, v in ipairs(what) do
            if typeof(v) == "Instance" then addTree(v) else add(v) end
        end
    end
    if #pending > 0 and not running then
        task.spawn(worker)
    end
end

function Q.busy()
    return running or #pending > 0
end

return Q

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local S = {}

local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
local BODY = Color3.fromRGB(58, 62, 69)
local BODY_RIM = Color3.fromRGB(96, 101, 110)
local CARD = Color3.fromRGB(38, 41, 47)
local CARD_EDGE = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 30)
local SKY = { Color3.fromRGB(70, 175, 255), Color3.fromRGB(30, 110, 225) }
local STUDS = "rbxassetid://138926013267839"
local HEAD = 78
local FAST = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

S.WindowAlpha = 0.5
S.CardAlpha = 0.55
S.TargetHeight = 560

local GREEN = { Color3.fromRGB(70, 230, 40), Color3.fromRGB(215, 255, 50) }
local BLUE = { Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 255), Color3.fromRGB(80, 225, 255) }
local HEADS = {
	Shop = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 40) },
	Index = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 230) },
	SellShop = GREEN,
	Rebirth = GREEN,
	FreeRewards = GREEN,
	GiftWindow = GREEN,
	TrailShop = BLUE,
	Settings = BLUE,
	Confirm = BLUE,
	FuseMachine = { Color3.fromRGB(20, 120, 240), Color3.fromRGB(70, 235, 255) },
	Admin = { Color3.fromRGB(230, 40, 40), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 50) },
	ActivePets = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 20), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60) },
	GrowingEggs = { Color3.fromRGB(235, 45, 45), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 90) },
}
local KEEP_SIZE = { GiftWindow = true, Confirm = true, ActivePets = true, GrowingEggs = true, Rebirth = true }
local SIDE = { ActivePets = true, GrowingEggs = true }
local SEE_THROUGH = { SellShop = 0.5 }
local DECOR = { Studs = true, Bevel = true, Underside = true, SkinRim = true, Header = true }

local function keyOf(panel)
	if panel.Name == "Frame" and panel.Parent then
		return panel.Parent.Name
	end
	return panel.Name
end

local function mul(a, b)
	return Color3.new(a.R * b.R, a.G * b.G, a.B * b.B)
end

local function titleCase(s)
	return (s:lower():gsub("(%a)([%w']*)", function(first, rest)
		return first:upper() .. rest
	end))
end

local function edge(o, thickness, colour, transparency)
	local s = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = thickness
	s.Color = colour or INK
	s.Transparency = transparency or 0
	s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Enabled = true
	s.Parent = o
	return s
end

local function corner(o, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = o
	return c
end

local function hideShadow(o)
	local parent = o.Parent
	if not parent then
		return
	end
	for _, c in parent:GetChildren() do
		if c.Name == o.Name .. "_Shadow" and c:IsA("Frame") then
			c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
	end
end

local function square(o)
	for _, c in o:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("UICorner") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, n in { "Bevel", "Underside", "InnerRing" } do
		local x = o:FindFirstChild(n)
		if x then
			x.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local inner = o:FindFirstChild("Inner")
	if inner and inner:IsA("Frame") and inner.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 and inner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") then
		inner.Visible = false
	end
	local studs = o:FindFirstChild("Studs")
	local sc = studs and studs:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if sc then
		sc:Destroy()
	end
	hideShadow(o)
end

local function studs(o, alpha, tile, z)
	local st = o:FindFirstChild("Studs")
	if not (st and st:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
		st = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		st.Name = "Studs"
		st.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		st.Active = false
		st.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		st.Parent = o
	end
	st.Image = STUDS
	st.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
	st.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(tile, tile)
	st.ImageTransparency = alpha
	st.Visible = true
	st.ZIndex = z or o.ZIndex
	return st
end

local RIM_BARS = {
	{ UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) },
	{ UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2) },
	{ UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -4), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) },
	{ UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -4), UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 2) },
}
local function setRim(r, colour, transparency)
	for _, bar in r:GetChildren() do
		if bar:IsA("Frame") then
			bar.BackgroundColor3 = colour
			if transparency then
				bar.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
			end
		end
	end
end

local function innerRim(o, colour, transparency, z)
	local r = o:FindFirstChild("SkinRim")
	if not r then
		r = Instance.new("Frame")
		r.Name = "SkinRim"
		r.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		r.Active = false
		r.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		r.Parent = o
		for i, look in RIM_BARS do
			local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
			bar.Name = "Bar" .. i
			bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
			bar.Active = false
			bar.Size = look[1]
			bar.Position = look[2]
			bar.Parent = r
		end
	end
	r.ZIndex = z or o.ZIndex
	for _, bar in r:GetChildren() do
		if bar:IsA("Frame") then
			bar.ZIndex = r.ZIndex
		end
	end
	setRim(r, colour, transparency or 0)
	return r
end

local function raise(o, d)
	if d <= 0 then
		return
	end
	o.ZIndex += d
	for _, x in o:GetDescendants() do
		if x:IsA("GuiObject") then
			x.ZIndex += d
		end
	end
end

local function heightOf(o)
	local h = o:GetAttribute("BlockHeight")
	if not h or h <= 0 then
		h = (o.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and o.Size.Y.Offset > 0) and o.Size.Y.Offset or o.AbsoluteSize.Y
	end
	return math.max(h, 1)
end

function S.button(b)
	if b:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned") then
		return
	end
	b:SetAttribute("WindowSkinned", true)
	b:SetAttribute("HoverMaxGrow", 0)
	local h = math.max(heightOf(b), 20)
	local radius = math.clamp(math.floor(h * 0.22), 6, 10)
	square(b)
	local old = b:FindFirstChild("Studs")
	if old then
		old.Visible = false
	end
	local ink = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if ink then
		ink.Enabled = false
	end
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local z = b.ZIndex
	local function layer(parent, name, inset, colour, r, zi)
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.Name = name
		f.Active = false
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.BackgroundColor3 = colour
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2)
		f.ZIndex = zi
		f.Parent = parent
		corner(f, math.max(2, r))
		return f
	end
	for _, c in b:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.ZIndex <= z + 5 then
			raise(c, z + 6 - c.ZIndex)
		end
	end
	local border = layer(b, "BtnBorder", 0, INK, radius, z + 1)
	local rim = layer(border, "BtnRim", 2, BLACK, radius - 2, z + 2)
	local fill = layer(rim, "BtnFill", 2, WHITE, radius - 4, z + 3)
	local fg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	fg.Rotation = 90
	fg.Parent = fill
	local st = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	st.Name = "BtnStuds"
	st.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	st.Active = false
	st.Image = STUDS
	st.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
	local tile = math.clamp(math.floor(h * 0.15), 4, 12)
	st.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(tile, tile)
	st.ImageTransparency = 0.3
	st.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	st.ZIndex = z + 4
	st.Parent = fill
	corner(st, math.max(2, radius - 4))
	local glow = layer(fill, "BtnHover", 0, WHITE, radius - 4, z + 5)
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	corner(b, radius)
	local function shade()
		local bg = b.BackgroundColor3
		local top, base = bg, bg
		local g = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		if g then
			local k = g.Color.Keypoints
			top = mul(bg, k[1].Value)
			base = mul(bg, k[math.min(2, #k)].Value)
		end
		fg.Color = ColorSequence.new(top, base)
		rim.BackgroundColor3 = base:Lerp(BLACK, 0.45)
	end
	shade()
	b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(shade)
	local g = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if g then
		g:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"):Connect(shade)
	end
	local function light(on)
		local lit = on and b:GetAttribute("Active") ~= false
		TweenService:Create(glow, FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = lit and 0.8 or 1 }):Play()
	end
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		light(true)
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		light(false)
	end)
	for _, t in b:GetDescendants() do
		if t:IsA("TextLabel") then
			local s = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if s then
				s.Color = INK
			end
		end
	end
	local label = b:FindFirstChild("Label")
	local sym = label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and (label.Text == "+" or label.Text == "-") and label.Text
	if sym then
		label.TextTransparency = 1
		local ls = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if ls then
			ls.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	local signs = {}
	for _, c in b:GetChildren() do
		if c.Name == "Sign" and c:IsA("Frame") then
			table.insert(signs, c)
		end
	end
	if not sym and #signs > 0 then
		sym = #signs >= 4 and "+" or "-"
		for _, c in signs do
			c.Visible = false
		end
	end
	if sym then
		local inset = math.max(3, math.floor(h * 0.1))
		local box = Instance.new("Frame")
		box.Name = "Symbol"
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.Active = false
		box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		box.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		box.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.6)
		box.ZIndex = z + 6
		box.Parent = b
		Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint").Parent = box
		for i, look in { { INK, 0 }, { WHITE, inset } } do
			for _, angle in (sym == "+" and { 0, 90 } or { 0 }) do
				local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
				bar.Name = i == 1 and "BarOutline" or "Bar"
				bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				bar.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -look[2], 0.36, -look[2])
				bar.Rotation = angle
				bar.BackgroundColor3 = look[1]
				bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
				bar.Active = false
				bar.ZIndex = z + 6 + i
				bar.Parent = box
				corner(bar, 3)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function shownColours(o, g)
	local bg = o.BackgroundColor3
	if not g then
		return { bg }
	end
	local k = g.Color.Keypoints
	if k[1].Value == WHITE and bg ~= WHITE then
		return { bg, mul(bg, k[math.min(2, #k)].Value) }
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, p in k do
		table.insert(out, mul(bg, p.Value))
	end
	return out
end

local function vivid(colours)
	for _, c in colours do
		local _, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		if s > 0.3 and v > 0.25 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function sequence(colours)
	if #colours == 1 then
		return ColorSequence.new(colours[1])
	end
	local points = {}
	for i, c in colours do
		table.insert(points, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((i - 1) / (#colours - 1), c))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(points)
end

local function colourCard(o, g, side, alpha)
	g.Enabled = true
	local rim = innerRim(o, BLACK, 0)
	local function paint()
		local uikit = g.Color.Keypoints[1].Value == WHITE and o.BackgroundColor3 ~= WHITE
		local colours = shownColours(o, g)
		if uikit then
			local _, _, v = colours[2]:ToHSV()
			if v < 0.62 then
				colours = { SKY[1], SKY[2] }
			else
				colours = { colours[2], colours[2]:Lerp(BLACK, 0.4) }
			end
		end
		o.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		g.Color = sequence(colours)
		local dark = colours[#colours]:Lerp(BLACK, 0.45)
		setRim(rim, dark)
		for _, d in o:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("Frame") and d.Parent ~= rim and d.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and d.Size.Y.Offset > 0
				and d.Size.Y.Offset <= 6 and d.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and not d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiButton") then
				d.BackgroundColor3 = dark
				d.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				for _, c in d:GetChildren() do
					if c:IsA("UICorner") or c:IsA("UIGradient") then
						c:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	paint()
	o.BackgroundTransparency = alpha or 0.1
	edge(o, 3, INK)
	studs(o, 0.6, math.clamp(math.floor(side * 0.12), 6, 14))
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(function()
		if o.BackgroundColor3 ~= WHITE then
			paint()
		end
	end)
end

local function whiteText(o)
	for _, t in o:GetDescendants() do
		if t:IsA("TextLabel") then
			local c = t.TextColor3
			if 0.299 * c.R + 0.587 * c.G + 0.114 * c.B < 0.3 then
				t.TextColor3 = WHITE
				t.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
				local s = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
				s.Color = INK
				s.Thickness = math.max(s.Thickness, 2)
				s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
				s.Parent = t
			end
		end
	end
end

function S.card(o, key)
	if o:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned") then
		return
	end
	o:SetAttribute("WindowSkinned", true)
	local normal = o.BackgroundColor3
	square(o)
	local size = o.AbsoluteSize
	local side = (size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0) and math.min(size.X, size.Y) or heightOf(o)
	local g = o:FindFirstChild("Gradient") or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if g and vivid(shownColours(o, g)) then
		colourCard(o, g, side, key and SEE_THROUGH[key])
		whiteText(o)
		return
	end
	if g then
		g.Enabled = false
	end
	o.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
	o.BackgroundTransparency = S.CardAlpha
	local line = edge(o, 2, CARD_EDGE)
	studs(o, 0.62, math.clamp(math.floor(side * 0.15), 6, 16))
	whiteText(o)
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(function()
		local c = o.BackgroundColor3
		if c == CARD then
			return
		end
		local marked = c ~= normal
		line.Color = marked and c or CARD_EDGE
		line.Thickness = marked and 3 or 2
		o.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
	end)
end

function S.close(close)
	if close:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned") then
		return
	end
	close:SetAttribute("WindowSkinned", true)
	close:SetAttribute("HoverMaxGrow", 0)
	square(close)
	close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	if close:IsA("TextButton") then
		close.TextTransparency = 1
	end
	local ink = close:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if ink then
		ink.Enabled = false
	end
	for _, c in close:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
			c.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local z = close.ZIndex
	local side = HEAD - 16
	local face = Instance.new("Frame")
	face.Name = "SkinFace"
	face.Active = false
	face.BorderSizePixel = 0
	face.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	face.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	face.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	face.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(side, side)
	face.ZIndex = z + 1
	face.Parent = close
	edge(face, 3, INK)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(245, 60, 50), Color3.fromRGB(190, 20, 20))
	g.Parent = face
	studs(face, 0.4, 9, z + 2)
	innerRim(face, Color3.fromRGB(120, 10, 10), 0.1, z + 2)
	local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
	glow.Name = "SkinGlow"
	glow.Active = false
	glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	glow.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	glow.ZIndex = z + 3
	glow.Parent = face
	local x = Instance.new("Frame")
	x.Name = "SkinX"
	x.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	x.Active = false
	x.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	x.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	x.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.62)
	x.ZIndex = z + 4
	x.Parent = face
	Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint").Parent = x
	for i, look in { { INK, 0 }, { WHITE, 6 } } do
		for _, angle in { 45, -45 } do
			local arm = Instance.new("Frame")
			arm.Name = i == 1 and "ArmOutline" or "Arm"
			arm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			arm.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			arm.Size = UDim2.new(1.2, -look[2], 0.3, -look[2])
			arm.Rotation = angle
			arm.BackgroundColor3 = look[1]
			arm.BorderSizePixel = 0
			arm.Active = false
			arm.ZIndex = z + 4 + i
			arm.Parent = x
			corner(arm, 999)
		end
	end
	close.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(glow, FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 }):Play()
	end)
	close.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(glow, FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

local function insideSkinned(o, stop)
	local a = o.Parent
	while a and a ~= stop do
		if a:IsA("GuiButton") and a:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned") then
			return true
		end
		a = a.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function inHeader(o, stop)
	local a = o
	while a and a ~= stop do
		if a.Name == "Header" then
			return true
		end
		a = a.Parent
	end
	return false
end

function S.content(panel)
	local root = panel
	if panel.Name == "Frame" and panel.Parent and panel.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
		root = panel.Parent
	end
	for _, o in root:GetDescendants() do
		if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o:GetAttribute("BlockHeight") and not o:GetAttribute("WindowSkinned")
			and not o:FindFirstChild("Header") and not inHeader(o, root) and not insideSkinned(o, root) then
			local c = o.BackgroundColor3
			local light = 0.299 * c.R + 0.587 * c.G + 0.114 * c.B > 0.85
			local label = o:FindFirstChild("Label") or o:FindFirstChild("Text")
			local buttonLike = o:GetAttribute("SkinButtonLook")
				or (label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Size == UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) and heightOf(o) < 100)
			if o:IsA("GuiButton") or buttonLike then
				S.button(o)
			elseif heightOf(o) >= 50 or (light and heightOf(o) >= 30) then
				S.card(o, keyOf(panel))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function movable(c, head)
	if not c:IsA("GuiObject") or c == head or DECOR[c.Name] or c.Position.Y.Scale ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	return not (c.Size.Y.Scale >= 1 and c.Position.Y.Offset <= 0)
end

local function shiftUp(c, delta)
	if c:GetAttribute("SkinShifted") then
		return
	end
	c:SetAttribute("SkinShifted", true)
	c.Position -= UDim2.fromOffset(0, delta)
	c:SetAttribute("MovedBy", UDim2.fromOffset(0, -delta))
	if c.Size.Y.Scale ~= 0 then
		c.Size += UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.floor(c.Size.Y.Scale * delta + 0.5))
	end
end

local function straddle(panel, head)
	local list = {}
	local top = math.huge
	for _, c in panel:GetChildren() do
		if movable(c, head) then
			table.insert(list, c)
			local h = c.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and c.Size.Y.Offset or 0
			top = math.min(top, c.Position.Y.Offset - c.AnchorPoint.Y * h)
		end
	end
	local delta = top - (HEAD / 2 + 14)
	if top == math.huge or delta <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	for _, c in list do
		shiftUp(c, delta)
	end
	panel.Size -= UDim2.fromOffset(0, delta)
	panel.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		task.defer(function()
			if c.Parent == panel and movable(c, head) then
				shiftUp(c, delta)
			end
		end)
	end)
	return delta
end

function S.window(panel)
	local head = panel:FindFirstChild("Header")
	if not head or panel:GetAttribute("SkinWindow") then
		return
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinWindow", true)
	local key = keyOf(panel)
	local pal = HEADS[key] or BLUE

	square(panel)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = false
	local pg = panel:FindFirstChild("Gradient") or panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if pg then
		pg.Enabled = false
	end
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = BODY
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = S.WindowAlpha
	edge(panel, 4, INK)
	studs(panel, 0.82, 24)
	innerRim(panel, BODY_RIM, 0.3)

	square(head)
	head.ClipsDescendants = false
	for _, c in head:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
			c.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local hg = head:FindFirstChild("Gradient") or head:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
	local headColours = ColorSequence.new(pal[1], pal[2])
	hg.Enabled = true
	hg.Rotation = 0
	hg.Color = headColours
	hg.Parent = head
	head.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	head.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	head:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(function()
		if head.BackgroundColor3 ~= WHITE then
			head.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		end
	end)
	hg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"):Connect(function()
		if hg.Color ~= headColours then
			hg.Color = headColours
		end
	end)
	hg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Rotation"):Connect(function()
		if hg.Rotation ~= 0 then
			hg.Rotation = 0
		end
	end)
	edge(head, 4, INK)
	studs(head, 0.72, 20)
	innerRim(head, pal[1]:Lerp(BLACK, 0.4), 0)
	local oldHead = head.Size.Y.Offset
	head.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
	head.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-10, -HEAD / 2)
	head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 20, 0, HEAD)

	local titleX = 24
	local icon = head:FindFirstChild("Icon")
	for _, c in head:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("ImageLabel") and c.Name ~= "Studs" then
			if c.Name:match("Shadow$") then
				c.Visible = false
			elseif not (icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
				icon = c
			end
		end
	end
	if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, -8, 0.5, -4)
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(HEAD + 34, HEAD + 34)
		titleX = HEAD + 32
	end
	local extra = 0
	for _, c in head:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("GuiButton") and c.Name ~= "Close" and c:GetAttribute("BlockHeight") then
			extra = math.max(extra, c.Size.X.Offset + 14)
			S.button(c)
		end
	end
	local title = head:FindFirstChild("Title")
	if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
		local function fix()
			local t = titleCase(title.Text)
			if title.Text ~= t then
				title.Text = t
			end
		end
		fix()
		title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(fix)
		local right = (head:FindFirstChild("Close") and HEAD or 16) + extra + 8
		title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, titleX, 0.5, 0)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(titleX + right), 0.8, 0)
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextScaled = true
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
		local lim = title:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") or Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		lim.MinTextSize = 14
		lim.MaxTextSize = 64
		lim.Parent = title
		local ts = title:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if ts then
			ts.Thickness = 2.5
			ts.Color = INK
		end
		local ghost = head:FindFirstChild("Title_Shadow")
		if ghost then
			ghost.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local close = head:FindFirstChild("Close")
	if close then
		S.close(close)
		local face = close:FindFirstChild("SkinFace")
		local p, s, a = close.Position, close.Size, close.AnchorPoint
		if face and p.X.Scale == 1 and s.X.Scale == 0 and s.Y.Scale == 0 then
			local side = face.Size.X.Offset
			local cx = p.X.Offset + (0.5 - a.X) * s.X.Offset
			local cy = p.Y.Scale * HEAD + p.Y.Offset + (0.5 - a.Y) * s.Y.Offset
			face.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.floor(-(12 + side / 2) - cx), 0.5, math.floor(HEAD / 2 - cy))
		end
	end

	local sg = panel:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
	local global = sg and sg.ZIndexBehavior == Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
	local topZ = 0
	for _, c in (global and panel:GetDescendants() or panel:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= head and not c:IsDescendantOf(head) then
			topZ = math.max(topZ, c.ZIndex)
		end
	end
	raise(head, topZ + 1 - head.ZIndex)

	local delta = straddle(panel, head)
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinShift", delta)
	if SIDE[key] then
		panel.Position -= UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0)
		local shell = panel.Parent
		if shell and shell:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local groups = {}
			local function frameFor(name, dy)
				if not groups[name] then
					local f = Instance.new("Frame")
					f.Name = name
					f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					f.Active = false
					f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-14, dy)
					f.ZIndex = panel.ZIndex + 1
					f.Parent = shell
					groups[name] = f
				end
				return groups[name]
			end
			local h = shell.Size.Y.Offset
			local below, belowTop = {}, math.huge
			for _, c in shell:GetChildren() do
				if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= panel and c.Name ~= panel.Name .. "_Shadow" then
					local y = c.Position.Y
					if y.Scale == 0.5 then
						c.Parent = frameFor("SkinSideMiddle", -math.floor((HEAD / 2 + delta) / 2))
					elseif y.Scale == 1 or (y.Scale == 0 and y.Offset > h / 2) then
						table.insert(below, c)
						if not c.Name:match("_Shadow$") then
							local sh = c.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and c.Size.Y.Offset or 0
							belowTop = math.min(belowTop, y.Scale * h + y.Offset - c.AnchorPoint.Y * sh)
						end
					else
						c.Parent = frameFor("SkinSideTop", 0)
					end
				end
			end
			if #below > 0 and belowTop < math.huge then
				local bottom = panel.Position.Y.Scale * h + panel.Position.Y.Offset
					+ (1 - panel.AnchorPoint.Y) * panel.Size.Y.Offset
				local f = frameFor("SkinSideBelow", math.floor(bottom + 10 - belowTop))
				for _, c in below do
					c.Parent = f
				end
			end
		end
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinOldHead", oldHead)
	S.content(panel)
end

local function available()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		return S.TargetHeight, 1000
	end
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	local small = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) < 500
	local room = vp.Y - (small and 16 or (GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y + 110))
	return math.min(S.TargetHeight, room), vp.X - 24
end

function S.normalize(panel)
	if KEEP_SIZE[keyOf(panel)] or panel:GetAttribute("SkinNormalized") then
		return
	end
	local holder = panel
	local sc
	while holder and holder:IsA("GuiObject") do
		sc = holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if sc then
			break
		end
		holder = holder.Parent
	end
	if not sc then
		return
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinNormalized", true)
	local function wanted()
		local h, w = available()
		local visualH = panel.Size.Y.Offset + HEAD / 2
		local visualW = panel.Size.X.Offset + 20
		return math.min(h / math.max(visualH, 1), w / math.max(visualW, 1))
	end
	if holder ~= panel then
		local own = Instance.new("UIScale")
		own.Name = "SkinScale"
		own.Parent = panel
		local shift = panel:GetAttribute("SkinShift") or 0
		if panel.Position.X.Scale == 0 and panel.Position.Y.Scale == 0 and panel.AnchorPoint == Vector2.zero then
			local size = panel.Size
			panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, size.X.Offset / 2, 0, (size.Y.Offset + shift + HEAD / 2) / 2)
		end
		local steady = sc.Scale
		local shelf
		local function place()
			if shelf then
				local w = panel.Size.X.Offset
				local extra = panel.Position.X.Offset + (w / 2 + 10) * own.Scale - holder.Size.X.Offset
				shelf.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(0, math.ceil(extra)), 0)
			end
		end
		local function apply()
			own.Scale = wanted() / math.max(steady, 0.05)
			place()
		end
		local function consider(c)
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c ~= panel and c ~= shelf and c.Position.X.Scale == 1
				and c.Size.X.Scale == 0 and c.Size.X.Offset > 0 then
				if not shelf then
					shelf = Instance.new("Frame")
					shelf.Name = "SkinOutside"
					shelf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					shelf.Active = false
					shelf.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					shelf.ZIndex = panel.ZIndex + 2
					shelf.Parent = holder
				end
				c.Parent = shelf
				place()
			end
		end
		for _, c in holder:GetChildren() do
			consider(c)
		end
		holder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
			task.defer(consider, c)
		end)
		local stamp = 0
		sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
			stamp += 1
			local mine = stamp
			task.delay(0.4, function()
				if mine == stamp then
					steady = sc.Scale
					apply()
				end
			end)
		end)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(apply)
		end
		apply()
	else
		panel:SetAttribute("FitHeadRoom", HEAD / 2)
		panel:SetAttribute("FitTargetHeight", S.TargetHeight * (panel:GetAttribute("SkinSizeFactor") or 1))
	end
end

function S.watch(panel)
	if panel:GetAttribute("SkinWatched") then
		return
	end
	panel:SetAttribute("SkinWatched", true)
	task.wait(0.1)
	S.window(panel)
	local queued = false
	local function queue()
		if queued then
			return
		end
		queued = true
		task.defer(function()
			queued = false
			S.content(panel)
		end)
	end
	local root = (panel.Name == "Frame" and panel.Parent and panel.Parent:IsA("GuiObject")) and panel.Parent or panel
	root.DescendantAdded:Connect(queue)
	local o = panel
	while o and o:IsA("GuiObject") do
		o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(queue)
		o = o.Parent
	end
	S.normalize(panel)
end

return S

local C = {}

local function rgb(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if RunService:IsServer() or not RunService:IsRunning() then
    local loader = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("ZoneLoader")
    if loader then require(loader).extend(C.ZONE_LIST) end
else
    local reg = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ZoneRegistry", 15)
    while not reg do
        warn("[EggConfig] still waiting for the world list from the server")
        reg = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ZoneRegistry", 15)
    end
    if reg then
        local extra = reg:GetChildren()
        table.sort(extra, function(a, b) return (a:GetAttribute("Index") or 0) < (b:GetAttribute("Index") or 0) end)
        for _, z in ipairs(extra) do
            table.insert(C.ZONE_LIST, {
                name = z:GetAttribute("Name"), emoji = z:GetAttribute("Emoji"),
                color = z:GetAttribute("Color"), power = z:GetAttribute("Power"),
            })
        end
    end
end

C.ZONES  = #C.ZONE_LIST
C.SAFE_Z = -107
C.X_MIN, C.X_MAX = 1416, 1584
C.LANE_L, C.LANE_R = 1452, 1548

C.Z0, C.BASE, C.STEP = -108, 180, 48
function C.len(n) return C.BASE + (n - 1) * C.STEP end
function C.bounds(n)
    local zTop = C.Z0
    for i = 1, n - 1 do zTop = zTop - C.len(i) end
    return zTop, zTop - C.len(n)
end
function C.zoneAt(z)
    if z > C.SAFE_Z then return 0 end
    for n = 1, C.ZONES do
        local a, b = C.bounds(n)
        if z <= a and z >= b then return n end
    end
    return nil
end

function C.bossSpot(n)
    local zTop, zBot = C.bounds(n)
    local z = zTop + (zBot - zTop) * 0.75
    local side = (n % 2 == 1) and -1 or 1
    return Vector3.new(1500 + side * 64, 0, z)
end

C.STUDS = "rbxassetid://138926013267839"

local function shortPower(v)
    if v < 1 then return "" end
    local units = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
    local i = 1
    while v >= 1000 and i < #units do v = v / 1000; i += 1 end
    return string.format("%g", math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10) .. units[i]
end

C.NAMES, C.COLORS, C.EMOJI, C.POWER, C.POWER_N = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
for n, z in ipairs(C.ZONE_LIST) do
    local prev, prev2 = C.POWER_N[n - 1], C.POWER_N[n - 2]
    local power = tonumber(z.power)
        or (prev and prev2 and prev2 > 0 and prev * math.clamp(prev / prev2, 4, 40))
        or (prev and prev * 10) or 1
    C.NAMES[n] = z.name or ("Zone " .. n)

    C.POWER[n] = shortPower(power)
end

C.RESPAWN_DELAY     = 8

C.FOREIGN_BOSS_CHASES = false

C.TIER_COLORS = {

    { rgb(232,226,206), rgb(168,200,138), rgb(111,191, 90), rgb(245,210, 74) },

    { rgb(224,207,194), rgb(224,138, 74), rgb(224, 69, 31), rgb(255,194, 58) },

    { rgb(222,213,184), rgb(168,160, 90), rgb(122,138, 58), rgb(240,178, 58) },
    { rgb(220,212,238), rgb(168,142,224), rgb(122, 90,216), rgb(232,192,255) },
    { rgb(245,228,234), rgb(240,184,206), rgb(232,132,174), rgb(255,208,232) },
    { rgb(230,217,184), rgb(200,178,122), rgb(201,162, 39), rgb(255,224,138) },
    { rgb(220,205,224), rgb(168,104,192), rgb(122, 46,150), rgb(155,255, 74) },
}

function C.eggColor(zone, tier)
    local row = C.TIER_COLORS[zone]
    local c = row and row[tier]
    if c then return c end
    return (C.TIERS[tier] or C.TIERS[1]).color
end

C.GLOW = {
    { shell = false, deco = false, light = 0.0, range =  0 },
    { shell = false, deco = true,  light = 0.0, range =  0 },
    { shell = true,  deco = true,  light = 1.4, range = 11 },
    { shell = true,  deco = true,  light = 3.2, range = 19 },
}

C.TIERS = {
    { name = "Common", weight = 60,    color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 232, 214), value = 1.0,
      glow = false, drops = {70, 22,  7,  1} },
    { name = "Uncommon", weight = 28,  color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 214, 158), value = 2.2,
      glow = false, drops = {35, 40, 20,  5} },
    { name = "Rare", weight = 10,      color = Color3.fromRGB(126, 178, 246), value = 5.0,
      glow = true,  drops = {10, 30, 45, 15} },
    { name = "Legendary", weight = 2, color = Color3.fromRGB(248, 196,  92), value = 12.0,
      glow = true,  drops = { 2, 13, 45, 40} },
}

C.EGG_BASE_H = 3.5
C.SIZES = {
    { name = "Tiny",   weight = 30.0, scale = 0.35, income =  0.5, carry = 1.00 },
    { name = "Small",  weight = 34.0, scale = 0.60, income =  0.8, carry = 0.96 },
    { name = "Normal", weight = 24.0, scale = 1.00, income =  1.0, carry = 0.90 },
    { name = "Large",  weight =  9.0, scale = 1.70, income =  2.0, carry = 0.82 },
    { name = "Huge",   weight =  2.5, scale = 3.00, income =  5.0, carry = 0.72 },
    { name = "Giant",  weight =  0.5, scale = 6.00, income = 12.0, carry = 0.60 },
}

function C.nestScaleFor(eggScale)
    return 1 + (eggScale - 1) * 0.45
end

C.ZONE_BASE   = {1, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 16384, 65536, 262144, 1048576, 4194304}

C.SPEED_START = 1
C.COINS_START = 0
C.WALK_MAX    = 100e12
C.SPEED_MAX   = math.max(C.WALK_MAX, (C.POWER_N[C.ZONES] or 0) * 20)

C.SIZE_REQ = {1.0, 1.3, 2.0, 3.5, 7.0, 15.0}

function C.requiredSpeed(zone, sizeIdx)
    return (C.POWER_N[zone] or 1) * (C.SIZE_REQ[sizeIdx] or 1)
end

local WALK_BASE = 16
local WALK_RANGE = 174
local WALK_CURVE = 1.6
C.WALK_BASE, C.WALK_RANGE, C.WALK_CURVE = WALK_BASE, WALK_RANGE, WALK_CURVE

function C.walkForSpeed(speed)
    speed = math.clamp(speed, 0, C.SPEED_MAX)
    local t = math.min(1, math.log10(1 + speed) / math.log10(1 + C.WALK_MAX))
    return C.WALK_BASE + C.WALK_RANGE * t ^ C.WALK_CURVE
end

C.BOSS_MULT_MIN = 0.70
C.BOSS_MULT_MAX = 4.50
function C.bossMultFor(playerSpeed, zone, sizeIdx)
    local req = C.requiredSpeed(zone, sizeIdx)
    local ratio = req / math.max(playerSpeed, 0.01)
    return math.clamp(0.97 * ratio ^ 0.55, C.BOSS_MULT_MIN, C.BOSS_MULT_MAX)
end

function C.bossSpeedFor(playerSpeed, zone, sizeIdx)
    local walk  = C.walkForSpeed(playerSpeed)
    local carry = C.SIZES[sizeIdx] and C.SIZES[sizeIdx].carry or 1
    return walk * C.bossMultFor(playerSpeed, zone, sizeIdx) * carry
end

function C.hitFor(playerSpeed, zone, sizeIdx)
    local ratio = C.requiredSpeed(zone, sizeIdx) / math.max(playerSpeed, 0.01)
    local f = math.clamp(ratio ^ 0.30, 1.0, 3.0)
    return {
        back = C.BOSS.knockback * math.min(f, 2.0),
        up   = C.BOSS.knockUp   * math.min(f, 1.35),
        stun = C.BOSS.stunTime  * f,
        f    = f,
    }
end

local UNITS = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc" }

function C.fmtShort(v)
    v = tonumber(v) or 0
    if v < 0 then return "-" .. C.fmtShort(-v) end
    if v < 1000 then
        if v == math.floor(v) then return string.format("%d", v) end
        return (string.format("%.1f", math.floor(v * 10) / 10):gsub("%.0$", ""))
    end
    local big = v >= 1e5
    local step = 1
    while v >= 1000 and step < #UNITS do
        v = v / 1000
        step += 1
    end
    local d = big and 100 or 10
    local text = string.format(big and "%.2f" or "%.1f", math.floor(v * d) / d)
    text = text:gsub("%.?0+$", "")
    return text .. UNITS[step]
end

function C.fmtMoney(v)
    return "$" .. C.fmtShort(v)
end

function C.fmtSpeed(v)
    v = tonumber(v) or 0
    if v >= 1000 then return C.fmtShort(v) end
    if v >= 10 then return string.format("%d", math.floor(v)) end
    return string.format("%.2f", math.floor(v * 100) / 100)
end

C.BOSS = {

    baseHeight   = 8,

    maxWidth     = 36,
    growth       = 1.15,
    speed        = {44, 44, 45, 45, 46, 46, 47, 47, 48, 48, 49, 50},
    catchRadius  = 9,
    knockback    = 90,
    knockUp      = 45,
    stunTime     = 1.6,
    hoverY       = 4,
    returnSpeed  = 70,
    fetchSpeed   = 82,
    carryBackSpd = 80,
    idleBob      = 1.2,
    grabRadius   = 7,

    closeRange   = 60,
    closeSpeed   = 2.60,
}

C.GEAR = {
    stickRange = 13, stickArc = 0.35, stickCd = 1.2,
    stickBack = 85, stickUp = 42, stickStun = 1.4,
    trapCd = 2, trapAhead = 6.5, trapOwnerGrace = 2.5, trapArm = 1.0,
    trapLife = 120, trapStun = 6, trapRadius = 4.5,
    maxTraps = 3,
}

C.PET_PAYOUT_EVERY = 1.0

C.INDEX = {
    MONEY_SECONDS = 120, MONEY_SIZE = 3, MONEY_TIER = 2,
    SPEED_NEXT_ZONE_SHARE = 0.5, SPEED_LAST_ZONE_MULT = 2,
    SLOT_DIVISOR = 4,
}

function C.pickWeighted(list, rng)
    local total = 0
    for _, e in ipairs(list) do total = total + (e.weight or 1) end
    local r = (rng and rng:NextNumber() or math.random()) * total
    for i, e in ipairs(list) do
        r = r - (e.weight or 1)
        if r <= 0 then return e, i end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

function C.eggValue(zone, tierIndex, sizeIndex)
    return (C.ZONE_BASE[zone] or 1) * C.TIERS[tierIndex].value * C.SIZES[sizeIndex].income
end

C.HATCH_BASE = 20
C.HATCH_SIZE = { 1, 1.6, 2.6, 5, 9, 18 }
C.HATCH_TIER = { 1, 1.6, 3.2, 10 }
C.HATCH_ZONE = 1.2328

function C.hatchTime(zone, size, tier)
    zone = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(zone) or 1), 1, math.max(C.ZONES, 1))
    size = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(size) or 1), 1, #C.HATCH_SIZE)
    tier = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(tier) or 1), 1, #C.HATCH_TIER)
    local t = C.HATCH_BASE
        * C.HATCH_SIZE[size]
        * C.HATCH_TIER[tier]
        * C.HATCH_ZONE ^ (zone - 1)
    return math.floor(t + 0.5)
end

function C.fmtTime(seconds)
    seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds + 0.5))
    if seconds < 60 then return seconds .. "s" end
    if seconds < 3600 then
        return ("%dm %02ds"):format(seconds // 60, seconds % 60)
    end
    return ("%dh %02dm"):format(seconds // 3600, (seconds % 3600) // 60)
end

C.ANIMAL_SCALE = { 0.75, 1.05, 1.5, 3.0, 7.0, 15.0 }

C.ANIMAL_PEN_FILL = 0.80

C.ANIMAL_INCOME_BASE = 1
C.ANIMAL_INCOME_SIZE = { 1, 2, 5, 15, 60, 300 }
C.ANIMAL_INCOME_TIER = { 1, 4, 25, 200 }
C.ANIMAL_INCOME_ZONE = 4.2570

function C.animalIncome(zone, size, tier)
    zone = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(zone) or 1), 1, math.max(C.ZONES, 1))
    size = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(size) or 1), 1, #C.ANIMAL_INCOME_SIZE)
    tier = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(tier) or 1), 1, #C.ANIMAL_INCOME_TIER)
    return C.ANIMAL_INCOME_BASE
        * C.ANIMAL_INCOME_SIZE[size]
        * C.ANIMAL_INCOME_TIER[tier]
        * C.ANIMAL_INCOME_ZONE ^ (zone - 1)
end

function C.petIncome(zone, size, tier, luck)
    return C.animalIncome(zone, size, tier) * (1 + (tonumber(luck) or 0) / 100)
end

function C.rollTier(rng, luck)
    luck = math.max(1, tonumber(luck) or 1)
    if luck <= 1 then
        local _, index = C.pickWeighted(C.TIERS, rng)
        return index
    end
    local boosted = {}
    for i, t in ipairs(C.TIERS) do
        boosted[i] = { weight = (t.weight or 1) * luck ^ ((i - 1) / math.max(#C.TIERS - 1, 1)) }
    end
    local _, index = C.pickWeighted(boosted, rng)
    return index
end
for n = #C.ZONE_BASE + 1, C.ZONES do C.ZONE_BASE[n] = C.ZONE_BASE[n - 1] * 4 end
for n = #C.TIER_COLORS + 1, C.ZONES do
    local c = C.COLORS[n]
    local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    C.TIER_COLORS[n] = { white:Lerp(c, 0.18), white:Lerp(c, 0.55), c, rgb(255, 214, 90) }
end
for n = #C.BOSS.speed + 1, C.ZONES do C.BOSS.speed[n] = C.BOSS.speed[n - 1] end

if RunService:IsServer() and RunService:IsRunning() then
    local loader = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("ZoneLoader")
    if loader then require(loader).build(C) end
end

return C
