local Rig = {}

local WING = { wing = true, membrane = true, patagium = true, primary = true, secondary = true,
               covert = true, pinion = true, remige = true }
local TAIL = { tail = true, rattle = true, stinger = true }
local TAIL_END = { fluke = true }
local HEAD = { head = true, skull = true, muzzle = true, nose = true, nostril = true, bill = true, beak = true,
               snout = true, brow = true, cheek = true, chin = true, ear = true, jaw = true, mandible = true,
               mouth = true, lip = true, tongue = true, tooth = true, teeth = true, fang = true, whisker = true,
               glint = true, pupil = true, iris = true, sclera = true, eyeball = true, eyelid = true, lid = true,
               face = true, antenna = true, clypeus = true }
local HEAD_NEAR = { neck = true, nape = true, mane = true, crest = true, crown = true, tuft = true,
                    socket = true, forelock = true, stalk = true, comb = true, wattle = true, horn = true,
                    antler = true, tine = true, tusk = true, casque = true, mask = true, beard = true,
                    trunk = true, frill = true, lure = true, lantern = true }
local LEG = { leg = true, thigh = true, shin = true, knee = true, femur = true, tibia = true, tarsus = true,
              coxa = true, shank = true, haunch = true, hock = true, ankle = true, foreleg = true,
              hindleg = true, flipper = true }
local LEG_END = { foot = true, toe = true, claw = true, paw = true, talon = true, hoof = true, heel = true,
                  sole = true, spur = true, pad = true, sock = true, forefoot = true, hindfoot = true,
                  toeclaw = true }
local ARM = { arm = true, forearm = true, upperarm = true, hand = true, finger = true, wrist = true,
              elbow = true, fist = true, pincer = true, humerus = true, spar = true, knuckle = true,
              palm = true }

local SIDE_L = { l = true, left = true, fl = true, bl = true }
local SIDE_R = { r = true, right = true, fr = true, br = true }
local END_F  = { front = true, fore = true, f = true, fl = true, fr = true }
local END_B  = { rear = true, hind = true, b = true, bl = true, br = true }

local SAMPLES = {
    leg  = { CFrame.Angles(0.55, 0, 0), CFrame.Angles(-0.55, 0, 0) },
    wing = { CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.9), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.9) },
    tail = { CFrame.Angles(0, 0.28, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, -0.28, 0) },
    head = { CFrame.Angles(0.10, 0.35, 0), CFrame.Angles(0.10, -0.35, 0),
             CFrame.Angles(-0.10, 0.35, 0), CFrame.Angles(-0.10, -0.35, 0) },
}
local AMP_STEPS = { 1, 0.7, 0.5, 0.35, 0.25, 0.15, 0.08, 0 }

local PROBE = {}
for x = -1, 1 do
    for y = -1, 1 do
        for z = -1, 1 do
            PROBE[#PROBE + 1] = Vector3.new(x, y, z) * 0.5
        end
    end
end

local cache = {}

local function tokens(name)
    local spaced = name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("(%u)(%u%l)", "%1 %2")
    local t = {}
    for w in spaced:lower():gmatch("%a+") do t[w] = true end
    return t
end

local function any(tok, set)
    for word in pairs(tok) do
        if set[word] then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function startsWith(tok, prefix)
    for word in pairs(tok) do
        if word:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function classify(name)
    local tok = tokens(name)
    if any(tok, WING) or startsWith(tok, "wing") then return "wing" end
    if any(tok, TAIL) or startsWith(tok, "tail") then return "tail" end
    if any(tok, HEAD) or startsWith(tok, "eye") then return "head" end
    if tok.tentacle then return "body" end
    if any(tok, LEG) then return "leg" end
    if any(tok, ARM) then return "arm" end
    if any(tok, LEG_END) then return "legEnd" end
    if any(tok, HEAD_NEAR) then return "headNear" end
    if any(tok, TAIL_END) then return "tailEnd" end
    if (any(tok, SIDE_L) or any(tok, SIDE_R)) and (any(tok, END_F) or any(tok, END_B)) then return "leg" end
    return "body"
end

local function extents(cf, sz)
    return Vector3.new(
        math.abs(cf.RightVector.X) * sz.X / 2 + math.abs(cf.UpVector.X) * sz.Y / 2 + math.abs(cf.LookVector.X) * sz.Z / 2,
        math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * sz.X / 2 + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * sz.Y / 2 + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * sz.Z / 2,
        math.abs(cf.RightVector.Z) * sz.X / 2 + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Z) * sz.Y / 2 + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Z) * sz.Z / 2)
end

local function pointGap(cf, sz, p)
    local l = cf:PointToObjectSpace(p)
    return Vector3.new(
        math.max(math.abs(l.X) - sz.X / 2, 0),
        math.max(math.abs(l.Y) - sz.Y / 2, 0),
        math.max(math.abs(l.Z) - sz.Z / 2, 0)).Magnitude
end

local function boxGap(cfA, szA, cfB, szB)
    local best = math.huge
    for _, v in ipairs(PROBE) do
        local d = pointGap(cfB, szB, cfA * (v * szA))
        if d < best then
            best = d
            if best <= 0 then return 0 end
        end
        d = pointGap(cfA, szA, cfB * (v * szB))
        if d < best then
            best = d
            if best <= 0 then return 0 end
        end
    end
    return best
end
Rig.boxGap = boxGap

local function about(hinge, rot)
    return CFrame.new(hinge) * rot * CFrame.new(-hinge)
end

local function limbTransform(limb, phase, t, w)
    if not limb or limb.amp <= 0 then return nil end
    local amp = limb.amp
    local rot
    if limb.kind == "leg" then
        if w <= 0 then return nil end
        rot = CFrame.Angles(math.sin(phase + limb.phase) * 0.55 * amp * w, 0, 0)
    elseif limb.kind == "wing" then
        local a = math.sin(t * 24) * 0.9 * w + math.sin(t * 2) * 0.12 * (1 - w)
        rot = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a * amp * limb.dir)
    elseif limb.kind == "tail" then
        local a = math.sin(t * 5 + limb.phase) * w + math.sin(t * 2.2 + limb.phase) * (1 - w)
        rot = CFrame.Angles(0, a * 0.28 * amp, 0)
    else
        local look = math.sin(t * 0.55) * 0.35 * (1 - w)
        local nod = math.sin(phase + 0.8) * (0.04 + 0.06 * w)
        rot = CFrame.Angles(nod * amp, look * amp, 0)
    end
    return about(limb.hinge, rot)
end

local function identity(e, len)
    local p = e.offset.Position / len
    return ("%s|%d|%d|%d"):format(e.part.Name, math.floor(p.X * 200 + 0.5),
        math.floor(p.Y * 200 + 0.5), math.floor(p.Z * 200 + 0.5))
end

local function solve(rig)
    local parts = rig.parts
    local n = #parts
    local len = math.max(rig.length, 1e-3)
    local reach = math.max(len * 0.015, 0.01)
    local far = len * 0.06
    local tol = rig.width * 0.04

    local kind0, kind, lo, hi, vol = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    for i, e in ipairs(parts) do
        kind0[i] = classify(e.part.Name)
        kind[i] = "body"
        local h = extents(e.offset, e.part.Size)
        lo[i], hi[i] = e.offset.Position - h, e.offset.Position + h
        vol[i] = e.part.Size.X * e.part.Size.Y * e.part.Size.Z
    end

    local function near(i, j, r)
        return lo[i].X <= hi[j].X + r and lo[j].X <= hi[i].X + r
           and lo[i].Y <= hi[j].Y + r and lo[j].Y <= hi[i].Y + r
           and lo[i].Z <= hi[j].Z + r and lo[j].Z <= hi[i].Z + r
    end
    local function gapOf(i, j)
        return boxGap(parts[i].offset, parts[i].part.Size, parts[j].offset, parts[j].part.Size)
    end

    local adj = {}
    for i = 1, n do adj[i] = {} end
    for i = 1, n do
        for j = i + 1, n do
            if near(i, j, reach) and gapOf(i, j) <= reach then
                adj[i][#adj[i] + 1] = j
                adj[j][#adj[j] + 1] = i
            end
        end
    end

    local function components(filter)
        local seen, out = {}, {}
        for i = 1, n do
            if not seen[i] and filter(i) then
                local list, stack = {}, { i }
                seen[i] = true
                while #stack > 0 do
                    local k = table.remove(stack)
                    list[#list + 1] = k
                    for _, j in ipairs(adj[k]) do
                        if not seen[j] and filter(j) then
                            seen[j] = true
                            stack[#stack + 1] = j
                        end
                    end
                end
                out[#out + 1] = list
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    local function centroidOf(list)
        local s = Vector3.zero
        for _, i in ipairs(list) do s += parts[i].offset.Position end
        return s / #list
    end

    local headParts = components(function(i) return kind0[i] == "head" end)
    local main, mainVol = nil, -1
    for _, c in ipairs(headParts) do
        local v = 0
        for _, i in ipairs(c) do v += vol[i] end
        if v > mainVol then main, mainVol = c, v end
    end
    if main then
        local mc = centroidOf(main)
        for _, c in ipairs(headParts) do
            if c == main or (centroidOf(c) - mc).Magnitude <= len * 0.3 then
                for _, i in ipairs(c) do kind[i] = "head" end
            end
        end
        local stack = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            if kind[i] == "head" then stack[#stack + 1] = i end
        end
        while #stack > 0 do
            local k = table.remove(stack)
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[k]) do
                if kind[j] == "body" and (kind0[j] == "headNear" or kind0[j] == "head")
                   and (parts[j].offset.Position - mc).Magnitude <= len * 0.35 then
                    kind[j] = "head"
                    stack[#stack + 1] = j
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, n do
        if kind[i] == "body" and kind0[i] == "wing" then kind[i] = "wing" end
    end
    do
        local stack = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            if kind[i] == "wing" then stack[#stack + 1] = i end
        end
        while #stack > 0 do
            local k = table.remove(stack)
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[k]) do
                if kind[j] == "body" and kind0[j] == "arm" then
                    kind[j] = "wing"
                    stack[#stack + 1] = j
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(components(function(i)
        return kind[i] == "body" and (kind0[i] == "leg" or kind0[i] == "legEnd")
    end)) do
        local core = false
        local inC = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(c) do inC[i] = true end
        for _, i in ipairs(c) do
            if kind0[i] == "leg" then core = true break end
        end
        if not core then
            for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                    if not inC[j] and kind[j] == "body" and kind0[j] ~= "arm" and kind0[j] ~= "legEnd" then
                        core = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if core then break end
            end
        end
        if core then
            for _, i in ipairs(c) do kind[i] = "leg" end
        end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(components(function(i)
        return kind[i] == "body" and (kind0[i] == "tail" or kind0[i] == "tailEnd")
    end)) do
        local core = false
        for _, i in ipairs(c) do
            if kind0[i] == "tail" then core = true break end
        end
        if core then
            for _, i in ipairs(c) do kind[i] = "tail" end
        end
    end

    local limbs = {}
    do
        local headList = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            if kind[i] == "head" then headList[#headList + 1] = i end
        end
        if #headList > 0 then limbs[#limbs + 1] = { kind = "head", members = headList } end
    end

    for _, k in ipairs({ "wing", "leg", "tail" }) do
        for _, c in ipairs(components(function(i) return kind[i] == k end)) do
            if k == "tail" then
                limbs[#limbs + 1] = { kind = k, members = c }
            else
                local side, pos, neg = {}, false, false
                for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                    local x = parts[i].offset.Position.X
                    side[i] = (x > tol and 1) or (x < -tol and -1) or 0
                    if side[i] > 0 then pos = true elseif side[i] < 0 then neg = true end
                end
                if pos and neg then
                    for _ = 1, 4 do
                        for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                            if side[i] == 0 then
                                local votes = 0
                                for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                                    if kind[j] == k and side[j] then votes += side[j] end
                                end
                                if votes ~= 0 then side[i] = votes > 0 and 1 or -1 end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local inside = {}
                    for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                        if side[i] == 0 then kind[i] = "body" else inside[i] = true end
                    end
                    for _, s in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
                        for _, sub in ipairs(components(function(i)
                            return inside[i] and kind[i] == k and side[i] == s
                        end)) do
                            limbs[#limbs + 1] = { kind = k, members = sub }
                        end
                    end
                else
                    limbs[#limbs + 1] = { kind = k, members = c }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local limbOf = {}
    local function index()
        table.clear(limbOf)
        for li, l in ipairs(limbs) do
            for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do limbOf[i] = li end
        end
    end
    index()

    for li = #limbs, 1, -1 do
        local l = limbs[li]
        local inL = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do inL[i] = true end
        local touches = false
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                if not inL[j] then
                    touches = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if touches then break end
        end
        if not touches then
            local target, bestGap = nil, far
            for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
                for j = 1, n do
                    if not inL[j] and near(i, j, far) then
                        local g = gapOf(i, j)
                        if g < bestGap then bestGap, target = g, j end
                    end
                end
            end
            local into = target and limbOf[target]
            if into and into ~= li then
                for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
                    table.insert(limbs[into].members, i)
                    kind[i] = limbs[into].kind
                end
                table.remove(limbs, li)
                index()
            end
        end
    end

    local bodyComps = components(function(i) return not limbOf[i] end)
    local core, coreVol = nil, -1
    for _, c in ipairs(bodyComps) do
        local v = 0
        for _, i in ipairs(c) do v += vol[i] end
        if v > coreVol then core, coreVol = c, v end
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(bodyComps) do
        if c ~= core then
            local count = {}
            for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                    local li = limbOf[j]
                    if li then count[li] = (count[li] or 0) + 1 end
                end
            end
            local best, bestN = nil, 0
            for li, cnt in pairs(count) do
                if cnt > bestN then best, bestN = li, cnt end
            end
            if not best then
                local inC = {}
                for _, i in ipairs(c) do inC[i] = true end
                local bestGap = far
                for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                    for j = 1, n do
                        if not inC[j] and near(i, j, far) then
                            local g = gapOf(i, j)
                            if g < bestGap then
                                bestGap = g
                                best = limbOf[j]
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if best then
                for _, i in ipairs(c) do
                    table.insert(limbs[best].members, i)
                    kind[i] = limbs[best].kind
                end
                index()
            end
        end
    end

    local function splitAlongZ(l)
        if l.kind ~= "leg" then return { l } end
        local inL = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do inL[i] = true end
        local roots = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                if not inL[j] and not limbOf[j] then
                    roots[#roots + 1] = i
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if #roots < 2 then return { l } end
        table.sort(roots, function(x, y) return parts[x].offset.Position.Z < parts[y].offset.Position.Z end)
        local group, groups = {}, 1
        group[roots[1]] = 1
        for r = 2, #roots do
            if parts[roots[r]].offset.Position.Z - parts[roots[r - 1]].offset.Position.Z > len * 0.12 then
                groups += 1
            end
            group[roots[r]] = groups
        end
        if groups < 2 then return { l } end
        local queue, head = {}, 1
        for _, r in ipairs(roots) do queue[#queue + 1] = r end
        while head <= #queue do
            local k = queue[head]
            head += 1
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[k]) do
                if inL[j] and not group[j] then
                    group[j] = group[k]
                    queue[#queue + 1] = j
                end
            end
        end
        local split = {}
        for g = 1, groups do split[g] = { kind = l.kind, members = {} } end
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
            local g = group[i]
            if not g then
                local z, bestD = parts[i].offset.Position.Z, math.huge
                for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
                    local d = math.abs(parts[r].offset.Position.Z - z)
                    if d < bestD then bestD, g = d, group[r] end
                end
            end
            table.insert(split[g].members, i)
        end
        local of = {}
        for g, c in ipairs(split) do
            for _, i in ipairs(c.members) do of[i] = g end
        end
        local parent = {}
        for g = 1, groups do parent[g] = g end
        local function find(g)
            while parent[g] ~= g do g = parent[g] end
            return g
        end
        local function slot(i)
            local name = parts[i].part.Name
            local tok = tokens(name)
            local words = {}
            for _, w in ipairs({ "front", "fore", "mid", "middle", "rear", "hind", "back" }) do
                if tok[w] then words[#words + 1] = w end
            end
            return table.concat(words, "+") .. (name:match("%d+") or "")
        end
        local links = {}
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                if inL[j] and i < j and of[i] ~= of[j] then
                    local x, y = math.min(of[i], of[j]), math.max(of[i], of[j])
                    local key = x * 1000 + y
                    links[key] = (links[key] or 0) + 1
                    local si, sj = slot(i), slot(j)
                    if links[key] >= 2 or si == "" or sj == "" or si == sj then
                        parent[find(y)] = find(x)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local merged = {}
        for g, c in ipairs(split) do
            local r = find(g)
            merged[r] = merged[r] or { kind = l.kind, members = {} }
            for _, i in ipairs(c.members) do table.insert(merged[r].members, i) end
        end
        local result = {}
        for g = 1, groups do
            if merged[g] and #merged[g].members > 0 then result[#result + 1] = merged[g] end
        end
        return result
    end

    do
        local splitLimbs = {}
        for _, l in ipairs(limbs) do
            for _, s in ipairs(splitAlongZ(l)) do splitLimbs[#splitLimbs + 1] = s end
        end
        limbs = splitLimbs
        index()
    end

    local bodyCentre = Vector3.zero
    do
        local cnt = 0
        for i = 1, n do
            if not limbOf[i] then
                bodyCentre += parts[i].offset.Position
                cnt += 1
            end
        end
        if cnt > 0 then bodyCentre /= cnt end
    end

    for _, l in ipairs(limbs) do
        l.contacts = {}
        local sum, cnt = Vector3.zero, 0
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
            for _, j in ipairs(adj[i]) do
                if not limbOf[j] then
                    sum += (lo[i]:Max(lo[j]) + hi[i]:Min(hi[j])) / 2
                    cnt += 1
                    l.contacts[#l.contacts + 1] = { i = i, j = j }
                end
            end
        end
        if cnt == 0 then
            local bi, bj, bg = nil, nil, far
            for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
                for j = 1, n do
                    if not limbOf[j] and near(i, j, far) then
                        local g = gapOf(i, j)
                        if g < bg then bi, bj, bg = i, j, g end
                    end
                end
            end
            if bi then
                sum = (lo[bi]:Max(lo[bj]) + hi[bi]:Min(hi[bj])) / 2
                cnt = 1
                l.contacts[1] = { i = bi, j = bj }
            end
        end
        l.centroid = centroidOf(l.members)
        if cnt > 0 then
            l.hinge = sum / cnt
        else
            local mn, mx = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
            for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
                mn = mn:Min(lo[i])
                mx = mx:Max(hi[i])
            end
            if l.kind == "leg" then
                l.hinge = Vector3.new((mn.X + mx.X) / 2, mx.Y, (mn.Z + mx.Z) / 2)
            else
                l.hinge = Vector3.new(math.clamp(bodyCentre.X, mn.X, mx.X), math.clamp(bodyCentre.Y, mn.Y, mx.Y),
                    math.clamp(bodyCentre.Z, mn.Z, mx.Z))
            end
        end
    end

    local groundY = math.huge
    for i = 1, n do groundY = math.min(groundY, lo[i].Y) end
    local dip = rig.height * 0.03
    local allowed = math.max(len * 0.015, 0.015)
    for _, l in ipairs(limbs) do
        local rest = {}
        for k, ct in ipairs(l.contacts) do rest[k] = gapOf(ct.i, ct.j) end
        l.amp = 0
        for _, amp in ipairs(AMP_STEPS) do
            local fits = true
            if amp > 0 then
                for _, s in ipairs(SAMPLES[l.kind]) do
                    local ax, ay, az = s:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
                    local rot = about(l.hinge, CFrame.Angles(ax * amp, ay * amp, az * amp))
                    for k, ct in ipairs(l.contacts) do
                        local a, b = parts[ct.i], parts[ct.j]
                        if boxGap(rot * a.offset, a.part.Size, b.offset, b.part.Size) - rest[k] > allowed then
                            fits = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if fits and (l.kind == "wing" or l.kind == "tail") then
                        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do
                            local cf = rot * parts[i].offset
                            if cf.Position.Y - extents(cf, parts[i].part.Size).Y < groundY - dip then
                                fits = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not fits then break end
                end
            end
            if fits then
                l.amp = amp
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local legsBySide = { [1] = {}, [-1] = {} }
    local tails = {}
    for _, l in ipairs(limbs) do
        l.dir = l.centroid.X >= 0 and 1 or -1
        l.phase = 0
        if l.kind == "leg" then
            table.insert(legsBySide[l.dir], l)
        elseif l.kind == "tail" then
            table.insert(tails, l)
        end
    end
    for s, list in pairs(legsBySide) do
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.centroid.Z < b.centroid.Z end)
        for rank, l in ipairs(list) do
            l.phase = ((rank - 1) % 2) * math.pi + (s < 0 and math.pi or 0)
        end
    end
    table.sort(tails, function(a, b) return a.centroid.Z < b.centroid.Z end)
    for rank, l in ipairs(tails) do l.phase = (rank - 1) * 0.6 end

    local plan = { keys = {}, byId = {}, limbs = {}, legs = 0 }
    for i = 1, n do plan.keys[i] = "body" end
    for li, l in ipairs(limbs) do
        local key = l.kind .. "#" .. li
        for _, i in ipairs(l.members) do plan.keys[i] = key end
        plan.limbs[key] = { hinge = l.hinge / len, kind = l.kind, amp = l.amp, dir = l.dir, phase = l.phase }
        if l.kind == "leg" then plan.legs += 1 end
    end
    for i, e in ipairs(parts) do plan.byId[identity(e, len)] = plan.keys[i] end
    return plan
end

function Rig.build(model)
    local pivot = model:GetPivot()
    local rig = { model = model, parts = {}, limbs = {}, height = 0, length = 0, width = 0 }

    local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
    rig.height = size.Y
    rig.length = math.max(size.X, size.Z)
    rig.width = size.X

    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            rig.parts[#rig.parts + 1] = { part = p, offset = pivot:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame), key = "body", named = false }
        end
    end

    local len = math.max(rig.length, 1e-3)
    local signature = tostring(model:GetAttribute("Species") or model.Name) .. "|" .. #rig.parts
    local plan = cache[signature]
    local keys
    if plan then
        keys = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(rig.parts) do
            local k = plan.byId[identity(e, len)]
            if not k then
                keys = nil
                break
            end
            keys[i] = k
        end
    end
    if not keys then
        plan = solve(rig)
        cache[signature] = plan
        keys = plan.keys
    end

    for i, e in ipairs(rig.parts) do
        e.key = keys[i]
        e.named = e.key ~= "body"
    end
    for key, l in pairs(plan.limbs) do
        rig.limbs[key] = { hinge = l.hinge * len, kind = l.kind, amp = l.amp, dir = l.dir, phase = l.phase }
    end
    rig.legs = plan.legs
    rig.slither = plan.legs < 2

    local restLow = math.huge
    for _, e in ipairs(rig.parts) do
        restLow = math.min(restLow, e.offset.Position.Y - extents(e.offset, e.part.Size).Y)
    end
    local lowest = restLow
    for step = 0, 7 do
        local ph = step * math.pi / 4
        local t = step * 0.0655
        local body = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(ph) * 0.05)
        for _, e in ipairs(rig.parts) do
            local s = limbTransform(rig.limbs[e.key], ph, t, 1)
            local cf = body * (s and (s * e.offset) or e.offset)
            lowest = math.min(lowest, cf.Position.Y - extents(cf, e.part.Size).Y)
        end
    end
    rig.lift = math.min(math.max(0, restLow - lowest), rig.height * 0.04)
    rig.shift = {}
    rig.moveParts = {}
    rig.moveCFrames = {}
    return rig
end

function Rig.pose(rig, cf, phase, t, moving)
    local last = rig.lastT
    local dt = last and math.clamp(t - last, 0, 0.25) or 1
    rig.lastT = t
    local target = moving and 1 or 0
    local w = rig.walk or target
    w += (target - w) * math.min(dt * 5, 1)
    rig.walk = w

    local bobAmp = rig.height * (0.012 + 0.018 * w)
    local wave = (math.sin(phase * 2) * w + math.sin(phase + t * 1.6) * (1 - w)) * 0.5 + 0.5
    local roll = math.sin(phase) * (0.015 + 0.035 * w)
    local body = CFrame.new(0, wave * bobAmp + (rig.lift or 0), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll)
    if rig.slither then
        body = body * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(phase * 0.8) * 0.18, 0)
    end
    local base = cf * body

    local shift = rig.shift
    for key, limb in pairs(rig.limbs) do
        shift[key] = limbTransform(limb, phase, t, w) or false
    end

    local list, cfs = rig.moveParts, rig.moveCFrames
    for i, e in ipairs(rig.parts) do
        local s = shift[e.key]
        list[i] = e.part
        cfs[i] = base * (s and (s * e.offset) or e.offset)
    end
    if rig.model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        workspace:BulkMoveTo(list, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
    else
        for i, p in ipairs(list) do p.CFrame = cfs[i] end
    end
end

return Rig

local PUPIL_COLOR = rgb(20, 18, 22)
local SCLERA_COLOR = rgb(248, 248, 244)
local GLINT_COLOR = rgb(255, 255, 255)
local DARK_BODY = 0.22

local function luminance(c)
    return 0.2126 * c.R + 0.7152 * c.G + 0.0722 * c.B
end

local EYE_WORDS = { "eye", "pupil", "iris", "sclera", "glint", "highlight" }
local NOT_EYEBALL = { "socket", "patch", "lid", "brow", "lash", "stalk", "turret", "ring", "star",
                      "glint", "spark", "shine", "highlight" }

local function hasWord(n, list)
    for _, k in ipairs(list) do
        if n:find(k, 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function Paint.eyeFlags(model)
    local f = { hasPupil = false, hasIris = false, hasEyePart = false, hasSclera = false }
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local n = p.Name:lower()
            if n:find("pupil", 1, true) then f.hasPupil = true end
            if n:find("iris", 1, true) then f.hasIris = true end
            if n:find("sclera", 1, true) or n:find("white", 1, true) or n:find("eyeball", 1, true) then f.hasSclera = true end
            if (n:find("eye", 1, true) or n:find("sclera", 1, true))
               and not n:find("pupil", 1, true) and not n:find("iris", 1, true)
               and not hasWord(n, NOT_EYEBALL) then
                f.hasEyePart = true
            end
        end
    end
    return f
end

function Paint.eyeRole(name, f)
    local n = name:lower()
    if not hasWord(n, EYE_WORDS) then
        if n:find("socket", 1, true) and f.hasPupil and not f.hasEyePart then return "sclera" end
        return nil
    end
    if n:find("glint", 1, true) or n:find("highlight", 1, true)
       or ((n:find("spark", 1, true) or n:find("shine", 1, true)) and n:find("eye", 1, true)) then
        return "glint"
    end
    if n:find("lid", 1, true) or n:find("brow", 1, true) or n:find("lash", 1, true) then return nil end
    if n:find("patch", 1, true) then return "patch" end
    if n:find("socket", 1, true) then
        if f.hasEyePart then return "base" end
        return f.hasPupil and "sclera" or "bead"
    end
    if n:find("stalk", 1, true) or n:find("turret", 1, true) then return "base" end
    if n:find("ring", 1, true) or n:find("star", 1, true) then return "accent" end
    if n:find("pupil", 1, true) then return "pupil" end
    if n:find("iris", 1, true) then return f.hasPupil and "iris" or "pupil" end
    if n:find("white", 1, true) or n:find("sclera", 1, true) or n:find("eyeball", 1, true) then return "sclera" end
    return (f.hasPupil or f.hasIris) and "sclera" or "bead"
end

local DEFAULT = { base = rgb(170,150,130), belly = rgb(226,216,200), dark = rgb(60, 52, 46), accent = rgb(230,200,150) }

Paint.TIER = {
    [1] = { tint = nil,                 amount = 0.00, glow = false },
    [2] = { tint = rgb(150, 230, 160),  amount = 0.14, glow = false },
    [3] = { tint = rgb(120, 180, 246),  amount = 0.20, glow = false },
    [4] = { tint = rgb(250, 205, 110),  amount = 0.24, glow = true  },
}

local function words(name)    local spaced = name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("(%u)(%u%l)", "%1 %2")
    local t = {}
    for w in spaced:lower():gmatch("%a+") do t[w] = true end
    return t
end

local function anyOf(tok, list)
    for _, k in ipairs(list) do
        if tok[k] then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local EYE    = { "eye", "pupil" }
local GLINT  = { "glint", "shine", "sparkle" }
local BEAK   = { "bill", "beak", "nose", "nostril" }
local BELLY  = { "belly", "chest", "bib", "breast", "throat", "underside", "under", "plastron" }
local FOOT   = { "foot", "paw", "hoof", "claw", "toe", "sock", "pad", "talon", "hock" }
local INNER  = { "inner", "tuft" }
local ACCENT = { "tip", "horn", "tusk", "antler", "crest", "mane", "shell", "carapace",
                 "elytra", "rattle", "stinger", "spot", "stripe",

                 "patch", "marking", "ember", "flame", "magma", "lava", "glow", "vent" }

local WHITE  = { "white", "sclera", "eyeball" }
local TOOTH  = { "tooth", "teeth", "fang", "tusk" }

local GLOW_MAX_SHARE = 0.12

local STUDS_IMAGE = "rbxassetid://138926013267839"
local STUDS_ALPHA = 0.35
local STUDS_PER_BODY = 12
local FACES = Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()

local STUD_FLAT_MIN = 0.8

local function clearStuds(part)
    for _, c in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Texture") and c.Name == "Studs" then c:Destroy() end
    end
end

local function addStuds(part, tile)
    for _, face in ipairs(FACES) do
        local t = Instance.new("Texture")
        t.Name = "Studs"
        t.Texture = STUDS_IMAGE
        t.Face = face
        t.StudsPerTileU = tile
        t.StudsPerTileV = tile
        t.Transparency = STUDS_ALPHA
        t.Parent = part
    end
end

local COPLANAR_TOL = 0.003
local COPLANAR_GAP = 0.005
local COPLANAR_EDGE = 0.002
local COPLANAR_MAX = 0.01

local function boxFaces(p)
    local cf, s = p.CFrame, p.Size
    local ax = { { cf.RightVector, s.X / 2 }, { cf.UpVector, s.Y / 2 }, { cf.LookVector, s.Z / 2 } }
    local list = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local j, k = (i % 3) + 1, ((i + 1) % 3) + 1
        for _, sg in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
            list[#list + 1] = {
                part = p, n = ax[i][1] * sg, c = cf.Position + ax[i][1] * (ax[i][2] * sg),
                u = ax[j][1], hu = ax[j][2], v = ax[k][1], hv = ax[k][2],
                area = ax[j][2] * ax[k][2],
            }
        end
    end
    return list
end

function Paint.separateCoplanar(model)
    local okBox, _, box = pcall(model.GetBoundingBox, model)
    if not (okBox and box) then return 0 end
    local span = math.max(box.X, box.Y, box.Z)
    local tol, gap = span * COPLANAR_TOL, span * COPLANAR_GAP
    local edge, maxMove = span * COPLANAR_EDGE, span * COPLANAR_MAX
    local faces = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.9 then
            for _, f in ipairs(boxFaces(p)) do faces[#faces + 1] = f end
        end
    end
    local shift = {}
    for a = 1, #faces do
        local fa = faces[a]
        for b = a + 1, #faces do
            local fb = faces[b]
            if fa.part ~= fb.part and fa.n:Dot(fb.n) > 0.999 then
                local d = fb.c - fa.c
                local off = fa.n:Dot(d)
                if math.abs(off) < tol then
                    local du, dv = d:Dot(fa.u), d:Dot(fa.v)
                    local eu = math.abs(fb.u:Dot(fa.u)) * fb.hu + math.abs(fb.v:Dot(fa.u)) * fb.hv
                    local ev = math.abs(fb.u:Dot(fa.v)) * fb.hu + math.abs(fb.v:Dot(fa.v)) * fb.hv
                    if math.abs(du) < fa.hu + eu - edge and math.abs(dv) < fa.hv + ev - edge then

                        local small, rel
                        if fb.area <= fa.area then small, rel = fb, off else small, rel = fa, -off end
                        local front = math.abs(rel) < 0.001 or rel > 0
                        local target = front and gap or -gap
                        shift[small.part] = (shift[small.part] or Vector3.zero) + small.n * (target - rel)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local moved = 0
    for part, v in pairs(shift) do
        if v.Magnitude > maxMove then v = v.Unit * maxMove end
        part.CFrame = part.CFrame + v
        moved += 1
    end
    return moved
end

local HEAD  = { "head" }
local EYES  = { "eye", "pupil" }
local SNOUT = { "nose", "snout", "muzzle", "beak", "bill", "mouth", "jaw" }
local TAILS = { "tail" }

local function centroid(parts, list)
    local sum, n = Vector3.zero, 0
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local hit = list == nil
            if not hit then
                local name = p.Name:lower()
                for _, k in ipairs(list) do
                    if name:find(k, 1, true) then hit = true break end
                end
            end
            if hit then
                sum += p.Position
                n += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return n > 0 and sum / n or nil
end

function Paint.frontDir(parts, up)
    up = up or Vector3.yAxis
    local front = centroid(parts, EYES) or centroid(parts, SNOUT) or centroid(parts, HEAD)
    local back = centroid(parts, TAILS) or centroid(parts)
    if not (front and back) then return nil end
    local d = front - back
    d -= up * d:Dot(up)
    if d.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return nil end
    return d.Unit
end

function Paint.previewEye(front, up)
    up = up or Vector3.yAxis
    return (front + front:Cross(up) * 0.55 + up * 0.3).Unit
end

function Paint.pivotOf(source)
    if typeof(source) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
    if source:IsA("Tool") then
        local handle = source:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        local offset = handle and handle:GetAttribute("PivotOffset")
        if typeof(offset) == "CFrame" then return handle.CFrame * offset end
        return nil
    end
    if source:IsA("Model") then return source:GetPivot() end
    return nil
end

function Paint.viewDir(parts, source)
    local pivot = Paint.pivotOf(source)
    if pivot then
        return Paint.previewEye(pivot.LookVector, pivot.UpVector), pivot.UpVector
    end
    local front = Paint.frontDir(parts)
    if not front then return nil end
    return Paint.previewEye(front), Vector3.yAxis
end

function Paint.studs(model, perBody, skip)
    local ok, _, box = pcall(model.GetBoundingBox, model)
    if not (ok and box) then return 0 end
    Paint.separateCoplanar(model)
    local tile = math.clamp(math.max(box.X, box.Y, box.Z) / (perBody or STUDS_PER_BODY), 0.08, 6)
    local n = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            clearStuds(p)
            local tok = words(p.Name)
            if p.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon and p.Transparency < 0.9
               and not anyOf(tok, EYE) and not anyOf(tok, GLINT)
               and not (skip and skip(p))
               and math.max(p.Size.X, p.Size.Y, p.Size.Z) >= tile * 0.5
               and (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("StudFlat")) or 1) >= STUD_FLAT_MIN then
                addStuds(p, tile)
                n += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return n
end

function Paint.warm(c)
    local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
    if s < 0.18 then
        if v > 0.9 then return Color3.fromHSV(0.1, math.min(0.06, s + 0.03), v) end
        return Color3.fromHSV(0.085, math.max(s, 0.08 + (1 - v) * 0.1), math.min(1, 0.06 + v * 0.96))
    end
    if v < 0.2 then v = 0.14 + v * 0.5 end
    return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(0.92, s * 1.08), v)
end

function Paint.paint(model, tier, opts)
    local species = model:GetAttribute("Species") or model.Name

    if not (opts and opts.preview) then Paint.separateCoplanar(model) end

    local tile = 0
    if model:IsA("Model") then
        local ok, _, box = pcall(model.GetBoundingBox, model)
        if ok and box then
            tile = math.clamp(math.max(box.X, box.Y, box.Z) / STUDS_PER_BODY, 0.08, 4)
        end
    end
    local pal = Paint.PALETTE[species] or DEFAULT
    local rule = Paint.TIER[tier or 1] or Paint.TIER[1]

    local function shade(c)
        if rule.tint and rule.amount > 0 then
            c = c:Lerp(rule.tint, rule.amount)
        end
        return Paint.warm(c)
    end

    local eyeFlags = Paint.eyeFlags(model)
    local eyeTint = Paint.EYE_COLOR[species]
    local darkBody = luminance(pal.base) < DARK_BODY
    local totalVolume = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then totalVolume += p.Size.X * p.Size.Y * p.Size.Z end
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local tok = words(p.Name)
            local colour, neon = pal.base, false

            local role = Paint.eyeRole(p.Name, eyeFlags)
            local eyePart = role ~= nil and role ~= "base" and role ~= "accent" and role ~= "patch"

            local addedGlint = p.Name:sub(1, 6) == "glint_"
            if role == "glint" then
                colour = (darkBody and addedGlint and not eyeFlags.hasPupil) and PUPIL_COLOR or GLINT_COLOR
            elseif role == "bead" and darkBody and not eyeFlags.hasSclera then
                local hasOwnGlint = p.Parent and p.Parent:FindFirstChild("glint_" .. p.Name) ~= nil
                if hasOwnGlint then
                    colour = eyeTint or SCLERA_COLOR
                else
                    colour = luminance(pal.accent) > 0.35 and pal.accent or SCLERA_COLOR
                end
            elseif role == "pupil" or role == "bead" then
                colour = PUPIL_COLOR
            elseif role == "sclera" then
                colour = eyeTint or SCLERA_COLOR
            elseif role == "iris" then
                colour = eyeTint or pal.accent
            elseif role == "patch" then
                colour = pal.dark
            elseif role == "accent" then
                colour = pal.accent
            elseif role == "base" then
                colour = pal.base
            elseif anyOf(tok, TOOTH) then
                colour = rgb(242, 238, 226)
            elseif anyOf(tok, BEAK) then
                colour = pal.accent
            elseif anyOf(tok, FOOT) and not tok.whisker then
                colour = pal.dark
            elseif anyOf(tok, BELLY) or tok.whisker then
                colour = pal.belly
            elseif anyOf(tok, INNER) then
                colour = pal.belly
            elseif anyOf(tok, ACCENT) then
                colour = pal.accent
                neon = rule.glow and (p.Size.X * p.Size.Y * p.Size.Z) <= totalVolume * GLOW_MAX_SHARE
            end

            p.Color = eyePart and colour or shade(colour)

            p.Material = neon and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

            clearStuds(p)
            if tile > 0 and not neon and not (role and role ~= "base" and role ~= "accent")
               and math.max(p.Size.X, p.Size.Y, p.Size.Z) >= tile * 0.5
               and (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("StudFlat")) or 1) >= STUD_FLAT_MIN then
                addStuds(p, tile)
            end
        end
    end
end

return Paint

local Money = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))
local SpeedPass = {}

SpeedPass.TIERS = Money.SPEED_PASS_TIERS

SpeedPass.STUDIO_TEST = Money.STUDIO_TEST

SpeedPass.MAX_GREY = Money.SPEED_MAX_GREY == true

function SpeedPass.max()
    local m = 1
    for _, t in ipairs(SpeedPass.TIERS) do
        if t.mult > m then m = t.mult end
    end
    return m
end

function SpeedPass.nextAfter(mult)
    local have = tonumber(mult) or 1
    local best
    for _, t in ipairs(SpeedPass.TIERS) do
        if t.mult > have and (not best or t.mult < best.mult) then best = t end
    end
    return best
end

function SpeedPass.byPassId(id)
    for _, t in ipairs(SpeedPass.TIERS) do
        if (t.passId or 0) > 0 and t.passId == id then return t end
    end
    return nil
end

return SpeedPass

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Cfg = require(RS:WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local F = {}

F.SLOTS = 3

F.COST_SECONDS = 600

F.SIZE_WEIGHTS = { 30, 30, 22, 11, 5, 2 }

F.SIZE_BIAS = 1.35

F.LUCK_MIN = -50
F.LUCK_MAX = 50

F.LUCK_PER_TIER = 6
F.LUCK_PER_SIZE = 3

F.LUCK_BOOST_MAX_ROLLS = 10

function F.cost(zone, tier, size)
    return math.floor(Cfg.animalIncome(zone, size, tier) * F.COST_SECONDS + 0.5)
end

local function avg(list)
    local s = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(list) do s += v end
    return #list > 0 and s / #list or 1
end

function F.rollSize(sizes, rng)
    rng = rng or Random.new()
    local shift = math.max(0, avg(sizes) - 1)
    local total, weights = 0, {}
    for i, w in ipairs(F.SIZE_WEIGHTS) do
        weights[i] = w * (F.SIZE_BIAS ^ ((i - 1) * shift / (#F.SIZE_WEIGHTS - 1) * 2))
        total += weights[i]
    end
    local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
    for i, w in ipairs(weights) do
        roll -= w
        if roll <= 0 then return i end
    end
    return #weights
end

function F.rollLuck(tier, sizes, boost, rng)
    rng = rng or Random.new()
    local bonus = (math.max(1, tier or 1) - 1) * F.LUCK_PER_TIER
        + math.max(0, avg(sizes) - 1) * F.LUCK_PER_SIZE
    local rolls = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(boost) or 1), 1, F.LUCK_BOOST_MAX_ROLLS)
    local best = -math.huge
    for _ = 1, rolls do
        best = math.max(best, rng:NextInteger(F.LUCK_MIN, F.LUCK_MAX))
    end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(best + bonus + 0.5), F.LUCK_MIN, F.LUCK_MAX)
end

function F.incomeMult(luck)
    return 1 + (tonumber(luck) or 0) / 100
end

return F

    return price or fallback

    local products, passes, problems, unset = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local function check(seen, label, id)

        if id <= 0 then
            table.insert(unset, label)
        elseif seen[id] then
            table.insert(problems, ("%s and %s use the same id %d"):format(seen[id], label, id))
        else
            seen[id] = label
        end
    end
    for key, e in pairs(M.GAME_PASSES) do check(passes, key, e.passId) end
    for _, t in ipairs(M.SPEED_PASS_TIERS) do check(passes, "SpeedPass x" .. t.mult, t.passId) end
    for _, e in ipairs(M.SPEED_PACKS) do check(products, e.key, e.productId) end
    for _, e in ipairs(M.CASH_PACKS) do check(products, e.key, e.productId) end
    for key, e in pairs(M.NEST) do check(products, key, e.productId) end
    for id, e in pairs(M.TRAILS) do check(products, "Trail_" .. id, e.productId) end
    for kind, u in pairs(M.UPGRADES) do
        for level, id in ipairs(u.productIds) do
            check(products, ("Upgrade_%s_%d"):format(kind, level), id)
        end
    end
    for key, e in pairs(M.GIFT_PASS_PRODUCTS) do check(products, "Gift_" .. key, e.productId) end
    check(products, "RebirthSkip", M.REBIRTH_SKIP and M.REBIRTH_SKIP.productId)
    for _, p in ipairs(problems) do warn("[Monetization] " .. p) end
    if #unset > 0 then
        warn(("[Monetization] %d items have no id yet: %s"):format(#unset, table.concat(unset, ", ")))
    end
    return #problems == 0, #unset
end

return M

local A = {}

local ANIM_NAMES = { "Idle", "Run", "Attack", "Sleep", "Wake" }

function A.animations(model)
	local found, any = {}, false
	for _, name in ipairs(ANIM_NAMES) do
		local id
		for _, c in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Animation") and c.Name:lower() == name:lower() and c.AnimationId ~= "" then id = c.AnimationId break end
		end
		if not id then
			local v = model:GetAttribute(name) or model:GetAttribute(name .. "Animation")
			local digits = type(v) == "number" and v > 0 and tostring(math.floor(v))
				or type(v) == "string" and v:match("%d+")
			if digits and tonumber(digits) and tonumber(digits) > 0 then id = "rbxassetid://" .. digits end
		end
		if id then found[name] = id any = true end
	end
	return any and found or nil
end

function A.embedded(model)
	local folder = model:FindFirstChild("Animations")
	if not folder then return nil end
	local found, any = {}, false
	for _, name in ipairs(ANIM_NAMES) do
		local k = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if k and k:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then found[name] = k any = true end
	end
	return any and found or nil
end

function A.animated(model)
	return A.animations(model) ~= nil or A.embedded(model) ~= nil
end

function A.animRoot(model)
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true)
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then return root end
	if model.PrimaryPart then return model.PrimaryPart end
	local isChild, candidates = {}, {}
	for _, j in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if j:IsA("Motor6D") and j.Part0 and j.Part1 then
			isChild[j.Part1] = true
			candidates[j.Part0] = true
		end
	end
	for p in pairs(candidates) do
		if not isChild[p] then return p end
	end
	return model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

return A

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local TOPIC = "GlobalBoost"
local KEY = "current"

local KINDS = { "eggluck", "hatch", "money", "luck", "speed", "treadmill" }
local IS_KIND = {}
for _, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do IS_KIND[kind] = true end

local MAX_MULT = 1000

local store
do
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStores.Boost)
	end)
	store = ok and result or nil
end

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 20)
local remote = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("GlobalBoost", 10)

local GlobalBoost = {}

_G.GlobalBoost = GlobalBoost

local function blank()
	local out = {}
	for _, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do
		out[kind] = { mult = 1, endsAt = 0, setBy = "", setAt = 0 }
	end
	return out
end

local shared = blank()
local here = blank()

local function liveIn(where, kind)
	local entry = where[kind]
	if not entry or entry.mult <= 1 then return false end
	if entry.endsAt > 0 and os.time() >= entry.endsAt then return false end
	return true
end

local function multIn(where, kind)
	return liveIn(where, kind) and where[kind].mult or 1
end

function GlobalBoost.value(kind)
	if not IS_KIND[kind] then return 1 end
	if kind=="treadmill" then return math.max(multIn(shared, kind),multIn(here, kind)) end
 return multIn(shared, kind) * multIn(here, kind)
end

function GlobalBoost.state()
	local out = {}
	for _, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do
		local mult = GlobalBoost.value(kind)
		if mult > 1 then

			local ends, began = 0, 0
			for _, where in ipairs({ shared, here }) do
				local entry = where[kind]
				if liveIn(where, kind) and entry.endsAt > 0 then
					if ends == 0 or entry.endsAt < ends then
						ends = entry.endsAt

						began = math.floor((tonumber(entry.setAt) or 0) / 1000)
					end
				end
			end
			if kind=="treadmill" then
 local chosen = multIn(here,kind)>=multIn(shared,kind) and here[kind] or shared[kind]
 ends=chosen.endsAt began=math.floor((chosen.setAt or 0)/1000)
 end
 out[kind] = { mult = mult, endsAt = ends, startedAt = began }
		end
	end
	return out
end

function GlobalBoost.kinds()
	return KINDS
end

local function tellClients()
	if not remote then return end
	remote:FireAllClients(GlobalBoost.state())
end

local function adoptKind(kind, data)
	if not IS_KIND[kind] or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end

	local setAt = tonumber(data.setAt) or 0
	if setAt < (shared[kind].setAt or 0) then return false end

	shared[kind] = {
		mult = math.clamp(tonumber(data.mult) or 1, 1, kind=="treadmill" and 1000 or MAX_MULT),
		endsAt = tonumber(data.endsAt) or 0,
		setBy = tostring(data.setBy or ""),
		setAt = setAt,
	}
	return true
end

local function adopt(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
	local changed = false
	for _, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do
		if adoptKind(kind, data[kind]) then changed = true end
	end
	if changed then tellClients() end
	return changed
end

function GlobalBoost.set(kind, mult, minutes, everywhere, byName)
	if not IS_KIND[kind] then return nil, "unknown kind" end

	local raw, duration = tonumber(mult), tonumber(minutes)
 if not raw or raw ~= raw or math.abs(raw)==math.huge then return nil, "invalid multiplier" end
 if kind=="treadmill" and raw>1 and (not duration or duration~=duration or duration<0.1 or duration>1440) then return nil, "treadmill duration must be 0.1 to 1440 minutes" end
 local value = math.clamp(raw, 1, kind=="treadmill" and 1000 or MAX_MULT)
	local mins = math.max(tonumber(minutes) or 0, 0)
	local endsAt = (value > 1 and mins > 0) and (os.time() + math.floor(mins * 60)) or 0

	local entry = {
		mult = value,
		endsAt = endsAt,
		setBy = tostring(byName or ""),
		setAt = DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis,
	}

	if not everywhere then
		here[kind] = entry
		tellClients()
		return GlobalBoost.value(kind)
	end

	adoptKind(kind, entry)
	tellClients()

	if store then

		local ok, err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync(KEY, shared) end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Boost] boost not saved: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPIC, { [kind] = entry })
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Boost] boost not published to other servers: " .. tostring(err))
	end

	return GlobalBoost.value(kind)
end

function GlobalBoost.clear(byName)
	local stamp = DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis
	local payload = {}
	for _, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do
		here[kind] = { mult = 1, endsAt = 0, setBy = "", setAt = 0 }
		local entry = { mult = 1, endsAt = 0, setBy = tostring(byName or ""), setAt = stamp }
		adoptKind(kind, entry)
		payload[kind] = entry
	end
	tellClients()
	if store then
		local ok, err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync(KEY, shared) end)
		if not ok then warn("[Boost] boost not saved: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function() MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPIC, payload) end)
	if not ok then warn("[Boost] boost not published to other servers: " .. tostring(err)) end
	return true
end

function GlobalBoost.Init()
	if GlobalBoost._started then return end
	GlobalBoost._started = true
	if not remote then
		warn("[Boost] no Remotes.GlobalBoost; the boost will pay but stay invisible")
	end

	if store then
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync(KEY) end)
		if ok then adopt(data) end
	else
		warn("[Boost] no DataStore; the boost will not survive a restart")
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(TOPIC, function(message)
				adopt(message and message.Data)
			end)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Boost] global boost: no live updates from other servers (" .. tostring(err) .. ")")
		end
	end)

	local function greet(player)
		if remote then remote:FireClient(player, GlobalBoost.state()) end
	end

	if remote then
		local asked = {}
		remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
			local t = os.clock()
			if (asked[player] or 0) + 1 > t then return end
			asked[player] = t
			greet(player)
		end)
		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) asked[player] = nil end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(greet)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do greet(player) end

	local function signature()
		local parts = {}
		for _, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do
			parts[#parts + 1] = ("%s=%.2f"):format(kind, GlobalBoost.value(kind))
		end
		return table.concat(parts, ",")
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local was = signature()
		while true do
			task.wait(5)
			local now = signature()
			if now ~= was then
				was = now
				tellClients()
			end
		end
	end)

	print(("[Boost] GlobalBoostService ready (%s)"):format(signature()))
end

return GlobalBoost

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BatConfig"))
local M={}
local initialized=false
function M.unlocked(profile,zone)
 if zone==0 then return true end
 if type(zone)~="number" or zone~=math.floor(zone) or not Config[zone] then return false end
 if tonumber(profile.BatForced)==zone then return true end
 local found={}
 for _,key in ipairs(profile.PetIndex or {}) do found[key]=true end
 for slot=1,8 do if not found[zone.."_"..slot] then return false end end
 return true
end
local function profile(p) return _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(p) end
function M.equipped(p)
 local prof=profile(p)
 local zone=prof and tonumber(prof.BatEquipped) or 0
 if not prof or not M.unlocked(prof,zone) then return 0 end
 return zone
end
local function visibility(tool)
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do
  if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Name=="IndexBatParticles" then v.Enabled=tool.Parent and tool.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")~=nil end
 end
end
function M.apply(p,tool)
 if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Name~="Stick" then return end
 local zone=M.equipped(p)
 if tool:GetAttribute("BatZone")==zone then visibility(tool) return end
 local cfg=Config[zone]
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do if v.Name=="IndexBatFX" then v:Destroy() end end
 for _,part in tool:GetDescendants() do
  if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
   if part:GetAttribute("BatOriginalTexture")==nil then
    part:SetAttribute("BatOriginalTexture",part.TextureID)
    part:SetAttribute("BatOriginalColor",part.Color)
   end
   part.TextureID=cfg and cfg.Texture or part:GetAttribute("BatOriginalTexture")
   part.Color=cfg and cfg.Color or part:GetAttribute("BatOriginalColor")
  end
 end
 local barrel=tool:FindFirstChild("barrel_geom") or tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
 if cfg and barrel then
  for i=-1,1 do
   local fx=Instance.new("Attachment") fx.Name="IndexBatFX"
   fx.Position=Vector3.new(i==0 and -.4 or .4,i*barrel.Size.Y*.32,0)
   fx.Parent=barrel
   local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter") e.Name="IndexBatParticles" e.Texture=cfg.Particle
   e.Rate=12 e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.8,1.3) e.Speed=NumberRange.new(.7,1.2)
   e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180) e.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360) e.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-65,65)
   e.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.4),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.25,.7),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.12)})
   e.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.08),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.65,.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
   e.Color=ColorSequence.new(cfg.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.3))
   e.LightEmission=.8 e.LightInfluence=0 e.LockedToPart=true e.ZOffset=.15 e.Parent=fx
  end
 end
 tool:SetAttribute("BatZone",zone)
 tool.ToolTip=cfg and cfg.Name or "Golden Bat"
 tool.TextureId=cfg and cfg.Icon or "rbxassetid://128088129405176"
 visibility(tool)
 if not tool:GetAttribute("BatWatched") then
  tool:SetAttribute("BatWatched",true)
  tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() visibility(tool) end)
 end
end
function M.refresh(p)
 p:SetAttribute("BatEquipped",M.equipped(p))
 for _,root in {p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),p.Character} do
  if root then for _,t in root:GetChildren() do M.apply(p,t) end end
 end
end
function M.equip(p,zone)
 if type(zone)~="number" or zone~=zone or zone~=math.floor(zone) then return false end
 local prof=profile(p)
 if not prof or not M.unlocked(prof,zone) then return false end
 prof.BatEquipped=zone M.refresh(p) return true
end
function M.adminSet(p,zone)
 if type(zone)~="number" or zone~=zone or zone~=math.floor(zone) then return false end
 if zone~=0 and not Config[zone] then return false end
 local prof=profile(p)
 if not prof then return false end
 prof.BatForced=zone~=0 and zone or nil
 prof.BatEquipped=zone
 M.refresh(p)
 return true
end
function M.knockback(p)
 local cfg=Config[M.equipped(p)]
 local n=cfg and tonumber(cfg.KnockbackMultiplier) or 1
 if not n or n~=n or n==math.huge then return 1 end
 return math.clamp(n,0,10)
end
function M.init()
 if initialized then return end initialized=true
 local watched=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local function bind(p)
  local function watch(root)
   if not root or watched[root] then return end
   watched[root]=true
   root.ChildAdded:Connect(function(t) task.defer(M.apply,p,t) end)
   for _,t in root:GetChildren() do M.apply(p,t) end
  end
  p.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Backpack") then watch(c) end end)
  p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
   watch(ch)
   watch(p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
   local bag=p:WaitForChild("Backpack",30)
   if bag then watch(bag) end
   if p.Character then watch(p.Character) end
   for i=1,120 do if not p.Parent then return end if profile(p) then M.refresh(p) return end task.wait(.5) end
  end)
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do bind(p) end
end
return M

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RARITY = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AnimalRarity"))

local M = {}
M.RARITY = RARITY

local folder = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("EggAssets"):WaitForChild("AnimalEggs")
local rng = Random.new()

function M.tierOf(species)
	return species and RARITY[species] or nil
end

function M.template(species)
	return species and folder:FindFirstChild(species) or nil
end

local function speciesOf(zone)
	local names, seen = {}, {}
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	local set = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. tostring(zone))
	if set then
		for _, m in ipairs(set:GetChildren()) do
			if not seen[m.Name] then seen[m.Name] = true table.insert(names, m.Name) end
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if t:GetAttribute("Zone") == zone and not seen[t.Name] then
			seen[t.Name] = true
			table.insert(names, t.Name)
		end
	end
	return names
end
M.speciesOf = speciesOf

function M.pick(zone, tier)
	local all = speciesOf(zone)
	local list = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(all) do
		if RARITY[name] == tier then table.insert(list, name) end
	end
	if #list == 0 then list = all end
	if #list == 0 then return nil end
	return list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)]
end

function M.legacy(zone, tier, size)
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	local set = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. tostring(zone))
	if not set then return nil end
	local list = set:GetChildren()
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	if #list == 0 then return nil end
	local slot = (tier or 1) >= 3 and 6 + ((tier or 3) - 2) or math.clamp(size or 1, 1, 6)
	return list[((slot - 1) % #list) + 1].Name
end

return M

local Ragdoll = {}

local SWING, TWIST = 42, 26

local function attach(part, cf, name)
    local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
    a.Name = name
    a.CFrame = cf
    a.Parent = part
    return a
end

local function limpLimbs(char, on)
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if on then
                p:SetAttribute("RagdollWasCollide", p.CanCollide)
                p.CanCollide = true
            else
                local was = p:GetAttribute("RagdollWasCollide")
                if was ~= nil then p.CanCollide = was end
                p:SetAttribute("RagdollWasCollide", nil)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Ragdoll.on(char)
    if not char or char:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    char:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", true)

    hum.AutoRotate = false
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    local sockets = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then sockets[d.Name] = true end
    end

    local modern = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d.Enabled and sockets[d.Name .. "BallSocket"] then
            d.Enabled = false
            d:SetAttribute("RagdollOff", true)
            modern += 1
        end
    end

    if modern == 0 then
        for _, m in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part0 and m.Part1 and m.Name ~= "RootJoint" then
                local a0 = attach(m.Part0, m.C0, "RagdollA0")
                local a1 = attach(m.Part1, m.C1, "RagdollA1")
                local joint = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
                joint.Name = "RagdollJoint"
                joint.Attachment0 = a0
                joint.Attachment1 = a1
                joint.LimitsEnabled = true
                joint.UpperAngle = SWING
                joint.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
                joint.TwistLowerAngle = -TWIST
                joint.TwistUpperAngle = TWIST
                joint.Parent = m.Part1
                local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
                tag.Name = "RagdollMotor"
                tag.Value = m
                tag.Parent = joint
                m.Enabled = false
            end
        end
    end

    limpLimbs(char, true)
end

function Ragdoll.off(char)
    if not char or not char:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") then return end
    char:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", false)

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d:GetAttribute("RagdollOff") then
            d.Enabled = true
            d:SetAttribute("RagdollOff", nil)
        end
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and d.Name == "RagdollJoint" then
            local tag = d:FindFirstChild("RagdollMotor")
            if tag and tag.Value then tag.Value.Enabled = true end
            d:Destroy()
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Attachment") and (d.Name == "RagdollA0" or d.Name == "RagdollA1") then
            d:Destroy()
        end
    end

    limpLimbs(char, false)

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.Parent then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
end

return Ragdoll

name: ZoneTools
source:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local BossAnim = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BossAnim"))

local T = {}

local RARITY_NAMES = { "Common", "Uncommon", "Rare", "Legendary" }
local RARITY_WANT = { 4, 2, 1, 1 }
local BY_NAME = { common = 1, uncommon = 2, rare = 3, legendary = 4 }

local function say(...)
	print("[ZoneTools]", ...)
end

local function rarityOf(m)
	local v = m:GetAttribute("Rarity")
	if type(v) == "number" then return math.clamp(math.floor(v), 1, 4) end
	if type(v) == "string" then return BY_NAME[v:lower()] end
	return nil
end

local function hasPart(inst)
	return inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) ~= nil
end

function T.Check()
	local problems = {}
	local function bad(msg) table.insert(problems, msg) end
	local loader = require(ServerStorage.ZoneLoader:Clone())
	local sources, nextFree = loader.sources(bad)
	local speciesZone = {}

	for n, src in ipairs(sources) do
		local label = ("World %d (%s)"):format(n, src.Name)
		local boss = src:FindFirstChild("Boss")
		if not (boss and hasPart(boss)) then
			bad(label .. ": no Boss model yet - the previous world's boss will be used")
		else
			local anims = BossAnim.animations(boss) or {}
			local embedded = BossAnim.embedded(boss) or {}
			for name, k in pairs(embedded) do anims[name] = anims[name] or k end
			if next(anims) == nil then
				bad(label .. ": the Boss has no animations - save Idle, Run, Attack, Sleep, Wake in Animation Editor or add their ids as attributes")
			else
				for _, name in ipairs({ "Idle", "Run", "Attack", "Sleep", "Wake" }) do
					if not anims[name] then bad(label .. ": the Boss has no " .. name .. " animation") end
				end
				if not boss:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true) then
					bad(label .. ": the Boss has animations but no Motor6D joints - rig it first")
				else
					local root = BossAnim.animRoot(boss)
					if boss.PrimaryPart and boss.PrimaryPart ~= root then
						bad(label .. ": the Boss PrimaryPart should be its root part (" .. tostring(root and root.Name) .. ")")
					end
					local links = {}
					local function link(a, b)
						if a and b then
							links[a] = links[a] or {}
							links[b] = links[b] or {}
							table.insert(links[a], b)
							table.insert(links[b], a)
						end
					end
					for _, j in ipairs(boss:GetDescendants()) do
						if j:IsA("JointInstance") then link(j.Part0, j.Part1)
						elseif j:IsA("WeldConstraint") then link(j.Part0, j.Part1) end
					end
					local seen, queue = { [root] = true }, { root }
					while #queue > 0 do
						local p = table.remove(queue)
						for _, q in ipairs(links[p] or {}) do
							if not seen[q] then seen[q] = true table.insert(queue, q) end
						end
					end
					local loose = 0
					for _, p in ipairs(boss:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") and not seen[p] then loose += 1 end
					end
					if loose > 0 then
						bad(("%s: %d Boss parts are not joined to the skeleton - weld them, or they fall through the map"):format(label, loose))
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local animals = src:FindFirstChild("Animals")
		local list = animals and animals:GetChildren() or {}
		local count = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
		for _, m in ipairs(list) do
			if speciesZone[m.Name] then
				bad(("%s: animal name \"%s\" is also used in world %d - every animal needs its own name"):format(label, m.Name, speciesZone[m.Name]))
			end
			speciesZone[m.Name] = n
			if not hasPart(m) then bad(label .. ": " .. m.Name .. " has no parts") end
			local t = rarityOf(m)
			if t then count[t] += 1 else bad(label .. ": " .. m.Name .. " has no Rarity attribute (Common / Uncommon / Rare / Legendary)") end
		end
		if #list == 0 then
			bad(label .. ": no animals in the Animals folder")
		elseif #list ~= 8 then
			bad(("%s: %d animals - the index and the world's bat need exactly 8"):format(label, #list))
		end
		for t = 1, 4 do
			if #list > 0 and count[t] ~= RARITY_WANT[t] then
				bad(("%s: %d %s animals (recommended %d)"):format(label, count[t], RARITY_NAMES[t], RARITY_WANT[t]))
			end
		end
		local eggs = src:FindFirstChild("Eggs")
		for _, e in ipairs(eggs and eggs:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if not (animals and animals:FindFirstChild(e.Name)) then
				bad(label .. ": egg \"" .. e.Name .. "\" has no animal with the same name")
			elseif not hasPart(e) then
				bad(label .. ": egg \"" .. e.Name .. "\" has no parts")
			end
		end
	end

	say(("%d worlds found. A new world gets Zone = %d."):format(#sources, nextFree or (#sources + 1)))
	if #problems == 0 then
		say("Everything looks good.")
	else
		for _, p in ipairs(problems) do warn("[ZoneTools] " .. p) end
		say(("%d thing(s) to fix, see the warnings above."):format(#problems))
	end
	return #problems == 0
end

return T
